local local_class = newclass('BossSalamandraExplodeLavaSingleRaidBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)
	self.teleport_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TeleportDuration', 0.15)
	self.teleport_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TeleportPrepareDuration', 0.5)
	self.explosion_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionDuration', 0.5)
	self.casting_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CastingDuration', 3)

	self.explosion_effect_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionEffectCount', 30)

	self.effect_ignore_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'EffectIgnoreRangeToCenter', 3)
	self.interval_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionEffectIntervalRange', 1)
	self.effect_delay_min = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'EffectDelayMin', 0)
	self.effect_dealy_max = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'EffectDelayMax', 1)

	self.stomp_camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeMagnitude', 0.08)
	self.stomp_camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeDuration', 0.3)

	self.explosion_max_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionMaxCount', 2)
	self.explosion_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionDamageModifier', 1.0)

	self.repeat_casting_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RepeatCastingDuration', 2.0)

	self.range_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RangeOffset', 2.0)
	local knockback_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackRadius', 4.0)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce', 2.0)

	local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(knockback_radius, 1, -1)
	self.knockback_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		teleport_prepare = 3,
		teleport = 4,
		casting = 5,
		prepare = 6,
		explosion = 7,
		post = 8
	}

	self.explosion_dir = {
		left = 1,
		right = 2
	}

	--피격 범위 어택레인지(싱글레이드는 맵 절반, 세팅은 set_battle_zone 에서)
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.teleport_finish = true

	self.random_pos_list = {}
	self.explosion_effect_list = {}
	self.index_list = {}
	self.interval_count_x = 0
	self.interval_count_z = 0

	self.current_explostion_dir = nil
	self.current_explosion_count = 0
	self.explosion_pos = nil

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	if self.attack_range == nil then
		local size = vector(self.zone_bound.size.x / 2, self.zone_bound.size.z)
		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		self.avoid_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(self.zone_bound.size.x / 2 + self.range_offset, self.zone_bound.size.z))
		self.avoid_range:Hide()
	end

	local s = vector(self.zone_bound.size.x / 2, 1, self.zone_bound.size.z)
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(s, 99, -1, false)
	self.explosion_calculator =  CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	-- RiskMap 형성용 가상 어택레인지
	local virtual_range_width = 3
	local virtual_range_num = math.floor(self.avoid_range.Size.x / virtual_range_width) - 1
	self.virtual_ranges = {}
	for i = 1, virtual_range_num do
		local range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, virtual_range_width * i, self.avoid_range.Size.y, 0)
		table.insert(self.virtual_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.random_pos_list ~= nil then
		self.random_pos_list = nil
	end

	if self.explosion_effect_list ~= nil then
		self.explosion_effect_list = nil
	end
	self.explosion_effect_list = {}

	if self.index_list ~= nil then
		self.index_list = nil
	end
	self.index_list = {}

	self.teleport_finish = false
	self.current_casting_duration = 0

	self.current_explostion_dir = nil
	self.current_explosion_count = 0

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.teleport_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.avoid_range))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if next_state ~= self.state.casting then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if self.attack_range ~= nil then
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.avoid_range ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.avoid_range))
		end
		for i = 1, #self.virtual_ranges do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_ranges[i]))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink_start", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink_thunder", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink_end", self.character.Position)

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.casting then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.current_explosion_count == 0 then
			self.current_casting_duration = self.casting_duration
		else
			self.current_casting_duration = self.repeat_casting_duration
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.current_casting_duration))

		--맵 절반 어택레인지 표시
		self.explosion_pos = self:get_explosion_pos()
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.explosion_pos, battle_util.get_height(self.zone_bound.center))
		self.attack_range:Show(self.current_explosion_count)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.avoid_range, self.explosion_pos, battle_util.get_height(self.zone_bound.center))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.avoid_range))

		local range_pos = self.avoid_range.CacheTransform.position
		local virtual_range_dir = (self.current_explostion_dir == self.explosion_dir.left and -1 or 1)
		local initial_x_pos = range_pos.x + virtual_range_dir * self.avoid_range.Size.x / 2
		for i = 1, #self.virtual_ranges do
			local range = self.virtual_ranges[i]
			range_pos.x = initial_x_pos - virtual_range_dir * range.Size.x / 2
			range.Position = range_pos
			range.RotationAngle = self.shoot_clockwise and - range.ArcAngle / 2 or 180 + range.ArcAngle / 2
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("casting")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("casting")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("casting")

		self.current_explosion_count = self.current_explosion_count + 1

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explode")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.explosion_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		stage_camera:Shake(self.stomp_camera_shake_magnitude, self.stomp_camera_shake_duration)
		self:publish_explosion_damage()

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_explosion_effect()
	self.random_pos_list = self:get_radom_pos_list()
	for i = 1, self.explosion_effect_count do
		local delay = unity_class.random.Range(self.effect_delay_min, self.effect_dealy_max)
		local info = {
			pos = self.random_pos_list[i],
			delay_time = delay,
			progress_time = 0,
			is_finish = false
		}

		table.insert(self.explosion_effect_list, info)
	end
end

function local_class:get_radom_pos_list()
	self.index_list = {}
	local target_pos_list = {}
	self.interval_count_x = self.zone_bound.size.x / self.interval_range - 2
	self.interval_count_z = self.zone_bound.size.z / self.interval_range - 2


	local index_count = self.interval_count_x * self.interval_count_z
	if index_count < self.explosion_effect_count then
		index_count = self.explosion_effect_count
	end

	for i = 1, index_count do
		local index = 0
		index = i
		if index > self.interval_count_x * self.interval_count_z then
			index = i % (self.interval_count_x * self.interval_count_z)
		end
		table.insert(self.index_list, index)
	end

	for i = 1, self.explosion_effect_count do
		local index, pos = self:get_random_pos()
		--범위 pos가
		table.insert(target_pos_list, pos)
		table.remove(self.index_list, index)
	end

	return target_pos_list
end

function local_class:get_random_pos()
	local index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.index_list)
	local x_index = self.index_list[index] % self.interval_count_x
	local z_index = math.ceil(self.index_list[index] / self.interval_count_x)
	local pos = vector(self.zone_bound.min.x + self.interval_range + (x_index * self.interval_range),
			0, self.zone_bound.min.z + self.interval_range + (z_index * self.interval_range))

	local diff = self.zone_bound.center - pos
	if math.abs(diff.magnitude) < self.effect_ignore_range then
		table.remove(self.index_list, index)
		index, pos = self:get_random_pos()
	end
	return index, pos
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.zone_bound.center)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
				self:change_state(self.state.casting)
				-- 근접 애들 리스크맵에서 길 못찾는 문제 해결 위해 넉백
				self:publish_teleport_knockback()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_casting_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
			if self.current_explosion_count < self.explosion_max_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.casting)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_explosion_effect(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.explosion_effect_list) do
		if not v.is_finish then
			if v.progress_time > v.delay_time then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", v.pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				v.is_finish = true
			else
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:publish_explosion_damage()
	self.explosion_calculator:Start()
	self.explosion_calculator.Position = self.explosion_pos

	local objects = self.explosion_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.explosion_calculator:End()
end

function local_class:publish_teleport_knockback()
	self.knockback_calculator:Start()
	self.knockback_calculator.Position = self.zone_bound.center

	local objects = self.knockback_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position - self.zone_bound.center).normalized
		if dir == vector_util.zero then
			dir = vector_util.right
		end
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.explosion_calculator:End()
end

function local_class:update_explosion_damage(dt)
	local b = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.explosion_pos, vector(self.zone_bound.size.x / 2, self.zone_bound.size.y, self.zone_bound.size.z))
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(b, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for _, v in pairs(fo_list) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = v
		damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(target_list, target)
	local hit_targets = target_list
	if hit_targets == nil then
		hit_targets = self.hit_target_list
	end
	for _,v in pairs(hit_targets) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_explosion_pos()
	local offset = self.zone_bound.size.x / 4

	if self.current_explostion_dir == nil then
		if self.target.Position.x < self.zone_bound.center.x then
			self.current_explostion_dir = self.explosion_dir.left
			return vector(self.zone_bound.min.x + offset, self.character.Position.y + 0.05, self.zone_bound.center.z)
		else
			self.current_explostion_dir = self.explosion_dir.right
			return vector(self.zone_bound.max.x - offset, self.character.Position.y + 0.05, self.zone_bound.center.z)
		end
	end

	-- 2차는 이전 방향 반대로
	if self.current_explostion_dir == self.explosion_dir.left then
		self.current_explostion_dir = self.explosion_dir.right
		return vector(self.zone_bound.max.x - offset, self.character.Position.y + 0.05, self.zone_bound.center.z)
	else
		self.current_explostion_dir = self.explosion_dir.left
		return vector(self.zone_bound.min.x + offset, self.character.Position.y + 0.05, self.zone_bound.center.z)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.range_light_color = nil
	self.range_dark_color = nil
	self.random_pos_list = nil
	self.explosion_effect_list = nil
	self.index_list = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	if self.virtual_ranges ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.virtual_ranges do
			self.virtual_ranges[i] = nil
		end
	end
	self.virtual_ranges = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.laser_hit_target_list ~= nil then
		self.laser_hit_target_list = nil
	end
	self.laser_hit_target_list = {}
	self.laser_info = {
		is_start = false,
		start_pos = nil,
		dir = nil,
		time_passed = 0,
		effect = nil
	}
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.casting)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end
	self:dispose_laser()

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.prepare then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

		if self.attack_range ~= nil then
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

		self:dispose_laser()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.casting then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.casting_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("casting")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("casting")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("casting")

		self.laser_info.start_pos = self.character.Position + self.laser_offset

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.laser_info.start_pos,
				unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)

		--어택레인지 시작
		self:start_laser_attack_range()

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
		--laser 시작
		self:start_laser()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:start_laser_attack_range()
	--laser attack range 시작
	local dir = (self.target.Position - self.laser_info.start_pos).normalized
	self.laser_info.dir = dir
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.laser_info.start_pos, dir)
	self.attack_range:Show(self.casting_duration)
end

function local_class:update_laser_attack_range(dt)
	--self.target_lock_speed의 속도로 타겟을 추적
	local dir = (self.target.Position - self.laser_info.start_pos).normalized
	local diff = math.abs((dir - self.laser_info.dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.01 then
		local move_dir = (self.laser_info.dir - ((self.laser_info.dir - dir).normalized * dt * 1.2)).normalized
		self.laser_info.dir = move_dir
	end
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.laser_info.start_pos, self.laser_info.dir)
end

function local_class:start_laser()
	--laser이팩트 생성
	self.laser_info.effect = self:create_laser_effect(self.laser_info.start_pos, self.laser_info.dir)
	self.laser_info.effect.transform.localScale = vector(self.laser_distance / self.effect_base_size, 1, 1)
	self.laser_info.is_start = true

	--
	local target_pos = self.laser_info.start_pos + (self.laser_info.dir * self.laser_distance)
	local bound_size = vector(self.laser_width, 1.5, self.laser_width)
	self.laser_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(target_pos, bound_size)
	self.laser_move = vector_util.get_x0z(self.laser_info.start_pos - target_pos)
end

function local_class:update_laser_damage(dt)
	--피격 딜레이 적용
	for i = #self.laser_hit_target_list, 1, -1 do
		self.laser_hit_target_list[i].time_passed = self.laser_hit_target_list[i].time_passed - dt
		if self.laser_hit_target_list[i].time_passed <= 0 then
			table.remove(self.laser_hit_target_list, i)
		end
	end

	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.laser_bounds, self.laser_move)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or
				self:check_hit_target(v) then
		else
			local dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(self.laser_move).normalized
			local target_dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(v.Bounds.center - self.laser_info.start_pos).normalized
			local det = vector_util.cross(dir_xz, target_dir_xz)
			local angle = 110
			if det > 0 then
				angle = -110
			end

			local knockback_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * self.laser_move.normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.laser_damage_modifier
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			table.insert(self.laser_hit_target_list, {
				target = v,
				time_passed = self.laser_damage_term
			})
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:create_laser_effect(start_pos, shoot_dir)
	local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(shoot_dir.z, -shoot_dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
	local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
	local create_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos)
	local laser_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("laser", create_pos,
			vector(0, angle, 0), nil)
	laser_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation
	laser_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)

	return laser_effect
end

function local_class:dispose_laser()
	if self.laser_info ~= nil then
		if self.laser_info.effect ~= nil then
			self.laser_info.effect:Dispose()
			self.laser_info.effect = nil
		end

		self.laser_info = nil
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		if self.time_passed >= self.casting_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		else
			--어택레인지 타겟 추적
			self:update_laser_attack_range(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.laser_info.time_passed > self.laser_duration then
				--지속시간 경과로 종료
			else
				--충돌 업데이트
				self:update_laser_damage(dt)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(target)
	for _,v in pairs(self.laser_hit_target_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent))

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.laser_offset = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.laser_info = nil
	self.laser_hit_target_list = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSandMonsterFuryClusterBombBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4,
	}

	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	-- preapre
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.0)
	self.target_search_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetSearchDuration", 0.0)
	self.target_pos = nil

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1.0)
	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExdplosionRadius', 1.0)
	self.explosion_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionModifier', 0.1);
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce', 0.1);

	self.shoot_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ShootAmount', 8)

	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_circle(self.explosion_radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	local ps = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.character)
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec('magic_shot_earth')
	local pattern_info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_info.columns = 1
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional, ps, spec, pattern_info,
			CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.None)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	self.fx_sand = nil
	self.sfx_sand = nil

	-- 어그로 타겟 변경, 오너만 체크함, 일단 다 구독은 함
	self.on_aggro_change_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent),
			self.on_aggro_change_event_func)

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	info:AppendPosition(target.Position)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	local target_pos = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.target_pos = target_pos
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 싱크 대기
		if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			--- 싱크 트리거 정보 구성
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			--- 라벨 2 => 실제 공격
			trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, 2)
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self.target_pos)

			--- 커맨드 생성
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	if self.current_state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		self:fade_out_sand_sfx()
		self:dispose_sand_eff()
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, self.attack_range)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.target_pos == nil then
			self.target_pos = self.target.Position
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

		self.fx_sand = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('burrow', self.target_pos, vector_util.zero)

		self.sfx_sand = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('burrow')

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos, self.target_pos.y)
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif new_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack')

	elseif new_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.current_state = new_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:publish_damage(target_pos)
	if target_pos == nil then
		return
	end

	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(target_pos, self.explosion_radius)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - target_pos).normalized
			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_modifier
			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.convertAttackTo = CS.Oak.ElementalType.Earth
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			damage_info.hitEffect = CS.Oak.BasicMeHitEffect.Create(fo.Bounds.center)
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()

	-- 폭발 연출
	local eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('unburrow', self.target_pos, vector_util.zero)
	eff.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * 0.5
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion')
end

function local_class:shoot_proj(shoot_pos)
	local pos = shoot_pos + vector_util.up * 0.3
	for i = 0, self.shoot_amount do
		local shoot_dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.shoot_amount, 0) * vector_util.forward).normalized
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(pos, shoot_dir, 0, 0, nil, false)
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if not trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) or not trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) then
		return
	end

	local label = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)

	if label == 1 then
		local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
		self:sync_target_pos(target, target_pos)
	elseif label == 2 then
		local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self:publish_damage(shoot_pos)
		self:shoot_proj(shoot_pos)
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end
end

function local_class:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
		return
	end
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare and self.time_passed < self.target_search_duration then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Subject) and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.Target) then
			self:publish_change_target_pos(e.Target)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:publish_change_target_pos(target)
	--- 싱크 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	--- 라벨 1 => 타겟 위치 변경
	self.target = target
	local new_target_pos = self.target.Position
	trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, 1)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, new_target_pos)
	trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, self.target)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
end

function local_class:sync_target_pos(target, target_pos)
	self.target = target
	self.target_pos = target_pos
	effect_util.update_object(self.fx_sand, self.target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos, self.target_pos.y)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)

	--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
	if self.show_target_arrow then
		coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
	end
end

function local_class:fade_out_sand_sfx()
	if self.sfx_sand == nil then
		return
	end

	self.sfx_sand:FadeOut(0.25)
	self.sfx_sand = nil
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose_sand_eff()
	if self.fx_sand == nil then
		return
	end

	self.fx_sand:Dispose()
	self.fx_sand = nil
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:fade_out_sand_sfx()
	self:dispose_sand_eff()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSandMonsterFuryClutchBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state =
	{
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.storm_state = {
		none = 1,
		preapre = 2,
		attack = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.0)
	self.init_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InitRadius', 1.6)
	self.dust_eff_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DustEffTerm', 0.25)
	self.dust_remain_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DustRemainTime', 0.0)
	self.dust_fade_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DustFadeTime', 0.25)
	self.target_search_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetSearchDuration", 0.0)

	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_circle(self.init_radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.667)
	self.storm_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'StormAmount', 6)
	self.storm_scale = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormScale', 0.55)

	local ps = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.character)
	local projectile_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Projectile', 'coop_exp_boss_sand_proj')
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(projectile_name)
	local pattern_info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_info.columns = 1
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional, ps, spec, pattern_info,
			CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.None, 0)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	self.projectile_penetrate_character = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectilePenetrateCharacter', false)

	self.sfx_dust = nil
	self.dust_time_passed = 0

	self.on_aggro_change_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent),
			self.on_aggro_change_event_func)

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local random_escape_dir = self:get_escape_direction()
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	info:AppendDirection(random_escape_dir)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target

	local escape_dir = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.escape_direction = escape_dir

	if self.running_dust_eff_list ~= nil then
		for i = #self.running_dust_eff_list, 1, -1 do
			local v = self.running_dust_eff_list[i]
			v.effect:Dispose()
		end
	end
	self.running_dust_eff_list = { }

	-- 원둘레에 생성될 이펙트의 상대 위치를 미리 계산한다, 탈출 위치는 항상 첫번째
	self.dust_eff_pos_diffs = { }
	local amount = self.storm_amount + 1
	local angle = 360 / amount
	for i = 0, amount - 1 do
		local add_angle = angle * i
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, add_angle, 0) * self.escape_direction
		local pos_diff = dir * self.init_radius
		table.insert(self.dust_eff_pos_diffs, pos_diff)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	if self.current_state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.sfx_dust ~= nil then
			self.sfx_dust:FadeOut(0.5)
			self.sfx_dust = nil
		end

		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.target_locked = false
		self.target_pos = nil

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

		self.sfx_dust = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('dust')

		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
		self:update_tracking(0)
		self.dust_time_passed = 0

	elseif new_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif new_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.sfx_dust ~= nil then
			self.sfx_dust:FadeOut(0.5)
			self.sfx_dust = nil
		end
	end

	self.current_state = new_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:change_storm_state(data, new_state)
	if data.current_state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if data.current_state == self.storm_state.preapre then
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, self.attack_range)
	elseif data.current_state == self.storm_state.attack then
	elseif data.current_state == self.storm_state.post then
	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.storm_state.preapre then
	elseif new_state == self.storm_state.attack then
	elseif new_state == self.storm_state.post then
	end

	data.current_state = new_state
	data.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_dust_eff(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 싱크 완료 대기중 계속 이펙트를 업데이트함
		self:update_tracking(dt)
		self:spawn_dust_eff(dt)

		-- 싱크 대기
		if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			--- 싱크 트리거 정보 구성
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			--- 라벨 2 => 실제 공격
			trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, 2)
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self:get_target_pos())

			--- 커맨드 생성
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
		elseif not self.target_locked and self.time_passed >= self.target_search_duration then
			--- 싱크 트리거 정보 구성
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			--- 라벨 1 => 타겟 싱크
			trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, 1)
			trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, self.target)

			--- 커맨드 생성
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_target_pos()
	if self.target_pos == nil then
		return self.target.Position
	end
	return self.target_pos
end

function local_class:update_tracking(dt)
	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	local target_pos = self:get_target_pos()
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, target_pos, target_pos.y)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)
end

function local_class:update_dust_eff(dt)
	if self.running_dust_eff_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = #self.running_dust_eff_list, 1, -1 do
		local v = self.running_dust_eff_list[i]
		v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt

		if v.time_passed >= self.dust_remain_time + self.dust_fade_time then
			v.effect:Dispose()
			table.remove(self.running_dust_eff_list, i)

		elseif v.time_passed >= self.dust_remain_time and v.time_passed < self.dust_fade_time then
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				local prog = 1 - (v.time_passed / self.dust_fade_time);
				v.effect.transform.localScale = prog * vector_util.one
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:spawn_dust_eff(dt)
	self.dust_time_passed = self.dust_time_passed + dt

	if self.dust_time_passed >= self.dust_eff_term then
		self.dust_time_passed = self.dust_time_passed - self.dust_eff_term

		-- 이펙트를 계속 껐다 켰다 하는데 이유는 잘 모르지만 이전 액션들에서 다 이렇게 하고 있음
		for _, v in pairs(self.dust_eff_pos_diffs) do
			local pos = self:get_target_pos() + v
			local eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('dust', pos, vector_util.zero)
			table.insert(self.running_dust_eff_list, { time_passed = 0, effect = eff })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_storm()
	local target_pos = self:get_target_pos()
	for i = 2, #self.dust_eff_pos_diffs do
		local v = self.dust_eff_pos_diffs[i]
		local init_pos = target_pos + v

		local unburrow_eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('unburrow', init_pos, vector_util.zero)
		unburrow_eff.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * self.storm_scale

		local shoot_dir = - v
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(init_pos, shoot_dir, i, 0, nil, false)
	end
end

function local_class:get_escape_direction()
	local idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
	if idx == 1 then
		return vector_util.right
	elseif idx == 2 then
		return vector_util.back
	elseif idx == 3 then
		return vector_util.left
	else
		return vector_util.forward
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if not trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) then
		return
	end

	local label = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)

	-- 타겟 고정
	if label == 1 then
		self.target_locked = true
		local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
		self.target = target
		self:on_target_changed()
	-- 공격 시작
	elseif label == 2 then
		-- target_pos 싱크 및 고정
		local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self.target_pos = shoot_pos
		self:shoot_storm()
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end
end

function local_class:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	if self.target_locked then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare and self.time_passed < self.target_search_duration then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Subject) and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.Target) then
			self.target = e.Target
			self:on_target_changed()
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_target_changed()
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position, self.target.Position.y)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)
	--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
	if self.show_target_arrow then
		coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	local target = hit_info.target

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end

	if hit_info.hitType ~= CS.Oak.Projectile.HitType.FieldObject then
		return true
	end

	local target_crash_behaviour_type = target.CrashBehaviour:GetType()

	-- 벽과 문은은 관통하게
	if target_crash_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) or
			target_crash_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.OneWayGateCrashBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil and not is_unity_null(target) then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	-- 투사체 쉴드 체크 하지 않으면 무조건 true 반환
	if not self.projectile_penetrate_character then
		return true
	end

	return target_crash_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ProjectileShieldCrashBehaviour)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	if self.sfx_dust ~= nil then
		self.sfx_dust:FadeOut(0.5)
		self.sfx_dust = nil
	end

	self.dust_eff_pos_diffs = nil
	self.running_dust_eff_list = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSandMonsterCoExpFleeBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	local stat = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour
	local move_speed = stat.DashSpeed
	self.flee_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Speed", move_speed)
	self.flee_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FleeRange', 3.0)
	self.flee_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FleeDistance', 5.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 0.1)

	self.fx_dust_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Trap_Sandmonster_Ready')
	self.dust_key = 'dust'

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		flee = 2,
		post = 3
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

function local_class:get_flee_pos()
	local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if target_list == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local target_poses = { }
	for _, v in pairs(target_list) do
		if v ~= nil then
			local sqr_dist = self.character.Position:SqrDistance(v.Position)
			if sqr_dist <= self.flee_distance * self.flee_range then
				table.insert(target_poses, v.Position)
			end
		end
	end

	local flee_pos = self:search_flee_pos(target_poses)
	target_list:Dispose()

	if flee_pos == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(flee_pos - self.character.Position)
	self.flee_direction = diff.normalized
	self.flee_duration = diff.magnitude / self.flee_speed

	return flee_pos
end

function local_class:search_flee_pos(pos_list)
	local flee_dist = self.flee_distance
	local flee_dir, free_dist = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetBestEtherealFleeDirection(
			self.character, pos_list, self.flee_range, self.flee_distance)

	if vector_util.is_almost_zero(flee_dir) or math.abs(free_dist) < 0.0001 then
		return nil
	end

	local actual_move_dist = math.min(flee_dist, free_dist)
	local dest_pos = self.character.Position + flee_dir * actual_move_dist

	if field:IsThereFloorAt(dest_pos) == false then
		return nil
	end

	return dest_pos
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local flee_pos = self:get_flee_pos()
	if flee_pos == nil then
		return false
	end

	--- 싱크 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self.character.Position)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.flee_direction)
	trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, self.flee_duration)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(
			self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, sync_info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.start_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	self.flee_direction = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	self.flee_duration = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)
	self:change_state(self.state.flee)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.flee then
		if self.fx_dust ~= nil then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_dust)
			self.fx_dust = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	if next_state == self.state.flee then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Position = self.start_pos
		self.fx_dust = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.dust_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.dist_remain = self.flee_duration * self.flee_speed
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.flee then
		local magnitude = math.min(self.flee_speed * dt, self.dist_remain)
		if magnitude > 0 then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.flee_direction
			move_info.magnitude = magnitude

			self.dist_remain = self.dist_remain - magnitude

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, CS.Oak.Direction.Down, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.Move)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_dust, self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
		end

		if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.flee_duration then
			--- 싱크 트리거 정보 구성
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self.character.Position)
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if not trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end
	local position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	self.character.Position = position
	self:change_state(self.state.post)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
		return false
	end

	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) and self.current_state == self.state.flee then
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self.character.Position)
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_dust) then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_dust)
		self.fx_dust = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.flee_direction = nil

	self.unburrow_knock_back_factor = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'UnburrowKnockBackFactor', CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorNormalStrong)

	self.shoot_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootTerm", 1)

	self.state = {

		prepare = 2,
		burrow = 3,
		flee = 4,
		unburrow = 5,
		cast = 6,
		action = 7,
		post = 8
	}

function local_class:is_loaded()

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

function local_class:trigger()

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local dir_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, dir_index)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.zone_bound.center)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.zone_bound.size)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true

function local_class:start(info)
	local zone_center = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	local zone_size = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)
	local bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(zone_center, zone_size)

	self:init_zone_bound(bound)

	local dir_index = info:GetIntegerAt(0)
	self.flee_position = self.flee_position_list[dir_index]

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:init_zone_bound(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(bound.size.x - self.safe_area_width, bound.size.z), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	if #self.flee_position_list == 0 then
		local height = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.zone_bound.center):GetHeightAt(self.zone_bound.center)
		table.insert(self.flee_position_list, unity_class.vector3(bound.min.x + 1, height, bound.center.z))
		table.insert(self.flee_position_list, unity_class.vector3(bound.max.x - 1, height, bound.center.z))
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	if self.current_state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		if self.fx_dust ~= nil then
			self.fx_dust:Dispose()
			self.fx_dust = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.flee then

		if self.sfx_sinksand ~= nil then
			self.sfx_sinksand:FadeOut(1.3);
			self.sfx_sinksand = nil
		end

		if new_state ~= self.state.unburrow then
			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.unburrow then
		if self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour == CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance then
			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

		if new_state == self.state.action then
			if not is_unity_null(self.casting_eff) then
				self.casting_eff.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
			end
		else
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
			if not is_unity_null(self.casting_eff) then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.casting_eff)
			end
			self.casting_eff = nil

			if self.sfx_storm then
				self.sfx_storm:FadeOut(2)
			end
			self.sfx_storm = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		if not is_unity_null(self.casting_eff) then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.casting_eff)
		end
		self.casting_eff = nil

		if self.sfx_storm then
			self.sfx_storm:FadeOut(2)
		end
		self.sfx_storm = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif new_state == self.state.burrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('burrow')
		self.fx_dust = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('dust', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('burrow')

	elseif new_state == self.state.flee then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.sfx_sinksand = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('sinksand')

		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.flee_position - self.character.Position)
		self.flee_duration = diff.magnitude / self.move_speed
		self.flee_direction = diff.normalized

		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterIgnoreDamagedBehaviour.Create()
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	elseif new_state == self.state.unburrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('unburrow')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('unburrow', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('unburrow')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('unburrow2')

		-- 넉백
		self.shoot_dir = self.zone_bound.center.x > self.flee_position.x and unity_class.vector3.right or unity_class.vector3.left
		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.modifier = self.unburrow_damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = self.shoot_dir
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.unburrow_knock_back_factor
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = self.shoot_dir
		damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.unburrow_knock_back_force

		local battle = battle_manager_util.get_battle_for(self.character)
		local allies = battle.Allies
		for i = 0, allies.Count - 1 do repeat
			local ally = allies[i].Character
			if is_unity_null(ally) then
				break
			end
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, ally) and self.zone_bound:Contains(ally.Bounds.center) then
				damage_info.target = ally
				command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
			end
		until true end

	elseif new_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.shoot_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

		local init_pos = self.character.Position + 1 * self.shoot_dir
		self.casting_eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('storm', init_pos, vector_util.zero)
		self.casting_eff.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * self.init_scale

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')
		self.sfx_storm = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('storm')

		local range_pos = self.zone_bound.center + (self.safe_area_width - self.zone_bound.extents.x) * self.shoot_dir
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, range_pos, self.shoot_dir, self.character.Position.y)
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.cast_duration)

	elseif new_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.shoot_time = 0
		self.shoot_count = 0

		local div = (self.zone_bound.size.z - self.projectile_width) / self.projectile_gap
		self.projectile_align_count = math.floor(div + 0.5 + constants.epsilon) + 1
		local remain = div - self.projectile_align_count + 1
		if math.abs(remain) < constants.epsilon then
			remain = 0
		end
		self.projectile_initial_z_pos = self.zone_bound.max.z - (self.projectile_width + remain) * 0.5

	elseif new_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.attack_range then
			battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		end
	end

	self.current_state = new_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end


function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.burrow)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		if self.time_passed >= self.burrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.flee)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.flee then
		self:update_move(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.flee_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.unburrow)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.unburrow then
		if self.time_passed >= self.unburrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self:update_cast(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.shoot_count < self.shoot_amount and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_time then
			self:shoot()
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.flee_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.move_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, CS.Oak.Direction.Down, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

function local_class:update_cast(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, self.init_scale, 1, self.cast_duration - 0.1)
	progress = math.min(1, progress)
	self.casting_eff.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * progress
end

function local_class:shoot()
	self.shoot_time = self.shoot_time + self.shoot_term
	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1

	for i = 0, self.projectile_align_count - 1 do
		local shoot_x_pos = self.shoot_dir.x > 0 and
				self.zone_bound.min.x + self.safe_area_width + self.projectile_width or
				self.zone_bound.max.x - self.safe_area_width - self.projectile_width
		local shoot_z_pos = self.projectile_initial_z_pos - self.projectile_gap * i - constants.epsilon
		local shoot_pos = unity_class.vector3(shoot_x_pos, self.character.Position.y, shoot_z_pos)
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, self.shoot_dir, 100 * self.shoot_count + i + 1, 0, nil, false)
	end
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot')
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	local marker_0_pos = field:HasMarker('boss_storm_0') and field:GetMarker('boss_storm_0').position or nil
	local marker_1_pos = field:HasMarker('boss_storm_1') and field:GetMarker('boss_storm_1').position or nil
	self.flee_position_list = { }
	if marker_0_pos ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.flee_position_list, marker_0_pos)
	end
	if marker_1_pos ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.flee_position_list, marker_1_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	local target = hit_info.target

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end

	if hit_info.hitType ~= CS.Oak.Projectile.HitType.FieldObject then
		return true
	end

	local target_crash_behaviour_type = target.CrashBehaviour:GetType()

	-- 벽과 문은은 관통하게
	if target_crash_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) or
			target_crash_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.OneWayGateCrashBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	-- 투사체 쉴드 체크 하지 않으면 무조건 true 반환
	if not self.projectile_penetrate_character then
		return true
	end

	return target_crash_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ProjectileShieldCrashBehaviour)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.flee_position_list = nil
end

-- zone_bound의 너비가 너무 작지 않음을 가정함
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		--디폴트 무기 설정
		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id)
			local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end

		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id)
			local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end
		stage.CharacterManager:RegisterCharacterByName(monster)

		coroutine.yield(monster:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())
		table.insert(self.tentacle_holder, monster)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	self.spawn_marker_list = {}
	local marker_index = 0
	local base_str = 'spawn_marker_'
	while(true) do
		marker_index = marker_index + 1
		local marker_name = base_str .. marker_index
		if not field:HasMarker(marker_name) then
			break
		end
		local spawn_pos = field:GetMarker(marker_name).position
		self.spawn_marker_list[marker_index] = {pos = spawn_pos}
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.routine_load_monster, self))
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if e == nil or e.FieldObject == nil or self.character == nil then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character) then
		for _, v in pairs(self.tentacle_holder) do
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(v) * 10
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end

		for _, v in pairs(self.act_tentacle_holder) do
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(v) * 10
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_normal_dying_end_event(e)
	if e.character.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy3 and
			e.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.Id == self.tentacle_id then
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = e.character
		heal_info.heal = e.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		e.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.down * 100
		e.character.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		self:push_tentacle(e.character)
	end
end

function local_class:summon_tentacle()
	if self.tentacle_holder == nil then
		return
	end

	local tentacle = self:pop_tentacle()
	if tentacle == nil then
		return
	end

	local pos_index = -1
	for i, v in pairs(self.spawn_marker_list) do
		if v.tentacle == nil then
			pos_index = i
			break
		end
	end
	if pos_index == -1 then
		return
	end

	local battle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
	if battle == nil then
		return
	end

	self.spawn_marker_list[pos_index].tentacle = tentacle
	tentacle.Position = self.spawn_marker_list[pos_index].pos
	battle:AddEnemy(tentacle)

	tentacle.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	tentacle.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
	tentacle.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.down * 100

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(tentacle, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
	message_system:Send(tentacle.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(v, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
end

function local_class:pop_tentacle()
	if #self.tentacle_holder > 0 then
		local tentacle = table.remove(self.tentacle_holder, 1)
		table.insert(self.act_tentacle_holder, tentacle)
		return tentacle
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:push_tentacle(tentacle)
	for i = #self.act_tentacle_holder, 1, -1 do
		local v = self.act_tentacle_holder[i]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, tentacle) then
			table.remove(self.act_tentacle_holder, i)
			break
		end
	end

	for i, v in pairs(self.spawn_marker_list) do
		if v.tentacle ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(v.tentacle, tentacle) then
			self.spawn_marker_list[i].tentacle = nil
			break
		end
	end

	table.insert(self.tentacle_holder, tentacle)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destroyed_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_normal_dying_end_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.NormalDyingEndEvent), self.on_normal_dying_end_event_func)
		self.on_normal_dying_end_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.tentacle_holder = nil
	self.act_tentacle_holder = nil
	self.spawn_marker_list = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
