local local_class = newclass('BossSandMonsterFuryAreaShockWaveBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		tracking = 2,
		prepare = 3,
		action = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	-- trakcing
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TrackingDuration', 2.0)
	self.tracking_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TrackingSpeed', 7.0)
	self.tracking_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TrackingRadius', 2.0)

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.0)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.2)
	self.damage_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageRadius', 2.0)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1.0)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce', 0.0)
	self.effect_scale =CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'EffectScale', 1.6)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.damage_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	local info = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = vector_util.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Radius = self.damage_radius
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	self.fx_dust = nil
	self.sfx_dust = nil

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
end

function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	if self.current_state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		if self.fx_dust ~= nil then
			self.fx_dust:Dispose()
			self.fx_dust = nil
		end

		if self.sfx_dust ~= nil then
			self.sfx_dust:FadeOut(0.25)
			self.sfx_dust = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.state.tracking then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.fx_dust = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('dust', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
		self.sfx_dust = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('dust')

	elseif new_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.character.Position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)

	elseif new_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack')

		local eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('shockwave', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
		eff.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * self.effect_scale

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shockwave')

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

	elseif new_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.fx_dust ~= nil then
			self.fx_dust:Dispsoe()
			self.fx_dust = nil
		end

		if self.sfx_sand ~= nil then
			self.sfx_sand:FadeOut(0.25)
			self.sfx_sand = nil
		end
	end

	self.current_state = new_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end


function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration or self:update_trakcing(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:publish_damage(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_trakcing(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	move_info.direction = dir
	move_info.magnitude = self.tracking_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(dir), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	if self.fx_dust ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_dust, self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
	end

	local is_close = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude <= self.tracking_radius
	return is_close
end

function local_class:publish_damage(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
			dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
		end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = direction
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
		damage_info.hitEffect = CS.Oak.BasicMeHitEffect.Create(fo.Bounds.center)
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state =
	{
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.storm_state = {
		none = 1,
		preapre = 2,
		attack = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.0)
	self.init_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InitRadius', 1.6)
	self.dust_eff_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DustEffTerm', 0.25)
	self.dust_remain_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DustRemainTime', 0.25)
	self.dust_fade_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DustFadeTime', 0.25)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.init_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.dust_time_passed = 0
	-- 원둘레에 생성될 이펙트의 상대 위치를 미리 계산한다.
	self.dust_eff_pos_diffs = { }
	local amount = 8
	local angle = 360 / amount
	for i = 0, amount do
		local add_angle = angle * i
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, add_angle, 0) * vector_util.forward
		local pos_diff = dir * self.init_radius
		table.insert(self.dust_eff_pos_diffs, pos_diff)
	end
	self.running_dust_eff_list = { }

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.667)
	self.storm_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormDelay', 1.2)
	self.storm_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormDistance', 3.8)
	self.storm_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormSpeed', 2.6)
	self.storm_duration = self.storm_distance / self.storm_speed
	self.storm_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'StormAmount', 6)
	self.storm_post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormPostDuration', 0.5)

	self.storm_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormRadius', 0.55)
	self.storm_scale = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StormScale', 0.55)

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1.0)
	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 0.5)

	self.calc_holder = { }
	for _ = 1, self.storm_amount do
		self:push_calc(self:make_calc())
	end

	self.storm_holder = { }
	self.escape_direction = nil

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	self.sfx_dust = nil

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	if self.current_state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.sfx_dust ~= nil then
			self.sfx_dust:FadeOut(0.5)
			self.sfx_dust = nil
		end

		self.attack_range:Hide()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

		self.sfx_dust = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('dust')

		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		self:update_trakcing(0)
		self.dust_time_passed = 0

	elseif new_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:create_storm()

	elseif new_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.sfx_dust ~= nil then
			self.sfx_dust:FadeOut(0.5)
			self.sfx_dust = nil
		end
	end

	self.current_state = new_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:change_storm_state(data, new_state)
	if data.current_state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if data.current_state == self.storm_state.preapre then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	elseif data.current_state == self.storm_state.attack then
	elseif data.current_state == self.storm_state.post then
	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.storm_state.preapre then
	elseif new_state == self.storm_state.attack then
	elseif new_state == self.storm_state.post then
	end

	data.current_state = new_state
	data.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_dust_eff(dt)
	self:update_storm(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:update_trakcing(dt)
		self:spawn_dust_eff(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_trakcing(dt)
	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_dust_eff(dt)
	if self.running_dust_eff_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = #self.running_dust_eff_list, 1, -1 do
		local v = self.running_dust_eff_list[i]
		v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt

		if v.time_passed >= self.dust_remain_time + self.dust_fade_time then
			v.effect:Dispose()
			table.remove(self.running_dust_eff_list, i)

		elseif v.time_passed >= self.dust_remain_time and v.time_passed < self.dust_fade_time then
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				local prog = 1 - (v.time_passed / self.dust_fade_time);
				v.effect.transform.localScale = prog * vector_util.one
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_storm(dt)
	for i = #self.storm_holder, 1, -1 do
		local data = self.storm_holder[i]
		data.time_passed = data.time_passed + dt

		if data.current_state == self.storm_state.preapre then
			self:publish_storm_damage(data, dt)

			if data.time_passed >= self.storm_delay then
				self:change_storm_state(data, self.storm_state.attack)
			end

		elseif data.current_state == self.storm_state.attack then
			self:update_storm_move(data, dt)
			self:publish_storm_damage(data, dt)

			if data.time_passed >= self.storm_duration then
				self:change_storm_state(data, self.storm_state.post)
			end

		elseif data.current_state == self.storm_state.post then
			self:publish_storm_damage(data, dt)

			if data.time_passed >= self.storm_post_duration then
				self:dispose_storm(data)
				table.remove(self.storm_holder, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_storm_move(data, dt)
	local prog = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(data.time_passed, 0, 1, self.storm_duration)
	local storm_eff = data.effect
	local dir = data.direction
	local t_pos = data.target_pos
	local calc = data.calc

	local calc_pos = t_pos + dir * (self.init_radius - prog * self.storm_distance)
	storm_eff.transform.position = calc_pos

	calc.Position = calc_pos
end

function local_class:publish_storm_damage(data, dt)
	local calc = data.calc
	local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - calc.Position).normalized
		if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
			dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
		end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = dir
		damage_info.convertAttackTo = CS.Oak.ElementalType.Earth
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
		damage_info.hitEffect = CS.Oak.BasicMeHitEffect.Create(fo.Bounds.center)
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:spawn_dust_eff(dt)
	self.dust_time_passed = self.dust_time_passed + dt

	if self.dust_time_passed >= self.dust_eff_term then
		self.dust_time_passed = self.dust_time_passed - self.dust_eff_term

		for _, v in pairs(self.dust_eff_pos_diffs) do
			local pos = self.target.Position + v
			local eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('dust', pos, vector_util.zero)
			table.insert(self.running_dust_eff_list, { time_passed = 0, effect = eff })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_storm()
	self:set_escape_direction()
	local unit_angle = 360 / (self.storm_amount + 1)

	for i = 0, self.storm_amount - 1 do
		local add_angle = unit_angle * (i + 1)
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, add_angle, 0) * self.escape_direction
		local init_pos = self.target.Position + dir * self.init_radius
		local storm_eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('storm', init_pos, vector_util.zero)
		storm_eff.transform.position = init_pos
		storm_eff.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * self.storm_scale

		local unburrow_eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('unburrow', init_pos, vector_util.zero)
		unburrow_eff.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * self.storm_scale

		local calc = self:pop_calc()
		calc.Position = init_pos
		calc:Start()

		local data = {
			time_passed = 0,
			current_state = self.storm_state.none,
			target_pos = self.target.Position,
			direction = dir,
			init_pos = init_pos,
			effect = storm_eff,
			calc = calc
		}

		self:change_storm_state(data, self.storm_state.preapre)
		table.insert(self.storm_holder, data)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_storm(data)
	if data.effect ~= nil then
		data.effect:Dispose()
		data.effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:set_escape_direction()
	local idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
	if idx == 1 then
		self.escape_direction = vector_util.right
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.escape_direction = vector_util.back
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.escape_direction = vector_util.left
	else
		self.escape_direction = vector_util.forward
	end
end

function local_class:make_calc()
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = vector_util.zero
	info.DamageTerm = self.damage_term
	info.Duration = self.storm_delay + self.storm_distance / self.storm_speed + self.storm_post_duration
	info.Radius = self.storm_radius
	info.Height = self.character.Bounds.size.y

	return CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
end

function local_class:pop_calc()
	if #self.calc_holder > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.calc_holder, 1)
	end

	return self:make_calc()
end

function local_class:push_calc(calc)
	calc:End()
	table.insert(self.calc_holder, calc)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	if self.sfx_dust ~= nil then
		self.sfx_dust:FadeOut(0.5)
		self.sfx_dust = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSandMonsterFuryTentacleLoaderBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.tentacle_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'TentacleId', 104410)
	self.tentacle_load_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'TentacleLoadAmount', 5)
	self.tentacle_holder = nil

	self.tentacle_level = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Level

	self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_stage_loaded_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:get_tentacle_holder()
	return self.tentacle_holder
end

function local_class:routine_load_monster()
	self.tentacle_holder = {}

	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, self.tentacle_level)

	for i = 1, self.tentacle_load_amount do
		local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('Characters'):GetSpec(self.tentacle_id)
		if spec == nil then
			print('### CANT FIND MONSTER SPEC!!! ID = ' .. self.tentacle_id)
			break
		end

		local loader = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(spec)
		coroutine.yield(loader)
		local monster = loader.Character
		if monster == nil then
			print('### CANT FIND Character!!! ID = ' .. self.tentacle_id)
			break
		end

		monster.Name = spec.Name == nil and 'boss_sandmonster_tentacle_'.. i or spec.Name .. '_' .. i
		monster.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy3
		monster.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour();
		monster.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController('battle', CS.Oak.PatrolAI.Watch)
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = 'battle2'
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.EventGroupName = 'battle2'
		monster.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		monster.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(CS.Oak.DeathType.Disppear)
		monster.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.SmallExplosion
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:AddExp(exp)
		monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
		monster.Position = vector(999, 0 , 999)
		monster.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.down * 100
		monster.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
		CS.Oak.NetworkEntityManager.Instance:RegisterEntity(monster)
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'disabled')
		local changed_weapon = false
		--디폴트 무기 설정
		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id)
			local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end

		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id)
			local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end
		stage.CharacterManager:RegisterCharacterByName(monster)

		coroutine.yield(monster:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())
		table.insert(self.tentacle_holder, monster)
	end
end

function local_class:get_tentacle_id()
	return self.tentacle_id
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.routine_load_monster, self))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSandMonsterFuryTentacleSwingBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.5)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('action')
	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackRadius', 3.0)
	local delay_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDelayRatio', 0.2)
	self.attack_sfx_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackSfxRatio', 0.2)
	local attack_duration = self.action_duration - (self.action_duration * delay_ratio)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce', 1.0)

	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Radius = self.attack_radius
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, self.action_duration * delay_ratio)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 0.6)

	self.run_swing_sfx = false

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.attack_radius
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.attack_calculator:End()

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')

		self.target_dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.character.Position)
		self.attack_range:Show(0)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir_vector
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.run_swing_sfx = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:update_action(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration * self.attack_sfx_ratio and self.run_swing_sfx == false then
			self.run_swing_sfx = true
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('swing')
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_action(dt)
	-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) and self:is_hittable(fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

end

function local_class:start(info)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.fx_dust ~= nil then
			self.fx_dust:Dispose()
			self.fx_dust = nil
		end

		self.attack_range:Hide()

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.unburrow then
		self.damage_calc:End()
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.zero

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.down * self.burrow_height

		self.fx_dust = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('dust', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.character.Position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	elseif next_state == self.state.unburrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('unburrow', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)

		self.damage_calc.Position = self.character.Position
		self.damage_calc:Start()

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.zero
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.unburrow)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.unburrow then
		self:update_unburrow(dt)
		self:publish_damage(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.unburrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_unburrow(dt)
	local prog = 1 - CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutQuint(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.unburrow_duration)
	self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = self.burrow_height * prog * vector_util.down
end

function local_class:publish_damage(dt)
	local calc = self.damage_calc
	local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - calc.Position).normalized
		if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
			dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
		end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = dir
		damage_info.convertAttackTo = CS.Oak.ElementalType.Earth
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	if self.fx_dust ~= nil then
		self.fx_dust:Dispose()
		self.fx_dust = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	end

		end

			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.down * self.burrow_height
		else
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.zero
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.flee then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		if self.sfx_sinksand ~= nil then
			self.sfx_sinksand:FadeOut(1.3);
			self.sfx_sinksand = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.unburrow then
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.zero

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')

		self.current_repeat = 0

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif new_state == self.state.burrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('burrow')
		self.fx_dust = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('dust', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('burrow')

	elseif new_state == self.state.flee then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.sfx_sinksand = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('sinksand')

		self.flee_position = self:get_flee_pos()
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.flee_position - self.character.Position)
		self.flee_duration = diff.magnitude / self.move_speed
		self.flee_direction = diff.normalized

		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterIgnoreDamagedBehaviour.Create()
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('unburrow')

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('burrow')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('scream')

	elseif new_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

		self.shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position).normalized

		self:create_storm()

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')
		self.sfx_storm = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('storm')

	elseif new_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:create_storm()

	elseif new_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.attack_range:Hide()

	end

	self.current_state = new_state
	self.time_passed = 0

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_storm(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.burrow)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		self:update_burrow(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.burrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.flee)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.flee then
		self:update_move(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.flee_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.unburrow)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.unburrow then
		self:update_unburrow(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.unburrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:change_state(self.state.interval)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			if self.current_repeat < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.action)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.flee_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.move_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, CS.Oak.Direction.Down, false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

function local_class:update_burrow(dt)
	local prog = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.burrow_duration)
	self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = self.burrow_height * prog * vector_util.down
end

function local_class:update_unburrow(dt)
	local prog = 1 - CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.unburrow_duration)
	self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = self.burrow_height * prog * vector_util.down
end

function local_class:update_storm(dt)
	if self.storm_holder == nil or #self.storm_holder == 0 then
		if self.sfx_storm ~= nil then
			self.sfx_storm:FadeOut(0.5)
			self.sfx_storm = nil
		end
		return
	end

	for i = #self.storm_holder, 1, -1 do
		local data = self.storm_holder[i]
		data.time_passed = data.time_passed + dt
		local prog = (data.time_passed - data.hold_time) / self.duration

		if data.time_passed > data.hold_time then
			local wave = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(data.wave_dir, vector_util.up)
					* data.dir * math.sin(self.wave_frequency * math.pi * prog)
			local calc_pos = data.start_pos + data.dir * (self.init_distance + prog * self.distance) + wave

			data.effect.transform.position = calc_pos
			data.calc.Position = calc_pos

			data.vr.Position = calc_pos
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, data.vr))
		end

		local objects = data.calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - data.calc.Position).normalized
			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce + 5000
			damage_info.hitEffect = CS.Oak.BasicMeHitEffect.Create(fo.Bounds.center)
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if prog >= 1 then
			self:dispose_storm_data(data)
			table.remove(self.storm_holder, i)
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_flee_pos()
	local dest = nil
	local dist = 0

	for _, v in pairs(self.flee_position_list) do
		local sqr = (self.target.Position - v).magnitude
		if sqr > dist then
			dist = sqr
			dest = v
		end
	end

	return dest
end

function local_class:create_storm()
	local create_amount = self.current_repeat % 2 == 0 and self.amount_even or self.amount_odd

	local half_unit_angle = create_amount > 1 and self.shoot_angle / (2 * (create_amount - 1)) or 0
	local variant_angle = self.current_repeat % 2 == 0 and self.repeat_angle_variant or -self.repeat_angle_variant
	local wave_dir = self.current_repeat % 2 == 0 and 90 or -90
	local hold_time = self.current_repeat == 0 and self.prepare_duration or self.repeat_prepare_time

	for i = 0, create_amount - 1 do
		local diff_angle = half_unit_angle * (1 + 2 * i - create_amount) + variant_angle
		local init_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, diff_angle, 0) * self.shoot_dir
		local init_pos = self.character.Position + init_dir * self.init_distance

		local eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('storm', init_pos, vector_util.zero)
		eff.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * self.init_scale

		local calc = self:pop_calc()
		calc.Position = init_pos + vector_util.up * self.character.Bounds.extents.y
		calc:Start()

		local vr = self:pop_vr()
		vr.Position = init_pos
		vr.Radius = self.init_radius

		local data = {
			time_passed = 0,
			effect = eff,
			start_pos = init_pos,
			dir = init_dir,
			hold_time = hold_time,
			wave_dir = wave_dir,
			calc = calc,
			vr = vr
		}
		table.insert(self.storm_holder, data)
	end

	self.current_repeat = self.current_repeat + 1
end

function local_class:dispose_storm_data(data)
	self:push_calc(data.calc)
	self:push_vr(data.vr)
	data.effect:Dispose()
end

function local_class:make_calc()
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = vector_util.zero
	info.DamageTerm = self.damage_term
	info.Duration = self.action_duration + self.duration + self.prepare_duration
	info.Radius = self.init_radius
	info.Height = self.character.Bounds.size.y

	return CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
end

function local_class:pop_calc()
	if #self.calc_holder > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.calc_holder, 1)
	end

	return self:make_calc()
end

function local_class:push_calc(calc)
	calc:End()
	table.insert(self.calc_holder, calc)
end

function local_class:make_vr()
	return CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.init_radius)
end

function local_class:pop_vr()
	if #self.vr_holder > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.vr_holder, 1)
	end

	return self:make_vr()
end

function local_class:push_vr(vr)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, vr))
	table.insert(self.vr_holder, vr)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	local margin_x = self.character.Bounds.extents.x
	local margin_bot = self.character.Bounds.extents.z
	local margin_top = self.character.Bounds.extents.z

	local left_top = vector(bound.min.x + margin_x, 0, bound.max.z - margin_top)
	local left_bot = vector(bound.min.x + margin_x, 0, bound.min.z + margin_bot)
	local right_top = vector(bound.max.x - margin_x, 0, bound.max.z - margin_top)
	local right_bot = vector(bound.max.x - margin_x, 0, bound.min.z + margin_top)

	self.flee_position_list = { }
	table.insert(self.flee_position_list, left_top)
	table.insert(self.flee_position_list, left_bot)
	table.insert(self.flee_position_list, right_top)
	table.insert(self.flee_position_list, right_bot)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	for i = #self.storm_holder, 1, -1 do
		local data = self.storm_holder[i]
		self:dispose_storm_data(data)
		table.remove(self.storm_holder, i)
	end

	if self.sfx_storm ~= nil then
		self.sfx_storm:FadeOut(0.5)
		self.sfx_storm = nil
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossSelectorBasicAttackBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region prepare state

local prepare_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 준비 시간
	prepare_duration = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
prepare_state_class.mt = { __index = prepare_state_class }

--- create action state
function prepare_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function prepare_state_class:init(param)
	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')

	--- 싱크 유형
	self.sync_type = {
		attack_range = 1,
		aoe_start = 2,
	}
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function prepare_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function prepare_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 타겟 위치 캐싱
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)

	--- 타겟팅 되었음을 배포
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, self.target)
end

--- action state enter
function prepare_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)
end

function prepare_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 트래킹 하는 동안 대상 위치 캐싱
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
		self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))
	end

	--- 준비시간 끝나면 다음으로
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(self.action.action_state)
	end
end

--endregion

--region post state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,

	--- 이펙트 오프셋

	--- 사출 타이밍
	shoot_timings = nil,
	--- 이펙트 테이블
	fire_ball_fxs = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,

	--- cs projectile shooter

	--- shoot helper

	--- projectile spec

	--- 사출 오프셋

	calculator = nil,

	--- AOE 피해유형

	--- AOE 정보

	--- 현재 지나간 시간

}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')

	--- 장판 깔리는 간극
	self.aoe_interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AOEInterval')
	--- 넉백
	self.knock_back_force = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce')

	--- 액션 시간
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 대기 시간
	local post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')

	--- 최대 장판 개수
	self.max_claw_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MawClawCount')

	--- 상태 유지시간
	self.state_duration = self.action_duration + post_duration

	--- 충돌체 리스트
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	--- 2차공격 여부
	self.is_additional_attack = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(param, 'IsAdditionalAttack')

	if self.is_additional_attack then
		--- 충돌체 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
		--- 충돌체 길이
		self.range_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 충돌체 크기
		local range_size = vector(self.range_length, width)
		--- 사이 간격
		self.interval_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'IntervalLength')

		--- 어택 레인지 추가
		for idx = 1, self.max_claw_count do
			local attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(range_size, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
			table.insert(self.attack_range_list, attack_range)
		end
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function action_state_class:sync_attack_range(info)

	local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 어택 레인지 바로 출력
	for idx = 1, self.max_claw_count do
		self:update_attack_range(self.attack_range_list[idx],
			self.action:get_aoe_pos(idx, target_pos, dir_vector, self.interval_length, self.max_claw_count), dir_vector)
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_attack_range(attack_range, pos, dir)
	battle_range_util.show(attack_range, self.action_duration - self.aoe_interval)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, pos, dir)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, pos)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, attack_range)
end

function action_state_class:sync_aoe_start(info)
	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(prev_state)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 이전 상태에서 포지션 이관
	if prev_state == self.action.prepare_state then
		self.target_pos = prev_state.target_pos
		self.target = prev_state.target
	end

	local rand_target = self:get_random_except_target()

	--- 랜덤 타겟이 있으면 해당 대상 방향으로, 없으면 그냥 랜덤
	if rand_target then
		self.dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, rand_target)
	else
		self.dir_vector = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_util.get_random_value() * 360, 0) * vector_util.forward
	end

	--- 항상 아래에서 위로 긁어야 하니 후보정을 쳐줌
	if 0 <= self.dir_vector.z then
		self.dir_vector = vector(-self.dir_vector.x, 0, -self.dir_vector.z)
	end

	--- 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'claw', bounds_util.get_center(self.target))

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'claw')

	--- 타겟이 존재할때만 직접공격
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
		self:apply_damage(self.target)
	end
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end
end

function action_state_class:dispose()
	for idx = #self.attack_range_list, 1, -1 do
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		self.attack_range_list[idx] = nil
	end

	self.attack_range_list = {}
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 어택레인지 시작 때 트리거
	if self.is_additional_attack and is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.aoe_interval) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.attack_range)
		--- 쏠 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos)
		--- 쏠 방향
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 장판 타이밍때 장판 트리거
	if self.is_additional_attack and is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.aoe_start)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:get_random_except_target()

	--- 1타만 존재한다면 랜덤 타겟 자체가 필요가 없다.
	if not self.is_additional_attack then
		return nil
	end

	local targets = battle_manager_util.get_targets(self.owner)

	--- 타겟이 아직 멀쩡하다면 모든 적 중애서 타겟만 제외시켜야 한다.
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
		for idx = #targets, 1, -1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(targets[idx], self.target) then
				table.remove(targets, idx)
			end
		end
	end

	if #targets <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	return targets[random_util.get_random_int(1, #targets)]
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_force

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,
	--- 폭발 판정 계산기
	calculator_list = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')
	--- 사이 간격
	self.interval_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'IntervalLength')

	--- 충돌체 폭
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 충돌체 길이
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 충돌체 지속시간
	local duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Duration')
	--- 데미지 간격
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')
	--- 충돌체 크기
	local collision_size = vector(length, 2, width)

	--- 최대 장판 개수
	self.max_claw_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MawClawCount')

	--- 충돌체 리스트
	self.calculator_list = {}

	--- 충돌체 3개 추가
	for idx = 1, self.max_claw_count do repeat
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(collision_size, duration, damage_term, false)
		local calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		table.insert(self.calculator_list, calculator)
	until true end

	--- 상태 유지시간
	self.state_duration = duration
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function field_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 타겟 위치
	self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info))

	--- 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'attack', self.target_pos)

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'aoe')

	--- 싱크받은대로 간격 체크해서 위치 조정, 이펙트 출력
	for idx = 1, self.max_claw_count do
		local pos = self.action:get_aoe_pos(idx, self.target_pos, self.dir_vector, self.interval_length, self.max_claw_count)

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_list[idx], pos)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator_list[idx], self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator_list[idx])

		--- 방향에 따라 다른 이펙트
		if self.dir_vector.x < 0 then
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'aoe', pos, self.dir_vector)
		else
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'aoe_rev', pos, self.dir_vector)
		end
	end
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 장판 판정 종료
	for idx = 1, #self.calculator_list do
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_list[idx])
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 장판 판정
	for idx = 1, self.max_claw_count do repeat
		if not battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.state_duration) then
			break
		end

		--- 판정 동작 중 처리
		if not area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator_list[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator_list[idx], dt)

		--- 피격 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo)
		end
	until true end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- projectile state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.prepare_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.prepare_state, self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.prepare_state = nil
		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.prepare_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.prepare_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.prepare_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local sync_flag = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.attack_range then
		self.action_state:sync_attack_range(info)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.aoe_start then
		self.action_state:sync_aoe_start(info)
		self.field_state:sync(info)
		self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- field state reset
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:get_aoe_pos(index, target_pos, dir_vector, length, max_claw_count)
	local interval_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * dir_vector * (length / 2) * (max_claw_count - 1)
	return target_pos + interval_dir + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * dir_vector * length * (index - 1)
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}
