--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossSelectorChargeBurstBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region prepare state

local prepare_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 준비 시간
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 어택 레인지
	attack_range = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
prepare_state_class.mt = { __index = prepare_state_class }

--- create action state
function prepare_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function prepare_state_class:init(param)
	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 대상 추적 시간
	self.tracking_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TrackingDuration')

	--- 싱크 유형
	self.sync_type = {
		track_end = 1,
		action_start = 2,
		shoot = 3,
		reveal_beacon = 4,
		show_safe_zone = 5,
		explosion = 6
	}

	--- 가로
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 길이
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 어택 레인지
	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(length, width), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function prepare_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function prepare_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 타겟 위치 캐싱
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
	--- 트래킹 진행 여부
	self.is_tracking = true

	--- 타겟팅 되었음을 배포
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, self.target)
end

--- action state enter
function prepare_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'ready')

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')

	--- 어택 레인지 활성화
	battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
	--- 어택레인지 갱신
	self:update_attack_range(character_util.get_position(self.owner), self.dir_vector)

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)
end

function prepare_state_class:update_attack_range(position, direction)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, position, direction)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)
end

function prepare_state_class:exit(new_state)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	if not new_state then
		--- 애니메이션 해제
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		--- 방향 해제
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
end

--- 방향 싱크를 받아옴
function prepare_state_class:sync(info)
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	self.is_tracking = false
end

function prepare_state_class:dispose()
	battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)
	--- 준비 상태 완료하여 싱크 보낼 예정인가
	local prepare_ready = is_usable_routine and time_passed >= self.prepare_duration
	--- 이번 프레임에 싱크를 진행할 수 있는가 (로컬인 경우에만 허용한다)
	local can_sync_now = is_usable_routine and not prepare_ready

	--- 트래킹 하는 동안 대상의 방향을 갱신함
	if self.is_tracking and self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = self.action:selector_set_locked_target(self.target, self.dir_vector)

		--- 어택레인지도 갱신
		self:update_attack_range(character_util.get_position(self.owner), self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- tracking 끝, 방향 고정 싱크 필요
	if can_sync_now and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.tracking_duration) then
		--- 싱크를 하지 않도록 변경한다.
		can_sync_now = false

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.track_end)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- prepare 끝
	if prepare_ready then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.action_start)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

--endregion

--region charge state

--- 돌진 후 액션
local charge_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,

	--- 폭발 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
charge_state_class.mt = { __index = charge_state_class }

--- create action state
function charge_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function charge_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')

	--- 비컨들이 배치되어야 할 거리
	self.projectile_shoot_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjectileShootRange')
	--- 폭발 시간
	self.shoot_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootDelay')
	--- 폭발 시간
	self.explosion_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionTiming')
	--- 생성해야 할 개수
	self.proj_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjCount')
	--- 생성 최대 각도
	self.proj_angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjAngle')
	--- 차지 길이
	self.charge_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 차지 가로
	self.charge_width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 마법진 반경
	self.safe_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SafeRadius')

	--- 넉백
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce', 1)
	--- 돌진하는 시간
	self.charge_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ChargeDuration')
	--- 액션 시간
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 대기 시간
	local post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')

	--- 상태 유지시간
	self.state_duration = self.action_duration + post_duration

	--- 지정된 목표 위치
	self.cached_target_pos = {}

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(bounds_util.get_size(self.owner), self.charge_duration)
	self.charge_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, true, 0, 1)

	--- 현재 존 캐싱
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)
	self.zone_center = self.zone_bound.center
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function charge_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function charge_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function charge_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'charge')
	--- 변수 초기화
	self.cached_target_pos = {}

	--- 돌진해야 할 거리를 여기서 미리 계산
	self.current_charge_length = self.charge_length

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		self.owner.Bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, self.charge_length * self.dir_vector
	)

	if closest_object then
		--- 대상이 있다면 충돌 최소 거리
		local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
			self.owner.Bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 실제 이동가능한 거리 갱신
		self.current_charge_length = math.min(self.charge_length, ray_dist)
	end

	--- 크래시 비헤이비어 세팅
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'action', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * 0.5, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.charge_calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	area_collision_util.start(self.charge_calculator)
end

function charge_state_class:exit(new_state)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	if not new_state then
		--- 애니메이션 해제
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		--- 방향 해제
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 크래시 비헤이비어 제거
	battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour)
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil

	--- 장판 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.charge_calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function charge_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 돌진동안 돌진
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.charge_duration) then
		self:charge_update(dt)

		--- 판정이 종료되었을때
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.charge_calculator) then
			--- 크래시 비헤이비어 제거
			battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour)
			self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil

			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.charge_calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 돌진 끝나면 임의로 애니메이션 재생
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.charge_duration) then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.2)
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'charge_end')
	end

	--- 쏘는 타이밍때 쏘기
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.charge_duration + self.shoot_delay) then

		--- 타겟 위치를 여기서 지정
		self.cached_target_pos = self:get_spread_pos()

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 싱크타입 설정
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.shoot)
		--- 시작 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(self.owner))

		--- 각 대상마다 search
		for idx = 1, #self.cached_target_pos do repeat
			--- 목표 위치
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.cached_target_pos[idx])
		until true end

		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

function charge_state_class:charge_update(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.dir_vector
	move_info.magnitude = (self.current_charge_length / self.charge_duration) * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector), true,
		CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.SlipAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.owner, move_event)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.charge_calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 판정 체크
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.charge_calculator, dt)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		--- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, fo)

			--- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
			local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
			local xz_move_direction = self.dir_vector:GetXz().normalized
			local knock_direction
			if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.dir_vector
			else
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.dir_vector
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.owner
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_slash_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function charge_state_class:convert_position_to_inside(zone_bound, destination, radius)
	if zone_bound:Contains(destination) then
		return destination
	else

		if zone_bound.center.x + (zone_bound.size.x / 2) < destination.x then
			destination.x = zone_bound.center.x + (zone_bound.size.x / 2) - radius
		elseif destination.x < zone_bound.center.x - (zone_bound.size.x / 2) then
			destination.x = zone_bound.center.x - (zone_bound.size.x / 2) + radius
		end

		if zone_bound.center.z + (zone_bound.size.z / 2) < destination.z then
			destination.z = zone_bound.center.z + (zone_bound.size.z / 2) - radius
		elseif destination.z < zone_bound.center.z - (zone_bound.size.z / 2) then
			destination.z = zone_bound.center.z - (zone_bound.size.z / 2) + radius
		end

		return destination
	end
end

function charge_state_class:get_spread_pos()
	local pos_list = {}

	--- 맵 센터로 향하는 dir vector
	local dir_to_center = vector_util.normalized(self.zone_center - character_util.get_position(self.owner))

	--- 안전지대 인덱스부터 랜덤
	local safe_idx = random_util.get_random_int(0, self.proj_count - 1)
	local idx = 0

	while idx < self.proj_count do
		--- 반드시 첫 1개가 안전지대여야하므로, 안전지대부터 계산하도록 한다.
		local target_idx = (idx + safe_idx) % self.proj_count

		--- 인덱스 각도만큼 돌려주자
		local spread_pos = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, (-self.proj_angle / 2) + (self.proj_angle / (self.proj_count - 1)) * target_idx, 0) * dir_to_center

		spread_pos = self:convert_position_to_inside(self.zone_bound, character_util.get_position(self.owner) + spread_pos * self.projectile_shoot_range, self.safe_radius)

		--- 순서대로 넣어줌
		table.insert(pos_list, spread_pos)

		idx = idx + 1
	end

	return pos_list
end

function charge_state_class:apply_damage(target, dir_vector)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 스턴 추가
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration

	local knock_back_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
	knock_back_dir = vector_util.is_almost_zero(knock_back_dir) and dir_vector or knock_back_dir

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_back_dir
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knockback_force

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--region burst state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,

	--- 폭발 판정 계산기
	calculator_list = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

	--- 안전지대 fx
	fx_safe_zone = nil,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionDamageRate')
	--- atk modifier
	self.proj_atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjDamageModifier')

	--- 날아가는 시간
	self.shoot_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootDuration')
	--- 투사체 높이
	self.shoot_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootHeight')
	--- 안전지대 대기시간
	self.safe_zone_interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SafeZoneInterval')
	--- 폭발 시간
	self.explosion_interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionInterval')
	--- 대기 시간
	local post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')

	--- 폭발시 타입
	self.explosion_type = {
		explode = 1,
		safe = 2
	}

	--- 리스트 초기화
	self.target_shoot_list = {}

	--- 생성해야 할 개수
	self.proj_count = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjCount')

	--- 반지름
	self.safe_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SafeRadius')

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionRadius')
	--- 반지름
	local duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionDamageDuration')

	--- 리스트 초기화
	self.calculator_list = {}

	--- 생성 개수 만큼 충돌체 생성 필요
	for idx = 1, self.proj_count do repeat
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius, duration)

		table.insert(self.calculator_list, area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, 1))
	until true end

	--- 리스트 초기화
	self.calculator_proj_list = {}

	--- 생성 개수 만큼 충돌체 생성 필요
	for idx = 1, self.proj_count do repeat
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.safe_radius)

		table.insert(self.calculator_proj_list, area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info))
	until true end

	--- 마법진 어택레인지 리스트
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.proj_count do
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, battle_range_util.create_circle(self.safe_radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward))
	end

	--- 폭발 어택레인지 리스트
	self.attack_range_list_explosion = {}

	for idx = 1, self.proj_count do
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list_explosion, battle_range_util.create_donut(self.safe_radius, radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward))
	end

	--- state 지속시간
	self.state_duration = self.shoot_duration + self.safe_zone_interval + self.explosion_interval + post_duration

	--- 사운드에서 3d 요소 임시 제거.. sfx 파싱 부분에 대응이 없어서 여기서 제거한다.
	self.action.sfx_info['beacon'].spatialBlend = 0
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function field_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync_shoot(info)

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'beacon')

	--- 생성 개수만큼 충돌처리
	for idx = 1, self.proj_count do repeat
		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = {}

		--- 시작 위치는 항상 0번
		sync_info.start_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
		--- 목표 위치
		sync_info.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, idx)
		--- 지나간 시간
		sync_info.duration = self.shoot_duration

		--- 투사체 타입
		sync_info.proj_type = idx == 1 and self.explosion_type.safe or self.explosion_type.explode

		--- safe position 싱크
		if sync_info.proj_type == self.explosion_type.safe then
			self.safe_pos = sync_info.target_pos
		end

		--- 이펙트 출력
		sync_info.fx_proj = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj', sync_info.start_pos)

		table.insert(self.target_shoot_list, sync_info)

		--- 마법진 attack range
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_list[idx], self.shoot_duration)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_list[idx], sync_info.target_pos)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	until true end
end

function field_state_class:sync_reveal_beacon(info)
	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	for idx = 1, #self.target_shoot_list do
		local sync_info = self.target_shoot_list[idx]

		--- 착지 대상 주변 데미지
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator_proj_list[idx], sync_info.target_pos)

		if 0 < #fo_list then
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(fo, self.proj_atk_modifier)
			end
		end

		if sync_info.fx_beacon then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(sync_info.fx_beacon)
			sync_info.fx_beacon = nil
		end

		--- 이펙트 출력
		if sync_info.proj_type == self.explosion_type.explode then
			sync_info.fx_beacon = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'beacon', sync_info.target_pos)
		else
			sync_info.fx_beacon = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'beacon_safe', sync_info.target_pos)
		end

		--- 다음 폭발 어택레인지를 보여줌
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_list_explosion[idx], self.safe_zone_interval + self.explosion_interval)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_list_explosion[idx], sync_info.target_pos)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range_list_explosion[idx])
	end
end

function field_state_class:sync_show_safe_zone(info)
	self.fx_safe_zone = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'safe_zone', self.safe_pos)
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync_explosion(info)
	for idx = 1, #self.target_shoot_list do
		local sync_info = self.target_shoot_list[idx]

		--- 충돌체 위치 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_list[idx], sync_info.target_pos)
		--- 충돌체 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator_list[idx])

		--- 폭발 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', sync_info.target_pos)

		--- 비컨 타입 별 이펙트 출력
		if sync_info.proj_type == self.explosion_type.explode then
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'beacon_end', sync_info.target_pos)

		else
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'safe_zone_end', sync_info.target_pos)
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'beacon_safe_end', sync_info.target_pos)
		end
	end

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shout')

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, direction_util.down)
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shout')
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.5)

	if self.fx_safe_zone then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_safe_zone, true)
		self.fx_safe_zone = nil
	end

	--- 폭발어택 레인지 비활성화
	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list_explosion do
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list_explosion[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list_explosion[idx])
	end

	--- 이제 필요없으니 모두 해제
	for idx = #self.target_shoot_list, 1, -1 do
		local sync_info = self.target_shoot_list[idx]

		if sync_info.fx_proj then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(sync_info.fx_proj)
		end

		if sync_info.fx_beacon then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(sync_info.fx_beacon)
		end

		sync_info.fx_proj = nil
		sync_info.fx_beacon = nil
	end

	self.target_shoot_list = {}
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 비컨 어택 레인지 비활성화
	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	--- 폭발어택 레인지 비활성화
	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list_explosion do
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list_explosion[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list_explosion[idx])
	end

	for idx = #self.target_shoot_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.target_shoot_list[idx].fx_proj then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.target_shoot_list[idx].fx_proj)
		end

		if self.target_shoot_list[idx].fx_beacon then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.target_shoot_list[idx].fx_beacon)
		end

		self.target_shoot_list[idx].fx_proj = nil
	end

	self.target_shoot_list = {}

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	for idx = 1, #self.calculator_list do
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_list[idx])
	end
end

function field_state_class:dispose()
	--- 배틀레인지 제거
	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	self.attack_range_list = {}

	--- 폭발어택 레인지 제거
	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list_explosion do
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_list_explosion[idx])
	end

	self.attack_range_list_explosion = {}
end

--- ease out in 이 없어서 새로 만든 것
function field_state_class:get_ease_out_in_value(t, b, c, d)
	t = t / (d / 2);

	if t < 1 then
		return -c * t * (t - 2) + b;
	end

	t = t - 1;

	return 1 - (c * t * t + b);
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- beacon 보여줘야 하면
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 싱크타입 설정
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.reveal_beacon)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- safezone 보여줘야 하면
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_duration + self.safe_zone_interval) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 싱크타입 설정
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.show_safe_zone)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 폭발 타이밍때 데미지와 장판 트리거
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_duration + self.safe_zone_interval + self.explosion_interval) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 싱크타입 설정
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.explosion)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 보유중인 shoot 정보 탐색
	for idx = #self.target_shoot_list, 1, -1 do repeat
		local sync_info = self.target_shoot_list[idx]

		--- duration 이 끝났으면 업뎃할 필요가 없음
		if sync_info.duration < 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local current_pos = vector_util.lerp(sync_info.start_pos, sync_info.target_pos, 1 - (sync_info.duration / self.shoot_duration))

		current_pos = current_pos + vector(0, self.shoot_height * self:get_ease_out_in_value(self.shoot_duration - sync_info.duration, 0, 1, self.shoot_duration), 0)

		--- 포지션 업데이트
		effect_util.update_object(sync_info.fx_proj, current_pos)

		sync_info.duration = sync_info.duration - dt

		--- 끝났으면 연출 제거
		if sync_info.duration < 0 then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(sync_info.fx_proj)
			sync_info.fx_proj = nil
		end
	until true end

	--- 싱크 정보랑 상관없이 장판은 판정
	for idx = 1, #self.calculator_list do
		--- 판정 동작 중 처리
		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator_list[idx]) then
			--- 판정 체크
			local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator_list[idx], dt)

			--- 데미지 부여
			if 0 < #fo_list then
				for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
					--- 안전지대 거름처리도 여기서 같이
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, fo) and not self:is_safe_area(fo) then
						self:apply_damage(fo, self.atk_modifier)
					end
				end
			end

			--- 판정이 종료되었을때
			if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator_list[idx]) then
				--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
				area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_list[idx])
			end
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function field_state_class:is_safe_area(target)
	if not self.safe_pos then
		return false
	end

	local target_pos = character_util.get_position(target)

	if self.safe_radius < (target_pos - self.safe_pos).magnitude then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- charge state
	self.charge_state = charge_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.prepare_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.charge_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.field_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.prepare_state, self.charge_state, self.field_state)

		self.prepare_state = nil
		self.charge_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.prepare_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.prepare_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.prepare_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local sync_flag = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.track_end then
		--- 준비 상태가 이미 지나갔다면 굳이 싱크 처리할 필요가 없다.
		if self.state_machine.state == self.prepare_state then
			self.prepare_state:sync(info)
		end

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.action_start then
		self.charge_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.charge_state)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.shoot then
		self.field_state:sync_shoot(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.field_state)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.reveal_beacon then
		self.field_state:sync_reveal_beacon(info)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.show_safe_zone then
		self.field_state:sync_show_safe_zone(info)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.explosion then
		self.field_state:sync_explosion(info)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	if not self.charge_state then
		return
	end

	if not self.state_machine.state then
		return
	end

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

function local_class:selector_set_locked_target(target, dir_vector)
	if is_unity_null(target) or character_util.is_dead(target) then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self:selector_to_direction(dir_vector))

		return nil, dir_vector
	end

	dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.cs_action.Character, target)

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(dir_vector.magnitude) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.cs_action.Character))
	end

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self:selector_to_direction(dir_vector))

	return target, dir_vector
end

function local_class:selector_to_direction(v)
	if v.magnitude == 0 then
		return CS.Oak.Direction.None
	end

	if math.abs(v.x) >= math.abs(v.z) then
		if v.x > 0 then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		else
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end
	else
		if v.z > 0 then
			if v.x > 0 then
				return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			else
				return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			end
		else
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossSelectorCrossLaserBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region prepare state

local prepare_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 준비 시간
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 어택 레인지 리스트
	attack_range_list = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
prepare_state_class.mt = { __index = prepare_state_class }

--- create action state
function prepare_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function prepare_state_class:init(param)
	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 대상 추적 시간
	self.tracking_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TrackingDuration')

	--- 싱크 유형
	self.sync_type = {
		track_end = 1,
		action_start = 2,
		attack_range_start = 3,
		apply_aoe = 4,
		additional_attack_range_start = 5,
		additional_apply_aoe = 6,
	}

	--- 대상 찾는 시간
	self.search_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchTerm')

	--- 최대 생성 개수
	self.max_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxTargetCount')

	--- 대상 추적 리스트
	self.search_target_list = {}

	--- 충돌체 폭
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

	--- 어택 레인지 생성
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.max_count do
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(width, width), attack_range_show_type.overlay_outward))
	end
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function prepare_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function prepare_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 타겟 위치 캐싱
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
	--- 트래킹 진행 여부
	self.is_tracking = true

	--- 내가 속한 전투에서 타겟을 찾음
	local battle = battle_manager_util.get_battle_for(self.owner)

	if battle then
		local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.owner)

		--- 일단 모든 타겟 다 담기
		for idx = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			local target = targets[idx]

			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
				table.insert(self.search_target_list, target)
			end
		end

		targets:Dispose()

		--- 어그로 순으로 정렬
		table.sort(self.search_target_list,
			function(a, b)
				return battle:GetAggro(self.owner, b) < battle:GetAggro(self.owner, a)
			end
		)
	end

	--- max count 만큼 지워준다.
	for idx = #self.search_target_list, 1, -1 do
		if idx <= self.max_count then
			break
		end

		table.remove(self.search_target_list, idx)
	end

	--- 어택 레인지 활성화
	for idx = 1, #self.search_target_list do
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_list[idx], self.tracking_duration)
	end

	--- 타겟팅 되었음을 배포
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, self.target)
end

--- action state enter
function prepare_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)
end

function prepare_state_class:update_attack_range(idx, position)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_list[idx], position)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
end

function prepare_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)

	--- 초기화
	self.search_target_list = {}
end

--- 방향 싱크를 받아옴
function prepare_state_class:sync_track_end(info)
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	self.is_tracking = false
end

function prepare_state_class:dispose()
	--- 배틀레인지 제거
	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	self.attack_range_list = {}
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)
	--- 준비 상태 완료하여 싱크 보낼 예정인가
	local prepare_ready = is_usable_routine and time_passed >= self.prepare_duration
	--- 이번 프레임에 싱크를 진행할 수 있는가 (로컬인 경우에만 허용한다)
	local can_sync_now = is_usable_routine and not prepare_ready

	--- 트래킹 하는 동안 대상 위치 캐싱
	if self.is_tracking and self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		--- 각 대상마다 어택레인지도 갱신
		for idx = 1, #self.search_target_list do
			self:update_attack_range(idx, character_util.get_position(self.search_target_list[idx]))
		end
	end

	--- tracking 끝, 방향 고정 싱크 필요
	if can_sync_now and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.tracking_duration) then
		--- 싱크를 하지 않도록 변경한다.
		can_sync_now = false

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.track_end)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- prepare 끝
	if prepare_ready then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.action_start)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)

		--- 대상 개수 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, #self.search_target_list)

		--- 싱크될 위치 추가
		for idx = 1, #self.search_target_list do
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.attack_range_list[idx].CacheTransform.position)
			trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.search_target_list[idx])
		end

		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

--endregion

--region post state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')

	--- 액션 시간
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 이펙트 출력 위치로 인해 살짝 오프셋 줄 부분
	self.attack_range_offset = 0 -- cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRangeOffset')
	--- 대기 시간
	local post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')

	--- 어택 레인지 보여주기
	self.is_show_attack_range = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(param, 'IsShowAttackRange')

	--- 상태 유지시간
	self.state_duration = self.action_duration + post_duration

	--- 이펙트 나오고 range 나오기 전까지 interval
	self.attack_range_interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRangeInterval')
	--- attack range 보여줄 기간
	self.attack_range_duration = self.action_duration - self.attack_range_interval

	--- 최대 생성 개수
	self.max_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxTargetCount')

	--- 어택 레인지 리스트도 생성
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	--- 충돌체 폭
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 충돌체 길이
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')

	--- 생성해야할 개수만큼 생성
	for idx = 1, self.max_count * 2 do
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(length, width), attack_range_show_type.overlay_outward))
	end

	--- AOE 정보 세팅
	self.aoe_damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'AoeDamageType')
	self.aoe_spec = CS.Oak.AreaOfEffectManager.AoeSpecParams()
	self.aoe_spec.shape = CS.AttackRangeShape.Rectangle
	self.aoe_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, "AoeAttackFactor")
	self.aoe_spec.rectSize = vector(width, length)
	self.aoe_spec.duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, "AoeDuration")
	self.aoe_spec.damageTerm = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, "AoeTerm")

	--- AOE 히트 콜백
	self.on_aoe_hit_func = function(target, dir_vector, modifier, _) self:on_aoe_hit(target, dir_vector, modifier) end

	--- 추가공격 보유 여부..
	self.has_additional_attack = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(param, 'IsAdditionalAttack')

	--- 공 연출 리스트
	self.fx_sphere_list = {}

	self.additional_action_duration = 0
	self.additional_attack_range_interval = 0
	self.additional_attack_range_list = {}

	if self.has_additional_attack then
		self.additional_aoe_dir = {}

		--- 충돌체 폭
		local additional_width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AdditionalWidth')
		--- 충돌체 길이
		local additional_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AdditionalLength')

		--- 생성해야할 개수만큼 생성
		for idx = 1, self.max_count * 2 do
			table.insert(self.additional_attack_range_list, battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(additional_length, additional_width), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward))
		end

		--- 이펙트 나오고 range 나오기 전까지 interval
		self.additional_attack_range_interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AdditionalAttackRangeInterval')
		--- 액션 시간
		self.additional_action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AdditionalActionDuration')
		--- attack range 보여줄 기간
		self.additional_attack_range_duration = self.additional_action_duration - self.additional_attack_range_interval

		--- 추가 AOE 정보 세팅
		self.additional_aoe_spec = CS.Oak.AreaOfEffectManager.AoeSpecParams()
		self.additional_aoe_spec.shape = CS.AttackRangeShape.Rectangle
		self.additional_aoe_spec.rectSize = vector(additional_length, additional_width)
		self.additional_aoe_spec.duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, "AdditionalAoeDuration")
		self.additional_aoe_spec.damageTerm = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, "AoeTerm")

		--- 상태 유지시간
		self.state_duration = self.action_duration + self.additional_action_duration + post_duration
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync_action_start(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 타겟 개수
	self.target_count = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 1)

	--- 타겟 포지션 리스트
	self.target_pos_list = {}

	--- 타겟 리스트. 2차 공격이 있을 때만 쓰인다.
	self.target_list = {}

	--- 공 연출 리스트
	self.fx_sphere_list = {}

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'circle')

	for idx = 0, self.target_count - 1 do

		--- 타겟 싱크
		table.insert(self.target_list, trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, idx))

		--- 위치 싱크
		local sync_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, idx))
		table.insert(self.target_pos_list, sync_pos)

		--- 이펙트 출력
		table.insert(self.fx_sphere_list, battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'sphere', sync_pos))
	end
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync_attack_range_start(info)
	for idx = 1, self.target_count do
		--- 어택 레인지 활성화
		if self.is_show_attack_range then
			battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_list[idx * 2 - 1], self.attack_range_duration)
			battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_list[idx * 2], self.attack_range_duration)

			self:update_attack_range(self.attack_range_list[idx * 2 - 1], self.target_pos_list[idx] + (vector_util.forward * self.attack_range_offset), vector_util.forward)
			self:update_attack_range(self.attack_range_list[idx * 2], self.target_pos_list[idx] + (vector_util.forward * self.attack_range_offset), vector_util.right)
		end

		--- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'laser', self.target_pos_list[idx])
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_attack_range(attack_range, position, dir)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, position, dir)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, position)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, attack_range)
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync_apply_aoe(info)

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cross')

	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	for idx = 1, self.target_count do repeat
		--- 장판이 설치될 위치
		local aoe_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos_list[idx]) + (vector_util.forward * self.attack_range_offset)

		--- 유효한 바닥이 아니라면 장판 설치는 생략한다.
		if not battle_util.is_there_floor_at(aoe_pos) then
			break
		end

		--- 가로 장판 설치
		self.aoe_spec.rotateDirection = vector_util.right
		stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.owner, aoe_pos, nil, self.aoe_spec,
			self.on_aoe_hit_func, nil, nil, true)

		--- 세로 장판 설치
		self.aoe_spec.rotateDirection = vector_util.forward
		stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.owner, aoe_pos, nil, self.aoe_spec,
			self.on_aoe_hit_func, nil, nil, true)

		--- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'aoe', aoe_pos)

		--- 추가 공격이 없으면 공 이펙트 해제.. timelimit 걸어둘거니 immediate 해제
		if not self.has_additional_attack then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_sphere_list[idx], true)
			self.fx_sphere_list[idx] = nil
		end

	until true end

	self.fx_sphere_list = {}
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync_additional_attack_range_start(info)

	self.additional_aoe_dir = {}

	for idx = 1, self.target_count do
		--- 싱크된 방향 대로 출력
		local range_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, idx - 1)

		table.insert(self.additional_aoe_dir, range_dir)

		--- 어택 레인지 활성화
		if self.is_show_attack_range then
			battle_range_util.show(self.additional_attack_range_list[idx], self.additional_attack_range_duration)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.additional_attack_range_list[idx], self.target_pos_list[idx], range_dir)
			battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.additional_attack_range_list[idx])
		end

		--- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'laser_2', self.target_pos_list[idx], range_dir)
	end
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync_additional_apply_aoe(info)

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'add')

	for idx = 1, #self.additional_attack_range_list do
		--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
		battle_range_util.hide(self.additional_attack_range_list[idx])
		--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.additional_attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	for idx = 1, self.target_count do repeat
		local aoe_dir = self.additional_aoe_dir[idx]
		--- 장판이 설치될 위치
		local aoe_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos_list[idx] + aoe_dir * (self.additional_aoe_spec.rectSize.x / 2))

		--- 가로 장판 설치
		self.additional_aoe_spec.rotateDirection = self.additional_aoe_dir[idx]
		stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.owner, aoe_pos, nil, self.additional_aoe_spec,
			self.on_aoe_hit_func, nil, nil, true)

		--- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'aoe_2', self.target_pos_list[idx], self.additional_aoe_dir[idx])
	until true end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 불필요한 리스트 삭제
	self.target_list = {}

	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	if self.has_additional_attack then
		for idx = 1, #self.additional_attack_range_list do
			--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
			battle_range_util.hide(self.additional_attack_range_list[idx])
			--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
			battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.additional_attack_range_list[idx])
		end
	end

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- 혹시나 force cancel 이 온다면 이펙트 즉시 해제 필요한 이펙트들
function action_state_class:force_cancel()
	for idx = #self.fx_sphere_list, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_sphere_list[idx], true)
		self.fx_sphere_list[idx] = nil
	end

	self.fx_sphere_list = {}
end

function action_state_class:dispose()
	--- 배틀레인지 제거
	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	self.attack_range_list = {}

	if self.has_additional_attack then
		for idx = 1, #self.additional_attack_range_list do
			battle_range_util.destroy(self.additional_attack_range_list[idx])
		end

		self.additional_attack_range_list = {}
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 어택레인지 시작
	if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_range_interval) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.attack_range_start)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 어택레인지 끝, aoe 적용 필요
	if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.apply_aoe)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 2차 공격 어택레인지 시작
	if self.has_additional_attack and is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration + self.additional_attack_range_interval) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.additional_attack_range_start)

		--- 대상 위치 계산해서 방향 싱크
		for idx = 1, self.target_count do repeat
			if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target_list[idx]) then
				break
			end

			local target_dir = character_util.get_position(self.target_list[idx]) - self.target_pos_list[idx]

			--- 타겟이 계속 제자리에 있는 경우.. 이럴땐 랜덤하게 360도 넣어주자.
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(target_dir)) then
				target_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_util.get_random_value() * 360, 0) * vector_util.forward
			end

			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, vector_util.normalized(target_dir))
		until true end

		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 2차 공격 어택레인지 끝, aoe 적용 필요
	if self.has_additional_attack and is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration + self.additional_action_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.additional_apply_aoe)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_aoe_hit(target, dir_vector, modifier)
	-- aoe 스팩이 유효하지 않다면 이미 해제된 것으로 간주한다.
	if not self.aoe_spec then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.aoe_damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp_mod(target) * self.aoe_modifier)
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- projectile state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.prepare_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.prepare_state, self.action_state)

		self.prepare_state = nil
		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.prepare_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.prepare_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.prepare_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local sync_flag = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.track_end then
		--- 준비 상태가 이미 지나갔다면 굳이 싱크 처리할 필요가 없다.
		if self.state_machine.state == self.prepare_state then
			self.prepare_state:sync_track_end(info)
		end

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.action_start then
		self.action_state:sync_action_start(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)


	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.attack_range_start then
		self.action_state:sync_attack_range_start(info)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.apply_aoe then
		self.action_state:sync_apply_aoe(info)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.additional_attack_range_start then
		self.action_state:sync_additional_attack_range_start(info)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.additional_apply_aoe then
		self.action_state:sync_additional_apply_aoe(info)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	if not self.action_state then
		return
	end

	self.action_state:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossSelectorDDRBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,

	else
		self.jump_marker_pos = self.jump_marker_list[self.marker_pos_type.right]
	end

	--- 점프 시작 위치
	self.jump_start_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
end

--- 점프 끝났을때 오는 곳. 주변 넉백
function jump_state_class:sync_action_start(info)
	local jump_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

	--- 주변 넉백
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator_knock_back, jump_pos)

	if 0 < #fo_list then
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(character_util.get_position(fo) - jump_pos)
			self:apply_knock_back(fo, dir_vector)
		end
	end

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'knockback', jump_pos)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function jump_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 점프시켜줌
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.jump_duration) then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.jump_time_passed / self.jump_duration)

		self.jump_time_passed = self.jump_time_passed + dt

		local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * self.jump_height

		self.current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.jump_start_pos, self.jump_marker_pos, progress)
			+ unity_class.vector3.up * h

		self.owner.Position = self.current_pos
	end

	--- 점프 끝
	if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.action_start)
		--- 점프 목표 위치 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.jump_marker_pos)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

function jump_state_class:apply_knock_back(target, target_dir)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = target_dir
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_force

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지

	return true

--- 눈 모두 생성
function actions_state_class:create_all_eye()
	--- 목표 위치
	local target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + vector_util.up * self.eye_height_offset

	for idx = #self.eye_effect_list, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.self.eye_effect_list[idx])
		self.eye_effect_list[idx] = nil
	end

	--- 어차피 4방향박에 없음
	for idx = 1, 4 do
		self.eye_effect_list[idx] = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'eye_open',
			target_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90 * (idx - 1), 0) * vector_util.forward * 2.5)
	end
end

--- 눈을 모두 떠야 할 때
function actions_state_class:open_all_eye()
end

--- 눈판정 시작
function actions_state_class:sync_eye_start(info)
end

--- 눈판정 끝, 틀린애들 넉백
function actions_state_class:sync_field_damage(info)
	self:open_all_eye()

	--- 싱크 왔을때 기준으로 오너 위치 설정
	local sync_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

	--- 현재 속한 존을 기반으로 세팅
	local target_dir = sync_pos.x < self.zone_center.x and vector_util.right or vector_util.left

	--- 올바른 눈 방향
	local eye_dir = vector_util.to_direction(trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info))

	--- 내가 속한 전투에서 타겟을 찾음
	local battle = battle_manager_util.get_battle_for(self.owner)

	if battle then
		local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.owner)

		--- 각 타겟을 보고 눈 방향과 다른곳을 보고있으면 넉백
		for idx = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			local target = targets[idx]

			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
				if eye_dir ~= character_util.get_look_direction(target) then
					self:apply_knock_back(target, target_dir)
				end
			end
		end

		targets:Dispose()
	end
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function actions_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 혹시 모르니깐 점프 끝나는 위치로 싱크
	local jump_target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

	self.owner.Position = jump_target_pos

	--- 현재 존
	local zone_center = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner).center

	--- 카메라 세팅
	self.action:set_camera_size(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration, zone_center)
end

--- action state enter
function actions_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')

	--- eye duration 리스트 초기화
	self.eye_start_timing = {}
	self.eye_end_timing = {}

	--- 눈 방향 랜덤을 여기서 미리 해주자.
	self.eye_rand_index = {}

	--- action duration 초기화
	self.state_duration = 0

	--- 시작하면 랜덤 타이밍 고려해서 duration 을 다시 계산해줘야 함
	for idx = 1, self.repeat_count + 1 do
		local rand_duration = random_util.get_random_value() * (self.eye_max_duration - self.eye_min_duration) + self.eye_min_duration

		table.insert(self.eye_start_timing, self.state_duration)
		table.insert(self.eye_end_timing, self.state_duration + rand_duration)

		--- 더해줌
		self.state_duration = self.state_duration + rand_duration

		--- 눈 방향 랜덤
		table.insert(self.eye_rand_index, random_util.get_random_int(0, 3))
	end

	self.current_count = self.repeat_count
end

function actions_state_class:exit(_)

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 눈 이펙트도 다 해제
	for idx = 1, #self.eye_effect_list do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.eye_effect_list[idx])
	end

	self.eye_effect_list = {}
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function actions_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 눈 판정 시작때 싱크
	for idx = 1, #self.eye_start_timing do repeat
		if not is_usable_routine then
			break
		end

		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.eye_start_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별 이넘
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.eye_start)
		--- 랜덤 인덱스 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.eye_rand_index[idx])
		--- 반복 횟수 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.current_count - 1)
		--- 오너 포지션 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(self.owner))
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	until true end

	--- 눈 판정 끝났을 때 싱크
	for idx = 1, #self.eye_end_timing do repeat
		if not is_usable_routine then
			break
		end

		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.eye_end_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별 이넘
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.field_damage)

		--- 눈 인덱스 기반으로 올바른 방향 넣어주자
		local eye_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90 * (self.eye_rand_index[idx]), 0) * vector_util.forward
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, eye_dir)

		--- 현재 위치 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(self.owner))
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	until true end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별 이넘
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.laser_start)
		--- 내 위치 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(self.owner))
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

function actions_state_class:apply_knock_back(target, target_dir)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = target_dir
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_force

	--- 스턴 추가
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

function laser_state_class:init(param)

	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')

	--- 맵 충돌체 정보
	self.laser_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LaserActionDuration')
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LaserDamageTerm')

	--- 맵 충돌체 정보
	local post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')
	self.camera_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CameraDuration', 2)

	--- 현재 존
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)
	self.zone_center = zone_bound.center

	--- 충돌체
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(vector(zone_bound.size.x / 2, 2, zone_bound.size.z), self.laser_duration, damage_term, true)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 어택 레인지
	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(zone_bound.size.x / 2, zone_bound.size.z), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)

	--- 상태 유지시간
	self.state_duration = self.prepare_duration + self.laser_duration + post_duration
end

--- action state enter
function laser_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)
end

function laser_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	--- 카메라 원복
	self.action:set_camera_default(self.camera_duration)

	--- 충돌체 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- 레이저 시작
function laser_state_class:sync_laser_start(info)
	--- 싱크 왔을때 기준으로 오너 위치 설정
	local sync_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

	--- 현재 속한 존을 기반으로 세팅
	self.target_dir = sync_pos.x < self.zone_center.x and vector_util.right or vector_util.left

	--- 어택 레인지 활성화
	battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.zone_center, self.target_dir)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)
end

--- 데미지 깔아줌
function laser_state_class:sync_apply_aoe(info)
	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)

	--- 절반 판정 시작
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.zone_center)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.target_dir)
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function laser_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 레이저 판정 깔 때 싱크
	if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별 이넘
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.apply_aoe)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 판정 동작 중 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 데미지 부여
		if 0 < #fo_list then
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(fo)
			end
		end

		--- 판정이 종료되었을때
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function laser_state_class:dispose()
	battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
end

function laser_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보

	--- 스턴
	self.stun_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'StunDuration', 1)

	--- 현재 존
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)
	self.zone_center = zone_bound.center

	--- 어택 레인지
	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(zone_bound.size.x / 2, zone_bound.size.z), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)

	self.state_duration = 0.2
