function field_state_class:sync_eye_start(info)
	--- 싱크 왔을때 기준으로 오너 위치 설정
	self.sync_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

	--- 현재 속한 존을 기반으로 세팅
	self.target_dir = self.sync_pos.x < self.zone_center.x and vector_util.right or vector_util.left

	--- 올바른 눈 방향
	local eye_dir = vector_util.to_direction(trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info))

	--- 내가 속한 전투에서 타겟을 찾음
	local battle = battle_manager_util.get_battle_for(self.owner)

	if battle then
		local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.owner)

		--- 각 타겟을 보고 눈 방향과 다른곳을 보고있으면 넉백
		for idx = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			local target = targets[idx]

			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
				if eye_dir ~= character_util.get_look_direction(target) then
					self:apply_knock_back(target, self.target_dir)
				end
			end
		end

		targets:Dispose()
	end

	return self.prepare_state:is_controlling()

	return self.prepare_state:is_run_cancelable()

function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local sync_flag = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.jump_start then
		self.jump_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.jump_state)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.action_start then
		self.jump_state:sync_action_start(info)

		self.action_state:sync(info)
		self.action_state:open_all_eye()
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.eye_start then
		self.action_state:sync_eye_start(info)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.field_damage then
		self.action_state:sync_field_damage(info)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.laser_start then
		self.laser_state:sync_laser_start(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.laser_state)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.apply_aoe then
		self.laser_state:sync_apply_aoe(info)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함

	self:set_camera_default(2)
end

	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

	stage_camera:Move(user_party, vector_util.zero, duration, user_party)

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossSelectorFindFakeBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region prepare state

local prepare_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 준비 시간
	prepare_duration = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
prepare_state_class.mt = { __index = prepare_state_class }

--- create action state
function prepare_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function prepare_state_class:init(param)
	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 텔포 타이밍
	self.teleport_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TeleportTiming')
	--- 텔포 기간
	self.teleport_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TeleportDuration')

	--- 싱크 유형
	self.sync_type = {
		on_teleport = 1,
		action_start = 2,
		cast_start = 3,
		repeat_start = 4,
		rock_create = 5,
		gimmik_revive = 6,
	}

	--- 반복횟수
	self.repeat_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'RepeatCount')
	--- 안전지대 개수
	self.max_safe_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxSafeCount')
	--- 존 개수
	self.zone_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ZoneCount')

	--- 현재 존 캐싱
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)
	self.zone_center = zone_bound.center

	--- state duration
	self.state_duration = self.prepare_duration
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function prepare_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function prepare_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 타겟팅 되었음을 배포
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, target)
end

--- action state enter
function prepare_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 타겟 초기화
	self.target = nil

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.back)
	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)
end

function prepare_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 혹시 모르니깐 여기서도 fade 를 해제한다.
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0)

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
end

function prepare_state_class:sync_on_teleport()
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'teleport', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0)
end

function prepare_state_class:dispose()
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 텔포 타이밍
	if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.teleport_timing) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.on_teleport)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- prepare 끝
	if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.action_start)
		--- 반복횟수 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.repeat_count + 1)
		--- 안전지대 개수 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.max_safe_count)

		local rand_list = self:get_random_list(self.max_safe_count, self.zone_count)

		--- 세이프존 랜덤 인덱스 추가
		for idx = 1, #rand_list do
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, rand_list[idx])
		end

		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

--- 중복되지 않는 count 개의 랜덤을 1 ~ max 사이에서 반환한다.
function prepare_state_class:get_random_list(count, max)
	local rv = {}
	local mem = {}

	for idx = 1, max do
		table.insert(mem, idx)
	end

	for idx = 1, count do
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, #mem)
		table.insert(rv, table.remove(mem, rand))
	end

	return rv
end

--region charge state

--- 돌진 후 액션
local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,

	--- 폭발 판정 계산기
	calculator_knock_back = nil,
	--- 어택 레인지
	attack_range = nil,
	--- 존 인덱싱 리스트
	safe_zone_idx_list = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')

	--- 대기 시간
	local post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')

	--- 넉백
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce', 1)
	--- 포효 시간
	self.shouting_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShoutingDuration')
	--- 바위 생성시간
	self.rock_create_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RockCreateDuration')
	--- 기믹 생성 시간
	self.gimmik_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'GimmikCreateDuration')
	--- 캐스팅 시간
	self.casting_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CastingDuration')
	--- hp ui 사이즈
	self.hp_bar_size = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'GimmikHpBarSize')

	--- 반복횟수
	self.repeat_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'RepeatCount')
	--- 안전지대 개수
	self.max_safe_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxSafeCount')
	--- 안전지대 감소 개수
	self.decrease_safe_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'DecreaseSafeCount')
	--- 존 개수
	self.zone_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ZoneCount')
	--- 안전지대 범위
	self.safe_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SafeRadius')
	--- 현재 안전지대 개수
	self.current_safe_zone = self.max_safe_count

	self.safe_zone_idx_list = {}

	--- 카메라 사이즈
	self.camera_size = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CameraSize', 10)
	self.camera_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CameraDuration', 2)

	--- 존 타입
	self.zone_type = {
		none = 1,
		safe = 2,
	}

	--- 타이머 초기화
	self.current_timer = 0

	--- 현재 존 캐싱
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)
	self.zone_center = zone_bound.center

	--- 현재 쏴야할 개수
	self.current_shoot_count = self.shoot_start_num

	--- 상태 유지시간
	self.state_duration = (self.shouting_duration + self.gimmik_duration + self.casting_duration) * (self.repeat_count + 1) + post_duration

	--- 기믹 오브젝트 캐싱
	self.gimmik_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.zone_count - 1 do
		local fo = get_field_object('selector_gimmik_' .. idx)
		fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.HittableObstacle

		table.insert(self.gimmik_list, fo)
	end

	--- 안전지대 기믹 오브젝트 캐싱
	self.gimmik_safe_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.max_safe_count do
		local fo = get_field_object('selector_gimmik_safe_' .. idx)
		fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.HittableObstacle

		table.insert(self.gimmik_safe_list, fo)
	end

	--- 단순히 넣어줌..
	self.marker_pos_list = {}

	--- 마커 이름
	local marker_names = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(param, 'MarkerNames')

	for _, action_name in pairs(marker_names) do
		table.insert(self.marker_pos_list, field:GetMarker(action_name).position)
	end

	--- 넉백 충돌체 정보
	local knock_back_collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.safe_radius)
	self.calculator_knock_back = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, knock_back_collision_info)

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(vector(zone_bound.size.x, 2, zone_bound.size.z))
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 어택 레인지
	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(zone_bound.size.x, zone_bound.size.z), attack_range_show_type.overlay_outward)

	--- 마법진 어택레인지
	self.attack_range_beacon = {}

	for idx = 1, self.zone_count do
		table.insert(self.attack_range_beacon, battle_range_util.create_circle(self.safe_radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward))
	end

	--- 안전지대 이펙트
	self.fx_safe_zone = {}

	--- 마법진 이펙트.
	self.fx_beacon = {}
	self.fx_beacon_safe = {}
	self.fx_attack_range = {}
	self.rock_fx_list = {}
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync_action_start(info)
	--- 어차피 존위치가 달라질일은 없으니깐 그냥 포지션 세팅
	self.owner.Position = self.zone_center

	--- fade 해제
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0)
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'teleport', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 카메라 세팅
	stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)
	stage_camera:Move(self.zone_center, self.camera_duration, nil)

	--- 모든 적 넉백
	local fo_list = battle_manager_util.get_targets(self.owner)

	if 0 < #fo_list then
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(character_util.get_position(fo) - self.zone_center)
			self:apply_knock_back(fo, dir_vector)
		end
	end

	--- 나머지 세팅
	self:setting_zone(info)
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync_cast_start(info)

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'beacon')

	for idx = 1, self.zone_count do
		--- 각 마법진 별 어택레인지 생성
		-- battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_beacon[idx], self.gimmik_duration)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_beacon[idx], self.marker_pos_list[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range_beacon[idx])

		--- 각 마법진 이펙트 생성
		local zone_info = self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx]

		if zone_info.zone_type == self.zone_type.safe then
			table.insert(self.fx_beacon_safe, battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'beacon_safe', self.marker_pos_list[zone_info.index]))
		else
			table.insert(self.fx_beacon, battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'beacon', self.marker_pos_list[zone_info.index]))
		end

		--- 어택 레인지
		table.insert(self.fx_attack_range, battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'attack_range', self.marker_pos_list[zone_info.index]))
	end
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync_repeat_start(info)
	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	--- 우선 모든 기믹들 꺼줌
	for idx = 1, #self.gimmik_list do
		self.gimmik_list[idx].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	for idx = 1, #self.gimmik_safe_list do
		self.gimmik_safe_list[idx].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	for idx = 1, self.zone_count do
		--- 각 마법진 이펙트 생성
		local zone_info = self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx]

		if zone_info.zone_type == self.zone_type.safe then
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'beacon_safe_end', self.marker_pos_list[zone_info.index])
		else
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'beacon_end', self.marker_pos_list[zone_info.index])
		end
	end

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.2)

	--- 데미지 부여
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.zone_center)

	if 0 < #fo_list then
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

			local is_in_safe = false

			for idx = 1, self.zone_count do
				local zone_info = self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx]

				--- 현재 safe 존 들 중 한개에 들어가 있는가?
				if zone_info.cleared and vector_util.magnitude(character_util.get_position(fo) - self.marker_pos_list[idx]) < self.safe_radius then
					is_in_safe = true
					break
				end
			end

			--- safe 에 없으면 데미지
			if not is_in_safe then
				self:apply_damage(fo)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- 폭발이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

	--- 그 외 이펙트 해제
	for idx = #self.fx_beacon, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_beacon[idx])
		table.remove(self.fx_beacon, idx)
	end

	self.fx_beacon = {}

	for idx = #self.fx_beacon_safe, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_beacon_safe[idx])
		table.remove(self.fx_beacon_safe, idx)
	end

	self.fx_beacon_safe = {}

	--- 현재 남은 반복횟수
	local repeat_remain = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 1)

	if repeat_remain <= 0 then
		--- 마지막 반복이면 마지막 애니메이션 하고 나간다.
		if self.current_time_passed < self.state_duration then
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack_end')
		end

		return
	end

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')

	--- safezone fx 가 존재한다면 지우고 그 자리에 end 생성
	for idx = 1, #self.fx_safe_zone do
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'safe_end', self.fx_safe_zone[idx].transform.position)

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_safe_zone[idx], true)
		self.fx_safe_zone[idx] = nil
	end

	self.fx_safe_zone = {}

	--- 나머지 세팅
	self:setting_zone(info)
end

function action_state_class:sync_rock_create(info)
	--- 안전지대 카운트용
	local safe_idx = 0
	self.rock_fx_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.zone_count do
		local zone_info = self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx]
		local rock_fx = nil

		if zone_info then
			--- 적절하게 바위 이펙트를 깔아준다.
			if zone_info.zone_type == self.zone_type.none then
				rock_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'rock_create', self.marker_pos_list[idx])

			else
				rock_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'rock_create_safe', self.marker_pos_list[idx])
				safe_idx = safe_idx + 1
			end

			table.insert(self.rock_fx_list, rock_fx)
		end
	end
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync_gimmik_revive(info)
	--- 전체 공격 범위 어택 레인지 활성화
	battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.casting_duration)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.zone_center)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	--- 마법진 어택레인지 제거, 넉백
	for idx = 1, self.zone_count do
		--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_beacon[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_beacon[idx])

		--- 주변 넉백
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator_knock_back, self.marker_pos_list[idx])

		if 0 < #fo_list then
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(character_util.get_position(fo) - self.marker_pos_list[idx])
				self:apply_knock_back(fo, dir_vector)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 어택레인지 이펙트 해제
	for idx = #self.fx_attack_range, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_attack_range[idx])
		table.remove(self.fx_attack_range, idx)
	end

	self.fx_attack_range = {}

	--- 돌 이펙트 해제
	for idx = #self.rock_fx_list, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.rock_fx_list[idx])
		table.remove(self.rock_fx_list, idx)
	end

	self.rock_fx_list = {}

	--- 안전지대 카운트용
	local safe_idx = 0

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'object')

	for idx = 1, self.zone_count do
		local zone_info = self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx]

		if zone_info then
			local target = nil

			--- 적절한 기믹 오브젝트를 가져옴
			if zone_info.zone_type == self.zone_type.none then
				target = self.gimmik_list[idx - safe_idx]

				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'rock_spawn', self.marker_pos_list[idx])
			else
				safe_idx = safe_idx + 1
				target = self.gimmik_safe_list[safe_idx]

				--- zone index list 에 safe 기믹 오브젝트를 달아줘야 한다.
				self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx].gimmik = target

				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'rock_spawn_safe', self.marker_pos_list[idx])
			end

			--- 기믹오브젝트 세팅, 부활
			target.Position = self.marker_pos_list[idx]

			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
			heal_info.sender = self.owner
			heal_info.target = target
			heal_info.heal = 10
			heal_info.isRevive = true

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:dispose()
	battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
	self.attack_range = nil

	for idx = #self.attack_range_beacon, 1, -1 do
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_beacon[idx])
		table.remove(self.attack_range_beacon, idx)
	end

	self.attack_range_beacon = nil
end

--- 한 사이클 시작 시 공통적으로 오브젝트 부활시키고 해야 할 것들
function action_state_class:setting_zone(info)
	--- 현재 남은 반복횟수
	self.repeat_remain = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 1)

	--- 현재 safezone 개수
	self.current_safe_zone = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 2)

	--- 초기화
	for idx = #self.safe_zone_idx_list, 1, -1 do
		self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx].gimmik = nil
		table.remove(self.safe_zone_idx_list, idx)
	end

	--- safezone 세팅
	self.safe_zone_idx_list = {}

	--- 어차피 safezone 이 1개는 올테니 인덱스를 3부터 시작
	for idx = 3, self.current_safe_zone + 2 do

		local zone_info = {}

		zone_info.zone_type = self.zone_type.safe
		zone_info.index = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, idx)
		zone_info.cleared = false

		self.safe_zone_idx_list[zone_info.index] = zone_info
	end

	--- 나머지 없는애들 모두 none 으로
	for idx = 1, self.zone_count do

		local zone_info = self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx]

		if not zone_info then
			zone_info = {}

			zone_info.zone_type = self.zone_type.none
			zone_info.index = idx
			zone_info.cleared = false

			self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx] = zone_info
		end
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.back)
	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'ready')
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')

	self.fx_cast = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner), parent_follow_flag.position)

	--- 무적행
	self.action:set_invincible()
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 무적끝
	self.action:unset_invincible()

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 카메라 원복
	stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_duration)
	stage_camera:Move(user_party, vector_util.zero, self.camera_duration, user_party)

	--- 초기화
	for idx = #self.safe_zone_idx_list, 1, -1 do
		self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx].gimmik = nil
		table.remove(self.safe_zone_idx_list, idx)
	end

	self.safe_zone_idx_list = {}

	--- fx 제거
	for idx = #self.fx_safe_zone, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_safe_zone[idx], true)
		table.remove(self.fx_safe_zone, idx)
	end

	self.fx_safe_zone = {}

	for idx = #self.rock_fx_list, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.rock_fx_list[idx])
		table.remove(self.rock_fx_list, idx)
	end

	self.rock_fx_list = {}

	for idx = #self.fx_beacon, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_beacon[idx])
		table.remove(self.fx_beacon, idx)
	end

	self.fx_beacon = {}

	for idx = #self.fx_beacon_safe, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_beacon_safe[idx])
		table.remove(self.fx_beacon_safe, idx)
	end

	self.fx_beacon_safe = {}

	--- 어택레인지 이펙트 해제
	for idx = #self.fx_attack_range, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_attack_range[idx])
		table.remove(self.fx_attack_range, idx)
	end

	self.fx_attack_range = {}

	if self.fx_cast then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_cast)
		self.fx_cast = nil
	end

	--- 기믹들 꺼줌
	for idx = 1, #self.gimmik_list do
		self.gimmik_list[idx].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	for idx = 1, #self.gimmik_safe_list do
		self.gimmik_safe_list[idx].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	--- 혹시모를 어택레인지 꺼줌
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_beacon do
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_beacon[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_beacon[idx])
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 샤우팅 시작 타이밍
	for idx = 0, self.repeat_count do repeat
		if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shouting_duration + (self.shouting_duration + self.gimmik_duration + self.casting_duration) * idx) then
			--- 트리거 정보 구성
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			--- 식별용 플래그 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.cast_start)
			--- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end
	until true end

	--- 바위 이펙트 떨구는 타이밍
	for idx = 0, self.repeat_count do repeat
		if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shouting_duration + self.rock_create_duration + (self.shouting_duration + self.gimmik_duration + self.casting_duration) * idx) then
			--- 트리거 정보 구성
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			--- 식별용 플래그 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.rock_create)
			--- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end
	until true end

	--- 기믹 시작 타이밍
	for idx = 0, self.repeat_count do repeat
		if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shouting_duration + self.gimmik_duration + (self.shouting_duration + self.gimmik_duration + self.casting_duration) * idx) then
			--- 트리거 정보 구성
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			--- 식별용 플래그 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.gimmik_revive)
			--- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end
	until true end

	--- 캐스팅 시작 타이밍
	for idx = 0, self.repeat_count do repeat
		if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, (self.shouting_duration + self.gimmik_duration + self.casting_duration) * (idx + 1)) then
			--- 트리거 정보 구성
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			--- 식별용 플래그 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.repeat_start)
			--- 반복횟수 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.repeat_remain - 1)

			--- 안전지대 개수 줄이고 추가
			self.current_safe_zone = math.max(self.current_safe_zone - self.decrease_safe_count, 1)
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.current_safe_zone)

			local rand_list = self.action.prepare_state:get_random_list(self.current_safe_zone, self.zone_count)

			--- 세이프존 랜덤 인덱스 추가
			for idx = 1, #rand_list do
				trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, rand_list[idx])
			end

			--- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end
	until true end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

function action_state_class:apply_knock_back(target, target_dir)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner

	damage_info.knock_back_dir = target_dir

	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_force

--- 누군가 죽음
function action_state_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	--- 사망한 fo 캐싱
	local fo = e.FieldObject

	for idx = 1, #self.safe_zone_idx_list do repeat
		local zone_info = self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx]

		--- 어차피 안전지대가 아니면 의미가 없다
		if zone_info.zone_type ~= self.zone_type.safe then
			break
		end

		--- 지금 죽은 애가 안전지대로 타겟된 애와 일치하면 플래그 올려주고 이펙트 생성
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(zone_info.gimmik, fo) then
			self.safe_zone_idx_list[idx].cleared = true

			--- 효과음 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shield')

			table.insert(self.fx_safe_zone, battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'safe', self.marker_pos_list[zone_info.index]))
		end

	until true end
end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- charge state

	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	do

--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local sync_flag = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.on_teleport then
		if self.state_machine.state == self.prepare_state then
			self.prepare_state:sync_on_teleport(info)
		end

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.action_start then
		self.action_state:sync_action_start(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.cast_start then
		if self.state_machine.state == self.action_state then
			self.action_state:sync_cast_start(info)
		end

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.rock_create then
		if self.state_machine.state == self.action_state then
			self.action_state:sync_rock_create(info)
		end

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.gimmik_revive then
		if self.state_machine.state == self.action_state then
			self.action_state:sync_gimmik_revive(info)
		end

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.repeat_start then
		if self.state_machine.state == self.action_state then
			self.action_state:sync_repeat_start(info)
		end
	end
end

	print('aaaa')

end

function local_class:set_invincible()
	if self.activate_invincible then return end
	self.activate_invincible = true

	--- attach crash behaviour
	battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.ethereal_crash_behaviour)
	--- set crash behaviour
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = self.ethereal_crash_behaviour

	-- 데미지 비헤비어 캐시
	self.damage_behaviour_cache = CS.Oak.MonsterIgnoreDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	--- 바꾸기 전에 DeathType 이식
	self.damage_behaviour_cache.DeathType = self.owner.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
	--- override 데미지 비헤비어 설정
	self.owner.OverrideDamageBehaviour = self.damage_behaviour_cache
end

function local_class:unset_invincible()
	if not self.activate_invincible then return end
	self.activate_invincible = false

	--- detach crash behaviour
	battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.ethereal_crash_behaviour)
	--- unset crash behaviour
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil

	--- 이 액션에서 설정한 데미지 비헤비어가 맞으면 그 떄만 건들임
	if self.owner.OverrideDamageBehaviour == self.damage_behaviour_cache then
		self.owner.OverrideDamageBehaviour = nil
	end
	--- 대미지 비헤비어 캐시 해제 (원본은 풀로 갔을것임)
	self.damage_behaviour_cache = nil
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_fo_destroyed_event_func = function(e) self:on_fo_destroyed_event(e) end
	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.fo_destroyed, self.on_fo_destroyed_event_func)

	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 처리 함수

	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 구독 해제
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.fo_destroyed, self.on_fo_destroyed_event_func)
	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_fo_destroyed_event_func = nil

	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 구독 해제
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)
	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_damage_event_func = nil
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	--- action state가 유효할 때만 처리
	if not self.action_state then return end
	--- 이벤트 타입 검증
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, event_type.fo_destroyed) then return end

	self.action_state:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	--- action state가 유효할 때만 처리
	if not self.action_state then return end
	--- 이벤트 타입 검증
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, event_type.damage) then return end

	--- fo 캐싱
	local fo = e.Info.target

	if not lua_helper.type_compare(fo.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.FixedHitsGimmickDamagedBehaviour)) then
		return
	end

	local hpbar = stage.FieldUIManager:GetUIByKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar, fo)

	if is_unity_null(hpbar) or not hpbar then
		return
	end

	hpbar.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * self.action_state.hp_bar_size
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossSelectorJumpPressBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region prepare state

local prepare_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 준비 시간
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 어택 레인지
	attack_range = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 점프 시작 타이밍
	jump_start_time = 0,
}
prepare_state_class.mt = { __index = prepare_state_class }

--- create action state
function prepare_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function prepare_state_class:init(param)
	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 대상 추적 시간
	self.tracking_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TrackingDuration')

		action_start = 2,
	}

	self.center_gap = self.owner.Bounds.center.z - self.owner.Position.z

	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone(self.owner.Position).Bounds
	self.stomp_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(zone_bound.center - vector(0, 0, self.center_gap), zone_bound.size - self.owner.Bounds.size);

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지

end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function prepare_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 여기서 최초 한번 갱신
	self.target_pos = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertPositionToInsideOfBounds(self.stomp_bound, self.target.Position, 0);
	--- 트래킹 진행 여부
	self.is_tracking = true

	--- 타겟팅 되었음을 배포
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, self.target)
end

--- action state enter
function prepare_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 락
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_vector))
	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')

	--- 어택 레인지 활성화
	battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)

	--- 포지션 업데이트
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)

	--- 어택레인지 갱신
	self:update_attack_range(self.target_pos)

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)

	self.jump_start_time = 0
end

function prepare_state_class:update_attack_range(position)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, position)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)
end

function prepare_state_class:exit(new_state)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	if not new_state then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

		--- 만약 점프중에 취소된거면 위치도 되돌려줌
		if 0 < self.jump_start_time then
			local half_timer = (self.prepare_duration - self.jump_start_time) / 2

			if self.current_time_passed < self.jump_start_time + half_timer then
				self.owner.Position = self.jump_start_pos
			else
				self.owner.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner))
			end
		end
	end

	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
end

--- 싱크 받았으면 점프를 해야함
function prepare_state_class:sync(info)
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	self.is_tracking = false

	--- 점프 시작 포지션
	self.start_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'jump')

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'jump')
	--- 점프 시작 시간 기록
	self.jump_start_time = self.current_time_passed
	--- 점프 시작 위치 기록
	self.jump_start_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner))
end

function prepare_state_class:dispose()
	battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)
	--- 준비 상태 완료하여 싱크 보낼 예정인가
	local prepare_ready = is_usable_routine and time_passed >= self.prepare_duration
	--- 이번 프레임에 싱크를 진행할 수 있는가 (로컬인 경우에만 허용한다)
	local can_sync_now = is_usable_routine and not prepare_ready

	--- 트래킹 하는 동안 대상의 방향을 갱신함
	if self.is_tracking and self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = self.action:selector_set_locked_target(self.target, self.dir_vector)

		--- 포지션 업데이트
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
			self.target_pos = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertPositionToInsideOfBounds(self.stomp_bound, self.target.Position, 0);
		end

		--- 어택레인지도 갱신
		self:update_attack_range(self.target_pos)
	end

	--- 점프가 시작되었다면
	if 0 < self.jump_start_time then
		local half_timer = (self.prepare_duration - self.jump_start_time) / 2

		if time_passed < self.jump_start_time + half_timer then
			--- 올라가는중
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(time_passed - self.jump_start_time, 0, 1, half_timer))
			self.owner.Position = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + vector_util.up * self.jump_height * progress

		else
			--- 내려가는중
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuart(time_passed - self.jump_start_time - half_timer, 0, 1, half_timer))
			self.owner.Position = self.target_pos + vector_util.up * 30 * (1 - progress)
		end

		--- 애니메이션 지정
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_start_time + half_timer) then
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
		end

		--- 애니메이션 지정
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration - 0.2) then
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action_end')
		end
	end

	--- tracking 끝, 방향 고정 싱크 필요
	if can_sync_now and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.tracking_duration) then
		--- 싱크를 하지 않도록 변경한다.
		can_sync_now = false

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.track_end)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos)
		--- 점프 시작
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(self.owner))
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- prepare 끝
	if prepare_ready then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.action_start)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

--- 돌진 후 액션
local actions_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신

	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,

	--- 폭발 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}

--- create action state

---- parsing battle action data
function actions_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')

	--- 넉백
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce', 1)
	--- 2차 들가기전 대기
	self.donut_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DonutDelay')

	--- 2차공격 여부
	self.is_additional_attack = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(param, 'IsAdditionalAttack')

	--- 상태 유지시간
	self.state_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')

	--- 1차 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompRadius1')
	--- 2차 반지름
	local radius_outer = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompRadius2')
	--- 2차 내부 반지름
	local radius_inner = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompRadius2Inner')

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 어택 레인지
	if self.is_additional_attack then
		self.attack_range_donut = battle_range_util.create_donut(radius_inner, radius_outer, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function actions_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function actions_state_class:dispose()
	if self.attack_range_donut then
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_donut)
	end
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function actions_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

	local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'stomp')

	--- 원지름 판정
	if 0 < #fo_list then
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, self.target_pos)
		end
	end

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'stomp_1', self.target_pos)

	--- 어택 레인지 활성화
	if self.is_additional_attack then
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'stomp_2')

		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_donut, self.donut_delay)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_donut, self.target_pos)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range_donut)
	end
end

--- action state enter
function actions_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
end

function actions_state_class:exit(new_state)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	if not new_state then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end

	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))

	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	if self.is_additional_attack then
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_donut)
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_donut)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function actions_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 도넛 차징 애니메이션 각자 해버리기
	if self.is_additional_attack and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.3) then
		--- 애니메이션 지정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'stomp_2')
	end

	--- 도넛 내려찍는 애니메이션 각자 해버리기
	if self.is_additional_attack and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.donut_delay - 0.1) then
		--- 애니메이션 지정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'stomp_2_end')
	end

	--- 도넛
	if self.is_additional_attack and is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.donut_delay) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 추가공격이 없다면 여기서 끝내자.
	if not self.is_additional_attack and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function actions_state_class:apply_damage(target, target_pos)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = (character_util.get_position(target) - target_pos).normalized
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_force

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')

	--- 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompRadius2')
	self.radius_inner = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompRadius2Inner')

	--- 자기장 반지름
	self.radius_start = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompRadiusField')
	self.radius_end = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompFieldEnd')

	--- 도넛 충돌체
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_donut(self.radius_inner, self.radius, 2)
	self.calculator_donut = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 자기장 필드 정보
	self.field_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FieldDelay')
	self.field_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FieldDuration')
	self.field_damage_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FieldDamageDuration')
	local field_damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FieldDamageTerm')

	--- 대기 시간
	local post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')

	--- 자기장 필드 반지름
	self.radius_field = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FieldRadius')

	--- 움직여야하는 자기장 필드 충돌체
	self.collision_info_field = collision_info_util.create_donut(self.radius_start - self.radius_field, self.radius_start, 2, self.field_delay + self.field_damage_duration, field_damage_term)
	self.calculator_field = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info_field)

	--- 상태 유지시간
	self.state_duration = self.field_delay + self.field_duration + post_duration
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function field_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

	--- 그냥 시작하자마자 판정
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator_donut, self.target_pos)

	--- 도넛 판정
	if 0 < #fo_list then
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo)
		end
	end

	--- 2차 범위 이펙트
	self.fx_stomp_2 = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'stomp_2', self.target_pos)

	--- 위치 조정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_field, self.target_pos)
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator_field)
	self.collision_info_field.OuterRadius = self.radius
	self.collision_info_field.InnerRadius = self.radius - self.radius_field
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_field)

	--- 이펙트 해제
	if self.fx_field then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_field, true)
		self.fx_field = nil
	end

	if self.fx_stomp_2 then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_stomp_2)
		self.fx_stomp_2 = nil
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.field_delay) then
		if self.fx_stomp_2 then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_stomp_2)
			self.fx_stomp_2 = nil
		end

		--- 점점 줄어야 할 필드 이펙트
		self.fx_field = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'stomp_3', self.target_pos)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.field_delay, self.field_delay + self.field_duration) then
		local progress = (time_passed - self.field_delay) / self.field_duration

		--- 점점 좁혀드는
		self.collision_info_field.OuterRadius = self.radius_end + (self.radius - self.radius_end) * (1 - progress)
		self.collision_info_field.InnerRadius = self.radius_end - self.radius_field + (self.radius - self.radius_end) * (1 - progress)

		local ratio = self.collision_info_field.OuterRadius / self.radius_start

		--- outer radius 의 비율 대로 이펙트 크기 조정
		self.fx_field.transform.localScale = vector(ratio, 1, ratio)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.field_delay + self.field_damage_duration) then
		--- 판정 동작 중 처리
		if is_usable_routine and area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator_field) then
			--- 판정 체크
			local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator_field, dt)

			--- 데미지 부여
			if 0 < #fo_list then
				for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
					self:apply_damage(fo)
				end
			end

			--- 판정이 종료되었을때
			if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator_field) then
				--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
				area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_field)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	self.level = level

	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- charge state
	self.action_state = actions_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정

	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.field_state.machine = self.state_machine

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	do

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end

	do

		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.prepare_state, self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.prepare_state = nil
		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지

end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지

function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.prepare_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.prepare_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.prepare_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local sync_flag = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.track_end then
		--- 준비 상태가 이미 지나갔다면 굳이 싱크 처리할 필요가 없다.
		if self.state_machine.state == self.prepare_state then
			self.prepare_state:sync(info)
		end

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.action_start then
		self.action_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)

	else
		self.field_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.field_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

function local_class:selector_set_locked_target(target, dir_vector)
	if is_unity_null(target) or character_util.is_dead(target) then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(dir_vector))

		return nil, dir_vector
	end

	dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.cs_action.Character, target)

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(dir_vector.magnitude) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.cs_action.Character))
	end

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(dir_vector))

	return target, dir_vector
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossSelectorSpreadBallBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region prepare state

local prepare_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 준비 시간
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 어택 레인지
	attack_range = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
prepare_state_class.mt = { __index = prepare_state_class }

--- create action state
function prepare_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function prepare_state_class:init(param)
	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 대상 추적 시간
	self.tracking_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TrackingDuration')

	--- 싱크 유형
	self.sync_type = {
		track_end = 1,
		action_start = 2
	}

	self.target_pos_list = {}

	--- 볼 생성 개수
	self.ball_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CreateBallCount')
	--- 볼 생성 거리
	self.ball_distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BallDistance')
	--- 볼 생성 각도
	self.ball_angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BallAngle')

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 어택 레인지
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.ball_count do
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, battle_range_util.create_circle(radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward))
	end
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function prepare_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function prepare_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 타겟 위치 캐싱
	self.target_pos_list = self:get_spread_pos()

	--- 타겟팅 되었음을 배포
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, self.target)
end

function prepare_state_class:get_spread_pos()
	local pos_list = {}

	local dest_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)

	--- 맵 센터로 향하는 dir vector
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)
	local dir_to_center = vector_util.normalized(zone_bound.center - dest_pos)

	if self.ball_count <= 1 then
		table.insert(pos_list, dest_pos + dir_to_center * self.ball_distance)
		return pos_list
	end

	for idx = 0, self.ball_count - 1 do
		--- 인덱스 각도만큼 돌려주자
		local spread_pos = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, (-self.ball_angle / 2) + (self.ball_angle) * idx, 0) * dir_to_center

		--- 순서대로 넣어줌
		table.insert(pos_list, dest_pos + spread_pos * self.ball_distance)
	end

	return pos_list
end

--- action state enter
function prepare_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')

	for idx = 1, self.ball_count do
		--- 어택 레인지 활성화
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_list[idx], self.prepare_duration)
		--- 어택레인지 갱신
		self:update_attack_range(self.attack_range_list[idx], self.target_pos_list[idx])
	end

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)
end

function prepare_state_class:update_attack_range(attack_range, position)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, position)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, attack_range)
end

function prepare_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	for idx = 1, self.ball_count do
		--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
end

function prepare_state_class:dispose()
	for idx = #self.attack_range_list, 1, -1 do
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- prepare 끝
	if is_usable_routine and time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 목표 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(self.owner))

		--- 생성 위치
		for idx = 1, self.ball_count do
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos_list[idx])
		end

		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

--endregion

		table.insert(self.target_pos_list, trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, idx))
		table.insert(self.current_pos_list, trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, idx))
	end

	--- 변수 초기화
	self.current_angle = 0
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'ball')

	--- 충돌체 세팅
	for idx = 1, self.ball_count do
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_list[idx], self.current_pos_list[idx])
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator_list[idx])
	end

	--- 이펙트 세팅
	for idx = #self.ball_fx_list, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.ball_fx_list[idx])
		self.ball_fx_list[idx] = nil
	end

	self.ball_fx_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.ball_count do
		table.insert(self.ball_fx_list, battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'attack', self.current_pos_list[idx]))
	end
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 충돌체 끝
	for idx = 1, self.ball_count do
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_list[idx])
	end

	for idx = #self.ball_fx_list, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.ball_fx_list[idx])
		self.ball_fx_list[idx] = nil
	end

	self.ball_fx_list = {}
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 히트 타이밍때 데미지와 장판 트리거
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.action_duration) then

		--- 진행도
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed - self.ball_delay , 0, 1, self.action_duration - self.ball_delay)
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress, 1)

		for idx = 1, self.ball_count do
			--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
			self.current_pos_list[idx] = vector_util.lerp(self.target_pos_list[idx], self.dest_pos, progress)

			effect_util.update_object(self.ball_fx_list[idx], self.current_pos_list[idx])

			if is_usable_routine and area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator_list[idx]) then
				--- 충돌체 위치 조정
				area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_list[idx], self.current_pos_list[idx])

				--- 판정 체크
				local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator_list[idx], dt)

				--- 데미지 부여
				if 0 < #fo_list then
					for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
						self:apply_damage(fo)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	--- 액션 끝나면 콜라이더를 끝냄
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		for idx = 1, self.ball_count do
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_list[idx])
		end

		for idx = #self.ball_fx_list, 1, -1 do
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.ball_fx_list[idx])
			self.ball_fx_list[idx] = nil
		end

		self.ball_fx_list = {}
	end

	--- 투사체 발사
	for idx = 1, #self.shoot_timing_list do repeat
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing_list[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 개수만큼 발사
		for ball_idx = 1, self.ball_count do
			for shoot_idx = 1, self.shoot_count do
				--- 발사할 각도를 먼저 계산
				local shoot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.current_angle + self.spread_angle * (shoot_idx - 1), 0) * vector_util.forward

				shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], self.current_pos_list[ball_idx], shoot_dir)

				--- 쐈으니 돌려준다.
				self.current_angle = self.current_angle + self.rotate_angle
			end
		end
	until true end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 위치 캐싱
	local hit_pos = hit_info.position

	--- 부딫혔으니 폭발
	self:on_explosion(hit_pos)

	--- 관통 없음
	return true
end

function action_state_class:on_explosion(target_pos)
	--- 폭발 연출
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[1], target_pos)

	--- 폭발 판정
	for _, fo in pairs(area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator_proj, target_pos)) do
		self:apply_damage(fo)
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- projectile state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.prepare_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.prepare_state, self.action_state)

		self.prepare_state = nil
		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.prepare_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.prepare_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.prepare_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- projectile state가 유효할 때만 처리
	if not self.action_state then return true end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}
