--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossSelectorStompAttackBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region prepare state

local prepare_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 준비 시간
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 어택 레인지
	attack_range_list = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
prepare_state_class.mt = { __index = prepare_state_class }

--- create action state
function prepare_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function prepare_state_class:init(param)
	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 대상 추적 시간
	self.tracking_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TrackingDuration')
	--- 나올 갯수
	self.collision_count = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CollisionCount')

	--- 싱크 유형
	self.sync_type = {
		track_end = 1,
		action_start = 2,
		apply_damage = 3,
		cast_start = 4,
	}

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 각도
	local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')

	--- 어택 레인지 갯수만큼 추가
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.collision_count do
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, battle_range_util.create_arc(radius, angle, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward))
	end
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function prepare_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function prepare_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 타겟 위치 캐싱
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
	--- 트래킹 진행 여부
	self.is_tracking = true

	--- 타겟팅 되었음을 배포
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, self.target)
end

--- action state enter
function prepare_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'ready')

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')

	--- 어택 레인지 활성화
	for idx = 1, self.collision_count do
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_list[idx], self.prepare_duration)
	end

	--- 어택레인지 갱신
	self:update_attack_range(character_util.get_position(self.owner), self.dir_vector)

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)
end

function prepare_state_class:update_attack_range(position, direction)
	for idx = 1, self.collision_count do
		--- collision count 에 비례해 돌려준다.
		local range_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, (360 / self.collision_count) * idx, 0) * direction

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[idx], position, range_dir)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end
end

function prepare_state_class:exit(new_state)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	if not new_state then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	for idx = 1, self.collision_count do
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
end

--- 방향 싱크를 받아옴
function prepare_state_class:sync(info)
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	self.is_tracking = false
end

function prepare_state_class:dispose()
	for idx = #self.attack_range_list, 1, -1 do
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	self.attack_range_list = {}
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)
	--- 준비 상태 완료하여 싱크 보낼 예정인가
	local prepare_ready = is_usable_routine and time_passed >= self.prepare_duration
	--- 이번 프레임에 싱크를 진행할 수 있는가 (로컬인 경우에만 허용한다)
	local can_sync_now = is_usable_routine and not prepare_ready

	--- 트래킹 하는 동안 대상의 방향을 갱신함
	if self.is_tracking and self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = self.action:selector_set_locked_target(self.target, self.dir_vector)

		--- 어택레인지도 갱신
		self:update_attack_range(character_util.get_position(self.owner), self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- tracking 끝, 방향 고정 싱크 필요
	if can_sync_now and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.tracking_duration) then
		--- 싱크를 하지 않도록 변경한다.
		can_sync_now = false

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.track_end)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- prepare 끝
	if prepare_ready then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.action_start)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

--endregion

--region post state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,

	--- 폭발 판정 계산기
	calculator_list = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')

	--- 넉백
	self.knockback_force = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce')
	--- 스턴시간
	self.stun_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StunDuration')
	--- 나올 갯수
	self.collision_count = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CollisionCount')

	--- 반복 횟수
	self.repeat_count = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RepeatCount')
	--- 반복 횟수
	self.repeat_angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RepeatAngle')
	--- 반복 횟수
	self.repeat_range_interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RepeatAttackRangeInterval')
	--- 반복 횟수
	self.repeat_interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RepeatInterval')

	--- 남은 횟수
	self.remain_repeat = self.repeat_count

	--- 액션 시간
	local action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 대기 시간
	local post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 각도
	local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')

	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.calculator_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.collision_count do
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, 2)
		table.insert(self.calculator_list, area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info))
	end

	--- 상태 유지시간
	self.state_duration = (self.repeat_range_interval + self.repeat_interval) * (self.repeat_count) + post_duration

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 각도
	local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')

	--- 어택 레인지 갯수만큼 추가
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.collision_count do
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, battle_range_util.create_arc(radius, angle, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward))
	end

	self.hit_timing_list = {}

	for idx = 0, self.repeat_count do
		table.insert(self.hit_timing_list, (self.repeat_range_interval + self.repeat_interval) * (idx - 1))
	end

	self.range_timing_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.repeat_count do
		table.insert(self.range_timing_list, self.repeat_range_interval + (self.repeat_range_interval + self.repeat_interval) * (idx - 1))
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

function action_state_class:sync_cast_start(info)
	local calculate_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')

	--- 어택 레인지 활성화
	for idx = 1, self.collision_count do
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_list[idx], self.repeat_interval)

		local range_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, (360 / self.collision_count) * idx, 0) * self.dir_vector

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[idx], calculate_pos, range_dir)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end
end

function action_state_class:sync_apply_damage(info)

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	for idx = 1, self.collision_count do
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.2)

	local calculate_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	local damage_idx = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 1)

	--- 효과음 출력
	if damage_idx == 0 then
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'stomp')
	elseif damage_idx == 1 then
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'stomp_1')
	else
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'stomp_2')
	end

	--- 원지름 판정
	for idx = 1, self.collision_count do

		--- collision count 에 비례해 돌려준다.
		local direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, (360 / self.collision_count) * idx, 0) * dir_vector

		--- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'attack', calculate_pos, direction)

		for _, fo in pairs(area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator_list[idx], calculate_pos, direction)) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, direction)
		end
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	for idx = 1, self.collision_count do
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end
end

function action_state_class:dispose()
	for idx = #self.attack_range_list, 1, -1 do
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	self.attack_range_list = {}
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	for idx = 0, self.repeat_count do repeat
		if not is_usable_routine then
			break
		end

		--- 히트 타이밍때 데미지와 장판 트리거
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, (self.repeat_range_interval + self.repeat_interval) * idx) then
			--- 트리거 정보 구성
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			--- 식별용 플래그 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.apply_damage)
			--- 인덱스 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, idx)
			--- 방향 정보 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
			--- 위치 정보 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(self.owner))
			--- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end
	until true end

	for idx = 1, self.repeat_count do repeat
		if not is_usable_routine then
			break
		end

		--- 히트 타이밍때 데미지와 장판 트리거
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.repeat_range_interval + (self.repeat_range_interval + self.repeat_interval) * (idx - 1)) then
			--- 트리거 정보 구성
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			--- 식별용 플래그 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.cast_start)
			--- 방향 정보 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.repeat_angle, 0) * self.dir_vector)
			--- 위치 정보 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(self.owner))
			--- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end
	until true end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, dir_vector)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 스턴 추가
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration

	local knock_back_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
	knock_back_dir = vector_util.is_almost_zero(knock_back_dir) and dir_vector or knock_back_dir

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_back_dir
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knockback_force

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- projectile state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.prepare_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.prepare_state, self.action_state)

		self.prepare_state = nil
		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.prepare_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.prepare_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.prepare_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local sync_flag = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.track_end then
		--- 준비 상태가 이미 지나갔다면 굳이 싱크 처리할 필요가 없다.
		if self.state_machine.state == self.prepare_state then
			self.prepare_state:sync(info)
		end

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.action_start then
		if self.state_machine.state == self.prepare_state then
			self.action_state:sync(info)
			self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
		end

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.apply_damage then
		if self.state_machine.state == self.action_state then
			self.action_state:sync_apply_damage(info)
		end

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.cast_start then
		if self.state_machine.state == self.action_state then
			self.action_state:sync_cast_start(info)
		end
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

function local_class:selector_set_locked_target(target, dir_vector)
	if is_unity_null(target) or character_util.is_dead(target) then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self:selector_to_direction(dir_vector))

		return nil, dir_vector
	end

	dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.cs_action.Character, target)

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(dir_vector.magnitude) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.cs_action.Character))
	end

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self:selector_to_direction(dir_vector))

	return target, dir_vector
end

function local_class:selector_to_direction(v)
	if v.magnitude == 0 then
		return CS.Oak.Direction.None
	end

	if math.abs(v.x) >= math.abs(v.z) then
		if v.x > 0 then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		else
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end
	else
		if v.z > 0 then
			if v.x > 0 then
				return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			else
				return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			end
		else
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossSelectorTrackingBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region prepare state

local prepare_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 준비 시간
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 어택 레인지
	attack_range = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 점프 시작 타이밍
	jump_start_time = 0,
}
prepare_state_class.mt = { __index = prepare_state_class }

--- create action state
function prepare_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function prepare_state_class:init(param)
	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 점프 준비 시간
	self.jump_prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpPrepareDuration')
	--- aoe 깔리는 타이밍
	self.aoe_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AoeDelay')

	--- 싱크 유형
	self.sync_type = {
		aoe_start = 1,
		jump_start = 2,
		action_start = 3,
		shoot_proj = 4,
		sync_target = 5,
	}

	--- 카메라 사이즈
	self.camera_size = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CameraSize', 10)
	self.camera_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CameraDuration', 2)

	--- 안전지대 범위
	self.safe_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SafeRadius')

	--- 현재 존
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)

	--- AOE 정보 세팅
	self.aoe_damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'AoeDamageType')
	self.aoe_spec = CS.Oak.AreaOfEffectManager.AoeSpecParams()
	self.aoe_spec.shape = CS.AttackRangeShape.Rectangle
	self.aoe_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, "AoeAttackFactor")
	self.aoe_spec.rectSize = vector(zone_bound.size.x, zone_bound.size.z)
	self.aoe_spec.duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, "AoeDuration")
	self.aoe_spec.damageTerm = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, "AoeTerm")

	--- AOE 콜백
	self.on_aoe_hit_func = function(target, dir_vector, modifier, _) self:on_aoe_hit(target, dir_vector, modifier) end
	self.on_aoe_finish_func = function(is_immediate, pos) self:on_aoe_finish(is_immediate, pos) end

	--- state duration
	self.state_duration = self.prepare_duration + self.jump_prepare_duration
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function prepare_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function prepare_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function prepare_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 싱크 받으면 각자 현재 존을 보고 aoe 를 깐다
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)

	--- 카메라 세팅
	stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)

	--- 타겟팅 되었음을 배포
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, target)
end

--- action state enter
function prepare_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 타겟 초기화
	self.target = nil

	--- 방향 락
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_vector))
	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)

	self.jump_start_time = 0
end

function prepare_state_class:exit(new_state)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	if not new_state then
		--- 애니메이션 해제
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		--- 방향 해제
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		--- 카메라 원복
		stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_duration)
	end

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
end

--- aoe 깔아줌
function prepare_state_class:sync_aoe(info)
	--- 싱크 받으면 각자 현재 존을 보고 aoe 를 깐다
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'aoe')

	self.safe_pos = zone_bound.center

	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.owner, self.safe_pos, nil, self.aoe_spec,
		self.on_aoe_hit_func, nil, self.on_aoe_finish_func)

	self.action:play_aoe_fx(self.safe_pos)
end

function prepare_state_class:dispose()
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 트래킹 하는 동안 대상의 방향을 갱신함
	if is_usable_routine and not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
		self.target = self.action.action_state:research_target()
	end

	--- aoe 시작해야 하는 타이밍
	if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.aoe_delay) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.aoe_start)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- prepare 끝
	if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.jump_start)
		--- 내 위치 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, character_util.get_position(self.owner))
		--- 방향 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

function prepare_state_class:on_aoe_finish(is_immediate, pos)
	self.action:dispose_aoe_fx()
end

function prepare_state_class:on_aoe_hit(target, dir_vector, modifier)
	-- aoe 스팩이 유효하지 않다면 이미 해제된 것으로 간주한다.
	if not self.aoe_spec then
		return
	end

	--- 대상이 안전범위 내에 있으면
	if vector_util.magnitude(self.safe_pos - character_util.get_position(target)) < self.safe_radius then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.aoe_damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp_mod(target) * self.aoe_modifier)
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

---- parsing battle action data
function jump_state_class:init(param)
	--- 점프 길이
	self.jump_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpDuration')
	--- 점프 높이
	self.jump_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpHeight')

	--- 무적버프 정보
	self.no_damage_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'NoDamageBuff')

	--- 점프 시간
	self.jump_time_passed = 0

	self.camera_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CameraDuration', 2)

	--- 점프뛸 마커를 가져와야 한다.
	local marker_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpMarkerName')
	self.jump_marker_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(field:GetMarker(marker_name).position)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function jump_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function jump_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 점프 시작 위치
	self.jump_start_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function jump_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 락
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_vector))
	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'jump')
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')

	--- 점프 시간
	self.jump_time_passed = 0
	--- 크래시 비헤이비어 세팅
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	--- 점프 들어갈 때 무적버프
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.no_damage_buff_info)
end

function jump_state_class:exit(new_state)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 크래시 비헤이비어 제거
	battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour)
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil

	if not new_state then
		--- 애니메이션 해제
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
		character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
		-- 방향 해제
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		--- 카메라 원복
		stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_duration)
	end

	--- 무적버프 제거
	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.no_damage_buff_info.name)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function jump_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 점프시켜줌
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.jump_duration) then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.jump_time_passed / self.jump_duration)

		self.jump_time_passed = self.jump_time_passed + dt

		local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * self.jump_height

		self.current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.jump_start_pos, self.jump_marker_pos, progress)
			+ unity_class.vector3.up * h

		self.owner.Position = self.current_pos
	end

	--- 점프 끝
	if is_usable_routine and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.action_start)
		--- 점프 목표 위치 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.jump_marker_pos)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 시간
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 대기 시간
	local post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')

	--- 쏘는 간격
	self.shoot_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTerm')
	--- 최소 사거리
	self.shoot_min_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjRadiusMin')
	--- 최대 사거리
	self.shoot_max_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjRadiusMax')

	--- 카메라 사이즈
	self.camera_size = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CameraSize', 10)
	self.camera_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CameraDuration', 2)

	--- 투사체 시작 개수
	self.shoot_start_num = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootNum')
	--- 투사체 추가 개수
	self.shoot_plus = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootNumPlus')
	--- 투사체 최대개수
	self.shoot_max_num = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootNumMax')

	--- 예외 각도
	self.exception_angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExceptionAngle')

	--- 현재 쏴야할 개수
	self.current_shoot_count = self.shoot_start_num

	--- 투사체 인덱스
	self.shoot_start_idx = 10
	self.shoot_index = self.shoot_start_idx

	--- 상태 유지시간
	self.state_duration = self.action_duration + post_duration

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지

function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 혹시 모르니깐 점프 끝나는 위치로 싱크
	local jump_target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

	self.owner.Position = jump_target_pos

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.2)
end

--- 타겟 싱크
function action_state_class:sync_target(info)
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 락
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, direction_util.down)

	--- 어차피 보스 존이 달라지진 않을 테니 enter 올때 각자 존 보고 센터포지션 캐싱
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)
	self.safe_pos = zone_bound.center

	--- 현재 쏴야할 개수 초기화
	self.current_shoot_count = self.shoot_start_num
	self.shoot_index = self.shoot_start_idx

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.action_duration)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 심볼도 해제
	self.action.field_state:dispose_symbol()

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)

	--- 카메라 원복
	stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_duration)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)

	--- 현재 타겟이 유효한지 계속 체크 필요
	if is_usable_routine and not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
		self.target = self:research_target()
	end

	--- 투사체 발사
	for idx = 1, math.floor(self.action_duration / self.shoot_term) do repeat
		if not is_usable_routine then
			break
		end

		--- 각 슛 텀마다 투사체를 쏴야한다.
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_term * idx) then
			break
		end

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 식별용 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.shoot_proj)
		--- 쏠 개수
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.current_shoot_count)

		--- 쏴야할 위치를 랜덤하게 설정
		for idx = 1, self.current_shoot_count do
			--- 예외 각도 빼고 랜덤 각도
			local angle = (random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5) * self.exception_angle
			local rand_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0) * vector_util.forward
			local rand_amount = unity_class.random.Range(self.shoot_min_radius, self.shoot_max_radius)

			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, rand_dir * rand_amount + self.safe_pos)

			--- 투사체 식별용 라벨에 쓸 인덱스를 여기서 갱신한다
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.shoot_index)
			self.shoot_index = self.shoot_index + 1
		end

		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

		--- 쏠 개수 갱신
		self.current_shoot_count = math.min(self.current_shoot_count + self.shoot_plus, self.shoot_max_num)
	until true end

	--- 액션 기간이 끝났으면 다시 내려와야함
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
		attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)

		--- 애니메이션 지정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action_end')
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:research_target()
	--- 내가 속한 전투에서 타겟을 찾음
	local battle = battle_manager_util.get_battle_for(self.owner)

	if not battle then
		return nil
	end

	--- 타겟 테이블
	local target_table = battle_manager_util.get_targets(self.owner)

	--- 타겟 랜덤하게 선정
	local target = target_table[random_util.get_random_int(1, #target_table)]

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	--- 식별용 플래그 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action.prepare_state.sync_type.sync_target)
	--- 타겟 싱크
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)

	--- 싱크 배포
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return target
end

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')

	--- 투사체 잠시 대기할 시간
	self.proj_delay_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjDelayDuration')

	--- 투사체 싱크 정보를 들고있을거
	self.proj_info_list = {}

	--- line 이펙트를 위해 투사체 객체를 들고있을 것
	self.proj_instance_list = {}

	--- 슈터 생성
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 투사체 데이터 파싱 및 생성
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 큰 투사체 쏴야하는 최소 갯수
	self.big_proj_min_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'BigProjMinCount')

	--- 클래스별 데미지 계수
	local modifier_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ClassSpecificModifier')

	--- 요기 버프
	local youkai_buff = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'YoukaiBuff')
	self.youkai_buff_id = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name('coop_expedition_stackable_youkai').Id

	self.class_modifier = {}

	self.class_modifier[CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionClass.Dealer] = modifier_list[1]
	self.class_modifier[CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionClass.Tanker] = modifier_list[2]
	self.class_modifier[CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionClass.Healer] = modifier_list[3]

	--- 투사체 타입
	self.proj_type = {
		normal = 1,
		big = 2
	}
	--- 징 이펙트
	self.fx_symbol = nil

	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(self.proj_spec[2]))
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function field_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 타겟 싱크
function field_state_class:sync_target(info)
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)

	--- 기존거 제거
	self:dispose_symbol()

	--- 심볼이펙트 신규 추가
	self.fx_symbol = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'symbol',
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.target).position + 0.7 * vector_util.up,
		nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.target),
		parent_follow_flag.position
	)
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync_shoot_proj(info)
	--- 쏘는 개수
	local shoot_count = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 1)

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'proj')

	for idx = 0, shoot_count - 1 do repeat
		local target_idx = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 2 + idx)

		--- 이미 이 인덱스에 뭔가 존재한다..?
		if self.proj_info_list[target_idx] then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_info_list[target_idx].fx_proj)
			self.proj_info_list[target_idx].fx_proj = nil

			self.proj_info_list[target_idx] = nil
		end

		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = {}

		sync_info.duration = self.proj_delay_duration
		sync_info.shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, idx)
		sync_info.shoot_dir = vector_util.normalized(character_util.get_position(self.target) - sync_info.shoot_pos)

		--- 큰 투사체를 쏴야할 조건이면 마지막 인덱스일 때 큰 투사체로 쏜다.
		sync_info.proj_type = (self.big_proj_min_count <= shoot_count and idx == shoot_count - 1) and self.proj_type.big or self.proj_type.normal

		sync_info.label = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 2 + idx) + sync_info.proj_type * 1000

		--- 이펙트 출력
		sync_info.fx_proj = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, sync_info.proj_type == self.proj_type.big and 'proj_big' or 'proj', sync_info.shoot_pos)

		table.insert(self.proj_info_list, sync_info)
	until true end
end

function field_state_class:on_end_action()
	self.target = nil
	self:dispose_symbol()
end

function field_state_class:dispose_symbol()
	if self.fx_symbol then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_symbol)
		self.fx_symbol = nil
	end
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 혹시나 들고있는게 있으면 모두 해제
	for idx = #self.proj_info_list, 1, -1 do repeat
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_info_list[idx].fx_proj)
		table.remove(self.proj_info_list, idx)
	until true end

	for _, proj_info in pairs(self.proj_instance_list) do repeat
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(proj_info.fx_laser)
	until true end

	self.proj_info_list = {}
	self.proj_instance_list = {}

	self:dispose_symbol()
end

function field_state_class:force_cancel()
	self:dispose_symbol()
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 보유중인 shoot 정보 탐색
	for idx = #self.proj_info_list, 1, -1 do repeat
		local sync_info = self.proj_info_list[idx]

		if 0 <= sync_info.duration then
			sync_info.duration = sync_info.duration - dt
			break
		end

		--- 기존 투사체 연출 제거
		if sync_info.fx_proj then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(sync_info.fx_proj)
			sync_info.fx_proj = nil
		end

		--- 쏜 투사체 객체를 다시 받아와 들고있어야 한다.
		local proj_info = {}

		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'contrail')

		proj_info.idx = sync_info.label
		proj_info.fx_laser = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'laser', sync_info.shoot_pos)
		proj_info.laser_component = proj_info.fx_laser:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))
		proj_info.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)

		--- label 대로 넣어줌
		self.proj_instance_list[sync_info.label] = proj_info

		--- 투사체 쏴버림
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[sync_info.proj_type],
			sync_info.shoot_pos, sync_info.shoot_dir, sync_info.label, nil, self.target)

		--- 투사체가 쏴지자마자 제거되었을 가능성이 있다..
		if self.proj_instance_list[sync_info.label] then
			self.proj_instance_list[sync_info.label].proj = self.shoot_helper[1]:GetProjectile(sync_info.label)
		end

		--- 필요없는것 제거
		table.remove(self.proj_info_list, idx)
	until true end

	--- 보유중인 proj 정보 탐색
	for _, proj_info in pairs(self.proj_instance_list) do repeat
		if not proj_info or is_unity_null(proj_info.proj) then
			self.proj_instance_list[proj_info.idx] = nil
			break
		end

		--- target to follow 가 죽었다면 라인을 제거하자.
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, proj_info.proj.targetToFollow) then
			if proj_info.fx_laser then
				proj_info.laser_component = nil
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(proj_info.fx_laser)
				proj_info.fx_laser = nil
				self.proj_instance_list[proj_info.idx] = nil
			end

			break
		end

		proj_info.target_pos = proj_info.proj.targetToFollow.Position
		local diff = proj_info.target_pos - proj_info.proj.moveInfo.position

		effect_util.update_object(proj_info.fx_laser, proj_info.proj.moveInfo.position, diff.normalized)
		proj_info.laser_component:SetFromTo(proj_info.proj.moveInfo.position, proj_info.target_pos)

	until true end
end

function field_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 대상 캐싱
	local hit_target = hit_info.target

	--- 대상 유효성 체크
	if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_target) then
		return false
	end

	local spec_proj_type = math.floor(label / 1000)

	local proj_info = self.proj_instance_list[label]

	if not proj_info then
		--- 이런 경우가 존재할까..
		return true
	end

	if proj_info.fx_laser then
		proj_info.laser_component = nil
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(proj_info.fx_laser)
		proj_info.fx_laser = nil
		self.proj_instance_list[label] = nil
	end

	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec[spec_proj_type], hit_info.position)


	if spec_proj_type == self.proj_type.big then
		--- 큰 투사체면 착지 대상 주변 데미지
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, hit_info.position)

		if 0 < #fo_list then
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				local is_youkai = character_util.has_active_buff_consider_remove(fo, self.youkai_buff_id)

				self:apply_damage(fo, is_youkai)
			end
		end

	else
		--- 아니면 단일 피해 부여
		local is_youkai = character_util.has_active_buff_consider_remove(hit_target, self.youkai_buff_id)

		self:apply_damage(hit_target, is_youkai)
	end

	--- 관통 없음
	return true
end

function field_state_class:on_deactivate(_, label)
	local proj_info = self.proj_instance_list[label]

	if proj_info and proj_info.fx_laser then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(proj_info.fx_laser)
		proj_info.fx_laser = nil
		proj_info.laser_component = nil

		self.proj_instance_list[label] = nil
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, is_youkai)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.class_modifier[character_util.get_coop_expedition_class(target)]

	if is_youkai then
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'youkai_hit')
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- jump state
	self.jump_state = jump_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- charge state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.prepare_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.jump_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(self.field_state, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.prepare_state, self.jump_state, self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.prepare_state = nil
		self.jump_state = nil
		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.field_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.prepare_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.prepare_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.prepare_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	if self.field_state then
		self.field_state:force_cancel()
	end

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local sync_flag = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.aoe_start then
		self.prepare_state:sync_aoe(info)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.jump_start then
		self.jump_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.jump_state)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.action_start then
		self.action_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.shoot_proj then
		self.field_state:sync_shoot_proj(info)

	elseif sync_flag == self.prepare_state.sync_type.sync_target then
		self.action_state:sync_target(info)
		self.field_state:sync_target(info)

	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:dispose_aoe_fx()

	if self.field_state then
		self.field_state:force_cancel()
	end
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- projectile state가 유효할 때만 처리
	if not self.field_state then return true end

	return self.field_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:on_deactivate(move_info, label)
	--- projectile state가 유효할 때만 처리
	if not self.field_state then return true end

function local_class:play_aoe_fx(position)

function local_class:dispose_aoe_fx()

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {

local local_class = newclass('BossSnakeBasicAttackBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.76)
	self.action_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDelay", 0)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.hit_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "HitAmount", 5)
	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.1)
	self.poison_buff_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "PoisonBuffId", 800083)

	self.attack_key = 'attack'

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(diff)
		self.character.Direction = direction

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
		self.is_attack_triggered = false
		self.hit_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- hit_amount 만큼 연타
	if self.is_attack_triggered and self.hit_count < self.hit_amount then
		self.next_attack_delay = self.next_attack_delay - dt
		if self.next_attack_delay <= 0 then
			self:apply_damage()
			self.next_attack_delay = self.next_attack_delay + self.damage_term
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(diff)
		self.character.Direction = direction

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.is_attack_triggered and self.time_passed >= self.action_delay then
			-- 공격 시작 플래그
			self.is_attack_triggered = true

			-- 첫 데미지
			self:apply_damage()

			-- 다음 데미지 딜레이
			self.next_attack_delay = self.damage_term - (self.time_passed - self.action_delay)

			-- TODO: 이펙트 및 사운드, time_limit 이펙트 가정
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_key, self.target.Position,
					unity_class.vector3.zero, character_util.get_transform(self.target))

			-- 독 디버프 스택
			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.target, self.poison_buff_id, 1, false, false)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_damage()
	local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = self.target
	damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = direction

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	self.hit_count = self.hit_count + 1
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSnakeCurseBattleAction')

local bomb_class = {
	action = nil,
	cs_battle_action = nil,
	owner = nil,

	time_passed = nil,
	effect = nil,
	-- 대상은 데미지를 입지 않음
	target = nil,

	damage_term = nil,
	tick_count = nil,

	bomb_key = 'bomb',
	explosion_key = 'explosion'
}
bomb_class.mt = { __index = bomb_class }

function bomb_class:new(parent_class, owner)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_battle_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.owner = owner

	local info = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = self.attack_duration
	info.Radius = self.damage_radius
	obj.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(owner, info, false, 0, -1)

	return obj
end

function bomb_class:set_param(damage_term, damage_radius, damage_modifier, attack_duration, bomb_offset, poison_buff_id)
	self.damage_term = damage_term
	self.damage_radius = damage_radius
	self.damage_modifier = damage_modifier
	self.attack_duration = attack_duration
	self.bomb_offset = bomb_offset
	self.poison_buff_id = poison_buff_id
end

function bomb_class:unset_param()
	self.damage_term = nil
	self.damage_radius = nil
	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.attack_duration = nil
	self.bomb_offset = nil
	self.poison_buff_id = nil
end

function bomb_class:activate(target)
	self.is_active = true
	self.target = target
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.tick_count = 0
	self.effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.bomb_key, self.target.Position + self.bomb_offset,
			unity_class.vector3.zero, character_util.get_transform(self.target))

	-- 게이지 ui
	if self.gauge_ui == nil then
		self.gauge_ui = {
			obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('icon_gauge'):Instantiate(target.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, target.Transform)
		}
		self.gauge_ui.ui = self.gauge_ui.obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIIconGauge))
		self.gauge_ui.ui:SetWarningValue(-1)
	end

	self.gauge_ui.ui:Init(target)

	local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('curse')
	if has_value and battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
		if sfx_info.loop then
			self.count_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('curse')
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('curse')
		end
	end
end

function bomb_class:deactivate()
	if not is_unity_null(self.effect) then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.effect)
	end

	if self.gauge_ui ~= nil and self.gauge_ui.obj ~= nil then
		self.gauge_ui.ui = nil
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.gauge_ui.obj)
		self.gauge_ui = nil
	end

	self.effect = nil

	self.is_active = false
	self.target = nil

	self.attack_calculator:End()

	if self.count_sfx then
		sfx_util.fade_out(self.count_sfx, 0.2)
	end
	self.count_sfx = nil
end

function bomb_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		local fo_list = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do repeat
			local fo = fo_list[i]
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, fo) then
				break
			end

			if not lua_helper.type_compare(fo, CS.Oak.Character) then
				break
			end

			if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, fo) then
				break
			end

			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.attack_calculator.Position).normalized
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.owner
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

			-- 독 디버프 스택
			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.poison_buff_id, 1, false, false)
		until true end
		fo_list:Dispose()

		if self.attack_calculator.IsFinished then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
	end

	self.gauge_ui.ui:SetValue((self.time_passed - (self.tick_count * self.damage_term)) / self.damage_term)

	if self.time_passed >= (self.tick_count + 1) * self.damage_term then
		self.tick_count = self.tick_count + 1
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		-- 이펙트 및 사운드, time_limit 이펙트 가정
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_key, self.target.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.explosion_key, self.target.Position)
	end
end

function bomb_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2.6)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.73)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	local damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1.1)
	local damage_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageRadius", 2.5)
	local damage_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageDuration", 0.5)
	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 3)
	local bomb_offset = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(params, 'BombOffset', vector(0, 0, 0))
	self.poison_buff_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "PoisonBuffId", 800083)
	bomb_class:set_param(damage_term, damage_radius, damage_modifier, damage_duration, bomb_offset, self.poison_buff_id)

	-- 폭탄은 1개만 생성됨
	self.bomb_instance = bomb_class:new(self, c)

	self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = function(e)
		self:on_fieldobject_destroyed_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- ui 프리로드
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('icon_gauge')

	-- 상태 초기화
	self.time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	local prev_state_duration = 0
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		prev_state_duration = self.prepare_duration
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		prev_state_duration = self.action_duration
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		prev_state_duration = self.post_duration
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		-- 폭탄 설치
		if self.bomb_instance.is_active then
			self.bomb_instance:deactivate()
		end
		self.bomb_instance:activate(self.target)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('curse', self.character.Bounds.center,
				unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.transform)

		-- 나머지 독 디버프
		-- 타겟이 유저라고 가정
		local members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.target)
		for _, member in ipairs(members) do repeat
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(member, self.target) then
				break
			end
			-- 독 디버프 스택 2개
			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, member, self.poison_buff_id, 1, false, false)
			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, member, self.poison_buff_id, 1, false, false)
		until true end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed - prev_state_duration
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.bomb_instance:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
	if self.bomb_instance.is_active then
		self.bomb_instance:deactivate()
	end
end

function local_class:on_fieldobject_destroyed_event(e)
	local fo = e.FieldObject

	if not self.bomb_instance.is_active or
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.bomb_instance.target) then
		return false
	end

	self.bomb_instance:deactivate()

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)
		self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = nil
	end

	bomb_class:unset_param()

	self.bomb_instance:dispose()
	self.bomb_instance = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	-- 내부 스테이트

	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
		if random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance then
			self.is_critical_attack = true

			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 9)--강공 여부

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		if is_unity_null(self.cast_effect) then
			self.cast_effect:Dispose()
			self.cast_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.attack_range:SetupByPosition(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self:set_ailment_resist()

		self.origin_size = stage_camera.Size
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)

		self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.is_target_seach = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.synced = false

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explode", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		--TODO:맵에 남아있는 보스의 공격잔재를 제거?
		--추후 패턴들에서 지워야될 것들에 대한 처리? 가 필요할듯? Event로받아서 지운다던지?

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:reset_ailment()

		stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_duration)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(0.1)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

--상태이상 면역
function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.prepare_duration then
		elseif CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			self.synced = true
			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
			info:AppendNumber(1)
			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_coop_expedition_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--싱크
	if idx == 1 then
		self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	elseif idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
