						battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
				self.laser_b_attack_range_list[i]:Show(self.prepare_duration)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_b_attack_range_list[i]))
			end
		end

		if not self.is_spawn_monster then
			self.origin_size = stage_camera.Size
			stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)
		end

		self.is_target_seach = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.synced = false

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.laser_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("laser_a", self.character.Position)
		local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
				unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_dir)).eulerAngles.y
		self.laser_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)

		if not self.is_spawn_monster then
			self.laser_list = {}
			for i = 1, #self.target_list do
				self.laser_b_attack_calc_list[i].Position = self.character.Position
				self.laser_b_attack_calc_list[i].Direction = self.target_dir_list[i]
				self.laser_b_attack_calc_list[i]:Start()

				local laser_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("laser_b", self.character.Position)
				local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
						unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_dir_list[i])).eulerAngles.y
				laser_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
				table.insert(self.laser_list, laser_effect)
			end
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
		self.sfx_loop = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action_loop")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if not self.is_spawn_monster then
			stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_duration)
		end
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		if not self.is_spawn_monster then
			stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(0.1)
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			if not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				self:sync_target_dir()
				if not self.is_spawn_monster then
					self:sync_target_dir_b()
				end
			end
		else
			self:update_attack_range(dt)

			if self.time_passed < self.laser_b_tracking_duration then
				if not self.is_spawn_monster then
					self:update_attack_range_b(dt)
				end
			else
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage_a(dt)
			if not self.is_spawn_monster then
				self:update_laser_b(dt)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	if idx == 5 then
		self.synced_target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--현재 로컬의 target_dir이 sync로 날라온 dir과 다르다면 자연스럽게 이동시켜준다.
		if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
			self.synced_dir_move_speed = 15
			--TODO: 현재 셋팅상 대기시간이 너무 짧기때문에 바로 싱크 옮겨줌
			self.target_dir = self.synced_target_dir
			self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.target_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end

	if idx == 6 then --LaserB 싱크
		self.synced_target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--현재 로컬의 target_dir이 sync로 날라온 dir과 다르다면 자연스럽게 이동시켜준다.
		local dir_count = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 1))
		for i = 1, dir_count do
			local sync_laser_b_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, i - 1)
			if self.target_dir_list[i] ~= sync_laser_b_dir then
				self.synced_dir_move_speed = 15
				--TODO: 현재 셋팅상 대기시간이 너무 짧기때문에 바로 싱크 옮겨줌
				self.target_dir_list[i] = sync_laser_b_dir
				self.laser_b_attack_range_list[i]:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.target_dir_list[i],
						battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_b_attack_range_list[i]))
			end
		end
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
	end

	self.target_dir = dir
	self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.target_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_attack_range_b(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.target_list do
		if not self.target_list[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_list[i].Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
			end

			self.target_dir_list[i] = dir
			self.laser_b_attack_range_list[i]:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.target_dir_list[i], battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_b_attack_range_list[i]))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync_target_dir()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 5)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.target_dir)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:sync_target_dir_b()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 6)
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, #self.target_dir_list)
	for _,v in pairs(self.target_dir_list) do
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, v)
	end
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:update_laser_b(dt)
	if self.laser_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.laser_list do
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, ((self.time_passed * self.laser_b_move_speed * 360) / 360), 0)
					* self.target_dir_list[i]
			self.laser_b_attack_calc_list[i].Direction = dir
			local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
					unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(dir)).eulerAngles.y
			self.laser_list[i].transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)

			self:update_damage_b(dt, i)
		end
	end
end

--laser a 공격 데미지
function local_class:update_damage_a(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_coop_expedition_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_modifier = self.laser_a_damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.laser_a_damage_modifier + self.laser_a_damage_modifier * self.critical_rate
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stunDuration = self.laser_a_stun_duration

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			if self.is_poison_debuff then
				-- 독 디버프 스택
				if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character))
						and (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player) ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None then
					buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.poison_buff_id, 1, false, false)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

--laser a 공격 데미지
function local_class:update_damage_b(dt, i)
	if not self.laser_b_attack_calc_list[i].IsStarted then
		self.laser_b_attack_calc_list[i]:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.laser_b_attack_calc_list[i]:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_coop_expedition_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_modifier = self.laser_b_damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.laser_b_damage_modifier + self.laser_b_damage_modifier * self.critical_rate
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stunDuration = self.laser_b_stun_duration

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			if self.is_poison_debuff then
				-- 독 디버프 스택
				buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.poison_buff_id, 1, false, false)
			end
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSnakeSpawnBattleAction')

--설명 : 매우 넓은 범위에 맹독 폭발을 만들어, 이후 지속피해를 주는 맹독 장판을 생성합니다.
-- 부채꼴 모양의 공격 후
-- 부채꼴 모양의 지속공격
-- 공격적중 시 중독 부여
-- 타겟 어그로

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	--공경 범위용 변수
	self.attack_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDistance", 10)
	self.attack_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackAngle", 100)
	self.attack_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Damagemodifier", 1)
	self.attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", 0.8)
	self.attack_stun_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackStunDuration", 2)
	self.attack_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackKnockbackForce", 1.1)

	--중독 장판용 변수
	self.poison_attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PoisonAttackDelay", 1)
	self.poison_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PoisonDistance", 8)
	self.poison_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PoisonAngle", 80)
	self.poison_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PoisonDamageModifier", 1)
	self.poison_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PoisonDuration", 1)
	self.poison_Damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PoisonDamageTerm", 0.5)
	self.poison_stun_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PoisonStunDuration", 0.15)

	self.poison_buff_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "PoisonBuffId", 800083)

	self.tracking_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TackingSpeed", 6.5)
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrackingDuration", 1.75)

	-- 카메라
	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeMagnitude", 0.2)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeDuration", 0.1)

	--해당 시간동안 어그로수치 변경 이벤트가 들어올 경우 타겟을 변경해 준다.
	self.target_search_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetSearchDuration", 2)

	self.critical_chance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CriticalDamageChance", 0.5)
	self.critical_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SuperDamageScale", 0.5)

	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	--true면 데미지를 줄때 중독디버프를 걸지 않는다.
	self.is_poison_debuff = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsNotPoisonDebuff", true)

	--소환수 전용 옵션 1타 뒤에 중독공격을 빼준다.
	self.is_spawn_monster = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsSpawnMonster", false)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_distance,
			self.attack_angle, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.Direction = unity_class.vector3.right
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = self.attack_duration
	info.Radius = self.attack_distance
	info.Angle = self.attack_angle
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 1)

	-- 중독 공격 계산기
	local poison_info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
	poison_info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	poison_info.Direction = unity_class.vector3.right
	poison_info.DamageTerm = self.poison_Damage_term
	poison_info.Duration = self.poison_duration
	poison_info.Radius = self.poison_distance
	poison_info.Angle = self.poison_angle
	poison_info.Height = 3
	self.poison_attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, poison_info, true, 0, 99)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.synced = nil
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_target_seach = false
	self.target = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.synced_target_dir = nil
	self.is_start_delay_poison_attack = false
	self.poison_attack_delay_time_passed = 0
	self.is_start_poison_attack = false
	self.poison_attack_time_passed = 0
	self.synced_dir_move_speed = 15

	self.is_action_end_ani = false
	self.end_ani_duration = 0.433

	self.on_aggro_change_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent),
			self.on_aggro_change_event_func)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare and self.time_passed < self.target_search_duration then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.Target) then
			self.target = e.Target
			self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.target_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
			if self.show_target_arrow then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false
	self.target = target
	self.synced_target_dir = nil
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_target_seach = false
	self.is_start_delay_poison_attack = false
	self.poison_attack_delay_time_passed = 0
	self.is_start_poison_attack = false
	self.poison_attack_time_passed = 0
	--TODO: 중동공격이 남아있는 상태에서 다시 중독공격이 시작되면 해제해 줘야하나?

	if not self.is_spawn_monster then
		--강공 발동 여부
		if CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			if random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance then
				self.is_critical_attack = true
				local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

				trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 9)--강공 여부
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
			end
		end
	end

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and self.target or nil)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self.attack_range:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

	if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	end

	self.is_start_poison_attack = false
	if self.poison_attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.poison_attack_calculator:End()
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.target_dir, self.character.Position.y)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.is_target_seach = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		local blast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blast", self.character.Position)
		local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
				unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_dir)).eulerAngles.y
		blast_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)

		--중독공격 딜레이타임 시작
		self.is_start_delay_poison_attack = true

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.is_action_end_ani = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action_end")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:start_poison_attack()
	--TODO: 중독 이팩트 + 공격 시작
	self.poison_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("poison", self.character.Position)
	local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
			unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_dir)).eulerAngles.y
	self.poison_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)

	self.poison_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	self.poison_attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
	self.poison_attack_calculator:Start()

	self.is_start_poison_attack = true
	self.poison_attack_time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_start_delay_poison_attack and not self.is_spawn_monster then
		self.poison_attack_delay_time_passed = self.poison_attack_delay_time_passed + dt
		if self.poison_attack_delay_time_passed >= self.poison_attack_delay then
			self.is_start_delay_poison_attack = false
			self:start_poison_attack()
		end
	else
	end

	if self.is_start_poison_attack then
		self:update_poison_attack(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
				self:update_attack_range(dt)
			elseif not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				self:sync_target_dir()
			elseif self.synced and self.synced_target_dir ~= nil and self.target_dir ~= nil then
				if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
					self:update_sync_dir(dt)
				end
			end

			if self.show_target_arrow and self.time_passed > self.target_search_duration and self.is_target_seach then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
				self.is_target_seach = false
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		else
			if self.is_action_end_ani then
				if self.time_passed >= self.end_ani_duration then
					self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
					self.is_action_end_ani = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync_target_dir()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 5)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.target_dir)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--호스트의 마지막 TargetDir에 맞춰서 싱크
	if idx == 5 then
		self.synced_target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--현재 로컬의 target_dir이 sync로 날라온 dir과 다르다면 자연스럽게 이동시켜준다.
		if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
			self.synced_dir_move_speed = 15
			--TODO: 현재 셋팅상 대기시간이 너무 짧기때문에 바로 싱크 옮겨줌
			self.target_dir = self.synced_target_dir
			self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.target_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
		-- 만약 확정된 타겟이 ai와 다른 경우
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.character)) then
			-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
			command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
		end
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_sync_dir(dt)
	local diff = math.abs((self.synced_target_dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.05 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - self.synced_target_dir).normalized * dt * self.synced_dir_move_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	else
		self.target_dir = self.synced_target_dir
	end

	self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.target_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
	end

	self.target_dir = dir
	self.attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.target_dir, battle_util.get_height(self.character.Position))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

--일반공격 데미지
function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_coop_expedition_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_modifier = self.attack_damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.attack_damage_modifier + (self.attack_damage_modifier * self.critical_rate)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.target_dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.attack_knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			if self.is_poison_debuff then
				if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character))
						and (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player) ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None then
					buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.poison_buff_id, 1, false, false)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_poison_attack(dt)
	self.poison_attack_time_passed = self.poison_attack_time_passed + dt
	if self.poison_attack_time_passed < self.poison_duration then
		self:update_poison_damage(dt)
	else
		--중독공격 종료
		self:end_poison_attack()
	end
end

--전멸기 후 종료불리면 다 종료처리 되어야함
function local_class:end_poison_attack()
	if self.poison_attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.poison_attack_calculator:End()
	end

	self.is_start_poison_attack = false
end

--장판 공격 데미지
function local_class:update_poison_damage(dt)
	if not self.poison_attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.poison_attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.poison_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_coop_expedition_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_modifier = self.poison_damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.poison_damage_modifier + self.poison_damage_modifier * self.critical_rate
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.poison_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stunDuration = self.poison_stun_duration

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			if self.is_poison_debuff then
				-- 독 디버프 스택
				buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.poison_buff_id, 1, false, false)
			end
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	if not is_unity_null(self.poison_effect) then
		self.poison_effect:Dispose()
		self.poison_effect = nil
	end

	if self.poison_attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.poison_attack_calculator:End()
	end

	self.is_start_poison_attack = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴

		self.is_critical_attack = false
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system_util.unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), self.on_move_field_object_event_func)

		if next_state ~= self.state.delay then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

			battle_range_util.hide(self.main_attack_range)
			for _, info in ipairs(self.sub_attack_range_infos) do
				battle_range_util.hide(info.range)
				if next_state ~= self.state.action then
					if info.target ~= nil then
						self.sub_attack_range_infos[info.target] = nil
					end
					info.target = nil
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.delay then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		battle_range_util.hide(self.main_attack_range)
		for _, info in ipairs(self.sub_attack_range_infos) do
			battle_range_util.hide(info.range)
			if next_state ~= self.state.action then
				if info.target ~= nil then
					self.sub_attack_range_infos[info.target] = nil
				end
				info.target = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		for _, info in ipairs(self.sub_attack_range_infos) do
			if info.target ~= nil then
				self.sub_attack_range_infos[info.target] = nil
			end
			info.target = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')

		battle_range_util.show(self.main_attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.main_attack_range, self.target.Position, self.target.Position.y)

		local range_index = 1
		local master = summonable_util.get_master(self.target)
		if master ~= nil then
			self.target = master
		end
		local members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.target)
		for _, member in ipairs(members) do repeat
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(member, self.target) then
				break
			end
			if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, member) then
				break
			end
			self.sub_attack_range_infos[range_index].target = member
			self.sub_attack_range_infos[member] = range_index
			battle_range_util.show(self.sub_attack_range_infos[range_index].range, self.prepare_duration)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.sub_attack_range_infos[range_index].range, member.Position, member.Position.y)
			range_index = range_index + 1
		until true end

		message_system_util.subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), self.on_move_field_object_event_func)
	elseif next_state == self.state.delay then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action')

		for _, info in pairs(self.new_attack_infos) do
			info.attack_calculator:Start()
			local pos = info.attack_calculator.Position
			if info.is_main then
				info.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.main_attack_key, pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.main_attack_key, pos)
			else
				info.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.sub_attack_key, pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.sub_attack_key, pos)
			end
		end
		self.new_attack_infos = nil

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.new_attack_infos = nil
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_attack_calculator(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 싱크 대기
		if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			--- 싱크 트리거 정보 구성
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self.target.Position)

			for _, info in ipairs(self.sub_attack_range_infos) do repeat
				if is_unity_null(info.target) then
					break
				end
				trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, info.target.Position)
			until true end

			--- 커맨드 생성
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.delay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_calculator(dt)
	for i, info in pairs(self.active_main_attack_list) do repeat
		if not info.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
			break
		elseif info.attack_calculator.IsFinished then
			self:return_main_attack_info(i, false)
			break
		end

		local fo_list = info.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do repeat
			local target = fo_list[i]
			if not battle_util.is_hittable_coop_expedition_target(self.character, target) then
				break
			end

			local damage_modifier = self.main_attack_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.main_attack_modifier + (self.main_attack_modifier * self.critical_rate)
			end

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			if self.main_stun_duration > 0 then
				damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_strong
				damage_info.stun_duration = self.main_stun_duration
			end
			if self.main_knock_back_force > 0 then
				local pos = info.attack_calculator.Position
				local diff = target.Position - pos
				local dir
				if vector_util.is_almost_zero(diff) then
					dir = direction_util.to_vector3(target.Direction)
				else
					dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
				end
				damage_info.knock_back_dir = dir
				damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.main_knock_back_factor
				damage_info.knock_back_force = self.main_knock_back_force
			end

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

			-- 독 디버프 스택
			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.poison_buff_id, 1, false, false)
		until true end
		fo_list:Dispose()
	until true end

	for i, info in pairs(self.active_sub_attack_list) do repeat
		if not info.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
			break
		elseif info.attack_calculator.IsFinished then
			self:return_sub_attack_info(i, false)
			break
		end

		local fo_list = info.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do repeat
			local target = fo_list[i]
			if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
				break
			end

			if not lua_helper.type_compare(target, CS.Oak.Character) then
				break
			end

			local damage_modifier = self.sub_attack_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.sub_attack_modifier + (self.sub_attack_modifier * self.critical_rate)
			end

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			if self.sub_stun_duration > 0 then
				damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_strong
				damage_info.stun_duration = self.sub_stun_duration
			end
			if self.sub_knock_back_force > 0 then
				local pos = info.attack_calculator.Position
				local diff = target.Position - pos
				local dir
				if vector_util.is_almost_zero(diff) then
					dir = direction_util.to_vector3(target.Direction)
				else
					dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
				end
				damage_info.knock_back_dir = dir
				damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.sub_knock_back_factor
				damage_info.knock_back_force = self.sub_knock_back_force
			end

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

			-- 독 디버프 스택
			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.poison_buff_id, 1, false, false)
		until true end
		fo_list:Dispose()
	until true end
end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	local fo = e.FieldObject

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.target) then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.main_attack_range, self.target.Position, self.target.Position.y)
		return false
	end

	if self.sub_attack_range_infos[fo] == nil then
		return false
	end

	local index = self.sub_attack_range_infos[fo]
	local range = self.sub_attack_range_infos[index].range
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, fo.Position, fo.Position.y)

	return false
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if not trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) then
		return
	end

	local poses = info.Positions
	self.new_attack_infos = {}

	-- main
	local main_attack_info = self:get_main_attack_info()
	main_attack_info.attack_calculator.Position = poses[0]
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.main_attack_range, poses[0], poses[0].y)
	table.insert(self.new_attack_infos, main_attack_info)

	--main_attack_info.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.main_attack_key, poses[0])
	--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.main_attack_key, poses[0])

	-- sub
	for i = 1, poses.Count - 1 do repeat
		local pos = poses[i]
		local sub_attack_info = self:get_sub_attack_info()
		sub_attack_info.attack_calculator.Position = pos
		table.insert(self.new_attack_infos, sub_attack_info)

		local sub_range_info = self.sub_attack_range_infos[i]
		if sub_range_info == nil then
			break
		end
		local range = sub_range_info.range
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos, pos.y)

		-- 이펙트 및 사운드, time_limit 이펙트 가정
		--sub_attack_info.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.sub_attack_key, pos)
		--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.sub_attack_key, pos)
	until true end

	self:change_state(self.state.delay)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
	self:deactivate_all_attack(true)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.main_attack_pool = nil
	self.sub_attack_pool = nil
	self.active_main_attack_list = nil
	self.active_sub_attack_list = nil

	self.main_attack_range = nil
	self.sub_attack_range_infos = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSnakeSpawnBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.marker_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MarkerCount", 4)
	self.marker_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'MarkerName', 'red_marker_')

	self.monster_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MonsterCount", 4)
	self.monster_name_Base = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "SpawnNameBase", "snake_monster_")

	--한번에 소환할 갯수
	self.monster_spawn_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MonsterSpawnCount", 2)

	--해당 시간동안 어그로수치 변경 이벤트가 들어올 경우 타겟을 변경해 준다.
	self.target_search_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetSearchDuration", 2)

	self.critical_chance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CriticalDamageChance", 0.5)
	self.critical_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SuperDamageScale", 0.5)

	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.spawn_monster_list = nil
	self.synced = nil
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_target_seach = false
	self.spawn_monster_info_list = {}

	self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent),
			self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)

	self.on_destroyed_event = function(e)
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroyed_event)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	self.marker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.marker_count do
		local marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. i)
		table.insert(self.marker_list, marker)
	end
	self:initialize_summon_list()
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.FieldObject) then
		--보스 사망 시 소환수 다 사망처리
		self:kill_all_monster()
	end

	if self.spawn_monster_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.spawn_monster_info_list) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.monster, e.FieldObject) then
				--TODO: 필요하면 사망이팩트 연출 넣어주자
				local info = table.remove(self.spawn_monster_info_list, _)
				info.monster.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

				if info.aura_effect ~= nil then
					info.aura_effect:Dispose()
					info.aura_effect = nil
				end

				self:return_spawn_monster(info.monster)
				self:return_marker(info.marker)
			end
		end
	end
end

--소환 몬스터 리스트 생성
function local_class:initialize_summon_list()
	-- 팬 캐릭터
	self.spawn_monster_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.monster_count do
		local obj = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.monster_name_Base, i))
		if is_unity_null(obj) then
			break
		else
			table.insert(self.spawn_monster_list, obj)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:kill_all_monster()
	-- 모든 살아있는 팬 전부 강제 킬
	for _,v in ipairs(self.spawn_monster_list) do
		self:kill_monster(v)
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.spawn_monster_info_list) do
		self:kill_monster(v.monster)
	end
end

function local_class:kill_monster(monster)
	if not is_unity_null(monster) then
		if not monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(monster.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
				monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
			else
				monster.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour()
				monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = monster
			damage_info.target = monster
			damage_info.noCritical = true
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10)

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_marker_random_pos(count)
	if #self.marker_list > 0 then
		local index_list = {}
		for i = 1, #self.marker_list do
			table.insert(index_list, i)
		end

		local pick_index_list = nil
		local pos_list = {}
		if #self.marker_list > 1 then
			local get_count = count
			if #index_list < count then
				get_count = #index_list
			end
			pick_index_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(index_list, {count = get_count})
			for i = 1, get_count do
				if pick_index_list[i] ~= nil and self.marker_list[pick_index_list[i]] ~= nil then
					table.insert(pos_list, self.marker_list[pick_index_list[i]].position)
				end
			end
		elseif #self.marker_list == 1 then
			table.insert(pos_list, self.marker_list[1].position)
		else
			return nil
		end

		return pos_list
	end

	if #self.marker_list > 0 then
		local random_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.marker_list)
		return self.marker_list[random_index].position
	else
		return nil
	end
end

function local_class:get_monsters(count)
	local monster_list = {}
	if #self.spawn_monster_list > 1 then
		for i = 1, count do
			table.insert(monster_list, self.spawn_monster_list[i])
		end
	elseif #self.spawn_monster_list == 1 then
		table.insert(monster_list, self.spawn_monster_list[1])
	else
		return nil
	end

	return monster_list
end

function local_class:get_monster_for_name(name)
	if self.spawn_monster_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.spawn_monster_list do
			if self.spawn_monster_list[i].name == name then
				return table.remove(self.spawn_monster_list, i)
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:get_marker_for_pos(pos)
	for i  = 1, #self.marker_list do
		if self.marker_list[i].position == pos then
			return table.remove(self.marker_list, i)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:return_marker(marker)
	if self.marker_list ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.marker_list, marker)
	end
end

function local_class:get_spawn_monster()
	if self.spawn_monster_list ~= nil then
		if #self.spawn_monster_list > 0 then
			return table.remove(self.spawn_monster_list)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:return_spawn_monster(monster)
	if self.spawn_monster_list ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.spawn_monster_list, monster)
	end
end

function local_class:spawn_monster(pos, monster)
	if monster ~= nil then
		--TODO:소환 이팩트나 연출이 있다면 넣어준다.

		monster.Position = pos
		monster.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		character_util.set_direction(monster, self:get_direction(pos))

		-- 힐
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = monster

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		-- 몬스터 노티스 이벤트를 쏴준다
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		message_system:Send(monster.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
	end
end

function local_class:heal_all_monster()
	for _,v in pairs(self.spawn_monster_info_list) do
		-- 힐
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = v.monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = v.monster

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
	end
end

function local_class:get_direction(pos)
	if pos.x > self.character.Position.x then
		return 'left'
	else
		return 'right'
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false
	self.target = target
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_target_seach = false

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.is_target_seach = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.synced = false

		--4마리가 소환되어있는 상태라면 소환몬스터에게 풀힐
		if #self.spawn_monster_info_list >= self.monster_count then
			self:heal_all_monster()
			self:change_state(self.state.post)

			return
		end

		for i = 1, #self.pos_list do
			if #self.spawn_monster_info_list < self.monster_count then
				local marker = self:get_marker_for_pos(self.pos_list[i])
				if marker == nil then
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
					return
				end

				local monster = self:get_monster_for_name(self.spawn_monster_name_list[i])
				self:spawn_monster(marker.position, monster)
				if monster == nil then
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
					return
				end

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("spawn", marker.position)
				local aura_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("spawn_aura", marker.position)

				table.insert(self.spawn_monster_info_list, {monster = monster,
															marker = marker, aura_effect = aura_effect })
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.prepare_duration then
		elseif not self.chain_synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			self.synced = true

			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
			info:AppendNumber(1)

			local pos_list = {}
			local monster_list = {}
			if #self.spawn_monster_info_list < self.monster_count then
				pos_list = self:get_marker_random_pos(self.monster_spawn_count)
				monster_list = self:get_monsters(self.monster_spawn_count)
				for i = 1, #pos_list do
					info:AppendPosition(pos_list[i])
					info:AppendTarget(monster_list[i])
				end
			end
			info:AppendNumber(#pos_list)

			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))
	if idx == 1 then
		local pos_count = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 1))
		self.pos_list = {}
		self.spawn_monster_name_list = {}
		for i = 1, pos_count do
			local pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, i - 1)
			table.insert(self.pos_list, pos)

			local name = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, i - 1).name
			table.insert(self.spawn_monster_name_list, name)
		end

		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_destroyed_event ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroyed_event)
		self.on_destroyed_event = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
