local local_class = newclass('BossSnowmanGeneralIceCubeBattleAction')

local laser = {
	action = nil,
	cs_action = nil,
	pos = nil,
	length = nil,
	max_length = nil,
	width = nil,
	degree_rotation = nil,
	damage_modifier = nil,
	damage_term = nil,
	fx = nil,
	battle_zone = nil,
	initial_direction = nil
}
laser.mt = { __index = laser }

function laser:new(parent_class, max_length, width, duration, pos, damage_modifier, damage_term, direction, fx, zone)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.pos = pos
	obj.degree_rotation = 0
	obj.max_length = max_length
	obj.width = width
	obj.damage_modifier = damage_modifier
	obj.damage_term = damage_term
	obj.fx = fx
	obj.battle_zone = zone

	obj.initial_direction = direction
	local dir = self.update_transform(obj, pos, 0)

	local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = pos
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = duration
	info.Size = unity_class.vector3(max_length, 2, width)
	info.IsCenterToSide = false
	obj.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(parent_class.character, info, true, 0, 0)
	obj.attack_calculator.Direction = dir
	obj.attack_calculator:Start()

	return obj
end

function laser:update_frame(dt, pos, rot)
	local dir = self:update_transform(pos, rot)
	return self:update_damage(dt, pos, dir)
end

function laser:update_transform(pos, degree)
	self.pos = pos
	self.degree_rotation = degree
	local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.degree_rotation, 0) * self.initial_direction).normalized
	effect_util.update_object(self.fx, self.pos, dir)

	local current_length = self:get_ray_dist_to_bound(dir)
	self.length = math.min(self.max_length, current_length)
	self.fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(self.length / 20,1,1)

	return dir
end

function laser:update_damage(dt, pos, dir)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = pos + self.max_length * 0.5 * dir
	self.attack_calculator.Direction = dir

	return self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
end

function laser:get_ray_dist_to_bound(dir_vector3)
	local origin = unity_class.vector2(self.pos.x, self.pos.z)
	local dir = unity_class.vector2(dir_vector3.x, dir_vector3.z)

	if dir.y < 0 and origin.y > self.battle_zone.min.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.min.x,self.battle_zone.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.max.x,self.battle_zone.min.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	elseif dir.y > 0 and origin.y < self.battle_zone.max.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.min.x,self.battle_zone.max.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.max.x,self.battle_zone.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	end
	if dir.x < 0 and origin.x > self.battle_zone.min.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.min.x,self.battle_zone.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.min.x,self.battle_zone.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	elseif dir.x > 0 and origin.x < self.battle_zone.max.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.max.x,self.battle_zone.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.max.x,self.battle_zone.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	end
	return 0
end

function laser:dispose_fx()
	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
		self.fx = nil
	end
end

function laser:dispose()
	self:dispose_fx()
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.action = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.pos = nil
	self.degree_rotation = nil

	self.attack_calculator:End()
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

local ice_cube = {
	state = {
		none = 0,
		fly = 1,
		shoot = 2
	},
	action = nil,
	cs_action = nil,
	index = nil,
	start_pos = nil,
	dest_pos = nil,
	height = nil,
	move_speed = nil,
	shoot_duration = nil,
	rotate_speed = nil,
	cube_fx = nil,
	shadow_fx = nil,
	core_fx = nil,
	laser_fx = nil,
	laser_sfx = nil,
	zone = nil,
	max_laser_length = nil,
	laser_width = nil,
	is_clockwise = nil,
	damage_modifier = nil,
	damage_term = nil
}
ice_cube.mt = { __index = ice_cube }

function ice_cube:new(parent_class, index, speed, shoot_duration, rotate_speed, battle_zone, laser_length, laser_width, is_clockwise, damage_modifier, damage_term)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.index = index
	obj.move_speed = speed
	obj.shoot_duration = shoot_duration
	obj.rotate_speed = rotate_speed * (is_clockwise and 1 or -1)
	obj.zone = battle_zone
	obj.max_laser_length = math.min(math.sqrt(battle_zone.size.x ^ 2 + battle_zone.size.z ^ 2), laser_length)
	obj.laser_width = laser_width
	obj.is_clockwise = is_clockwise
	obj.damage_modifier = damage_modifier
	obj.damage_term = damage_term

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	return obj
end

function ice_cube:init(start_pos, dest_pos, height, initial_rotate_angle)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.character = self.action.character
	self.start_pos = start_pos
	self.dest_pos = dest_pos
	local diff = self.dest_pos - self.start_pos
	local dist = diff.magnitude
	self.height = height
	self.initial_rotation = initial_rotate_angle * (self.is_clockwise and -1 or 1)
	self.move_duration = dist / self.move_speed

	self.laser_key = 'laser'
	self.shadow_key = 'shadow'

	self:change_state(self.state.fly)
end

function ice_cube:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.fly then
		-- 투사체 이펙트 제거
		self:remove_projectile_fx()
		-- break 이펙트, sfx
		self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('break', self.dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx('break', self.dest_pos)
		-- 어택레인지 숨김
		self.action:hide_attack_ranges(self.index,false)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self:dispose_lasers()
		self.hit_this_frame = nil
	end

	if next_state == self.state.fly then
		local dir = (self.dest_pos - self.start_pos).normalized
		-- 투사체, 그림자 이펙트
		self.cube_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('cube', self.start_pos, dir)
		self.shadow_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('customSprite', self.start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		local sprite = self.shadow_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		sprite.Atlas = stage.StageCustomAtlasManager:Get("spritesheets/battle", "battle_custom")
		sprite.SpriteName = "shadow.png"
		sprite.PixelToWorld = 0.02
		sprite.IgnoreOriginalSize = true
		sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
		sprite.SortingLayer = "Default"
		sprite.SortingOrder = -1
		sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		sprite:Rebuild()
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self:shoot_laser(self.dest_pos)
		self.hit_this_frame = {}
	else
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function ice_cube:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.fly then
		if self.time_passed < self.move_duration then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.move_duration)
			local xz_pos = self.start_pos * (1 - progress) + self.dest_pos * progress

			if self.cube_fx then
				local pos = xz_pos + self.height * progress * (1 - progress) * unity_class.vector3.up
				local rot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.time_passed * 360, 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.cube_fx, pos, rot_dir)
			end

			if self.shadow_fx then
				self.shadow_fx.transform.localPosition = xz_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.03
				self.shadow_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90,0,0)
			end
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed < self.shoot_duration then
			local rotation = self.rotate_speed * self.time_passed
			-- 1초 분 만큼 미리 돌려줌
			-- TODO: AI 정상 작동하게 어택레인지 개선 필요
			local range_rotation = rotation + self.rotate_speed + self.initial_rotation
			self.action:update_attack_ranges(self.index, self.dest_pos, range_rotation)
			for _,laser in pairs(self.lasers) do
				local objects = laser:update_frame(dt, self.dest_pos, rotation)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						self.hit_this_frame[fo] = true
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()
			end
			for fo,hit in pairs(self.hit_this_frame) do
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
			self.hit_this_frame = {}
		else
			self.action:dispose_ice_cube(self.index)
		end
	end
end

function ice_cube:shoot_laser(pos)
	-- core 이펙트
	self.core_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('core', pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	-- laser 사운드
	self.laser_sfx = self.cs_action:PlaySfx('laser', self.dest_pos)

	self.lasers = {}
	for _,dir in pairs(self.action.directions) do
		local direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0,self.initial_rotation,0)) * dir
		local laser_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('laser', pos, direction)
		local object = laser:new(self.action, self.max_laser_length, self.laser_width, self.shoot_duration, pos,
				self.damage_modifier, self.damage_term, direction, laser_fx, self.zone)
		table.insert(self.lasers, object)
	end
end

function ice_cube:dispose_lasers()
	if self.laser_sfx then
		self.laser_sfx:Stop()
		self.laser_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.core_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.core_fx)
		self.core_fx = nil
	end

	if self.lasers then
		for _,laser in pairs(self.lasers) do
			laser:dispose()
		end
		self.lasers = nil
	end
end

function ice_cube:remove_projectile_fx()
	if self.cube_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cube_fx)
		self.cube_fx = nil
	end

	if self.shadow_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.shadow_fx)
		self.shadow_fx = nil
	end
end

function ice_cube:dispose()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.move_duration = nil
	self.shoot_duration = nil
	self.rotate_speed = nil
	self.zone = nil
	self.max_laser_length = nil
	self.laser_width = nil
	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.damage_term = nil

	self.time_passed = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.start_pos = nil
	self.dest_pos = nil
	self.height = nil
	self.initial_rotation = nil
end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0)
	self.throwing_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ThrowDuration", 1)
	self.throwing_Timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ThrowTiming", 0.5)

	self.ice_cube_fly_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FlySpeed", 8)

	self.laser_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserLength", 20)
	self.laser_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserWidth", 1)
	self.laser_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserDuration", 5)
	self.laser_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserDamageTerm", 0.5)
	self.laser_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserDamageModifier", 1)

	self.laser_rotate_speed_a = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserRotateSpeedA", 30)
	self.laser_rotate_speed_b = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserRotateSpeedB", 30)
	self.initial_rotate_angle_a = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRotateAngleA", 0)
	self.initial_rotate_angle_b = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRotateAngleB", 0)
	self.is_clockwise_a = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsClockwiseA", true)
	self.is_clockwise_b = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsClockwiseB", true)

	self.min_center_dist = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BoundCenterRange", 0.5)
	self.enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced", false)

	self.directions = {
		unity_class.vector3(0,0,1),
		unity_class.vector3(1,0,0),
		unity_class.vector3(0,0,-1),
		unity_class.vector3(-1,0,0)
	}
	self.attack_range_lists = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local ranges = {}
		for _,dir in pairs(self.directions) do
			local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
					unity_class.vector2(self.laser_length, self.laser_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
			range:Hide()
			table.insert(ranges, range)
		end
		table.insert(self.attack_range_lists, ranges)
	end
	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3
	}

	if self.enhanced then
		self.cs_battle_action.Type = CS.Oak.BattleActionType.Super
	end

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return target ~= nil and not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
		end
		self.zone_bound = battle_zone_bound
	end
	cmd:AppendPosition(self.zone_bound.center)
	cmd:AppendPosition(self.zone_bound.size)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(info:GetPositionAt(0), info:GetPositionAt(1))
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
		end
		self.zone_bound = battle_zone_bound
	end

	self.target = target
	if self.ice_cube_a then
		self.ice_cube_a:dispose()
		self.ice_cube_a = nil
	end
	if self.ice_cube_b then
		self.ice_cube_b:dispose()
		self.ice_cube_b = nil
	end
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.target = nil
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self:hide_attack_ranges(1,true)
			self:hide_attack_ranges(2,true)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		if not self.thrown then
			self:hide_attack_ranges(1,true)
			self:hide_attack_ranges(2,true)
		end
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.synced = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(CS.Oak.Direction.Down,
				CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))

		local center = unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.center.x, self.target.Position.y, self.zone_bound.center.z)
		self:show_attack_ranges(1, self.target.Position, self.prepare_duration)
		local diff = self.target.Position - center
		self:show_attack_ranges(2, center - diff, self.prepare_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.thrown = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_ice_cube(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if not self.synced then
			local target_position = self.target.Position
			self:update_attack_ranges(1, target_position, 0)
			local center = unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.center.x, target_position.y, self.zone_bound.center.z)
			local diff = target_position - center
			self:update_attack_ranges(2, center - diff, 0)

			if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character,
						self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.target.Position)
				command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.thrown and self.time_passed >= self.throwing_Timing then
			self.thrown = true
			local is_target_center = false
			if (self.target_position - self.zone_bound.center):GetX0z().magnitude < self.min_center_dist then
				is_target_center = true
			end
			local dest_pos_a = nil
			local dest_pos_b = nil
			local rotate_angle_a = self.initial_rotate_angle_a
			local rotate_angle_b = self.initial_rotate_angle_b
			local is_clockwise_a = self.is_clockwise_a
			local is_clockwise_b = self.is_clockwise_b
			if is_target_center then
				local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.zone_bound.center):GetHeightAt(self.zone_bound.center)
				dest_pos_a = vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bound.center) + unity_class.vector3(0,floor_height,0)
				dest_pos_b = dest_pos_a
				rotate_angle_a = 0
				rotate_angle_b = rotate_angle_a + 45
				is_clockwise_b = is_clockwise_a
			else
				local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.target_position):GetHeightAt(self.target_position)
				dest_pos_a = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position) + unity_class.vector3(0,floor_height,0)
				local diff = dest_pos_a - self.zone_bound.center
				dest_pos_b = vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bound.center - diff) + unity_class.vector3(0,floor_height,0)
			end
			local start_pos = self.character.Position
			local dist_a = (dest_pos_a - start_pos).magnitude
			local dist_b = (dest_pos_b - start_pos).magnitude
			local height_a = math.max(dist_a, dist_b) + 4
			local height_b = height_a
			local speed_a = dist_a >= dist_b and self.ice_cube_fly_speed or self.ice_cube_fly_speed / dist_b * dist_a
			local speed_b = dist_a < dist_b and self.ice_cube_fly_speed or self.ice_cube_fly_speed / dist_a * dist_b
			self.ice_cube_a = self:throw_ice_cube(1, dest_pos_a, rotate_angle_a, height_a, speed_a, is_clockwise_a)
			self.ice_cube_b = self:throw_ice_cube(2, dest_pos_b, rotate_angle_b, height_b, speed_b, is_clockwise_b)
			self:update_attack_ranges(1, dest_pos_a, 0)
			self:update_attack_ranges(2, dest_pos_b, 0)
			self.target_position = nil
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.throwing_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_ice_cube(dt)
	if self.ice_cube_a then
		self.ice_cube_a:update_frame(dt)
	end
	if self.ice_cube_b then
		self.ice_cube_b:update_frame(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:throw_ice_cube(index, dest_pos, initial_rotation, height, speed, is_clockwise)
	local start_pos = self.character.Position
	local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(start_pos):GetHeightAt(start_pos)
	start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos) + unity_class.vector3(0,floor_height,0)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cube', start_pos)

	local rotate_speed = index == 1 and self.laser_rotate_speed_a or self.laser_rotate_speed_b
	local projectile = ice_cube:new(self, index, speed, self.laser_duration, rotate_speed, self.zone_bound,
			self.laser_length, self.laser_width, is_clockwise, self.laser_damage_modifier, self.laser_damage_term)
	projectile:init(self.character.Position, dest_pos, height, initial_rotation)

	return projectile
end

function local_class:dispose_ice_cube(index)
	if index == 1 and self.ice_cube_a then
		self.ice_cube_a:dispose()
		self.ice_cube_a = nil
	elseif index == 2 and self.ice_cube_b then
		self.ice_cube_b:dispose()
		self.ice_cube_b = nil
	end
	self:hide_attack_ranges(index,true)
end

function local_class:show_attack_ranges(range_list_index, pos, prepare_duration)
	local idx = 1
	for _,dir in pairs(self.directions) do
		if self.attack_range_lists[range_list_index] then
			local range = self.attack_range_lists[range_list_index][idx]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(range, pos, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.initial_rotate_angle_a, 0) * dir)
			range:Show(prepare_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			idx = idx + 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_ranges(range_list_index, pos, rotate_angle)
	local idx = 1
	for _,dir in pairs(self.directions) do
		if self.attack_range_lists[range_list_index] then
			local range = self.attack_range_lists[range_list_index][idx]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(range, pos, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.initial_rotate_angle_a + rotate_angle, 0) * dir)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			idx = idx + 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:hide_attack_ranges(range_list_index, end_event)
	if self.attack_range_lists[range_list_index] then
		for _,range in pairs(self.attack_range_lists[range_list_index]) do
			range:Hide()
			if end_event then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:dispose_ice_cube(1)
	self:dispose_ice_cube(2)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.target_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.throwing_duration = nil
	self.throwing_Timing = nil

	self.ice_cube_fly_speed = nil
	self.laser_length = nil
	self.laser_width = nil
	self.laser_duration = nil
	self.laser_damage_term = nil
	self.laser_damage_modifier = nil

	self.laser_rotate_speed_a = nil
	self.laser_rotate_speed_b = nil
	self.initial_rotate_angle_a = nil
	self.initial_rotate_angle_b = nil
	self.min_center_dist = nil

	self.directions = nil
	self.state = nil

	if self.attack_range_lists ~= nil then
		for _, range_list in ipairs(self.attack_range_lists) do
			for _, range in ipairs(range_list) do
				if not is_unity_null(range) then
					CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(range)
				end
				range = nil
			end
			range_list = nil
		end
		self.attack_range_lists = nil
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		else

			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
		end
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self:hide_attack_range()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.target.Position))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")

		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
		self:show_attack_range(self.target_position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.is_jump_start = false
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self:distribute_rock()

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:falling_rock_damage(damage_pos)
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(damage_pos, self.rock_radius, 2)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.rock_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 낙하 오브젝트 업데이트 처리
	if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.falling_rocks, 1, -1 do
			local rock_tp =  self.falling_rocks[i].time_passed + dt
			self.falling_rocks[i].time_passed = rock_tp

			-- 완료시 삭제
			if rock_tp >= self.rock_fall_duration then
				-- 낙하 위치에 데미지 + 넉백
				self:falling_rock_damage(self.falling_rocks[i].position)
				-- 투사체 패턴 발사.
				local shoot_pos = self.falling_rocks[i].position
				shoot_pos.y = shoot_pos.y + 0.2
				self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.forward, i, -1, nil, false, 0)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", shoot_pos)
				-- 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("break", shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("break", self.falling_rocks[i].position)
				-- 오브젝트 삭제
				if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
					self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = nil
				-- 그림자 제거 (TimeLimit 이므로 연출로 자연 소멸하게 놔둠)
				self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = nil
				-- 어택 레인지 반납
				self:return_fall_range(self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range)
				self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range = nil
				-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
				table.remove(self.falling_rocks, i)
			elseif rock_tp >= 0 then
				local prog = rock_tp / self.rock_fall_duration
				local calc_pos = self.falling_rocks[i].position + self.rock_fall_height * (1 - prog * prog) * unity_class.vector3.up

				if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				else
					self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("rock", calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shadow", self.falling_rocks[i].position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.target_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			local target_pos = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.target_position, false)
			-- 보정위치 계산후 존 밖으로 벗어나는지에 대한 재검사를 하는 편이 맞다.
			self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(target_pos)
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.target_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

					if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
						dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_jump_target_pos(dest_pos)
	local final_dest_pos = dest_pos
	if dest_pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:remove_rocks()
	-- 낙하중이던 오브젝트 해제
	if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
		for i = #self.falling_rocks, 1, -1 do
			-- 오브젝트 제거
			if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object) then
				self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.falling_rocks[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 그림자 제거 (remove 시엔 즉시 제거)
			if not is_unity_null(self.falling_rocks[i].shadow) then
				self.falling_rocks[i].shadow:Dispose()
			end
			self.falling_rocks[i].shadow = nil
			-- 어택 레인지 반납
			self:return_fall_range(self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range)
			self.falling_rocks[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 해제 & 리스트에서 제거
			table.remove(self.falling_rocks, i)
		end
	end
	self.falling_rocks = nil
end

function local_class:force_cancel(is_dispose)
	self:remove_rocks()
	self:cancel(is_dispose)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	-- Active 상태일 때만 sync.
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		-- 이전 데이터 남아있다면 먼저 지움
		if self.falling_rocks ~= nil then
			self:remove_rocks()
		end

		-- 새 바위 데이터 생성해서 넣음
		self.falling_rocks = {}
		local poses = info.Positions
		for i = 0, poses.Count-1 do
			local pos = poses[i]
			local range = self:get_fall_range()
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos)
			range:Show(self.initial_fall_delay + i * self.rock_fall_delay + self.rock_fall_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			table.insert(self.falling_rocks, {
				position = pos,
				time_passed = - self.initial_fall_delay - i * self.rock_fall_delay,
				attack_range = range
			})
		end
	end
end

function local_class:distribute_rock()
	if self.sliced_zone_bounds ~= nil then
		-- 바위 낙하할 위치 선택
		local available_shoot_points = {}
		for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
			-- 현재 캐릭터의 바운드와 겹치지 않는 곳만 추가
			if not bound:Intersects(self.character.Bounds) then
				table.insert(available_shoot_points, bound.center)
			end
		end
		local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_shoot_points, {count = self.rock_count})

		-- 돌 떨어질 위치에 대해 싱크 커맨드
		local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
		for _, point in ipairs(random_points) do
			point.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(point):GetHeightAt(point)
			info:AppendPosition(point)
		end

		local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
		command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel(true)

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	if self.rock_ranges ~= nil then
		for _, range in ipairs(self.rock_ranges) do
			if not is_unity_null(range) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(range)
			end
		end
		self.rock_ranges = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.sliced_zone_bounds = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
	-- zone bound 9등분 해서 저장
	local center = bound.center
	local modX = bound.size.x / 3
	local modZ = bound.size.z / 3
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, bound.size.y, modZ)

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size))
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:ready_shoot_helper(projectile_name, params)
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local shot_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(projectile_name)
	local shot_pattern = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	return CS.Oak.ShootHelper(
		CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,

		ps,
		shot_spec,
		shot_pattern,
		CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot
	)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()

	if self.enhanced then
		if self.main_shoot_helper ~= nil and self.sub_shoot_helper then
			return self.main_shoot_helper:IsLoaded() and self.sub_shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
		end
	else
		if self.main_shoot_helper ~= nil then
			return self.main_shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if (is_unity_null(target)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.shoot_count = 0

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:set_dir_for_target()
	local target_pos = self.target.Position

	local diff = target_pos - self.character.Position
	local dir = diff.normalized
	self.target_direction = dir
	local lock_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(dir))
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(lock_dir))

end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.shoot_count = 0
		self.label_index = 0
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:set_dir_for_target()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('fire')

		if self.is_period2 then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast2')
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.tracking then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('ready', self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local fire_pos = self:check_target_pos(self.character.Position + vector(0,0 , self.fire_start_height))
		local fire_dir = (self.target.Position - fire_pos).normalized
		self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
		self.label_index = self.label_index + 1

		self:set_dir_for_target()

		if self.enhanced then
			if self.shoot_count % self.combo_mod == 0 then
				self.sub_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(fire_pos, fire_dir, self.label_index)
			else
				self.main_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(fire_pos, fire_dir, self.label_index)
			end
		else
			self.main_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(fire_pos, fire_dir, self.label_index)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	for _, laser in ipairs(self.laser_list) do
		laser:update_frame(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.shoot_count >= self.shoot_amount then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clear_lasers()
	for _, laser in ipairs(self.laser_list) do
		laser:dispose()
	end

	for i = #self.laser_list, 1, -1 do
		table.remove(self.laser_list, i)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)

	if self.enhanced and label % self.combo_mod == 0 and hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		local laser = laser:new(self)
		table.insert(self.laser_list, laser)
		laser:start(hit_info.position)
		return true
	end

	if is_unity_null(hit_info.target) then
		return false
	end

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('proj_end', hit_info.position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('end', hit_info.position)

		if self.enhanced then
			if label % self.combo_mod == 0 then
				self.sub_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
				return true
			else
				self.main_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
				return true
			end
		else
			self.main_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			return true
		end

	else
		return false;
	end
end

function local_class:check_target_pos(pos)
	local final_dest_pos = pos

	if pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x
	end
	if pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x
	end
	if pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z
	end
	if pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self:clear_lasers()

	self.shoot_count = 0
	self.label_index = 0

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local event_string = e:GetParamAt(0)

	if event_string == 'start_phase2_period2' then
		self.is_period2 = true
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSymptomGhostBattleAction')


local area_effect = {
	action = nil,
	cs_battle_action = nil,
	character = nil,
	is_active = false,

	-- 내부 스테이트
	state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}
}
area_effect.mt = { __index = area_effect }

function area_effect:set_param(prepare_duration, action_duration, post_duration, radius, damage_ratio, damage_term)
	self.prepare_duration = prepare_duration
	self.action_duration = action_duration
	self.post_duration = post_duration
	self.radius = radius
	self.damage_ratio = damage_ratio
	self.damage_term = damage_term
end

function area_effect:new(parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_battle_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.character = parent_class.character

	obj.current_state = self.state.none

	obj.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(
		unity_class.vector3.zero,
		self.radius,
		CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward
	)
	obj.attack_range:Hide()

	local info = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = self.damage_term
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Radius = self.radius
	obj.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false, 0, 0)

	return obj
end

function area_effect:start(pos)
	self.start_pos = pos
	self.target = self.action.target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	self.is_active = true;
end

function area_effect:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.fx:Dispose()
		self.fx = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.start_pos, battle_util.get_height(self.target.Position))
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('aoe_cast')
		self.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('aoe', self.start_pos)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.start_pos
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then

	else
		self:dispose()
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function area_effect:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)

		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_calculator(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function area_effect:update_calculator(dt)
	if self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreOptions | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)
				damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('aoe_hit')
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function area_effect:dispose()
	self.is_active = false

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx) then
		self.fx:Dispose()
		self.fx = nil
	end

	self.action:stop_aoe_sfx()

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		summon = 3,
		predation = 4,
		action = 5,
		post = 6
	}

	-- 몬스터 스테이트
	self.monster_state = {
		none = 1,
		idle = 2,
		battle = 3,
		sacrificed =4,
	}


	local zone_name = self.character.FieldObjectController.Zone
	if zone_name then
		self.zone_bound = field:GetZone(zone_name).Bounds
	else
		self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2.5)
	self.born_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BornDelay", 1.0)

	self.summon_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SummonDuration", 6)
	self.aoe_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AOEPrepareDuration', 0.5)
	self.predation_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PredationDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 2)

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 5)

	local projectile_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Projectile', 'proj_symptom_ghost')
	local projectile_born = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectileBorn', 'proj_symptom_ghost_born')

	self.shoot_helper = self:ready_shoot_helper(
		projectile_name,
		CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
		CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot,
		params
	)
	self.shoot_helper_born = self:ready_shoot_helper(
		projectile_born,
		CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
		CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.None,
		params
	)

	self.born_shoot_offset_z = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BornShootOffsetZ", 1.5)

	self.summon_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'SummonCount', 8)
	self.current_summon_step = 0
	self.max_summon_step = self.summon_count / 2
	self.left_summon_start_index = 1
	self.right_summon_start_index = self.left_summon_start_index + self.max_summon_step

	self.summon_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SummonTerm", 1)
	self.summon_elapsed_time = self.summon_term

	self.marker_name = 'ghost_'
	self:get_marker_list()

	self.summon_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SummonRadius", 2)

	self.summon_info_list = {}

	self.camera_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraMagnitude", 1)
	self.camera_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraDuration", 0.6)

	-- AttackRange 세팅 ( 소환 )
	for _ = 1, self.summon_count do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.summon_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()

		local summon_info =
		{
			ar = ar,
			egg_fx = nil
		}

		table.insert(self.summon_info_list, summon_info)
	end

	self.summon_monster_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'SummonMonsterID', 104310)

	self.summon_monster_death_explosion = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion')
	end
	self.summon_monster_death_explosion()

	self.action_base_damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BaseActionDamageRatio", 0.2)
	self.action_additional_damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AdditionalActionDamageRatio", 0.1)
	self.triggered_action = false
	self.triggered_born = false
	self.triggered_land = false
	self.triggered_predation = false

	self.aoe_list = {}

	area_effect:set_param(
		self.aoe_prepare_duration,
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AOEActionDuration',3),
		0,
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AOERadius', 2),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AOEDamageRatio', 0.1),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AOEDamageTerm', 0.5)
		)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self.dissolve_in_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DissolveInDuration", 0.2)
	self.dissolve_out_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DissolveOutDuration", 0.2)
	self.dissolver_path = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'DissolverPath', 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/theatres/dissolve')
	self.dissolver_container = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'DissolverContainer', 'dissolve_material_container')

	self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = function(e)
		self:on_fieldobject_destroyed(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)

	self.on_stage_loaded_func = function(e)
		self:on_stage_loaded(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_func)

end

function local_class:ready_shoot_helper(projectile_name, move_type, shoot_effect_type, params)
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local shot_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(projectile_name)
	local shot_pattern = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	return CS.Oak.ShootHelper(
		move_type,
		ps,
		shot_spec,
		shot_pattern,
		shoot_effect_type
	)
end

function local_class:count_live_monster()

	self.alive_monster_count = 0
	for _, v in pairs(self.monster_list) do
		if v.state == self.monster_state.battle then
			self.alive_monster_count = self.alive_monster_count + 1
		end
	end

end

function local_class:damage_by_action()

	local damage_ratio = self.action_base_damage_ratio + self.alive_monster_count * self.action_additional_damage_ratio
	local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if targets ~= nil then
		for i = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			local fo = targets[i]
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreOptions | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * damage_ratio)
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		targets:Dispose()
	end

end

function local_class:get_marker_list()

	self.marker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.summon_count do
		local marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. i)
		table.insert(self.marker_list, marker)
	end

end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)

end

function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end


function local_class:start_summon_presentation()

	if self.triggered_born then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, self.summon_count do
		local marker_pos = self.marker_list[i].position
		local shoot_dir = (marker_pos - self.character.Position).normalized
		local distance = (marker_pos - self.character.Position).magnitude
		self.shoot_helper_born:ShootDirectionAtPosition(
			self.character.Position + vector(0,0,self.born_shoot_offset_z),
			shoot_dir,
			i,
			distance,
			nil,
			true,
			0.0,
			marker_pos)

		--table.insert(self.proj_list_born, self.shoot_helper_born:GetProjectile(i))
	end

	self.triggered_born = true
end

function local_class:summon_monsters_by_step(dt)

	if self.current_summon_step >= self.max_summon_step then
		return
	end

	self.summon_elapsed_time = self.summon_elapsed_time + dt

	if self.summon_elapsed_time >= self.summon_term then

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('monster_born')

		self.summon_elapsed_time = 0
		local left_index = self.left_summon_start_index + self.current_summon_step
		self:summon_monster(left_index)
		self.summon_info_list[left_index].egg_fx:Dispose()
		self.summon_info_list[left_index].egg_fx = nil
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("born_egg_hatch", self.marker_list[left_index].position)

		local right_index = self.right_summon_start_index + self.current_summon_step
		self:summon_monster(right_index)
		self.summon_info_list[right_index].egg_fx:Dispose()
		self.summon_info_list[right_index].egg_fx = nil
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("born_egg_hatch", self.marker_list[right_index].position)
		self.current_summon_step = self.current_summon_step + 1
	end

end

function local_class:summon_monster(index)

	local target_monster_info = self.monster_list[index]

	if target_monster_info.state == self.monster_state.idle then
		local monster = target_monster_info.fo
		local pos = self.marker_list[index].position

		monster.Position = pos

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = monster
		heal_info.heal = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		local thebattle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
		if thebattle == nil then
			print('### GetBattleForMyParty is null!!!')
			return
		end

		thebattle:AddEnemy(monster)
		monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
		monster.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		message_system:Send(
			monster.FieldObjectController,
			CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(
				monster,
				self.target,
				CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle
			)
		)

		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(pos, (self.target.Position - pos).normalized)

		target_monster_info.state = self.monster_state.battle
	end

end

function local_class:init_aoe()
	for i, v in pairs(self.monster_list) do
		if v.state == self.monster_state.battle then

			if v.fo.DamagedBehaviour ~= CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance then
				v.fo.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
			end

			v.fo.SpineController:AddColor('init_aoe', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)

			-- Create AOE
			local aoe = area_effect:new(self)
			table.insert(self.aoe_list, aoe)
			aoe:start(self.marker_list[i].position)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clear_monster()

	for i, v in pairs(self.monster_list) do
		if v.state == self.monster_state.battle then

			if v.fo.DamagedBehaviour ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(v.fo.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) == false then
				v.fo.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear)
			end

			v.fo.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear
			v.fo.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false

			v.fo.SpineController:RemoveColor('init_aoe', 0)

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreOptions
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v.fo
			damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(v.fo) * 10
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:routine_load_monster()

	if self.summon_monster_id == nil then
		return
	end

	self.monster_list = {}
	self.monster_list_by_name = {}

	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, 80)
	if stage ~= nil then
		if stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId) ~= nil then
			local stage_level = stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId).StageStandardLevel
			exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, stage_level)
		end
	end

	for i = 1 , self.summon_count do
		local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('Characters'):GetSpec(self.summon_monster_id)
		if spec == nil then
			print('### CANT FIND MONSTER SPEC!!! ID = ' .. self.summon_monster_id)
			break
		end

		local loader = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(spec)
		coroutine.yield(loader)
		local monster = loader.Character
		if monster == nil then
			print('### CANT FIND Character!!! ID = ' .. self.summon_monster_id)
			break
		end

		monster.Name = 'summon_'.. i
		monster.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0
		monster.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour();
		monster.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController('battle', CS.Oak.PatrolAI.Watch)
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = 'battle2'
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.EventGroupName = 'battle2'
		monster.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		monster.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear)
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:AddExp(exp)
		monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
		monster.Position = vector(999, 0 , 999)
		monster.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
		CS.Oak.NetworkEntityManager.Instance:RegisterEntity(monster)
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'disabled')
		local changed_weapon = false
		--디폴트 무기 설정
		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id)
			local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end

		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id)
			local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end
		stage.CharacterManager:RegisterCharacterByName(monster)

		coroutine.yield(monster:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())

		local data = {
			state = self.monster_state.idle,
			fo = monster,
		}

		self.monster_list[i] = data
		self.monster_list_by_name[monster.Name] = data
	end

end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil and self.shoot_helper_born ~= nil then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded() and self.shoot_helper_born:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

	if (is_unity_null(target)) then
		return false
	end

	return true

end

function local_class:trigger()

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true

end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.triggered_born = false
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.summon then
		self.summon_elapsed_time = self.summon_term
		self.current_summon_step = 0
		self.triggered_land = false
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.predation then
		self.fx_barrier:Dispose()
		self.fx_barrier = nil
		self.triggered_predation = false
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.triggered_action = false
		self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(self.character)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then

		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:ChangeStageMusicVolume(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event, 0.5, 4)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')
		self:set_ailment_resist()
		if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance then
			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.summon then
		self.character.SpineController:AddColor('dissolve', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		self.dissolver:set_dissolve_material(self.character)

		self.fx_barrier = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('summon', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('summon')

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('summon')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('summon2')

		self.character.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance;

	elseif next_state == self.state.predation then
		self:count_live_monster()
		self:init_aoe()

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.character.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', self.character.Position)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action')
		self.dissolve_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('dissolve_out')

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self:reset_ailment()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.None
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	for _, aoe in ipairs(self.aoe_list) do
		aoe:update_frame(dt)
	end
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.summon)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.born_delay then
				self:start_summon_presentation()
			end
 		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.summon then
		if self.time_passed < self.dissolve_in_duration then
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.dissolve_in_duration
			self.dissolver:set_dissolve_progress(self.character, progress)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.summon_duration and self.current_summon_step >= self.max_summon_step then
			self:change_state(self.state.predation)
		else
			self:summon_monsters_by_step(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.predation then
		if self.time_passed >= self.predation_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.aoe_prepare_duration and self.triggered_predation == false then
				self.aoe_loop_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('aoe_loop',self.target.Position)
				self:clear_monster()
				self.triggered_predation = true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed < self.dissolve_out_duration then
			local progress = 1 - self.time_passed / self.dissolve_out_duration
			self.dissolver:set_dissolve_progress(self.character, progress)
		else

			if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else

				if self.triggered_action == true then
					return
				end

				if self.dissolve_sfx ~= nil then
					self.dissolve_sfx:Stop()
					self.dissolve_sfx = nil
				end

				stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_magnitude, self.camera_duration)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action_explosion')
				CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:ChangeStageMusicVolume(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event, 1, 4)
				self:damage_by_action()
				self.character.SpineController:RemoveColor('dissolve', 0)
				self.triggered_action = true

			end

		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clear_aoe()
	for _, aoe in ipairs(self.aoe_list) do
		aoe:dispose()
	end

	for i = #self.aoe_list, 1, -1 do
		table.remove(self.aoe_list, i)
	end
end

function local_class:stop_aoe_sfx()

	if self.aoe_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.aoe_loop_sfx:FadeOut(1.0)
		self.aoe_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)

	if is_unity_null(hit_info.target) then

		if label > 0 then
			local pos = self.marker_list[label].position
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("born_explosion", pos)
			self.summon_info_list[label].egg_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("born_egg", pos)

			if self.triggered_land == false then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('proj_born')
				self.triggered_land = true
			end

		end

		return false
	end

	if label > 0 then
		return false
	end

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
		return true
	end

	return false;
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()

	self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(self.character)

	self:clear_aoe()

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.fx_barrier ~= nil then
		self.fx_barrier:Dispose()
		self.fx_barrier = nil
	end

	if self.character.DamagedBehaviour == CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.None
	end

	self.character.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	self:clear_monster()

	for i = 1, self.summon_count do
		if  self.summon_info_list[i].egg_fx ~= nil then
			self.summon_info_list[i].egg_fx:Dispose()
			self.summon_info_list[i].egg_fx = nil
		end
	end

	self:reset_ailment()

end

function local_class:on_fieldobject_destroyed(e)

	local fo = e.FieldObject
	if fo.EntityGroup ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0 then
		return
	end

	if self.monster_list_by_name == nil then
		return
	end

	local monster_info = self.monster_list_by_name[fo.Name]
	if monster_info == nil then
		return
	end

	monster_info.state = self.monster_state.idle

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.summon then
		return
	end

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('monster_slain')
	self.summon_monster_death_explosion():Instantiate(monster_info.fo.Position)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.routine_load_monster, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.routine_load_dissolver, self))
end

function local_class:routine_load_dissolver()
	self.dissolver = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.GetOrCreateGlobalTable('utils/SpineCharacterDissolver')
	self.dissolver:load_async(self.dissolver_path, self.dissolver_container)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(self.character)

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self:stop_aoe_sfx()

	if self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)
		self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = nil
	end


	if self.on_stage_loaded_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_func = nil
	end

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			self:update_action(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_action(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_action(dt)
	self.action_time_passed = self.action_time_passed + dt
	if self.current_action_index == 1 then
		if self.action_time_passed > 0.5 then
			self.action_time_passed = 0
			self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', self.character.Position + vector(0.45, 3.3, -0.65))
			stage_camera:Shake(self.cast_camera_shake_magnitude, 1.65)
			self.current_action_index = 2
		end
	elseif self.current_action_index == 2 then
		if self.action_time_passed > 1.45 then
			self.action_time_passed = 0

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.character.Position + vector(0.36, 0, -0.04))
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

			self.current_action_index = 3
		end
	elseif self.current_action_index == 3 then
		if self.action_time_passed > 0.25 then
			if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
				self.cast_effect:Dispose()
				self.cast_effect = nil
				self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("end")
			end
			stage_camera:Shake(1, 0.4)
			self:update_damage()

			self.action_time_passed = 0
			self.current_action_index = 6
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)

	for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local damage_rate = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(v) * self.damage_rate)
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.damage = damage_rate

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)

end

function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
		self.cast_effect:Dispose()
		self.cast_effect = nil
	end

	self:reset_ailment()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
