local local_class = newclass('BossSymptomRingBattleAction')

-- 플로우 설명

-- prepare
-- 1.5초 stomp_ready 에니메이션 상태로 대기

-- disappear
-- 끝났을 때 텔레포트 이팩트
-- 그리고 본인은 사라짐

-- trace
-- 바로 유저를 대상으로 원형 어텍 레인지 출력 / 어택 레인지의 지름은 5
-- 어택 레인지는 1초동안 유저를 쫒아 다니다가 남은 1초 위치 고정(lock, tracking 의 sub state 처리), 연출 마무리

-- appear
-- stomp 에니메이션
-- 폭팔 이펙트 연출, 시간 0.5초, 3번째 공격 시  추가공격 1/2 동시 실행
-- 일회성 데미지

-- 추가 공격 - 1
-- 추가 폭발, 지름 5 ~ 8 사이 범위
-- 링 모양의 범위
-- 지속 피해 고 텀 0.5초 / 지속시간 따로 정의 필요

-- 추가 공격 2
-- scream 에니메이션
-- 이펙트 연출
-- 캐릭터들 다운 상태 이상 부여
-- 카메라 쉐이크, 1.5초 0.8

-- 위 행동을 3번 반복
-- interval
-- to disappear / 조건 만족 시 post

-- post
-- groggy 에니메이션
-- 2초

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)
	self.disappear_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DisappearDuration", 0.4)
	self.trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TraceDuration", 1.3)
	self.lock_on_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LockOnDuration", 0.3)
	self.drop_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DropDuration", 0.2)
	self.appear_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AppearDuration", 0.2)

	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IntervalDuration", 0.0)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 2)

	self.stomp_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompRadius", 3)
	self.stomp_damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompDamageRatio", 0.2)

	self.drop_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DropDistance", 15)
	self.drop_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DropHeight", 8)

	self.repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RepeatCount", 3)

	self.appear_camera_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AppearCameraMagnitude", 0.6)
	self.appear_camera_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AppearCameraDuration", 0.3)

	self.enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced", false)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		disappear = 3,
		trace = 4,
		drop = 5,
		appear = 6,
		interval = 7,
		shake = 8,
		post = 9
	}

	self.dest_position = unity_class.vector3.zero

	self.attack_calculator = self:create_calculator(self.stomp_radius, self.appear_duration, self.appear_duration)

	if self.enhanced then
		self.ring_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RingRadius", 4)
		self.ring_damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RingDamageRatio", 0.1)
		self.ring_explosion_damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RingExplosionDamageRatio", 0.2)

		self.ring_list = {}

		local ring_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RingDamageTerm", 0.5)
		self.shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShakeDuration", 2.0)

		local duration = 6
		for i = 1, self.repeat_count do

			local ring_info =
			{
				attack_calculator = self:create_calculator(self.ring_radius, duration, ring_damage_term),
				fx_string = 'donut_crack_'..duration..'s',
				fx = nil
			}

			duration = duration - 2
			table.insert(self.ring_list, ring_info)
		end

		self.after_attack_camera_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AfterAttackCameraMagnitude", 0.8)
		self.after_attack_camera_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AfterAttackCameraDuration", 1.5)

		self.scream_offset_x = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ScreamOffsetX", 2.24)
		self.scream_offset_y = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ScreamOffsetY", 2.9)

		self.scream_period2_offset_x = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ScreamPeriod2OffsetX", 2.7)
		self.scream_period2_offset_y = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ScreamPeriod2OffsetY", 3.56)

	end

	if self.enhanced then
		self.attack_range_radius = self.ring_radius
	else
		self.attack_range_radius = self.stomp_radius
	end

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_range_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.current_count = 1
	self.has_ring_ended = false

	self.is_lock_on = false
	self.is_period2 = false

	self.dissolver_path = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'DissolverPath', 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/theatres/dissolve')
	self.dissolver_container = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'DissolverContainer', 'dissolve_material_container')

	self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent),self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)


	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.routine_load_dissolver, self))
end

function local_class:routine_load_dissolver()
	self.dissolver = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.GetOrCreateGlobalTable('utils/SpineCharacterDissolver')
	self.dissolver:load_async(self.dissolver_path, self.dissolver_container)
end

function local_class:create_calculator(radius, duration, damage_term)
	local info = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = duration
	info.Radius = radius
	return CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false, 0, -1)
end


function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if (is_unity_null(target)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:check_target_pos(pos)
	local final_dest_pos = pos
	local margin = self.stomp_radius
	if pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + margin then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + margin
	end
	if pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - margin then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - margin
	end
	if pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + margin then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + margin
	end
	if pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - margin then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - margin
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.disappear then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'disabled')
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'enabled')
		self.is_lock_on = false
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.drop then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.appear then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shake then
		self.has_ring_ended = false
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.current_count = 1
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.disappear then
		-- 텔레포트 이펙트 + 공격불가 판정
		self.character.SpineController:AddColor('dissolve', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		self.dissolver:set_dissolve_material(self.character)

		if self.current_count == 1 then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', self.character.Position)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.trace then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self:check_target_pos(self.target.Position), battle_util.get_height(self.target.Position))
		self.attack_range:Show(self.trace_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.drop then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('drop')
		self.character.SpineController:RemoveColor('dissolve', 0)
		self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(self.character)

		self.character.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

		local diced_step = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)

		local drop_direction = vector_util.left
		local face_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		if diced_step >= 0 then
			drop_direction = vector_util.left
			face_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		else
			drop_direction = vector_util.right
			face_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, face_direction)
		local drop_start_pos = self.dest_position + drop_direction * self.drop_distance + vector_util.up * self.drop_height;
		local diff = self.dest_position - drop_start_pos;
		self.drop_direction = diff.normalized;
		self.drop_speed = diff.magnitude / self.drop_duration

		self.character.Position = drop_start_pos

		self.trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("trail", self.character.Position)
		self.trail_effect.transform:SetParent(self.character.Transform)

	elseif next_state == self.state.appear then
		self.character.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true

		--self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('ring_explosion', self.dest_position)

		self.character.Position = self.dest_position

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', self.target.Position)
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.dest_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		stage_camera:Shake(self.appear_camera_magnitude, self.appear_camera_duration)

		if self.trail_effect ~= nil then
			self.trail_effect:Dispose()
			self.trail_effect = nil
		end

		if self.enhanced then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('donut_explosion', self.dest_position)

			self.ring_list[self.current_count].fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.ring_list[self.current_count].fx_string, self.dest_position)
			self.ring_list[self.current_count].attack_calculator.Position = self.dest_position
			self.ring_list[self.current_count].attack_calculator:Start()

			if self.current_count == 1 then
				self.ring_loop_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('ring_loop', self.target)
			end
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.current_count = self.current_count + 1
	elseif next_state == self.state.shake then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('scream')

		if self.is_period2 then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('scream2')
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('scream1')
		end

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = user_party[i]
			damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
		stage_camera:Shake(self.after_attack_camera_magnitude, self.after_attack_camera_duration)

		if self.is_period2 then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('scream_explosion', self.character.Position + vector(self.scream_period2_offset_x, self.scream_period2_offset_y, 0))
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('scream_explosion', self.character.Position + vector(self.scream_offset_x, self.scream_offset_y, 0))
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('scream_explosion')

		if self.ring_loop_sfx ~= nil then
			self.ring_loop_sfx:Stop()
			self.ring_loop_sfx = nil
		end

		self:shake_ring_explosion()

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:is_last_attack()
	return self.current_count >= self.repeat_count
end

function local_class:update_lock_on(dt)

	local target_pos = self:check_target_pos(self.target.Position)

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, target_pos)
	self.dest_position = target_pos
end

function local_class:update_drop(dt)
	self.character.Position = self.character.Position + self.drop_direction * self.drop_speed * dt;
end

function local_class:update_stomp_damage(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local dir = (fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreOptions | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.stomp_damage_ratio)
			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * 1.5

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_ring_damage(dt)

	if not self.enhanced then
		return
	end

	for _, ring in pairs(self.ring_list) do
		local attack_calculator = ring.attack_calculator
		if attack_calculator.IsStarted then
			local objects = attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local dir = fo.Position - attack_calculator.Position
					if dir.magnitude > self.stomp_radius then
						local dir_normalized = dir.normalized
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreOptions | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.ring_damage_ratio)
						damage_info.direction = dir_normalized
						damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_snow_01')
						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self:update_ring_damage(dt)

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	-- Prepare, Casting
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.disappear)
		else

		end
		-- Disappear
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.disappear then
		if self.time_passed >= self.disappear_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.trace)
		else
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.disappear_duration
			self.dissolver:set_dissolve_progress(self.character, progress)
		end
		-- Trace
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		if self.time_passed >= self.trace_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.drop)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.lock_on_duration then
				self:update_lock_on(dt)
			elseif self.is_lock_on == false then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('lock_on', self.target.Position)
				self.is_lock_on = true
			end
		end
		-- Drop
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.drop then
		if self.time_passed >= self.drop_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.appear)
		else
			self:update_drop(dt)
		end
		-- Appear
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.appear then
		if self.time_passed >= self.appear_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		else
			self:update_stomp_damage(dt)
		end
		-- Shake
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			if self.current_count >= self.repeat_count + 1 then
				if self.enhanced then
					self:change_state(self.state.shake)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end

			else
				self:change_state(self.state.disappear)
			end
		else

		end
		-- Interval
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shake then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shake_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			--if self.time_passed >= self.trace_duration and not self.has_ring_ended then
			--	self:shake_ring_explosion()
			--end
		end
		-- Post
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shake_ring_explosion()

	if not self.enhanced then
		return
	end

	for _, ring in pairs(self.ring_list) do
		local attack_calculator = ring.attack_calculator
		if attack_calculator.IsStarted then

			if attack_calculator:IsInRange(self.target) then
				local dir = self.target.Position - attack_calculator.Position
				if dir.magnitude > self.stomp_radius then
					local dir_normalized = dir.normalized
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = self.target
					damage_info.damage = math.floor(self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.ring_explosion_damage_ratio)
					damage_info.direction = dir_normalized
					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end

			if ring.fx ~= nil then
				ring.fx:Dispose()
				ring.fx = nil
			end

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('ring_explosion', attack_calculator.Position)
			attack_calculator:End()
		end
	end

	self.has_ring_ended = true

end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local event_string = e:GetParamAt(0)

	if event_string == 'start_phase2_period2' then
		self.is_period2 = true
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'enabled')
	self.character.SpineController:RemoveColor('dissolve', 0)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(self.character)
	self.current_count = 1

	if self.ring_list ~= nil then
		for _,ring in pairs(self.ring_list) do
			ring.attack_calculator:End()

			if ring.fx ~= nil then
				ring.fx:Dispose()
				ring.fx = nil
			end
		end

	end

	if self.trail_effect ~= nil then
		self.trail_effect:Dispose()
		self.trail_effect = nil
	end

	if self.ring_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.ring_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.ring_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(self.character)

	self.is_lock_on = false

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)

function local_class:cancel()

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_attack_range))

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.charge_attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.charge_attack_calculator:End()
		end

		end

		self.trail_effect_info.time_passed = 0
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.front_stamp_attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.front_stamp_attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.front_stamp then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.front_stamp_attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.front_stamp_attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.rear_stamp_prepare then
		self.rear_stamp_attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.rear_stamp_attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.rear_stamp then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.rear_stamp_attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.rear_stamp_attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_prepare_duration))

		self:set_dir_for_target()

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.charge_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
		self.charge_attack_range:Show(self.charge_prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_attack_range))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("charge_prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.charge_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.charge_attack_calculator:Start()

		self.trail_effect_info = {}
		self.dash_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("dash", self.character.Bounds.center
		, self.target_direction, self.character.Transform)
		local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-self.target_direction.z, self.target_direction.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
		local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
		self.dash_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation

		local trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("dash_trail", self.character.Bounds.center
		, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		trail.transform.localRotation = rotation
		self.trail_effect_info.effect = trail

		local charge_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("charge", self.character.Position
		, self.target_direction)
		charge_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("charge")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("charge")
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge_end then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("charge_end")
	elseif next_state == self.state.front_stamp_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.front_stamp_prepare_duration))

		self:set_dir_for_target()

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.front_stamp_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
		self.front_stamp_attack_range:Show(self.front_stamp_prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.front_stamp_attack_range))

		self.stamp_start_pos = self.character.Position

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stamp_ready")
		if self.enhanced and self.is_enlightened then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast2")
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast")
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.front_stamp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.front_stamp_attack_calculator.Position = self.stamp_start_pos
		self.front_stamp_attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction
		self.front_stamp_attack_calculator:Start()

		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('front_stamp', self.stamp_start_pos)
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, self.target_direction)
		effect.transform.rotation = rot

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("front_stamp")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stamp")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stamp2")
		self.current_stamp_count = self.current_stamp_count + 1

		stage_camera:Shake(self.front_shake_magnitude, self.front_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.rear_stamp_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:set_dir_for_target()

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.rear_stamp_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
		self.rear_stamp_attack_range:Show(self.rear_stamp_prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.rear_stamp_attack_range))

		self.stamp_start_pos = self.character.Position

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stamp_ready")
		if self.enhanced and self.is_enlightened then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast2")
		else

		self.rear_stamp_attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction
		self.rear_stamp_attack_calculator:Start()

		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('rear_stamp', self.stamp_start_pos)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stamp3")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stamp4")

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_dir_for_target()
	local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	local dir = diff.normalized
	self.target_direction = dir
	local lock_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, lock_dir)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.trail_effect_info ~= nil then
		if self.trail_effect_info.is_wait_dispose then

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.charge_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDamageTerm", 1)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(self.charge_distance, width))
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = 0.5
	info.Duration = self.charge_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(width / 2, 2, width / 2)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.nano_box_pos_list = {}
	self.dash_effect = nil
	self.trail_effect_info = nil

	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if (is_unity_null(target)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if self.character ~= nil then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
			if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'regen_nano_box' then
				local index = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
				local pos = vector(tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2)), tonumber(e:GetParamAt(3)), tonumber(e:GetParamAt(4)))
				table.insert(self.nano_box_pos_list,
						{index = index, pos = pos})
			end

			if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'remove_nano_box' then
				local index = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))

				for i = #self.nano_box_pos_list, 1, -1 do
					if self.nano_box_pos_list[i].index == index then
						table.remove(self.nano_box_pos_list, i)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	end

	end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end

		if self.dash_effect ~= nil then
			self.dash_effect:Dispose()
			self.dash_effect = nil
		end

		self.trail_effect_info.is_wait_dispose = true
		self.trail_effect_info.time_passed = 0
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	self.level = level

	self.animation_action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AnimationActionDuration", 0.3)

	end

	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = 1
	info.Duration = 99

		info.Radius = self.airborne_max_raidus
	end
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)

	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		animation_action = 3,
		action = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	self.on_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_event_func)

	self.is_enlightened = true--false
	self.target_pos = nil
	self.hit_target_list = nil
	-- 상태 초기화

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)

		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
			if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'start_phase2_period2' then
				self.is_enlightened = true

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

				self.zone_bound.center.z - self.z_distance_limit > self.character.Position.z then
			return false
		end

	self:set_dir_for_center()

	local pos = self.character.Position + (self.target_position_offset * self.target_dir.x)

function local_class:trigger()

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	end

	self.hit_target_list = nil

function local_class:cancel()

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	if self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.animation_action then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.hit_target_list = {}

		self:set_dir_for_center()

		local pos = self.character.Position + (self.target_position_offset * self.target_dir.x)
		self.target_pos = pos

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		if self.enhanced and self.is_enlightened then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast2")
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast")
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.animation_action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		if self.enhanced then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("smash")
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("smash3")
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("smash2")
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("smash")
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_pos
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("tail_smash", self.target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		stage_camera:Shake(self.shake_magnitude, self.shake_duration)
		if self.enhanced then
			local transform = stage_camera.Transform
			local ef = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("tail_screen", transform.position, unity_class.vector3.zero, transform.parent.transform)
			ef.transform.rotation = transform.rotation
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_dir_for_center()
	--센터 중앙과 반대방향으로 바라보도록
	local is_left_side = self.zone_bound.center.x > self.character.Position.x
	local side_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	if not is_left_side then
		side_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end

	self.target_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(side_dir)

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.animation_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.animation_action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.animation_action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '')
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_airborne(dt)
	--max범위 내에 캐릭터가 attack_pos로부터 min_radius 이상 떨어져 있다면 에어본
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.target_pos, self.airborne_max_raidus)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) or self:check_hit_target(fo) then
		else
			local dist = (fo.Position - self.target_pos).magnitude
			if math.abs(dist) < self.airborne_min_raidus then
				return
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo

			damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

	end
	return false

local local_class = newclass('BossTankerAscentAttackBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state =
	{
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		interval = 3,
		post = 4,

		-- actions
		slash = 11,
		back_slash = 12,
		thrust = 13,
		bash = 14
	}

	-- preapre
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.0)

	-- slash, back_slash, thrust, bash
	self.attack_duration = nil
	--self.attack_duration_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackDuration')
	self.attack_duration_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackDuration')
	self.attack_offset_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackOffset')

	self.interval_duration = nil
	self.interval_duration_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'IntervalDuration')

	self.attack_lenth = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackLenth')
	self.attack_width = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackWidth')

	self.dash_speed = nil
	self.dash_timing = nil
	self.dash_timing_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'DashTiming')
	self.dash_distance = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'DashDistance')
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'DashDuration')
	self.dash_dir = nil

	self.hit_timing_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	self.fx_timing = nil
	self.fx_timing_list = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'FxTiming')
	self.is_run_fx = false
	self.fx_thrust_dash = nil

	self.damage_modifier = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageModifier')
	self.damage_term = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageTerm')

	self.ani_key_list = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(params, 'AniKeys')

	self.default_sword_length = 1.7
	self.sword_lenth = self.default_sword_length
	local weapon1 = character_util.get_weapon_1(self.character)
	if weapon1 ~= nil and weapon1.WeaponSpec.WeaponTypeSpec.WeaponType == CS.Oak.WeaponType.OneHandSword then
		self.sword_lenth = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(weapon1.WeaponSpec.Data, 'Length', self.default_sword_length)
	end

	self.calculator_list = {}
	self.fixer = -10

	local size_y = bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y
	for i = self.state.slash, self.state.bash do
		local idx = i + self.fixer
		--local size = vector(self.attack_lenth[idx], size_y, self.attack_width[idx])
		local radius = self.sword_lenth
		local duration = self.attack_duration_list[idx]
		local term = self.damage_term[idx]
		local info = nil
		if i == self.state.slash or i == self.state.back_slash then
			info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, 180, 2, duration,term)
		elseif i == self.state.thrust then
			local size = vector(self.sword_lenth, size_y, 1.0)
			info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, duration, term, true)
		elseif i == self.state.bash then
			local size = vector(self.attack_lenth[idx], size_y, self.attack_width[idx])
			info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, duration, term, true)
		end

		local delay = self.hit_timing_list[idx]
		local calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, delay)
		table.insert(self.calculator_list, calc)
	end


	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

function local_class:trigger()

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state ~= nil and self.current_state >= self.state.slash and self.current_state <= self.state.bash then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.calculator_list[self.current_state + self.fixer]:End()

		if self.fx_thrust_dash ~= nil then
			self.fx_thrust_dash:Dispose()
			self.fx_thrust_dash = nil
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.ani_key_list[self.current_state + self.fixer], self.character.Position)
	end

	-- exit
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.interval_duration = self.interval_duration_list[self.current_state + self.fixer]

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true


	elseif next_state >= self.state.slash and next_state <= self.state.bash then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local ani_key = self.ani_key_list[next_state + self.fixer]
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(ani_key)

		local index = next_state + self.fixer
		self.calculator_list[index]:Start()
		self.attack_duration = self.attack_duration_list[index]
		self.fx_timing = self.fx_timing_list[index]
		self.dash_speed = self.dash_distance[index] / self.dash_duration[index]
		self.is_run_fx = false

		self:update_dir()

		local stay_time = self.dash_timing_list[index]
		local dash_time = self.attack_duration - stay_time
		local maxSpeed = 8.0
		local nonManualMaxSpeed = self.dash_distance[index] / dash_time
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(self.cs_battle_action, self.target,
				self.dash_dir, stay_time, dash_time,
				maxSpeed, nonManualMaxSpeed, nil, nil, 0)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

	end

	self.prev_state = self.current_state
	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:update_dir()

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.prev_state + 1)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	elseif self.current_state >= self.state.slash and self.current_state <= self.state.bash then
		--self:update_dash(dt)
		self:update_calc(dt)

		if self.fx_thrust_dash ~= nil then
			self:update_thrust_dash_fx()
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.fx_timing and self.is_run_fx == false then
			self:create_fx()
			self.is_run_fx = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.attack_duration then

function local_class:update_calc(dt)
	local calc = self.calculator_list[self.current_state + self.fixer]
	if calc == nil then
		return
	end

	local pos = self.character.Position
	local dir = self.dash_dir

	if self.current_state == self.state.slash or self.current_state == self.state.back_slash then
		local offset = self.attack_offset_list[self.current_state + self.fixer]
		pos = pos + direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction) * offset
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thrust then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
	else
	end

	calc.Position = pos
	calc.Direction = dir

	local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do

		self:publish_damage(fo)
	end

	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier[self.current_state + self.fixer]
	damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorNormal

function local_class:create_fx()
	local lengthScale = self.sword_lenth / self.default_sword_length;

	if self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		local rot = vector_util.zero;
		local offsetDist = 0.25
		local offset = vector_util.zero;
		local dirScale = vector_util.one * 0.7
		local yOffset = vector(0, 0.1, 0)

		if self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			rot = vector(0, 0, 0)
			offset = vector_util.forward * offsetDist

		elseif self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			rot = vector(0, 90, 0)
			offset = vector_util.right * offsetDist;
			dirScale.x = dirScale.x * -1

		elseif self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			rot = vector(0, 180, 0)
			offset = vector_util.back * offsetDist;
			dirScale.x = dirScale.x * -1

		elseif self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			rot = vector(0, 270, 0)
			offset = vector_util.left * offsetDist;
		end

		local pos = self.character.Position + yOffset + offset * lengthScale
		local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('slash', pos, vector_util.zero, self.character.transform)
		fx.transform.localScale = dirScale * lengthScale;
		fx.transform.localEulerAngles = rot

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.back_slash then
		local rot = vector_util.zero;
		local offsetDist = 0.25
		local offset = vector_util.zero;
		local dirScale = vector_util.one * 0.7
		local yOffset = vector(0, 0.1, 0)

		if self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			rot = vector(0, 0, 0)
			offset = vector_util.forward * offsetDist
			dirScale.x = dirScale.x * -1

		elseif self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			rot = vector(0, 90, 0)
			offset = vector_util.right * offsetDist;

		elseif self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			rot = vector(0, 180, 0)
			offset = vector_util.back * offsetDist;

		elseif self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			rot = vector(0, 270, 0)
			offset = vector_util.left * offsetDist;
			dirScale.x = dirScale.x * -1
		end

		local pos = self.character.Position + yOffset + offset * lengthScale
		local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('slash', pos, vector_util.zero, self.character.gameObject.transform)
		fx.transform.localScale = dirScale * lengthScale;
		fx.transform.localEulerAngles = rot

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thrust then
		local bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.character, '[base]weapon1').Bone
		local pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(bone, self.character)
		local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
		self.fx_thrust_dash = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('thrust', pos, dir)
		self.character.SpineController:Jump(0.2, 0.125)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.bash then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('bash', self.character.Position, self.dash_dir, self.character.gameObject.transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('bash', self.character.Position)
	end

	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

return {

local local_class = newclass('BossTankerAscentChargeBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.mod = {
		normal = 1,
		enhance = 2
	}

	self.state =
	{
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		charge = 3,
		impact = 4,
		post = 5,
	}

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration')

	-- charge
	self.charge_duration = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'ChargeDuration')
	self.charge_max_count = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(params, 'ChargeMaxCount')
	self.charge_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeLength', 6.0)
	self.charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeWidth', 2.0)
	self.charge_effect_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeEffectOffset', 0.3)
	self.charge_speed = nil
	self.charge_dir = nil
	self.charge_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeKnockbackForce', 1.0)
	self.charge_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDamageModifier', 1.0)
	local charge_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDamageTerm', 0.2)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, vector(self.charge_length, self.charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.charge_width / 2, 999, charge_damage_term)
	self.charge_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)

	-- impact
	self.impact_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ImpactRadius', 2.5)
	self.impact_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ImpactKnockbackForce', 1.0)
	self.impact_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ImpactDamageModifier', 1.0)
	info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.impact_radius, 999, -1)
	self.impact_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeMagnitude', 0.5)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeDuration', 0.1)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	-- etc
	self.enhace_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'EnhaceHpRatio', 0.5)

	self.fx_ready = nil
	self.fx_dash = nil
	self.fx_smoke = nil

	-- init
	self:change_mod(self.mod.normal)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.charge_count = 0
	self:check_and_change_mod()
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.charge_calculator:End()

		if self.fx_ready ~= nil then
			self.fx_ready:Dispose()
			self.fx_ready = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.impact then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.impact_calculator:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', self.character.Position)

		self.charge_count = self.charge_count + 1
		self.charge_speed = self.charge_length / self.charge_duration[self.current_mod]

		self:update_dir()

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration[self.current_mod])

		--local pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.right * self.charge_effect_offset
		self.fx_ready = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', vector_util.zero, vector_util.zero)
		self:update_fx_ready()

	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')

		self.charge_calculator:Start()

		self.fx_dash = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('charge', self.character.Position, self.charge_dir, self.character.transform)
		self.fx_smoke = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('smoke', self.character.Position, self.charge_dir, self.character.transform)

	elseif next_state == self.state.impact then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', self.character.Position)

		self.impact_calculator:Start()
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self:update_calc_impact(0)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('impact', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		if self.fx_ready ~= nil then
			self.fx_ready:Dispose()
			self.fx_ready = nil
		end

		if self.fx_dash ~= nil then
			self.fx_dash:Dispose()
			self.fx_dash = nil
		end

		if self.fx_smoke ~= nil then
			self.fx_smoke:Dispose()
			self.fx_smoke = nil
		end
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:change_mod(new_mod)
	if new_mod == self.current_mod then
		return
	end

	self.current_mod = new_mod
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:update_dir()
		self:update_attack_range()
		self:update_fx_ready()

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration[self.current_mod] then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self:update_move(dt)
		self:update_fx_ready()

		if self:update_calc_charge(dt) or self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration[self.current_mod] then
			self:change_state(self.state.impact)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.impact then
		self:change_state(self.state.post)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			if self.charge_count < self.charge_max_count[self.current_mod] then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.none)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_dir()
	self.charge_dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_dir)
end

	move_info.direction = self.charge_dir
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt

	--	self.prev_pos = self.character.Position
	--	return false
	--else
	--	return true
	--end
end

function local_class:update_calc_charge(dt)
	self.charge_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.charge_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	local is_hit = false
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.character) == false then
			self:publish_damage_charge(fo)
			is_hit = true
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	return is_hit
end

function local_class:update_calc_impact(dt)
	self.impact_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.impact_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		self:publish_damage_impact(fo)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_attack_range()
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_dir)
end

function local_class:update_fx_ready()
	if self.fx_ready == nil then
		return
	end

	local y = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector_util.forward, vector_util.get_x0z(self.charge_dir)).eulerAngles.y
	self.fx_ready.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, y, 0)

	local pos = self.character.Position + self.charge_dir * self.charge_effect_offset
	self.fx_ready.transform.localPosition = pos
end

function local_class:publish_damage_charge(fo)
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.charge_damage_modifier
	damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knockBackDirection = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.charge_knockback_force

	damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.impact_knockback_force
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

function local_class:check_and_change_mod()
	if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) <= self.enhace_hp_ratio then
		self:change_mod(self.mod.enhance)

	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.ambush then
		if self.time_passed >= self.ambush_duration then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ready then

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
	if diff.magnitude <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local direction = diff.normalized
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = direction
	local ctemp = self.tracking_speed * dt
	move_info.magnitude = diff.magnitude < ctemp and diff.magnitude or ctemp

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

function local_class:publish_damage_assault()
	self.assault_damage_calculator:Start()
	self.assault_damage_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.assault_damage_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		local knockback_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
		if knockback_direction == vector_util.zero then
			knockback_direction = (self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position).normalized
		end
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.assault_knockback_force
		damage_info.modifier = self.assault_damage_modifier
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end

	if objects.Count > 0 then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('assault_hit')
	end

	objects:Dispose()
	self.assault_damage_calculator:End()
end

function local_class:change_crash_behaviour(is_burrow)
	if is_burrow then
		-- 데미지 및 충돌 비헤이비어 변경
		self.damaged_behaviour_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour:GetType()
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
			self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
		end
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	else
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type ~= nil then
			if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
				self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
				self.death_type = nil
			else
				local instance_info = self.damaged_behaviour_type:GetProperty("Instance",
						CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public | CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static)

				if instance_info ~= nil then
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = instance_info:GetValue(nil)
				else
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.System.Activator.CreateInstance(self.damaged_behaviour_type)
				end
			end

			self.damaged_behaviour_type = nil
		end
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	end
end

function local_class:check_near_target()
	if self.target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if diff > self.near_distance then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.sfx_tracking ~= nil then
		self.sfx_tracking:Stop()
		self.sfx_tracking = nil
	end
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self:change_crash_behaviour(false)
end

	self:cancel()
end

	--변수 해제

	self.character = nil

	self.params_dict = nil

	}

	-- action
	self.rush_duration = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('rush')

	local radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DolphinRadius', 3.0)
	local term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 1.0)
	local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius, 99, term)
	self.damage_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	self.earthquake_attack_range:Hide()

	self.rush_speed = 10
	self.min_progress = 0.7

	self.ani_ambush = 'ambush'
	self.ani_assault = 'assault'

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.action)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.damage_calculator:End()
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ambush then
		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		--self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.earthquake then
		self.earthquake_attack_range:Hide()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.assault then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.prev_pos = self.character.Position
		self.rush_direction = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

		local c_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.rush_direction)
		self.character.Direction = c_dir
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, c_dir)

		self.damage_calculator:Start()

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.ani_dolphin)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('dolphin')

	elseif next_state == self.state.ambush then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.ani_ambush)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('ambush', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('ambush')

	elseif next_state == self.state.earthquake then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.earthquake_attack_range, self.character.Position)
		self.earthquake_attack_range:Show(self.earthquake_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.assault then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.ani_assault)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('assault', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('assault')

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- update
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:publish_damage_rush()

		if self:update_move(dt) or self.time_passed >= self.rush_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.ambush)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ambush then
		if self.time_passed >= self.ambush_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.earthquake)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.earthquake then
		if self.time_passed >= self.earthquake_duration then
			self:publish_damage_earthquake()
			self:change_state(self.state.assault)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.assault then
		if self.time_passed >= self.assault_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.rush_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.rush_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.rush_direction), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	-- 실제 이동 거리의 n% 이상 진행되었다면 스무스하게 미끄러지고 있다 판단
	local diff = (self.prev_pos - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if diff > self.rush_speed * dt * self.min_progress then
		self.prev_pos = self.character.Position
		return false
	else
		return true
	end
end

	local objects = self.damage_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		local knockback_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
		if knockback_direction == vector_util.zero then
			knockback_direction = (self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position).normalized
		end
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end

	end

	objects:Dispose()

	move_info.direction = self.rush_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.rush_speed[self.rush_count] * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.rush_direction), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	-- 실제 이동 거리의 n% 이상 진행되었다면 스무스하게 미끄러지고 있다 판단
	local diff = (self.prev_pos - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if diff > self.rush_speed[self.rush_count] * dt * self.rush_min_progress then
		self.prev_pos = self.character.Position
		return false
	else
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking(dt)
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
	if diff.magnitude <= 0 then
		return
	end


	local direction = diff.normalized
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = direction
	local ctemp = self.tracking_speed * dt
	move_info.magnitude = diff.magnitude < ctemp and diff.magnitude or ctemp

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(direction))
end

function local_class:update_calc(dt)
	self.rush_damage_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.rush_damage_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		local knockback_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.rush_knockback_force[self.rush_count]
		damage_info.modifier = self.rush_damage_modifier[self.rush_count]

	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	self.spread_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpreadAngle', 20)

	self.shoot_timing = math.min(self.action_duration, self.shoot_timing)
	self.mid = math.floor((self.projectile_amount + 1) / 2 - 1)

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Projectile', 'proj_valancia')
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local pattern_info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	pattern_info.columns = 1

	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	self.projectile_list = {}
end

function local_class:is_loaded()

		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

end

function local_class:trigger()
	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd);

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		return
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if self.prepare_duration > 0 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.forward = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.forward)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		if self.prepare_duration > 0 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		end
		self.update_dir = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.forward = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.forward)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.shoot then
		self:sfx_update()
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.character.Position.x <= self.target.Position.x then
				self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			else
				self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.shoot then
			if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
				self.shoot = true

				for i = 0, self.projectile_amount - 1 do
					local rot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(self.spread_angle * self.projectile_amount * -0.5 + i * self.spread_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * self.forward
					local label = math.floor(unity_class.time.time * 10) + i
					self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.character.Position + self.forward * 0.35, rot_dir.normalized, label)
					if i == self.mid then
						self.projectile_list[label] = self.shoot_helper:GetProjectile(label)
						self.sfx_list[label] = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blade", self.projectile_list[label].moveInfo.position)
					end
				end
			end
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sfx_update()
	local count = 0
	for label, sfx in pairs(self.sfx_list) do
		local projectile = self.projectile_list[label]
		if projectile ~= nil and projectile.active then
			count = count + 1
			sfx:SetPosition(projectile.moveInfo.position)
		else
			sfx:Stop()
			self.projectile_list[label] = nil
			self.sfx_list[label] = nil
		end
	end
	if count == 0 then
		self.shoot = false
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return bool
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil

	self.sfx_list = nil
	self.projectile_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
