	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		wait = 3,
		attack = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	-- parameters
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.5)
	self.wait_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WaitDuration', 3)
	self.attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDuration', 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RestTime', 1)

	self.charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDistance', 10)
	local charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeWidth', 2)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1.0)
	self.knockback_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackRadius', 1.5)
	self.counter_damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CounterDamageRatio', 0.5)

	self.ailment = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = self.attack_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(charge_width / 2, 2, charge_width / 2)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.charge_distance
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.cs_battle_action.crashBehaviour ~= nil then
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_battle_action.crashBehaviour = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.wait)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if self.time_passed >= self.wait_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		if self.time_passed < self.attack_duration then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.attack_duration * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, fo) and -- 공격한 대상만
				if CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerTypesExtensions.IsManual(fo.FieldObjectController) and -- 모든 메뉴얼 캐릭터(코옵 플레이어)
						battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.counter_damage_ratio)
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment, 1)
					damage_info.forceAilment = true

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if next_state ~= self.state.wait then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		self:reset_ailment()
		self.wait_fx:Dispose()
		self.wait_fx = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.sfx_holder = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		self.charge_direction = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('prepare', self.character.Position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('wait')
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('wait')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')
	elseif next_state == self.state.wait then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 충격파
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('knockback', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('knockback')
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.knockback_radius)
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

				if dir_vector:IsAlmostZero() then
					dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = 0
				damage_info.direction = dir_vector
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir_vector
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
				damage_info.knockBackForce = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()

		-- 반격 태세
		self:set_ailment_resist()
		self.wait_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('wait', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
		self.sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('wait')
	elseif next_state == self.state.attack then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
			self.charge_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack', self.character.Position + self.charge_direction * 2, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)

			if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
				self.attack_calculator:Start()
			end
			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.charge_direction)
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack')
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack')
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('dash')
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
			local exclude_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive | CS.Oak.DamageType.DotDamage
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) and
					CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerTypesExtensions.IsManual(e.Info.sender.FieldObjectController) and
					e.Info.type & exclude_damage_type == CS.Oak.DamageType.None then
				self.target = e.Info.sender
				self:change_state(self.state.attack)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.ailment = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.origin_resist = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
			self.attack_calculator:Start()
		end

		self.attack_count = 0
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)

	else

	end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		else
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			local dir_to_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(self.charge_direction)
			move_info.direction = dir_to_vector
			move_info.magnitude = (self.move_speed * self.action_duration) / self.action_duration * dt

				local line_start_pos = self.character.Bounds.center + dir_to_vector * self.hit_bound_offset

				self.effect_timer = 0.0
				local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', pos, dir, self.character.Transform)
				effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(dir, unity_class.vector3.up)
			end
		end
	end

end

end

	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.action_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.action_key, self.character.Position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
				{
					-- 어떤 이벤트인지
					'blood_bead_drop_request_by_target',
					-- 어느 캐릭터 주위로 뿌릴것인지
					self.character.Name,
					-- 몇개 뿌릴것인지
					self.create_bead_count
				}))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 넉백 추가
		self:knockback()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		--BloodBeadController 에 메세지
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		self.action_duration = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration(self.action_key)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end


function local_class:knockback()
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.character.Position, self.knockback_range, 2)
	for _, v in pairs(objects) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, v) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			--damage_info.damage = v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.knockback_damage
			damage_info.modifier = self.knockback_modifier
			damage_info.direction = vector_util.normalized(v.Position - self.character.Position)
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(v.Position - self.character.Position)
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.create_bead_count = nil
	self.prepare_key = nil
	self.action_key = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

	self.attack_range = nil

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
	-- 배틀존을 좌, 우 두 구역으로 나눠서 이동 계산시 쓰도록 함.
	local center = self.zone_bound.center
	local modX = self.zone_bound.size.x / 2
	local modZ = self.zone_bound.size.z
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, self.zone_bound.size.y, modZ)

	self.left_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX/2, 0, 0), size)
	self.right_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX/2, 0, 0), size)

	-- 사망후 부활 등으로 다시 설정되는 경우에 갯수 처음부터 카운트 하도록 수정
	self.current_bead_count = 0

	--전체범위 공격 범위 표시기
	center.y = 0.3
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(center,
			unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.size.x, self.zone_bound.size.z))
	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.move_outside then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_outside then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.inhale_bead then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:remove_remain_beads()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_blade then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_blade then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.is_attack_blade_done = true
		--락 풀어야 할때 호출
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		if next_state == self.state.groggy then
			self:reset_ailment()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_inside then -- 구슬 특정수 까지 흡수하지 못하면 발동하지 않음.
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_map then -- 맵어택 준비동작
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_map then -- 구슬 특정수 까지 흡수하지 못하면 발동하지 않음.
		-- 맵 범위 공격 모션 끝나는 시점에 동작 하도록 수정
		self:damage_to_all()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 그로기 들어가면 면역 해제 해도 될것으로 보임.
		self:reset_ailment()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then -- 2
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:set_ailment_resist()
		self.current_consumed_bead_count = 0
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_resize_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key, self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.move_outside then --3
		-- 순간이동하여 위치 변경 하는 것으로 사양 변경.
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 순간이동 이펙트 출력
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		-- 순간이동 하기위해 캐릭터 비활성화
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'disabled')

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		-- 벽끼임 사태가 발생하여 위치에 보정을 넉넉하게 함.
		local re_pos = self.character.Bounds.size.x + self.character.Bounds.extents.x
		-- 캐릭터가 오른쪽 바운드에 포함되어있다면 보스는 왼쪽 벽으로
		if self.right_bound:Contains(self.target.Position) then
			self.end_position = unity_class.vector3( -self.zone_bound.extents.x + re_pos, self.character.Position.y, self.zone_bound.center.z)
		else
			self.end_position = unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.extents.x - re_pos, self.character.Position.y, self.zone_bound.center.z)
		end
		-- 위치, 방향 세팅
		self.character.Position = self.end_position
		self.character.Direction =  vector_util.to_side_dir(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position)

		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'enabled')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		--텔레포트 하여 위치 변경된 이후 구슬 변경으로 수정됨
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
				{
					'blood_bead_mode_change_request_by_farthest',
					2, --모드 변경 데이터
					self.character.Name -- 어느캐릭터에서 가장 먼 위치의 구슬이 변경될 것인가
				}))

	elseif next_state == self.state.inhale_bead then -- 4
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.consume_key)-- 표정추가
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.consume_key) -- 애니메이션 추가
		-- 배틀존 중앙 바라봄
		local dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
		-- 보스에게 흡수되도록 이벤트 보냄
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
				{
					'blood_bead_move_request_by_target',
					self.character.Name,
				}))
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_blade then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_blade_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key) -- 캐스팅 애니메이션 추가

	elseif next_state == self.state.attack_blade then -- 5
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 개당 발사 시간
		self.blade_term =  self.blade_duration / self.blade_count
		self.current_blade_count = 0
		self.blade_time_passed = 0
		self:shoot_blade()
		-- 보호막 없애주는 타이밍 조정을 위해서
		self.is_attack_blade_done = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.move_inside then -- 6
		-- 순간이동하는 것으로 사양 변경
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 순간이동 이펙트 출력
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		-- 순간이동 하기위해 캐릭터 비활성화
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'disabled')

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		-- 배틀존 중앙으로 들어갈것
		self.end_position = self.zone_bound.center
		-- 캐릭터 높이차이로 인해 데미지 들어가지 않는 경우 발생.
		self.end_position.y = self.character.Position.y
		-- 위치, 방향 세팅
		self.character.Position = self.end_position
		-- 타겟 바라보는 방향으로
		self.character.Direction =  vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)

		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'enabled')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		-- 들어가는 동안 서서히 전체공격 표시
		self.attack_range:Show(self.move_in_duration + self.prepare_map_duration + self.map_attack_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_map then -- 7
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 맵공격 준비시 이모션/애니메이션 추가
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.cast2_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.attack_map then -- 7
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.map_explosion_key)
		self.map_attack_duration = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration(self.map_explosion_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then -- 8
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.groggy_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_key)

		stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_resize_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then -- 9
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

--상태이상 면역
function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

-- 캐릭터 forward 기준으로 좌, 우 1도씩 분할하여
-- 최대각 과 최소각 사이의 랜덤 각도를 뽑아 캐릭터 방향을 해당 각도로 돌린 방향을 산출함.
function local_class:random_dir()
	-- 계산 위한 최대각도는 지정된 범위각의 절반으로 함.
	local max_degree = self.blade_spread_degree / 2
	-- 각 방향으로 난사 하기 위한 랜덤 각도 산출
	local random_degree = random_util.get_random_int(-max_degree, max_degree)
	-- 현재 캐릭터가 보고있는 방향 기준으로 각도 회전 할것.
	local dir_vec = vector_util.normalized(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position)
	-- 위로 발사하거나 하지 않도록
	dir_vec.y = 0
	-- y 축 기준으로 회전각도 계산
	local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(random_degree, unity_class.vector3.up)
	-- 단위벡터로 반환
	return vector_util.normalized(rotation * dir_vec)
end

function local_class:get_shoot_offset_by_dir()
	local dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position)
	local str_dir = direction_util.to_str(dir)
	if str_dir == 'left' then
		return unity_class.vector3(-0.5, 0, 0)
	elseif str_dir == 'right' then
		return unity_class.vector3(0.5, 0, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_blade()
	--애니메이션 제거 후 재 플레이 가능 하도록.
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.blade_time_passed = 0
	self.current_blade_count = self.current_blade_count + 1
	self.shoot_dir = self:random_dir()
	self.shoot_helper:ShootDirection(self.shoot_dir, self:get_shoot_offset_by_dir(), self.current_blade_count, -1, nil, false, 0)

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.blade_key, self.character.Position)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.blade2_key, self.character.Position)
	local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_side_dir(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position))
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.blade_key, self.character.Bounds.center, dir)
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.blade_key)
end

function local_class:damage_to_all()
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.map_explosion_key, self.zone_bound.center)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.map_explosion_key, self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_magnitude, self.camera_duration)

	for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = v
		local damage = character_util.get_max_hp(v) * self.map_attack_damage_percent
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(damage)
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.is_attack_blade_done then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shield_break_duration then
			self:remove_barrier()
			self.is_attack_blade_done = false
		end
	end

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.move_outside)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_outside then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_out_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.inhale_bead)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.inhale_bead then
		-- 남아있는 구슬이 없다면 전환
		if self.current_bead_count <= 0 then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_blade)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.inhale_max_duration then
			-- 모종의 이유로 구슬이 전부 흡수되지 않았을때를 방지하기 위한 코드

			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_blade)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_blade then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_blade_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack_blade)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_blade then
		self:update_blade(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.blade_duration then
			--구슬 5개 이상 먹었다면 맵공격 루틴으로
			if self.current_consumed_bead_count >= self.consume_bead_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.move_inside)
			else
				-- 구슬 못먹었으면 그로기루틴으로
				self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_inside then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_in_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_map)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_map then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_map_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack_map)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_map then
		if self.time_passed >= self.map_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_remain_beads()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
		{
			'remove_beads'
		}))
end

-- 블레이드 시간당 연속 해서 공격함
function local_class:update_blade(dt)
	self.blade_time_passed = self.blade_time_passed + dt
	-- 시간마다 발사. 블레이드 최대 카운트 까지
	if self.blade_time_passed >= self.blade_term and self.current_blade_count < self.blade_count then
		self:shoot_blade()
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end
	-- 상태이상 면역 해제
	self:reset_ailment()
	--배리어 제거
	self:remove_barrier()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

-- 구슬과 충돌시 처리
-- 0 : 이벤트 구분
-- 1 : 부딛힌 캐릭터 이름
-- 2 : 구슬 모드
-- 3 : 구슬 좌표 x
-- 4 : 구슬 좌표 z
function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_collide' then
			-- 보스에게 충돌 되었다면 카운트 증가
			if e:GetParamAt(1) == self.character.Name then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.consume_key, position)
				self.current_consumed_bead_count = self.current_consumed_bead_count + 1
			end
			-- 배리어 모드의 구슬인데 플레이어 파티 캐릭터와 충돌 되었다면 부딛힌 위치에 배리어 설정해야 함.
			if tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2)) == 2 then
				local consume_character = get_character(e:GetParamAt(1))
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, consume_character) then
					self:set_barrier(tonumber(e:GetParamAt(3)), tonumber(e:GetParamAt(4)))
				end
			end
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_create' then
			self.current_bead_count = self.current_bead_count + 1
			if self.current_state >= self.state.inhale_bead then
				-- 이미 흡수이벤트 발동 한 이후로 구슬이 다시 생겼다면 구슬 이동 이벤트 재 발행
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
						{
							'blood_bead_move_request_by_target',
							self.character.Name,
						}))
			end
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'blood_bead_dispose' then
			self.current_bead_count = self.current_bead_count - 1
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 배리어 확인
-- 최대체력 비례 데미지를 입히기 때문에 OnHit 하지 않고 데미지 따로 보냄
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		if hit_info.target ~= nil then
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
				if #self.fx_barrier_list > 0 then
					for _, v in pairs(self.fx_barrier_list) do
						-- hit 된 캐릭터 위치와 배리어의 포지션을 비교
						local distance = vector_util.distance(hit_info.target.Position, v.transform.position)

						if distance > self.barrier_range then
							self:projectile_damage(hit_info.target)
						else
							if battle_util.is_manual_local(hit_info.target) then
								self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.barrier_hit_key, v.transform.position)
								self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.barrier_hit_key, v.transform.position)
							end
						end
					end
				else
					-- 배리어 존재하지 않으면 무조건 타격됨
					self:projectile_damage(hit_info.target)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:projectile_damage(target)
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	local damage = character_util.get_max_hp(target) * self.blade_damage_modifier
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(damage)
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

-- 해당 위치에 배리어 설치함.
function local_class:set_barrier(x, z)
	local position = unity_class.vector3(x, 0, z)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.barrier_key, position)
	table.insert(self.fx_barrier_list, self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.barrier_key, position))
end

function local_class:remove_barrier()
	if #self.fx_barrier_list > 0 then
		for i = #self.fx_barrier_list, 1, -1 do
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.barrier_end_key, self.fx_barrier_list[i].transform.position)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.barrier_end_key, self.fx_barrier_list[i].transform.position)
			self.fx_barrier_list[i]:Dispose()
			self.fx_barrier_list[i] = nil
			table.remove(self.fx_barrier_list, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_event_func)
		self.on_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.move_out_duration = nil
	self.blade_duration = nil
	self.blade_count = nil
	self.blade_damage_modifier = nil
	self.blade_spread_degree = nil
	self.barrier_range = nil
	self.barrier_count = nil
	self.move_in_duration = nil
	self.map_attack_duration = nil
	self.map_attack_damage_percent = nil
	self.consume_bead_count = nil
	self.groggy_duration = nil
	self.camera_size = nil
	self.camera_resize_duration = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.blade_term = nil
	self.blade_time_passed = nil
	self.current_bead_count = nil
	self.current_consumed_bead_count = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then

	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.cast_key = nil
	self.barrier_key = nil
	self.barrier_end_key = nil
	self.blade_key = nil
	self.map_explosion_key = nil
	self.groggy_key = nil
	self.fx_barrier_list = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.left_bound = nil
	self.right_bound = nil
end

local local_class = newclass('BossVampireLordBloodyStormBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	-- 구슬 몇개 생성 할것인지
	self.create_bead_count = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CreateBeadCount", 5)

	--데미지 들어가는 간격
	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.aerial_ailment = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	self.channeling_key = 'channeling'
	self.channeling_end_key = 'channeling_end'
	self.storm_key = 'storm'

	self.fx_storm = nil
	self.fx_channeling = nil
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()



	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_channeling) then
		self.fx_channeling:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_channeling = nil

	self:reset_ailment()

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		--액션으로 넘어가도 채널링 애니메이션 없어지지 않음
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_channeling) then
			self.fx_channeling:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_channeling = nil

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.channeling_end_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 상태이상 면역 해제
		self:reset_ailment()
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		-- 상태이상 면역
		self:set_ailment_resist()
		-- 캐스팅 시부터 채널링 애니메이션 출력
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.channeling_key)
		self.fx_channeling = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.channeling_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 시작할때 타겟 위치에 폭풍 이펙트
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.storm_key, self.target.Position)

		-- 액션 시작할려그러는데 남아있으면 해제
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_storm) then
			self.fx_storm:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_storm = nil

		self.fx_storm = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.storm_key, self.target.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.target.Transform)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
				{
					-- 어떤 이벤트인지
					'blood_bead_drop_request_by_target',
					-- 어느 캐릭터 주위로 뿌릴것인지
					self.target.Name,
					-- 몇개 뿌릴것인지
					self.create_bead_count
				}))
		self.damage_time_passed = 0
		-- 에어본 확정 시켜서 못움직이도록 해야 함.
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = self.target
		--에어본 확정
		damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.aerial_ailment, 1)
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

--상태이상 면역
function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

shot_class.mt = { __index = shot_class}

function shot_class:new(index, parent_class, position, attack_range)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj.index = index
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	local radius = parent_class.ball_radius
	local bound = parent_class.zone_bound
	local fix_pos = self:check_circle_in_bound(bound, position, radius)
	obj.position = fix_pos

	self.ball_state = parent_class.ball_state
	self.current_state = parent_class.ball_state.none

	self.time_passed = 0.0
	self.total_time_passed = 0.0

	return obj

function shot_class:check_circle_in_bound(bound, pos, radius)
	if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainCircle(bound, pos, radius) then
		return pos
	end

	local x = pos.x
	local z = pos.z

	-- left
	if bound.min.x + radius > pos.x then
		x = bound.min.x + radius
	end
	-- right
	if bound.max.x - radius < pos.x then
		x = bound.max.x - radius
	end
	-- top
	if bound.max.z - radius < pos.z then
		z = bound.max.z - radius
	end
	-- bot
	if bound.min.z + radius > pos.z then
		z = bound.min.z + radius
	end

	return unity_class.vector3(x, 0, z)
end

function shot_class:change_state(next_state)

	if self.current_state == self.ball_state.idle then
		self.attack_range:Hide()

	end

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	self:update_shoot(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot)
		else
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		if self.shot_count >= self.shot_max_count and self.shot_interval_passed >= self.shot_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.move_center)
			return
		end
		if self.shot_interval_passed >= self.shot_interval then
			local obj = self:create_shot_class(self.shot_index)
			table.insert(self.shot_class_holder, obj)
			obj:change_state(self.ball_state.idle)
			self.shot_interval_passed = 0
			self.shot_count = self.shot_count + 1
			self.shot_index = self.shot_index + 1
		else
			self.shot_interval_passed = self.shot_interval_passed + dt
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_center then
		self:change_state(self.state.knockback_prepare)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.knockback_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.knockback_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.knockback)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.knockback then
		self:change_state(self.state.post)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_shoot(dt)
	if self.shot_class_holder ~= nil and #self.shot_class_holder > 0 then
		for idx = #self.shot_class_holder, 1, -1 do
			local holder = self.shot_class_holder[idx]
			if holder.current_state == self.ball_state.destroy then
				table.remove(self.shot_class_holder, idx)
			else
				holder:update_frame(dt)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_shot_class(index)
	return shot_class:new(index, self, self.target.Position, self.attack_range_list[self.shot_count + 1])
end

function local_class:create_explosion(position)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion')
	-- 클로드 사망시 데미지 판정 X
	if self.character == nil or character_util.is_dead(self.character) then
		return
	end

	self.explosion_calculator.Position = position
	local objects = self.explosion_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - position).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			self:create_bead(fo.Name, self.explosion_bead_count)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

end

function local_class:create_bead(name, amount)
	-- 액션 활성화 되어있는 경우에만 구슬 드랍 되도록 수정
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
				{
					'blood_bead_drop_request_by_target',
					name,
					amount
				}))
	end
end

function local_class:create_cross_projectile(position)
	self.shoot_cross_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(position, unity_class.vector3.forward, 0, 0, nil, false)
	self.shoot_cross_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(position, unity_class.vector3.back, 0, 0, nil, false)
	self.shoot_cross_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(position, unity_class.vector3.right, 0, 0, nil, false)
	self.shoot_cross_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(position, unity_class.vector3.left, 0, 0, nil, false)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('blade')
end

function local_class:check_ball_collision(position)
	self.explosion_calculator.Position = position
	local is_collision = false
	local objects = self.explosion_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			is_collision = true
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	return is_collision

end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if hit_info.target == nil then
		return true
	end

	if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
		return true
	end

	-- label이 0 초과라면 구체에 히트된 것이다
	if label > 0 then
		if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
			self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			self:create_explosion(hit_info.position)
			local proj = self.shoot_helper:GetProjectile(label)
			proj:Deactive()
			self:create_cross_projectile(hit_info.position)
		end
	-- 0 이라면 십자 프로젝타일에 히트된 것이다
	else
		if self.shoot_cross_helper ~= nil then
			self.shoot_cross_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			self:create_bead(hit_info.target.Name, self.shot_bead_count)
		end
	end

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = hit_info.target
	damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

	return true
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	if self.shot_class_holder ~= nil then
		for idx = #self.shot_class_holder, 1, -1 do
			local holder = self.shot_class_holder[idx]
			if self.is_dispose == false then
				self:create_explosion(holder.position)
			end
			holder:dispose()
			table.remove(self.shot_class_holder, idx)
		end
	end
end

	self.level = nil

	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.shoot_cross_helper = nil

	self.time_passed = nil

	self.shot_class_holder = {}

	self.shot_bead_count = nil

	self.shoot_key = nil
	self.knockback_key = nil

create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

local local_class = newclass('BossVampireLordCloneChargeBattleAction')

local clone_class = {
    index = nil,

}
clone_class.mt = { __index = clone_class }

-- 분신 공격
-- 영웅으로부터 n떨어진 위치에 360도 랜덤 생성
-- n초후 돌진, 영웅 관통, 벽에 충돌 시 폭발 후 파괴
function clone_class:new(index, parent_class, start_pos, end_pos, dir)

    obj.action = parent_class
    obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action

    self.state = parent_class.clone_state

    self.fx_clone = nil
    self.fx_clone_dash = nil
    self.fx_clone_contrail = nil

    self.duration = parent_class.clone_range / parent_class.clone_speed
    local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(parent_class.clone_radius, self.duration, -1)
    self.clone_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(parent_class.character, info, false, 0, 0)

    self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
            unity_class.vector2(parent_class.clone_range, parent_class.clone_radius * 2), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
    self.attack_range:Hide()

end

function clone_class:change_state(next_state)
    -- state exit
    if self.current_state == self.state.stay then
        if self.fx_clone ~= nil then
            self.fx_clone:Dispose()
            self.fx_clone = nil
        end

        self.attack_range:Hide()
        message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

    elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
        if self.fx_clone_dash ~= nil then
            self.fx_clone_dash:Dispose()
            self.fx_clone_dash = nil
        end

        if self.fx_clone_contrail ~= nil then
            self.fx_clone_contrail:Dispose()
            self.fx_clone_contrail = nil
        end

    elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then

    elseif self.current_state == self.state.destroy then

    end
    -- state enter
    if next_state == self.state.stay then
        -- 분신 생성
        local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.end_pos - self.start_pos)
        local v_flip = side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right and vector_util.one or unity_class.vector3(-1, 1, 1)

        self.fx_clone = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect("clone", self.start_pos, vector_util.zero)
        self.fx_clone.transform.localScale = v_flip

        self.clone_calculator:Start()

        local dir = (self.end_pos - self.start_pos).normalized
        battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.current_pos + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -0.2), dir, 1)
        self.attack_range:Show(self.clone_delay)
        message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

    elseif next_state == self.state.move then
        -- 분신 모션 변경
        local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.end_pos - self.start_pos)
        local v_flip = side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right and vector_util.one or unity_class.vector3(-1, 1, 1)
        local contrail_dir = side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right and (self.end_pos - self.start_pos).normalized or (self.start_pos - self.end_pos).normalized

        self.fx_clone_dash = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect("clone_dash", self.start_pos, vector_util.zero)
        self.fx_clone_dash.transform.localScale = v_flip

        self.fx_clone_contrail = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect("clone_contrail", self.start_pos, contrail_dir)
        self.fx_clone_contrail.transform.localScale = v_flip
        self.cs_action:PlaySfx('clone_dash1')
        self.cs_action:PlaySfx('clone_dash2')

    elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
        -- 폭발 이펙트 로드
        self.action:create_explosion(self.end_pos)
        self.action:create_projectile(self.end_pos)

        self.clone_calculator:End()

    elseif next_state == self.state.destroy then
        -- 삭제 대기
    end

    self.current_state = next_state
    self.time_passed = 0
end

-- 분신 업데이트
function clone_class:update_frame(dt)
    if self.current_state == self.state.none then

    elseif self.current_state == self.state.stay then
        if self.time_passed >= self.clone_delay then
            self:change_state(self.state.move)
        end
    elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
        local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.action.clone_range / self.action.clone_speed)
        progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
        self.current_pos = self.start_pos + self.dir * (self.action.clone_range * progress)

        self.fx_clone_dash.transform.position = self.current_pos
        self.fx_clone_contrail.transform.position = self.current_pos

        if progress >= 1 or vector_util.sqr_distance(self.current_pos, self.end_pos) <= 0.01 then
            self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
        end
    elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
        self:change_state(self.state.destroy)
    elseif self.current_state == self.state.destroy then
    end

    self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
    self:check_collision(dt)
end

function clone_class:check_collision(dt)
    -- 주지사 사망시 데미지 판정 무효
    if self.action.character == nil or character_util.is_dead(self.action.character) then
        return
    end

    -- 스테이트 검사
    if self.current_state < self.state.stay or self.current_state > self.state.move then
        return
    end

    if not self.clone_calculator.IsStarted then
        self.clone_calculator:Start()
    end

    self.clone_calculator.Position = self.current_pos
    local objects = self.clone_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
    for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
        local fo = objects[index]
        if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.action.character, fo) then
            local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.current_pos).normalized
            local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
            damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
            damage_info.sender = self.action.character
            damage_info.target = fo
            damage_info.modifier = self.action.clone_damage_modifier
            damage_info.direction = direction
            damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.action.ailment_info, 1)
            command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
            self.action:create_bead(fo.Name, self.action.clone_bead_count)
        end

        if fo.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
            self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
            objects:Dispose()
            return
        end
    end
    objects:Dispose()
end

function clone_class:dispose()

    self.time_passed = nil
    self.clone_delay = nil
    self.duration = nil

    if self.fx_clone ~= nil then
        self.fx_clone:Dispose()
        self.fx_clone = nil
    end

    if self.fx_clone_dash ~= nil then
        self.fx_clone_dash:Dispose()
        self.fx_clone_dash = nil
    end

    if self.fx_clone_contrail ~= nil then
        self.fx_clone_contrail:Dispose()
        self.fx_clone_contrail = nil
    end

    -- 분신 대기 중 혹시 dispose될 시 안어색하게
    if self.current_state == self.state.stay or self.current_state == self.state.move then
        self.action:create_explosion(self.current_pos)
    end

    self.current_pos = nil
    self.attack_range = nil

    if not is_unity_null(self.test_ar) then
        CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.test_ar)
    end
end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
    self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
    self.character = c
    self.level = level

    -- 파라미터 파싱
    self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 4)
    self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

    -- 분신 파람 파싱
    self.clone_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CloneRadius", 0.75)
    self.clone_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CloneDistance", 4)
    self.clone_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CloneSpeed", 20)
    self.clone_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CloneRange", 20)
    self.clone_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CloneDelay", 0.5)
    self.clone_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CloneInterval", 1)
    self.clone_max_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "CloneMaxCount", 4)
    self.clone_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CloneDamageModifier", 1.5)

    -- 폭발 파람 파싱
    self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionRadius", 1)
    self.explosion_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDamageModifier", 1.5)
    local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.explosion_radius, 0.1, 0)
    self.explosion_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

    -- 흡혈 구슬 관련
    self.clone_bead_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "CloneBeadCount", 1)
    self.proj_bead_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ProjBeadCount", 1)

    -- 투사체 파람 파싱
    local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
    local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec('boss_vampirelord_blade')
    local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
    self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
            ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

    -- 공통
    self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

    -- 분신 관련
    self.clone_holders = { }
    self.clone_interval_passed = 0
    self.clone_count = 0
    self.fx_clone_cast = nil

    -- 분신 스테이트
    self.clone_state = {
        none = 1,
        stay = 2,
        move = 3,
        explosion = 4,
        destroy = 5,
    }

    -- 내부 스테이트
    self.state = {
        none = 1,
        action = 2,
        post = 3
    }

    -- 에니
    self.cast_key = 'cast'

    -- 상태 초기화
    self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
    self.zone_bound = bound

end

function local_class:is_loaded()
    return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
    return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
    if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
        return false
    end

    if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
        return false
    end

    -- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
    local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

    if is_unity_null(target) then
        return false
    end

    local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
    command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
    return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
    local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

    if is_unity_null(target) then
        return
    end

    self.target = target
    self:change_state(self.state.action)
end

function local_class:cancel()
    self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
    battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
    self:change_state(self.state.none)
    CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
    if next_state == self.current_state then
        return
    end

    -- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
    if self.current_state == self.state.action then
        CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
        self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

        if self.fx_clone_cast ~= nil then
            self.fx_clone_cast:Dispose()
            self.fx_clone_cast = nil
        end

    elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
        self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
        battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
    end

    -- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
    if next_state == self.state.action then
        self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
        message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.action_duration))

        battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
        self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
        self.fx_clone_cast = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("channeling", self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
        self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast_start')

        self.clone_count = 0
        self.clone_interval_passed = 0

    elseif next_state == self.state.post then
        self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
        self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("channeling_end", self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
    else
        self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
    end

    self.time_passed = 0
    self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

    self:update_clones(dt)

    if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
        return
    end

    self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

    -- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
    if self.current_state == self.state.action then
        if self.clone_count >= self.clone_max_count then
            self:change_state(self.state.post)
        else
            if self.clone_interval_passed >= self.clone_interval then
                table.insert(self.clone_holders, self:create_clone(self.target.Position))
                self.clone_count = self.clone_count + 1
                self.clone_interval_passed = self.clone_interval_passed - self.clone_interval
            else
                self.clone_interval_passed = self.clone_interval_passed + dt
            end
        end
    elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
        if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
            self:change_state(self.state.none)
        end
    end
end

function local_class:update_clones(dt)
    if self.clone_holders == nil or #self.clone_holders == 0 then
        return
    end

    for idx = #self.clone_holders, 1, -1 do
        local holder = self.clone_holders[idx]
        holder:update_frame(dt)

        if holder.current_state == self.clone_state.destroy then
            holder:dispose()
            table.remove(self.clone_holders, idx)
        end
    end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
    if self.shoot_helper == nil or hit_info.target == nil then
        return true
    end

    if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
        self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
        -- 투사체 피격시 상태이상 축적
        local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
        damage_info.sender = self.character
        damage_info.target = hit_info.target
        damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
        command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
        self:create_bead(hit_info.target.Name, self.proj_bead_count)
    end

    return true
end

function local_class:create_clone(position)
    local range = self.clone_radius * 2
    local size = unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.size.x - range, self.zone_bound.size.y, self.zone_bound.size.z - range)
    local bounds = unity_class.bounds(self.zone_bound.center, size)

    -- x, z방향 교점 list
    local x_list = {}
    local z_list = {}

    local coll_enum = {
        up      = 1 << 0,
        down    = 1 << 1,
        left    = 1 << 2,
        right   = 1 << 3,
    }

    local coll_num = 0
    local list1 = bounds_util.circle_intersect_line(bounds, 'up', position, self.clone_distance)
    local list2 = bounds_util.circle_intersect_line(bounds, 'left', position, self.clone_distance)
    local list3 = bounds_util.circle_intersect_line(bounds, 'down', position, self.clone_distance)
    local list4 = bounds_util.circle_intersect_line(bounds, 'right', position, self.clone_distance)

    if #list1 > 0 then
        for _, v in pairs(list1) do
            local pos = unity_class.vector3(v.x, self.zone_bound.center.y, v.y)
            table.insert(x_list, { v, vector_util.sqr_distance(self.zone_bound.center, pos) })
        end
        coll_num = coll_num | coll_enum.up
    end

    if #list2 > 0 then
        for _, v in pairs(list2) do
            local pos = unity_class.vector3(v.x, self.zone_bound.center.y, v.y)
            table.insert(z_list, { v, vector_util.sqr_distance(self.zone_bound.center, pos) })
        end
        coll_num = coll_num | coll_enum.left
    end

    if #list3 > 0 then
        for _, v in pairs(list3) do
            local pos = unity_class.vector3(v.x, self.zone_bound.center.y, v.y)
            table.insert(x_list, { v, vector_util.sqr_distance(self.zone_bound.center, pos) })
        end
        coll_num = coll_num | coll_enum.down
    end

    if #list4 > 0 then
        for _, v in pairs(list4) do
            local pos = unity_class.vector3(v.x, self.zone_bound.center.y, v.y)
            table.insert(z_list, { v, vector_util.sqr_distance(self.zone_bound.center, pos) })
        end
        coll_num = coll_num | coll_enum.right
    end

    if #x_list > 1 then
        table.sort(x_list, function(a, b)
            return a[2] < b[2]
        end)
    end

    if #z_list > 1 then
        table.sort(z_list, function(a, b)
            return a[2] < b[2]
        end)
    end

    -- 교점 두개 이상
    if #x_list + #z_list >= 2 then
        local point1 = unity_class.vector3.zero
        local point2 = unity_class.vector3.zero

        if #x_list > 0 and #z_list > 0 then
            table.sort(x_list, function(a, b)
                return a[2] < b[2]

function local_class:get_circle_coll_pos(cx0, cy0, radius0, cx1, cy1, radius1)
    -- 참고
    -- http://csharphelper.com/blog/2014/09/determine-where-two-circles-intersect-in-c/
    local dx = cx0 - cx1
    local dy = cy0 - cy1
    local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

    local a = (radius0 * radius0 - radius1 * radius1 + dist * dist) / (2 * dist)
    local h = math.sqrt(radius0 * radius0 - a * a)

    local cx2 = cx0 + a * (cx1 - cx0) / dist
    local cy2 = cy0 + a * (cy1 - cy0) / dist

    local p1 = unity_class.vector3((cx2 + h * (cy1 - cy0) / dist), 0, (cy2 - h * (cx1 - cx0) / dist))
    local p2 = unity_class.vector3((cx2 - h * (cy1 - cy0) / dist), 0, (cy2 + h * (cx1 - cx0) / dist))

    local d1 = vector_util.sqr_distance(self.zone_bound.center, p1)
    local d2 = vector_util.sqr_distance(self.zone_bound.center, p2)

    local size = unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.size.x - self.clone_radius * 2, self.zone_bound.size.y, self.zone_bound.size.z - self.clone_radius * 2)
    local bounds = unity_class.bounds(self.zone_bound.center, size)

    local p1_in = CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(bounds, p1)
    local p2_in = CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(bounds, p2)

    if p1_in and p2_in == false then
        return p1
    elseif p1_in == false and p2_in then
        return p2
    else
        if d1 > d2 then
            return p2
        else
            return p1
        end
    end
end

function local_class:get_angle(v1, v2)
    local cosAng = unity_class.vector3.Dot(v1, v2)
    return (v1.y * v2.x + v1.x * v2.y) > 0 and math.acos(cosAng) or -math.cos(cosAng)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
    self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
    -- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
    self:force_cancel()

    self.cs_battle_action = nil
    self.character = nil
    self.level = nil

    end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.shot_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.shot_range))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		--self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if self.shot_count + 1 >= self.shot_max_count then
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		else
			self.shot_range:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.shot_range))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		--self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)

		self.shot_count = 0

		local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.shot_range, self.character.Position, dir)
		self.shot_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.shot_range))

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)

		-- 마지막 공격은 폭발 공격
		if self.shot_count + 1 >= self.shot_max_count then
			self.explosion_pos = self.target.Position
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.explosion_pos)
			self.attack_range:Show(self.interval)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.interval))
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.explosion_key)
		else
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.shot_range, self.character.Position, dir)
			self.shot_range:Show(self.interval)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.shot_range))
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 마지막 공격은 폭발 공격
		if self.shot_count + 1 >= self.shot_max_count then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.explosion_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion')
			self:explosion_damage_update()

			self.shot_range:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.shot_range))
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			-- 바로 액션으로 보내서 첫발 바로 쏘도록
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.shot_range, self.character.Position, dir)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.shot_range, self.character.Position, dir)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.shot_count = self.shot_count + 1
		if self.shot_count >= self.shot_max_count then
			if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_ani_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_target()
	local _, dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_battle_action, self.target,
			direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)))
	self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.character.Position, dir)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('slash', self.character.Position, dir)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('blade')
end

function local_class:explosion_damage_update()
	self.explosion_calculator:Start()
	self.explosion_calculator.Position = self.explosion_pos
	local objects = self.explosion_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			self:create_bead(fo.Name, self.explosion_create_bead_count)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.explosion_calculator:End()
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil and hit_info.target ~= nil then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
			self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			-- 투사체 피격시 상태이상 축적
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = hit_info.target
			damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			self:create_bead(hit_info.target.Name, self.shot_create_bead_count)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:create_bead(name, amount)
	-- 액션 활성화 되어있는 경우에만 구슬 드랍 메세지 날릴수 있도록 수정
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
				{
					'blood_bead_drop_request_by_target',
					name,
					amount
				}))
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil

	self.interval = nil

	self.shot_max_count = nil
	self.shot_create_bead_count = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil

	self.explosion_damage_modifier = nil
	self.explosion_radius = nil
	self.explosion_prepare_duration = nil
	self.explosion_create_bead_count = nil

	self.explosion_calculator = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.shot_range = nil

	self.shot_count = nil

	self.cast_key = nil
	self.shoot_key = nil
	self.explosion_key = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

function local_class:set_safe_area()

function local_class:start(info)
