function local_class:set_safe_zone()

	-- 해당 n 개수에서 피격 회수를 뺀다 => safe_zone_count = safe_area_count - laser_attack_count
	local safe_zone_count = self.safe_area_count - self.laser_attack_count

	if safe_zone_count <= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- 남은 safe_area 들 중 save_zone_count 수 만큼 랜덤 선택 한다
	local candidates = {}
	for _, safe_area in pairs(self.safe_area_list) do
		table.insert(candidates, safe_area)
	end

	local selected_safe_area_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(candidates, {count = safe_zone_count})
	local y = 0.1

	-- 선택된 safe_area 를 save_zone_count 수 만큼 순회 하면서
	for index, safe_area in pairs(selected_safe_area_list) do
		-- 0. safe_area 에서 랜덤한 위치를 선택 한 뒤 safe_zone_position
		local min_x = -safe_area.Bounds.extents.x + self.safe_zone_size_x
		local max_x = safe_area.Bounds.extents.x - self.safe_zone_size_x

		local min_z = -safe_area.Bounds.extents.z + self.safe_zone_size_z
		local max_z = safe_area.Bounds.extents.z - self.safe_zone_size_z

		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(min_x, max_x)
		local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(min_z, max_z)

		local safe_zone_position = vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z) + safe_area.Bounds.center

		-- 1. safe_zone_position 에 바운드를 세팅하고
		local safe_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(safe_zone_position, vector(
			self.safe_zone_size_x,
			100,
			self.safe_zone_size_z)
		)

		table.insert(self.safe_zone_bounds_list, safe_bounds)

		-- 2. safe_zone_position 에 AttackRange 를 활성화 한다.
		local safe_ar = self.safe_zone_range_list[index]
		battle_range_util.increase_sorting_order(safe_ar, 1)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(safe_ar, safe_zone_position, y)
		battle_range_util.show(safe_ar)
	end

end

function local_class:unset_safe_zone()

	for i = #self.safe_zone_bounds_list, 1, -1 do
		table.remove(self.safe_zone_bounds_list, i)
	end

	for _, safe_zone_range in pairs(self.safe_zone_range_list) do
		safe_zone_range:Hide()
	end

end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		self.ready_fx:Dispose()
		self.ready_fx = nil

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calc:End()

		self.sfx_loop:FadeOut(1.0)
		self.sfx_loop = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')

		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		stage_camera:Shake(self.prepare_camera_shake_magnitude, self.prepare_camera_shake_duration)
		self:set_safe_zone()

		self.ready_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('judgement_ready', self.character.Position)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shoot')

		self.attack_calc.Position = self.zone_bound.center
		self.attack_calc:Start()
		self.shake_time_passed = self.action_shake_term

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('judgement_ready_end', self.character.Position)

		self.sfx_loop = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack_loop', self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'laser_recharge' }))
		self:unset_safe_zone()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		self:unset_safe_zone()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

		self:publish_damage(dt)
		self:update_shake(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_shake(dt)
	self.shake_time_passed = self.shake_time_passed + dt

	if self.shake_time_passed >= self.action_shake_term then
		stage_camera:Shake(self.action_camera_shake_magnitude, self.action_camera_shake_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('judgement_attack1', self.character.Position)

		self.shake_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:publish_damage(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		local is_affective = true

		for _, safe_zone_bounds in pairs(self.safe_zone_bounds_list) do
			if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(safe_zone_bounds, fo.Position) then
				is_affective = false
			end
		end

		if is_affective then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo

			if fo == user_party.Leader then
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)
			else
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio_none_leader)
			end

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('judgement_attack2', fo.Position)

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack', fo.Position)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit', fo.Position)

		end

	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:exit()

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.safe_area_list = nil
	self.safe_zone_bounds_list = nil
	self.safe_zone_range_list = nil
	self.safe_area_count = 0

	if not self.ready_fx == nil then
		self.ready_fx:Dispose()
		self.ready_fx = nil
	end

	end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	local x = bound.extents.x * 2
	local y = 0.05
	local z = bound.extents.z * 2

	local center = bound.center
	center.y = y

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(center, vector(x, z), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(vector(x, y, z), self.action_duration, self.damage_term)
	self.attack_calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossVeronicaLaserBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)
	self.shoot_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootDuration", 1)
	self.trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RangeFollowDuration", 0.8)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.laser_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserWidth", 1.5)
	self.laser_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserRange", 8)
	self.trace_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RangeFollowSpeed", 7)
	self.laser_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserOffset", 0.5)

	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.3)
	self.modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 어택레인지
	local size = unity_class.vector2(self.laser_range, self.laser_width)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 계산기
	local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	info.DamageTerm = self.damage_term
	info.Duration = self.shoot_duration;
	info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.laser_range, 2, self.laser_width)
	info.IsCenterToSide = true
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if (is_unity_null(target)) then
		return false
	end

	if ((target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude > self.laser_range + self.laser_offset) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.laser_ready_fx:Dispose()
		self.laser_ready_fx = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then

		local laser_fx_end = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('laser_end', self.character.Position + self.dir_vector * self.laser_offset + CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.up * 0.5)
		local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(self.dir_vector) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)
		laser_fx_end.transform.rotation = rotation

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.laser_fx:Dispose()
		self.laser_fx = nil
		self.dir_vector = nil

		self.sfx_laser_loop:FadeOut(1.0)
		self.sfx_laser_loop = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		local dir_vector = diff.normalized;
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)
		self.character.Direction = dir;

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, dir_vector)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + dir_vector * self.laser_offset
		self.laser_ready_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('laser_ready', shoot_pos)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', self.character.Position)

		self.prev_range_target_pos = self.target.Position
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shoot')

		local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self.dir_vector * self.laser_offset + CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.up * 0.5
		self.attack_calculator.Position = shoot_pos
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		-- 캐스팅 종료와 동시에 발사
		self.laser_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('laser', shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('laser_ready_end', shoot_pos)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack', shoot_pos)
		self.sfx_laser_loop = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack_loop', shoot_pos)
		self.sfx_laser_loop.Volume = 0.5

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot', shoot_pos)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.prev_range_target_pos = nil

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_laser_direction(dt)
	local target_pos_diff = self.target.Position - self.prev_range_target_pos
	local new_range_target_pos = self.prev_range_target_pos
		+ target_pos_diff.normalized * math.min(self.trace_speed * dt, target_pos_diff.magnitude)

	self.diff = new_range_target_pos - self.character.Position
	self.dir_vector = self.diff.normalized;
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
	self.character.Direction = dir;

	self.prev_range_target_pos = new_range_target_pos;
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		elseif self.time_passed < self.trace_duration then
			self:update_laser_direction(dt)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.dir_vector)
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

			self.laser_ready_fx.transform.position = self.character.Position + self.dir_vector * self.laser_offset
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_laser_direction(dt)

			local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self.dir_vector * self.laser_offset + CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.up * 0.5

			self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.dir_vector
			self.attack_calculator.Position = shoot_pos

			local dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
			self.character.Direction = dir;

			local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(self.dir_vector) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)
			self.laser_fx.transform.position = shoot_pos
			self.laser_fx.transform.rotation = rotation

			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.modifier
					damage_info.direction = self.dir_vector
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.dir_vector
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * 1.5

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit',fo.Position)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function stone_ready:new(parent_class, ready_pos, shoot_pos)

	obj.cs_battle_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action

	obj.shoot_pos = shoot_pos
	obj.projectile_init_pos = ready_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.2
	obj.projectile_pos = obj.projectile_init_pos

	obj.projectile_move_duration = 1
	obj.time_passed = 0

	obj.is_active = false

function stone_ready:set_param(ready_effect_duration, ready_preset, projectile_preset, sand_preset)

	self.projectile_preset = nil

function stone_ready:start()
	self.is_active = true
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.ready_preset, self.ready_pos)
end

function stone_ready:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return nil
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not self.projectile_fx then

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.sand_preset, self.projectile_pos)
			self:update_frame(self.time_passed - self.ready_effect_duration)
		end
	else
		if self.time_passed < self.projectile_move_duration then
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.projectile_move_duration)
			self.projectile_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.projectile_init_pos, self.shoot_pos, progress)

			return self.projectile_fx

function stone_projectile:shoot(target_pos)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(self.target_pos + CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.up * 0.5, self.damage_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Show(self.duration)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
end

function stone_projectile:update_frame(dt)

	end

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self:deactivate(true)
	else
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInCubic(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.duration)
		self.projectile_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.projectile_init_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
		effect_util.update_object(self.projectile_fx, self.projectile_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

function stone_projectile:deactivate(crashed)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	-- 투사체 이동 종료
	self.is_active = false;

	self.projectile_fx:Dispose()
	self.projectile_fx = nil

	self.attack_range:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
	self.attack_range = nil

	if not crashed then

			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

	self.target_pos = nil

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootInterval", 0.1)
	self.trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RangeFollowDuration", 1)
	self.trace_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetFollowSpeed", 6)

	local modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	local damage_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Radius", 1.25)
	local knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.5)
	local projectile_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjectileSpeed", 6)

	local has_value, offset_json = params:TryGetValue('ProjectileOffsets')
	if has_value then
		local prepare_offset_json = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(offset_json, 'prepare')
		local shoot_offset_json = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(offset_json, 'shoot')
		local prepare_x_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(prepare_offset_json, 'X')
		local prepare_y_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(prepare_offset_json, 'Y')
		local prepare_z_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(prepare_offset_json, 'Z')
		local shoot_x_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(shoot_offset_json, 'X')
		local shoot_y_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(shoot_offset_json, 'Y')
		local shoot_z_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(shoot_offset_json, 'Z')
		self.projectile_number = math.min(
				prepare_x_offsets.Count, prepare_y_offsets.Count, prepare_z_offsets.Count,
				shoot_x_offsets.Count, shoot_y_offsets.Count, shoot_z_offsets.Count)
		self.projectile_offsets = {
			prepare = {},
			shoot = {}
		}
		for i = 0, self.projectile_number - 1 do
			table.insert(self.projectile_offsets.prepare,
					unity_class.vector3(prepare_x_offsets[i], prepare_y_offsets[i], prepare_z_offsets[i]))
			table.insert(self.projectile_offsets.shoot,
					unity_class.vector3(shoot_x_offsets[i], shoot_y_offsets[i], shoot_z_offsets[i]))
		end
	else
		self.projectile_number = 6
		self.projectile_offsets = {
			prepare = { unity_class.vector3.left, unity_class.vector3.left, unity_class.vector3.left,
						unity_class.vector3.right, unity_class.vector3.right, unity_class.vector3.right },
			shoot = { unity_class.vector3(3.2, 2, 0.5), unity_class.vector3(2.2, 2, 1.8), unity_class.vector3(0.8, 2, 2.5),
					  unity_class.vector3(-3.2, 2, 0.5), unity_class.vector3(-2.2, 2, 1.8), unity_class.vector3(-0.8, 2, 2.5) }
		}
	end

	local prepare_fx_duration = 0.5
	local ready_preset = 'stone_ready'
	local projectile_preset = 'stone'
	local break_preset = 'stone_break'
	local sand_preset = 'stone_sand'

	stone_ready:set_param(prepare_fx_duration, ready_preset, projectile_preset, sand_preset)
	stone_projectile:set_param(modifier, damage_radius, projectile_speed, knock_back_force, break_preset)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.stone_prepare_list = {}
	self.stone_shoot_list = {}
	self.remove_list = {}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.shoot_count = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		local dir_vector = diff.normalized;
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)
		self.character.Direction = dir;

		self.prev_range_target_pos = self.target.Position

		stage_camera:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo('stone_prepare', 0.1, 0.5, false))

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shoot')

		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		self.dir_vector = diff.normalized;
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)

		self.shoot_index = 1
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_stones(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local stone_shoot_list_count = #self.stone_shoot_list
	local stone_prepare_list_count = #self.stone_prepare_list

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		elseif self.time_passed < self.trace_duration then
			self:chase_target(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.shoot_index > self.projectile_number  then
			if stone_shoot_list_count == 0 and stone_prepare_list_count == 0 then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_interval * (self.shoot_index - 1) then
				local stone = stone_ready:new(self,
						self.character.Position + self.projectile_offsets.prepare[self.shoot_index],
						self.character.Position + self.projectile_offsets.shoot[self.shoot_index])
				stone:start()
				table.insert(self.stone_prepare_list, stone)

				-- 첫 1회에만 효과음 재생
				if self.shoot_index == 1 then
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('projectile_ready', stone.shoot_pos)
				end

				self.shoot_index = self.shoot_index + 1
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_stones(dt)
	local prepare_count = #self.stone_prepare_list

	if prepare_count > 0 then
		self:chase_target(dt)
	end

	for i, stone in ipairs(self.stone_shoot_list) do
		stone:update_frame(dt)

		if not stone.is_active then
			stone:dispose()
			table.insert(self.remove_list, prepare_count + i)
		end
	end

	for i, stone in ipairs(self.stone_prepare_list) do
		local res = stone:update_frame(dt)

		if res then
			local projectile = stone_projectile:new(self, res)
			projectile:shoot(self.prev_range_target_pos)
			table.insert(self.stone_shoot_list, projectile)

			stone:dispose(false)
			table.insert(self.remove_list, i)
		elseif not stone.is_active then
			stone:dispose(true)
			table.insert(self.remove_list, i)
		end
	end

	local remove_count = #self.remove_list

	for i = remove_count, 1, -1 do
		local index = self.remove_list[i]

		if index > prepare_count then
			index = index - prepare_count
			table.remove(self.stone_shoot_list, index)
		else
			table.remove(self.stone_prepare_list, index)
		end
	end

	for _ = 1, remove_count do
		table.remove(self.remove_list)
	end
end

function local_class:chase_target(dt, change_direction)
	lua_helper.get_or_default(change_direction, true)

	local target_pos_diff = self.target.Position - self.prev_range_target_pos
	local new_range_target_pos = self.prev_range_target_pos
			+ target_pos_diff.normalized * math.min(self.trace_speed * dt, target_pos_diff.magnitude)
	self.prev_range_target_pos = new_range_target_pos

	if change_direction then
		local diff = new_range_target_pos - self.character.Position
		local dir_vector = diff.normalized
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)
		self.character.Direction = dir
	end

	print(self.prev_range_target_pos)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	stone_ready:unset_param()
	stone_projectile:unset_param()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil

	end

	if self.stone_shoot_list then
		for _, stone in pairs(self.stone_shoot_list) do
			stone:dispose(true)
		end
		self.stone_shoot_list = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossVolcanoHandClapBattleAction')

--region global region

local sync_symbol = {
	determine_pos = 1,
	execution = 2,
}

--endregion

--region action state

local prepare_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 액션 길이
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 트래킹 시간
	tracking_duration = nil,
	--- x 위치는 고정임
	center_x = nil,
	--- 복귀 포인트
	return_position = nil,
	--- x 오프셋
	offset_x = nil,
	--- 스파인 오프셋
	--- 벽에 파뭍히지 않기 위해 위상을 왜곡시킴
	spine_offset = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
prepare_state_class.mt = { __index = prepare_state_class }

--- create action state
function prepare_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = battle_state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function prepare_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 트래킹 시간
	self.tracking_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TrackingDuration')

	--- 중앙 마커 명칭
	local center_marker_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'CenterMarker')
	--- x 위치는 고정임
	self.center_x = field:GetMarker(center_marker_name).position.x
	--- 마커 명칭
	local marker_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'MarkerName')
	--- 마커 위치
	self.return_position = field:GetMarker(marker_name).position
	--- 방향 기준
	self.dir_vector = self.center_x > self.return_position.x and vector_util.left or vector_util.right
	--- x 오프셋
	--- 판정이 겹치지 않도록 Bounds의 절반만큼 중심에서 떨어트려둘 것임
	self.offset_x = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).x * 0.5
	--- 스파인 오프셋
	--- 벽에 파뭍히지 않기 위해 위상을 왜곡시킴
	self.spine_offset = vector(0, 1, -1)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function prepare_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 위치 해제
	self.target_pos = nil
	--- 손 위치 해제
	self.hand_pos = nil
end

function prepare_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 손 위치 고정
	self.hand_pos = self.target_pos + self.dir_vector * 9
end

--- action state enter
function prepare_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	-- 애니 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
end

function prepare_state_class:exit(next_state)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	-- 애니 회수
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	if next_state == nil then
		support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.return_position)
		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.zero)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.5) then
		-- 애니 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast_loop')
	end

	if not self.target_pos then
		local target_pos = vector(
			self.center_x, character_util.get_position(self.owner).y, character_util.get_position(self.target).z
		)
		--- 이번 프레임의 손 위치
		local hand_pos = target_pos + self.dir_vector * 9

		if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, 0.3) then
			local progress = math.min(time_passed / 0.3)
			support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.return_position, hand_pos, progress)
			spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), self.spine_offset * progress)
		else
			support_action_util.execute_move(self.owner, hand_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner))
		end

		-- 지금이 동기화 타이밍입니다.
		if time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
			--- 싱크에 필요한 정보들
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			-- 동기화 심볼
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, sync_symbol.determine_pos)
			-- 위치 동기화
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, target_pos)
			-- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end
	else
		if time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			--- 싱크에 필요한 정보들
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			-- 동기화 심볼
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, sync_symbol.execution)
			-- 위치 동기화
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos + self.dir_vector * self.offset_x)
			-- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		else
			support_action_util.execute_move(self.owner, self.hand_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner))
		end
	end
end

--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 판정 딜레이, 이때동안 손이 올것임
	hit_delay = nil,
	--- 후속 폭발 타이밍
	post_explosion_timing = nil,
	--- 연출 종료 시점
	end_of_act = nil,
	--- 돌아오는데 걸리는 시간
	post_duration = nil,
	--- 액션 종료 시점
	end_of_state = nil,
	--- 복귀 포인트
	return_position = nil,
	--- 스파인 오프셋
	--- 벽에 파뭍히지 않기 위해 위상을 왜곡시킴
	spine_offset = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = battle_state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 판정 딜레이
	self.hit_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDelay')
	--- 후속 폭발 타이밍
	self.post_explosion_timing = cs_util.get_nullable_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostExplosionTiming')
	-- 후속 폭발 존재시 처리
	--- 연출 종료 시점
	self.end_of_act = self.post_explosion_timing and self.post_explosion_timing or self.hit_delay
	--- 복귀 딜레이
	local return_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ReturnDelay')
	--- 복귀 딜레이까지 합산
	self.end_of_act = self.end_of_act + return_delay
	--- 복귀하는데 걸리는 시간
	self.post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')
	--- 종료 시점
	self.end_of_state = self.end_of_act + self.post_duration

	--- 마커 명칭
	local marker_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'MarkerName')
	--- 마커 위치
	self.return_position = field:GetMarker(marker_name).position

	--- 스파인 오프셋
	--- 벽에 파뭍히지 않기 위해 위상을 왜곡시킴
	self.spine_offset = vector(0, 1, -1)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 시작 위치
	self.start_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	-- 애니 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
end

function action_state_class:exit(next_state)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	-- 애니 회수
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	if next_state == nil then
		support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.return_position)
		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.zero)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.hit_delay) then
		local clamped_time_passed = math.min(time_passed, self.hit_delay)
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(clamped_time_passed, 0, 1, self.hit_delay)
		support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.start_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_delay + 0.1) then
		-- 애니 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action_loop')
	end

	if self.post_explosion_timing and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.post_explosion_timing) then
		-- 애니 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action_halt')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.end_of_act) then
		-- 애니 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action_end')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.end_of_act, self.end_of_state) then
		local clamped_time_passed = math.min(time_passed - self.end_of_act, self.post_duration)
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(clamped_time_passed, 0, 1, self.post_duration)
		support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.target_pos, self.return_position, progress)
		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), self.spine_offset * (1 - progress))
	end

	--- 준비 완료하면 싱크로 다음 스탭을 넘긴다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.end_of_state) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end


function action_state_class:apply_damage(fo)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = battle_state_machine:new(nil)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, _ = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then return false end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end
	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local symbol = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	-- 위치 동기화
	-- 동작 중이 아니라면 무시함
	if symbol == sync_symbol.determine_pos and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() then
		self.prepare_state:sync(info)
		-- 처리 시작
	elseif symbol == sync_symbol.execution then
		self.action_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- action state가 유효할 때만 처리
	if not self.action_state then return true end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--endregion

return { create = function(c, level, params, cs_action) return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action) end }

function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 준비 완료하면 싱크로 다음 스탭을 넘긴다.
	if time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
		self.action.action_state:process_next_action(self.target, self.repeat_count)
	end
end

--endregion

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier =  cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	--- knock back multiplier
	self.knock_back_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockBackMultiplier')

	--- damage type
	self.proj_damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.proj_atk_modifier =  cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjModifierBase')

	--- 부유 높이
	self.float_height = 7
	--- 부유하는데 소요되는 시간
	self.float_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FloatDuration')
	--- 내리찍는데 소요되는 시간
	self.stomp_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompDuration')
	--- 내려찍는 타이밍
	self.stomp_timing = self.float_duration + self.stomp_duration
	--- 대기 시간
	local interval_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'IntervalDuration')
	--- 상태 종료 타이밍
	self.state_end_timing = self.stomp_timing + interval_duration

	--- 판정 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- C# 슈터 생성
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 투사체 데이터 파싱 및 생성
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
	--- 사출 수
	local shoot_count = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootCount')
	--- 각도
	local angle = 360 / shoot_count
	--- 방향
	self.shoot_dirs = {}
	-- 방향 계산
	for idx = 1, shoot_count do
		local quaternion = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, idx * angle, 0)
		table.insert(self.shoot_dirs, quaternion * vector_util.back)
	end

	--- 카메라 쉐이킹 강도
	self.shake_magnitude = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShakeMagnitude')
	--- 카메라 쉐이킹 시간
	self.shake_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShakeDuration')

	--- 마커 명칭
	local marker_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'MarkerName')
	--- 마커 위치
	self.return_position = field:GetMarker(marker_name).position

	--- 관통 크래시비헤비어 캐시
	self.ethereal_crash_behaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 시작 위치
	self.start_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 남은 횟수
	self.sync_count = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(prev_state)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	-- 무적을 걸어줌
	self:set_invincible()
end

function action_state_class:exit(next_state)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	-- 애니 회수
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	-- 오프셋 초기화
	spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.zero)

	-- 내려찍기 전에 exit하면 무적 걸어둔 것을 풀어둬야한다.
	if self.current_time_passed < self.stomp_timing then
		-- 무적을 풀어줌
		self:unset_invincible()
	end

	-- 다음 상태가 없는경우 == 상태 이탈
	if not next_state then
		-- 원래 위치로 복구
		support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.return_position)
	end
end

function action_state_class:set_invincible()
	--- attach crash behaviour
	battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.ethereal_crash_behaviour)
	--- set crash behaviour
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = self.ethereal_crash_behaviour

	--- 데미지 비헤비어 캐시
	self.damage_behaviour_cache = CS.Oak.MonsterIgnoreDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	--- 바꾸기 전에 DeathType 이식
	self.damage_behaviour_cache.DeathType = self.owner.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
	--- override 데미지 비헤비어 설정
	self.owner.OverrideDamageBehaviour = self.damage_behaviour_cache
end

function action_state_class:unset_invincible()
	--- detach crash behaviour
	battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.ethereal_crash_behaviour)
	--- unset crash behaviour
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil

	--- 이 액션에서 설정한 데미지 비헤비어가 맞으면 그 떄만 건들임
	if self.owner.OverrideDamageBehaviour == self.damage_behaviour_cache then
		self.owner.OverrideDamageBehaviour = nil
	end
	--- 대미지 비헤비어 캐시 해제 (원본은 풀로 갔을것임)
	self.damage_behaviour_cache = nil
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.float_duration, self.stomp_timing) then
		-- 부유 연출
		local clamped_time_passed = math.min(time_passed - self.float_duration, self.stomp_duration)
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInCirc(clamped_time_passed, 0, 1, self.stomp_duration)
		local height = math.max(1 - progress, 0) * 7
		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * height)

		-- 이동 처리
		support_action_util.execute_move_between_time(self.owner, self.start_pos, self.target_pos, self.float_duration, self.stomp_timing, time_passed)

	elseif battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.float_duration) then
		-- 부유 연출
		local progress = math.min(time_passed / self.float_duration, 1)
		local height = progress * 7
		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * height)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.stomp_timing) then
		-- 애니 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
		-- 효과음 설정
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'action')

		-- 무적을 풀어줌
		self:unset_invincible()

		-- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'stomp', self.target_pos)
		-- 충격파 쉐이킹 발생
		stage_camera:Shake(self.shake_magnitude, self.shake_duration)
		--- 판정 처리
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo)
		end

		--- 투사체 사출
		for idx = 1, #self.shoot_dirs do
			local dir_vector = self.shoot_dirs[idx]
			local destination = self.target_pos + vector(dir_vector.z, 0, -dir_vector.x)
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
				self.shoot_helper[1],
				self.target_pos,
				dir_vector,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				false,
				nil,
				destination
			)
		end
	end

	--- 준비 완료하면 싱크로 다음 스탭을 넘긴다.
	if time_passed >= self.state_end_timing then
		-- 아직 더 쏴야함
		if self.sync_count > 1 then
			self:process_next_action(self.target, self.sync_count - 1)

		-- 전부 쐈음
		else
			--- 돌아감
			self.machine:change(self.action.post_state)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:process_next_action(target, counter)
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(target)))
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, counter)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 대상 캐싱
	local hit_target = hit_info.target

	--- 대상 유효성 체크
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_target) then
		-- 피해 부여
		self:apply_proj_damage(hit_target)
		-- 피해 대상에 닿는가도 만료하지 않는다.
		return false
	end

	-- 만료 이펙트 출력
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_expire_fx(self.proj_spec[1], hit_info.position)
	-- 만료함
	return true
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(fo)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_strong
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info.knock_back_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, fo)
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_multiplier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function action_state_class:apply_proj_damage(fo)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.proj_damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.proj_atk_modifier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

local post_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 액션 길이
	post_duration = nil,
	--- 복귀 위치
	return_position = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
post_state_class.mt = { __index = post_state_class }

--- create action state
function post_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = battle_state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function post_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 마무리 길이
	self.post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')
	--- 마커 명칭
	local marker_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'MarkerName')
	--- 마커 위치
	self.return_position = field:GetMarker(marker_name).position
end

--- action state enter
function post_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 시작 위치
	self.start_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
end

function post_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	-- 원래 위치로 복구
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.return_position)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function post_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.post_duration) then
		local clamped_time_passed = math.min(time_passed, self.post_duration)
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutQuad(clamped_time_passed, 0, 1, self.post_duration)

		-- 이동 처리
		support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.start_pos, self.return_position, progress)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.post_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- post state
	self.post_state = post_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = battle_state_machine:new(nil)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.prepare_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.post_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then return false end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end
	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신

	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 그로기 길이
	groggy_duration = nil,
	--- 폭발 대기 시간
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 폭발 타이밍
	current_explosion_timing = nil,
	--- 코어 엔티티 캐시
	core_entity = nil,

	--- 관통 크래시 비헤비어 캐시
	ethereal_crash_behaviour = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = battle_state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 그로기 길이
	self.groggy_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'GroggyDuration')
	--- 폭발 대기시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 관측할 코어
	self.core_entity = get_character(cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'CoreName'))
	--- 관통 크래시비헤비어 캐시
	self.ethereal_crash_behaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	self.option_activated = false

	--- 폭발 발생 타이밍
	self.current_explosion_timing = self.groggy_duration + self.prepare_duration
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync(info)
	self.option_activated = true

	--- 폭발 발생 타이밍
	self.current_explosion_timing = math.min(self.current_time_passed, self.groggy_duration) + self.prepare_duration
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 실행
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 본인 피통 UI 감춤
	stage.FieldUIManager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, self.owner)

	--- attach crash behaviour
	battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.ethereal_crash_behaviour)
	--- set crash behaviour
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = self.ethereal_crash_behaviour

	-- 데미지 비헤비어 캐시
	self.damage_behaviour_cache = CS.Oak.MonsterIgnoreDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	--- 바꾸기 전에 DeathType 이식
	self.damage_behaviour_cache.DeathType = self.owner.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
	--- override 데미지 비헤비어 설정
	self.owner.OverrideDamageBehaviour = self.damage_behaviour_cache
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 회수
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 본인 피통 UI 노출
	stage.FieldUIManager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, self.owner)

	--- detach crash behaviour
	battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.ethereal_crash_behaviour)
	--- unset crash behaviour
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil

	--- 이 액션에서 설정한 데미지 비헤비어가 맞으면 그 떄만 건들임
	if self.owner.OverrideDamageBehaviour == self.damage_behaviour_cache then
		self.owner.OverrideDamageBehaviour = nil
	end
	--- 대미지 비헤비어 캐시 해제 (원본은 풀로 갔을것임)
	self.damage_behaviour_cache = nil
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.5) then
		-- 애니 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast_loop')
	end

	--- 그로기 중에 코어가 파괴될 경우 처리
	if not self.option_activated and character_util.is_dead(self.core_entity) then
		--- 옵션 트리거 정보 생성
		local option_trigger_table = option_trigger_util.create()
		--- 오너 할당
		option_trigger_table.owner = self.owner
		--- 옵션 id 할당
		option_trigger_table.option_id = self.option_id
		-- 옵션 트리거
		command_util.publish_option_trigger(option_trigger_table)
		--- 옵션 발동했음
		self.option_activated = true

		--- 조기 종료를 위해
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 완료했으면 상태를 이탈한다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.current_explosion_timing) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)

	self.state_machine = battle_state_machine:new(nil)

	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	do

		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end

		self.state_machine = nil

	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil

	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
