---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier =  cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- field damage type
	self.field_damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'FieldDamageType')
	--- field atk modifier
	self.field_atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FieldModifierBase')

	--- explosion damage type
	self.explosion_damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionDamageType')
	--- explosion atk modifier
	self.explosion_atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionModifierBase')

	-- 판정 크기 패러미터
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	local size = vector(width, 5, length)
	-- 판정 텀
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')
	-- 판정 딜레이
	self.damage_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageDelay')
	-- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, damage_term, false)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)
	-- 폭발 판덩 정보
	collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size)
	--- 폭발 판정 계산기
	self.explosion_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	-- 가상 어택레인지
	self.virtual_range = virtual_range_util.create_rect(vector_util.get_xz(size))
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	self.sync_index = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	-- 위치 계산
	local target_pos = self.action:get_field_position(self.sync_index)

	-- 장판 설치 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'start', target_pos)
	-- 장판 위치에 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'start')
	-- 장판 이펙트 출력
	self.field_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'field', target_pos)

	--- 설치 시점 피해 추가
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.explosion_calculator, target_pos)
	-- 판정 처리
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		self:apply_damage(fo)
	end

	-- 가상 어택레인지 위치 갱신
	virtual_range_util.setup_by_position(self.virtual_range, target_pos)
	-- 가상 어택레인지 시작 배포
	virtual_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.virtual_range)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 장판 이펙트 해제
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.field_fx)
	self.field_fx = nil
	-- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	-- 가상 어택레인지 종료 배포
	virtual_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.virtual_range)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	-- damage_delay동안 장판 가동 X
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.damage_delay) then
		-- 위치 계산
		local target_pos = self.action:get_field_position(self.sync_index)
		-- 판정 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
		-- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	-- 장판 가동 중 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_field_damage(fo)
		end
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(fo)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_strong
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function field_state_class:apply_field_damage(fo)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.field_damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.field_atk_modifier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function field_state_class:act_expire()
	--- 이펙트 위치
	local target_pos = area_collision_util.get_position(self.calculator)
	-- 만료 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'end', target_pos)
end

function field_state_class:act_explosion()
	--- 폭발 위치
	local target_pos = area_collision_util.get_position(self.calculator)
	-- 폭발 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', target_pos)
end

function field_state_class:execute_explosion()
	--- 폭발 위치
	local target_pos = area_collision_util.get_position(self.calculator)
	--- 피해 부유
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.explosion_calculator, target_pos)
	-- 판정 처리
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		self:apply_explosion_damage(fo)
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_explosion_damage(fo)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.explosion_damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_atk_modifier

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_strong
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- post state
	self.post_state = post_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = battle_state_machine:new(nil)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.prepare_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.post_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- field state 모음
	self.field_states = {}
	--- field machine 모음
	self.field_machines = {}
	--- 장판 위치 모음
	self.field_positions = {}

	--- 동기화 처리를 위한 버프 id들
	self.buff_ids = {}
	--- 버프 식별용 테이블 추가
	for _, buff_name in pairs(cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(params, 'BuffNameList')) do
		--- 버프 아이디로 변환해서 들고 있기
		table.insert(self.buff_ids, buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(buff_name).Id)
	end

	--- 판정 위치 오프셋
	local field_offset_x = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Width') * 0.5
	--- 양 측 마커 명칭
	local side_marker_name_pre = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'SideMarkerPre')
	--- 순회돌며 체크
	for idx = 1, 2 do
		local field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
		local field_machine = battle_state_machine:new(nil)
		field_state.machine = field_machine

		local field_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(field:GetMarker(side_marker_name_pre .. idx).position)
		local offset = idx % 2 == 1 and vector_util.right * field_offset_x or vector_util.left * field_offset_x

		table.insert(self.field_states, field_state)
		table.insert(self.field_machines, field_machine)
		table.insert(self.field_positions, field_pos + offset)
	end

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.prepare_state, self.post_state)

		self.prepare_state = nil
		self.post_state = nil

		for _ = #self.field_machines, 1, -1 do
			local field_machine = table.remove(self.field_machines)
			local field_state = table.remove(self.field_states)

			field_machine:change(nil)

			battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(field_state)
		end
	end
	--endregion

	--region 기타 패러미터 해제
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.field_positions)
		self.field_positions = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, _ = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then return false end

	local index = self:get_valid_index(target)
	--- 적절한 index가 없다면 시전 실패
	if not index then return false end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- 싱크 심볼 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, index)
	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

function local_class:get_valid_index(target)
	local pos_of_target = character_util.get_position(target)
	local index = nil
	local shortest_sqr_dist = math.maxinteger

	for idx = 1, #self.field_machines do repeat
		-- 이미 설치된 장판이면 생략
		if not self.field_machines[idx]:is_nil_state() then break end
		-- index 별 위치를 가져와, 거리 비교
		local sqr_dist = vector_util.sqr_distance(pos_of_target, self:get_field_position(idx))
		-- 더 짧은 대상이 발견되면 index 갱신
		if shortest_sqr_dist > sqr_dist then
			index = idx
			shortest_sqr_dist = sqr_dist
		end

	until true end

	return index
end

function local_class:get_field_position(index)
	return self.field_positions[index]
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end
	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.post_state:sync(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.post_state)

	local index = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)
	-- 장판 설치
	self.field_states[index]:sync(info)
	self.field_machines[index]:change(self.field_states[index])
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	if self.field_machines then
		for idx = 1, #self.field_machines do self.field_machines[idx]:change(nil) end
	end
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machines then
		for idx = 1, #self.field_machines do self.field_machines[idx]:update(dt) end
	end
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
	--- 버프 부여 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_buff_add_event_func = function(e) self:on_buff_add_event(e) end
	-- 버프 부여 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.buff_add, self.on_buff_add_event_func)
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
	-- 버프 부여 이벤트 구독 취소
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.buff_add, self.on_buff_add_event_func)
	--- 버프 부여 이벤트 처리 함수 해제
	self.on_buff_add_event_func = nil
end

function local_class:on_buff_add_event(e)
	-- 이미 해제된 뒤라면 별도 처리할 필요가 없음
	if not self.field_machines then return end
	--- 추가된 버프
	local buff = e.Buff
	-- 버프 id 캐시
	local buff_id = buff.BuffSpec.Id
	--- 판정 처리를 위한 심볼
	local symbol = nil
	--- 순회하며 유효한지 체크
	for idx = 1, #self.buff_ids do
		if self.buff_ids[idx] == buff_id then
			symbol = idx
			break
		end
	end
	-- 이 액션에서 식별할 버프가 아니라면 패스한다.
	if not symbol then return end
	--- 버프를 보낸 객체 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, buff.Sender) then return end
	--- 버프를 받은 객체 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, buff.Target) then return end

	--- 장판을 순회하며 처리가 필요한지 체크
	for idx = 1, #self.field_machines do repeat
		if self.field_machines[idx]:is_nil_state() then break end

		-- 만료 심볼이면 장판 해제함
		if symbol == buff_symbol.expire then
			self.field_states[idx]:act_expire()
			self.field_states[idx]:execute_explosion()
			self.field_machines[idx]:change(nil)
		-- 폭발일 경우 연출 진행 (PRO)
		elseif symbol == buff_symbol.explosion then
			self.field_states[idx]:act_explosion()
			self.field_states[idx]:execute_explosion()
		end
	until true end
end

--endregion

return { create = function(c, level, params, cs_action) return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action) end }

--- 보스 배틀액션
--- 월드 22 보스 (volcano_mana) 범위 쓸기 액션
local local_class = newclass('BossVolcanoManaSweepBattleAction')

--region prepare state

local prepare_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신

	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 액션 길이
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 트래킹 시간
	tracking_duration = nil,
	--- 어택레인지
	battle_range = nil,
	--- 판정 절반 거리
	half_length = nil,
	--- 판정 절반 폭
	half_width = nil,
	--- 판정 기준점
	pivot = nil,
	--- z 제한치
	z_limit = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
prepare_state_class.mt = { __index = prepare_state_class }

--- create action state
function prepare_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = battle_state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function prepare_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 트래킹 시간
	self.tracking_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TrackingDuration')

	--- 폭
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 최대 크기
	local max_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxLength')
	--- 어택레인지
	self.battle_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(max_length, width), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)

	--- 판정 절반 거리
	self.half_length = max_length * 0.5
	--- 판정 절반 폭
	local half_width = width * 0.5
	--- 중앙 마커 명칭
	local center_marker_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'CenterMarker')
	--- 기준점
	self.pivot = battle_util.get_ground_pos(field:GetMarker(center_marker_name).position)
	-- 위 아래 마커
	local back_marker_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'BackMarker')
	local front_marker_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'FrontMarker')
	--- z 제한치
	self.z_limit = {
		field:GetMarker(back_marker_name).position.z - half_width,
		field:GetMarker(front_marker_name).position.z + half_width
	}
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function prepare_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function prepare_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	-- 애니 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	-- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 목표하는 위치
	self.target_pos = self:calculate_target_pos(self.target)
	-- 캐스팅
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)
	-- 어택레인지 위치 변경
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.battle_range, self.target_pos, self.dir_vector)
	-- 어택레인지 시작
	battle_range_util.show(self.battle_range, self.prepare_duration)
	-- 어택레인지 이벤트 배포
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.battle_range)
end

function prepare_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	-- 애니 회수
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	-- 캐스팅 종료
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
	-- 어택레인지 종료
	battle_range_util.hide(self.battle_range)
	-- 어택레인지 종료 이벤트 배포
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.battle_range)
end

function prepare_state_class:dispose()
	battle_range_util.destroy(self.battle_range)
end

function prepare_state_class:calculate_target_pos(target)
	local z_pos = character_util.get_position(target).z
	z_pos = math.min(z_pos, self.z_limit[1])
	z_pos = math.max(z_pos, self.z_limit[2])

	local target_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(self.pivot, z_pos)
	return target_pos - self.dir_vector * self.half_length
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	-- 트래킹 중의 처리
	if old_time_passed < self.tracking_duration then
		--- 목표하는 위치
		self.target_pos = self:calculate_target_pos(self.target)
		-- 어택레인지 위치 변경
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.battle_range, self.target_pos, self.dir_vector)
		-- 어택레인지 이벤트 배포
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.battle_range)
	end

	-- 준비 완료하면 싱크로 다음 스탭을 넘긴다.
	if time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
		--- 싱크에 필요한 정보들
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		-- 위치 동기화
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos)
		-- 방향 동기화
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		-- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

--endregion

function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier =  cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	--- knock back multiplier
	self.knock_back_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockBackMultiplier')

	--- 폭
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 시작 크기
	self.base_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseLength')
	--- 최대 크기
	self.max_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxLength')
	--- 최대 크기 절반
	self.half_length = self.max_length * 0.5
	--- 증가할 크기
	self.expand_length = self.max_length - self.base_length
	--- 높이
	self.height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 딜레이 시간
	self.hit_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDelay')
	--- 확장 시간
	self.expand_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpandDuration')
	--- 축소 타이밍
	self.reduce_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ReduceTiming')
	--- 축소 시간
	self.reduce_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ReduceDuration')
	--- 판정 지속 시간
	local attack_time = self.reduce_timing + self.reduce_duration
	--- post를 제회한 지속 시간
	local attack_duration = self.hit_delay + attack_time
	--- 이후 대기 시간
	local post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')
	--- 총 지속 시간
	self.end_of_state = attack_duration + post_duration
	--- 인터벌 시간
	local interval_duration = cs_util.get_nullable_float_from_dictionary(param, 'IntervalDuration')
	-- 인터벌 시간 있으면 부여
	if interval_duration then self.sync_timing = attack_duration + interval_duration end

	--- 판정 간격
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')
	--- max_hit
	local max_hit = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')

	--- 판정 크기
	local size = vector(self.max_length, self.height, self.width)
	--- 판정 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, attack_time, damage_term, true)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, true, 0, max_hit)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 설치 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(prev_state)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 연출 키
	local action_key = self.dir_vector.x > 0 and 'action' or 'action_rev'
	-- 애니 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, action_key)
	-- 효과음
	battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, action_key)
end

function action_state_class:exit(next_state)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	-- 애니 회수
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 판정 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_delay) then
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		-- 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self.dir_vector.x > 0 and 'sweep' or 'sweep_rev', self.target_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 싱크가 필요한지
	--- 인터벌 시간이 있으면 싱크를 한번 더 한다.
	local sync_required = self.sync_timing and self.dir_vector.x > 0

	--- 판정 동작 중 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 딜레이를 제외한 현재 프레임의 time_passed
		local attack_time_passed = time_passed - self.hit_delay

		--- 진행도 계산
		local expand_time_passed = math.min(attack_time_passed, self.expand_duration)
		local expand_progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutQuad(expand_time_passed, 0, 1, self.expand_duration)
		local reduce_progress = math.min(math.max((attack_time_passed - self.reduce_timing), 0) / self.reduce_duration, 1)

		--- 거리 계산
		local expend_dist = self.base_length + self.expand_length * expand_progress
		local reduce_dist = self.max_length * reduce_progress

		--- 충돌체 계산기 갱신
		local calc_pos = self.target_pos + reduce_dist * self.dir_vector
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, calc_pos)
		self.collision_info.Size = vector(expend_dist - reduce_dist, self.height, self.width)

		--- 데미지 처리
		for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)) do
			--- 폭발은 서브 스케일로 적용한다.
			self:apply_damage(target)
		end

		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

			if not sync_required then
				battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'end')
			end
		end
	end

	if sync_required then
		if time_passed >= self.sync_timing then
			--- 싱크에 필요한 정보들
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			-- 위치 동기화
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos + self.dir_vector * self.max_length)
			-- 방향 동기화
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, -self.dir_vector)
			-- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end

	--- 판정 처리 완료했으면 상태를 이탈한다.
	elseif battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.end_of_state) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(fo)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = fo
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	damage_info.knock_back_dir = self.dir_vector
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_multiplier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = battle_state_machine:new(nil)
	-- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.prepare_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.prepare_state, self.action_state)

		self.prepare_state = nil
		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, _ = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then return false end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, vector_util.right)
	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end
	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--endregion

return { create = function(c, level, params, cs_action) return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action) end }

local local_class = newclass('BossWolfBigBombSingleRaidBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.shoot_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootDuration", 1)

	self.shot_repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ShotRepeatCount", 3)
	self.main_shot_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MainShotCount", 4)
	self.main_shot_random_range = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MainShotRandomRange", 4)
	self.throw_bomb_interval = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ThrowBombInterval", 2)
	self.shot_offset_y = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotOffsetY", 2.1)
	self.initial_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialDelay", 0.133)
	self.shot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotInterval", 1)
	self.sub_shot_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "SubShotCount", 4)
	self.sub_shot_spread_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SubShotSpreadDistance", 2)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeMagnitude", 0.2)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeDuration", 0.3)

	--장판 정보
	self.aoe_spec = CS.Oak.AreaOfEffectManager.AoeSpecParams()
	self.aoe_spec.shape = CS.AttackRangeShape.Circle
	self.aoe_spec.radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldRadius", 1.5)
	self.aoe_spec.duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDuration", 3)
	self.aoe_spec.damageTerm = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDamageTerm", 0.45)
	self.aoe_spec.modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDamageModifier", 1.2)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3,
		interval = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	--- 프로젝타일 슈터
	self.cs_shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	self.proj_speed = battle_util.get_number(self.proj_spec[1].Speed)

	self.attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.shot_repeat_count * self.main_shot_count do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
				self.aoe_spec.radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, ar)
	end

	self.target = nil
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.shoot then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_shot_count = self.current_shot_count + 1
		self:shoot_proj()

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("interval")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:shoot_proj()
	local center_pos = self.target.Position
	local shot_area_angle = 360 / self.main_shot_count
	for i = 1, self.main_shot_count do
		local random_angle = unity_class.random.Range(0, shot_area_angle)
		local angle = shot_area_angle * i - shot_area_angle + random_angle
		local shoot_range = (self.main_shot_random_range - 1) / 4 * i
		--local shoot_range = unity_class.random.Range(0.3, self.main_shot_random_range / 2)
		local target_pos = center_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0)
				* (unity_class.vector3.right * shoot_range)
		local index = ((self.current_shot_count - 1) * self.main_shot_count) + i
		self.shoot_helper[1]:ShootTargetPosition(target_pos, self.shot_offset_y * unity_class.vector3.up,
				index, nil, false)

		local dist = (vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos) - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position)).magnitude
		local duration = dist / self.proj_speed
		local ar = self.attack_range_list[index]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, target_pos)
		battle_range_util.show(ar, duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_interval then
			if self.current_shot_count < self.shot_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	local owner = self.character

	if label <= self.shot_repeat_count * self.main_shot_count then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[label]))
		self.attack_range_list[label]:Hide()

		self.shoot_helper[1]:OnHit(hit_info)

		local hit_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.position, battle_util.get_height(hit_info.position))
		local offset = hit_pos - self.character.Bounds.center

		for i = 1, self.sub_shot_count do
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 360 * (i - 1) / self.sub_shot_count, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward
			local target_pos = hit_pos + self.sub_shot_spread_distance * dir
			self.shoot_helper[2]:ShootTargetPosition(target_pos, offset, 99, nil, false)
		end

		--장판 생성
		stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, hit_pos,
				self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("aoe"), self.aoe_spec)
	else
		self.shoot_helper[2]:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil

	self.cs_shooter = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.proj_spec = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

		return
	end

	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.punch1 then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.punch1_calc)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.punch2 then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.punch2_calc)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jingak then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.jingak_calc)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.kick then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.kick_calc)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.punch1 then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('punch1')
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack_1')
		self.next_act_state = self.state.punch2
		self.tracking_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.tracking_dir)
		local dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
		if dir == direction_util.left then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('punch_left', self.character.Position, self.tracking_dir, self.character.transform)
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('punch_right', self.character.Position, self.tracking_dir, self.character.transform)
		end
		area_collision_util.start(self.punch1_calc)

	elseif next_state == self.state.punch2 then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('punch2')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack_1')
		self.next_act_state = self.state.jingak
		self.tracking_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.tracking_dir)
		local dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
		if dir == direction_util.left then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('punch_left', self.character.Position, self.tracking_dir, self.character.transform)
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('punch_right', self.character.Position, self.tracking_dir, self.character.transform)
		end

		area_collision_util.start(self.punch2_calc)

	elseif next_state == self.state.jingak then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('jingak')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack_2')
		self.next_act_state = self.state.kick
		self.tracking_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		area_collision_util.start(self.jingak_calc)
		self.is_play_jingak_effect = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.kick then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('kick')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack_3')
		self.tracking_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.old_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.punch1)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.punch1 then
		self:update_dash(self.punch1_dash_timing, self.punch1_dash_duration, self.punch1_dash_speed)
		self:publish_damage(dt, self.punch1_calc, self.tracking_dir, self.punch1_offset, self.punch1_modifier)

		if self.time_passed >= self.punch1_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.punch2 then
		self:update_dash(self.punch2_dash_timing, self.punch2_dash_duration, self.punch2_dash_speed)
		self:publish_damage(dt, self.punch2_calc, self.tracking_dir, self.punch1_offset, self.punch1_modifier)
		if self.time_passed >= self.punch2_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jingak then
		self:update_dash(self.jingak_dash_timing, self.jingak_dash_duration, self.jingak_dash_speed)
		self:publish_damage(dt, self.jingak_calc, self.tracking_dir, self.jingak_offset, self.jingak_modifier)


		if self.is_play_jingak_effect == false and self.time_passed >= self.jingak_effect_timing then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('stomp', self.character.Position + self.tracking_dir * self.jingak_offset)
			self.is_play_jingak_effect = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.jingak_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.kick then
		self:update_dash(self.kick_dash_timing, self.kick_dash_duration, self.kick_dash_speed)
		self:publish_damage(dt, self.kick_calc, self.tracking_dir, self.kick_offset, self.kick_modifier)

		if self.time_passed >= self.kick_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.next_act_state)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_dash(dash_timing, dash_duration, dash_speed)
	if self.old_time_passed < dash_timing then
		self.dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(self.dir_vector.magnitude) then
			self.dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
		end
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(self.old_time_passed, self.time_passed, dash_timing) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
				self.cs_battle_action,
				self.target,
				self.dir_vector,
				0,
				dash_duration,
				dash_speed,
				dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
				nil,
				false,
				0
		)
	end
end

function local_class:publish_damage(dt, calc, dir, offset, modifier)
	calc.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position + dir * offset)
	calc.Direction = dir

	local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = modifier
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end
	fx:Dispose()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.spin)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.spin then
		self:update_tracking(dt)
		self:update_projectile(dt)
		self:publish_damage_charge(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.spin_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:update_projectile(dt)
		self:update_charge(dt)
		self:publish_damage_charge(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.action_count >= self.charge_amount then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self:update_tracking(dt)
		self:update_projectile(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end

function local_class:update_tracking(dt)
	self.tracking_dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.tracking_dir)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.tracking_ar, self.character.Position, self.tracking_dir)
end

function local_class:update_projectile(dt)
	if self.shoot_elapsed_time >= self.shoot_interval then
		local angle_interval = 360 / self.shoot_spread_amount
		for i = self.shoot_spread_amount, 1, -1 do
			local add_angle = angle_interval * (i - 1) + self.shoot_count * self.shoot_rotate_angle
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(add_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * vector_util.left
			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.character.Bounds.center, dir)
		end

		self.shoot_elapsed_time = self.shoot_elapsed_time - self.shoot_interval
		self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
	end

	self.shoot_elapsed_time = self.shoot_elapsed_time + dt
end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.tracking_dir
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt
	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.tracking_dir), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

function local_class:publish_damage_charge(dt)
	self.charge_calc.Position = self.character.Position

	local objects = self.charge_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.charge_damage_modifier

		local dir = vector_util.normalized(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo))
		if vector_util.is_almost_zero(dir) then
			dir = vector_util.back
		end
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) or hit_info.target == nil then

	end

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then

	end

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', hit_info.position)
	return true
end

	if fx == nil then

	end
	fx:Dispose()
end

	end

local local_class = newclass('BossWrestlerSomersaultKickBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		warning = 3,
		action = 4,
		interval = 5,
		post = 6
	}

	-- preapre
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.5)
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TrackingDuration', 1.0)
	self.tracking_pos = nil

	-- warning 어택레인지 보여주기 위한 스테이트라고 보면 됨
	self.warning_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WarningDuration', 0.5)
	local w = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackRangeWidth', 1.5)
	local l = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackRangeLength', 15.0)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1.0)
	self.action_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ActionAmount', 2)
	self.shoot_amounts = CS.Utils.GetIntListFromDictionary(params, 'ShootAmounts')
	self.shoot_angles = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(params, 'ShootAngles')
	self.shoot_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShootOffset', 0.5)
	self.shoot_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShootDelay', 0.5)
	self.shoot_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShootTerm', 0.3)

	self.sub_shoot_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'SubShootAmount', 3)
	self.sub_shoot_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SubShootAngle', 30.0)

	self.jump_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'JumpHeight', 15.0)
	self.jump_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'JumpDuration', 0.2)

	-- interval
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IntervalDuration', 1.0)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	-- proj main
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec('boss_wrestler_somersault_kick_main_proj')
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional, ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	-- proj sub
	spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec('boss_wrestler_somersault_kick_sub_proj')
	self.sub_shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional, ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	-- etc
	self.attack_range_list = {}
	self.main_dir_list = {}

	local bn = 0
	for _, v in pairs(self.shoot_amounts) do
		bn = math.max(bn, v)
	end

	for _ = bn, 1, -1 do
		local ar = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(l, w), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, ar)
	end

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.action_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.warning then
		for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('prepare', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('ready')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.warning then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('warning')

		local shoot_amount = self.shoot_amounts[self.action_count]
		if shoot_amount == 1 then
			local ar = self.attack_range_list[1]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(ar, self.character.Position, self.tracking_dir)
			battle_range_util.show(ar, self.warning_duration)
			return
		end

		self.main_dir_list = {}

		local angle = self.shoot_angles[self.action_count]
		local o_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-angle / 2, unity_class.vector3.up) * self.tracking_dir
		local interval = angle / (shoot_amount - 1)

		for i = shoot_amount, 1, -1 do
			local ar = self.attack_range_list[i]
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(interval * (i - 1), unity_class.vector3.up) * o_dir
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(ar, self.character.Position, dir)
			battle_range_util.show(ar, self.warning_duration)
			table.insert(self.main_dir_list, dir)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('action')
		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
		self.is_shoot = false

		local d = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.character.Direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('kick', self.character.Position, d, self.character.transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('fire')
		character_util.jump(self.character, self.jump_height, self.jump_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.old_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:update_tracking(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.warning)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.warning then
		if self.time_passed >= self.warning_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:update_main_shoot(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.action_count >= self.action_amount then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking(dt)
	if self.time_passed > self.tracking_duration then
		return
	end

	self.tracking_dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.tracking_dir)
end

function local_class:update_main_shoot(dt)
	if self.is_shoot or self.time_passed < self.shoot_delay then
		return
	end

	if #self.main_dir_list <= 0 then
		return
	end

	for i = #self.main_dir_list, 1, -1 do
		local dir = table.remove(self.main_dir_list, 1)
		local label = 10 + i
		local pos = self.character.Bounds.center + dir * self.shoot_offset
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(pos, dir, label)
	end

	self.is_shoot = true
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)

	if is_unity_null(hit_info.target) then
		return false;
	end

	-- main
	if label > 0 then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
			self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			return false

		elseif (hit_info.target.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			if self.sub_shoot_amount == 1 then
				self.sub_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(hit_info.position, -move_info.direction, 0, 0, nil, false)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('reflect')
			elseif self.sub_shoot_amount >= 2 then
				local o_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-self.sub_shoot_angle / 2, unity_class.vector3.up) * -move_info.direction
				local interval = self.sub_shoot_angle / (self.sub_shoot_amount - 1)
				for i = self.sub_shoot_amount, 1, -1 do
					local dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(interval * (i - 1), unity_class.vector3.up) * o_dir
					self.sub_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(hit_info.position, dir, 0, 0, nil, false)
				end
			end

		end
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', hit_info.position)
		return true
	end

	-- sub
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
		self.sub_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', hit_info.position)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end
	fx:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose_sfx(sfx)
	if sfx == nil then
		return
	end
	sfx:Stop()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.fall_count = 0

end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	local is_hide_ui = false

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.appear then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stand then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.BattleCamSize, self.zoom_out_duration, false)
		stage_camera:Move(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position, self.zoom_out_duration, user_party_leader)

		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_fade)
		self.fx_fade = nil


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.leap then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.chase then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_range_util.hide(self.impact_ar)
		battle_range_util.hide(self.weak_impact_ar)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_trail)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.w_impact then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.impact then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.spine_controller:Hide(true)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ready then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.spine_controller:Hide(false)
		battle_range_util.hide(self.ready_ar)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.action_calc)
		self:mod_timescale(false)
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_action)

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then

		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	end

	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.character.Direction == direction_util.up then

		end

		self.spine_controller:Hide(false)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')

		self.character.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.character.OverrideDamageBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
