		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('s_jump')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('jump', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.jump_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.jump_end_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.up * self.leap_height

	elseif next_state == self.state.appear then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('fall')
		self.character.Direction = direction_util.down
		self.appear_start_pos = self.jump_marker.position + vector_util.up * self.leap_height
		self.appear_end_pos = self.jump_marker.position
		self.is_play_appear_land_anim = false
		self.fx_spotlight = nil

		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.zoom_in_camera_size, self.zoom_in_duration)
		stage_camera:Move(self.jump_marker.position, self.zoom_in_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.stand then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('stand')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('victory', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir((self.target.Position - self.character.Position))
		self.fx_fade = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('fade', self.zone_bound.center)

	elseif next_state == self.state.leap then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('jump')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp_jump', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.leap_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.leap_end_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.up * self.leap_height

	elseif next_state == self.state.chase then
		self.chase_pos = self.target.Position
		self.select_impact_ar = self.impact_count + 1 >= self.total_impact_amount and self.impact_ar or self.weak_impact_ar
		battle_range_util.show(self.select_impact_ar, self.chase_duration)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.select_impact_ar, self.chase_pos)

	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('fall')
		self.character.Direction = direction_util.down
		self.fall_count = self.fall_count + 1
		self.fall_start_pos = self.chase_pos + vector_util.up * self.leap_height
		self.fall_end_pos = self.chase_pos
		self.character.Position = self.fall_start_pos

		if self.fall_count >= self.total_impact_amount then
			self.current_fall_duration = self.fall_duration
			self.fx_trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('stomp_trail', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero, self.character.transform)
		else
			self.current_fall_duration = self.weak_fall_duration
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.w_impact then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('land')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.impact_count = self.impact_count + 1
		self:publish_damage_impact(self.weak_impact_radius, self.weak_impact_modifier)
		stage_camera:Shake(self.weak_shake_magnitude, self.weak_shake_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.impact then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('land')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.impact_count = self.impact_count + 1
		self.exit_dir = self.character.Position.x < self.zone_bound.center.x and vector_util.left or vector_util.right

		self:publish_damage_impact(self.impact_radius, self.impact_modifier)
		stage_camera:Shake(self.shake_magnitude, self.shake_duration)

		for _, fo in pairs(user_party) do
			local summoned_list = summonable_util.get_summmoned(fo)
			for _, summoned in ipairs(summoned_list) do
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, summoned) then
					self:publish_ailment(summoned)
				end
			end

			self:publish_ailment(fo)
		end
		self:generate_wall()

	elseif next_state == self.state.exit then
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.exit_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('ready')
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('s_jump')
		self.exit_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.exit_end_pos = self.exit_dir == vector_util.left
			and vector(self.zone_bound.min.x - self.exit_offset, self.character.Position.y, self.character.Position.z)
			or vector(self.zone_bound.max.x + self.exit_offset, self.character.Position.y, self.character.Position.z)
		self.ready_ar_x = self.exit_dir == vector_util.left and self.zone_bound.min.x or self.zone_bound.max.x

		local magn = (self.exit_start_pos - self.exit_end_pos).magnitude
		local dur = magn / self.exit_speed
		self.exit_duration = dur + 0.1
		character_util.jump(self.character, self.exit_jump_height, self.exit_duration)
		is_hide_ui = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.ready then
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(-self.exit_dir)
		battle_range_util.show(self.ready_ar, self.ready_duration)
		local pos = vector(self.ready_ar_x, self.exit_end_pos.y, self.target.Position.z)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.ready_ar, pos, -self.exit_dir)
		is_hide_ui = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('spiral_kick')
		area_collision_util.start(self.action_calc)
		self.action_end_pos = self.exit_dir == vector_util.left
			and vector(self.zone_bound.max.x, self.action_start_pos.y, self.action_start_pos.z)
			or vector(self.zone_bound.min.x, self.action_start_pos.y, self.action_start_pos.z)

		local magn = (self.action_start_pos - self.action_end_pos).magnitude
		self.action_duration = magn / self.action_speed
		self.fx_action = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', self.character.Position, -self.exit_dir)
		self.fx_contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('contrail', self.character.Position)
		self:mod_timescale(true)

		-- action 충돌 검사에서 land start, end 포지션을 건드릴 수 있어서 여기서 set
		self.land_start_pos = self.action_end_pos
		self.land_end_pos = self.exit_dir == vector_util.left
			and vector(self.zone_bound.max.x - self.land_distance, self.land_start_pos.y, self.land_start_pos.z)
			or vector(self.zone_bound.min.x + self.land_distance, self.land_start_pos.y, self.land_start_pos.z)

		self.is_hit = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.land then
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.exit_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('s_jump')
		local magn = (self.land_start_pos - self.land_end_pos).magnitude
		local dur = magn / self.exit_speed
		self.land_duration = dur + 0.1
		character_util.jump(self.character, self.land_jump_height, dur)
		self:remove_wall()

	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('groggy')
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion('groggy')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('groggy')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('rock_break')
		self.character.OverrideDamageBehaviour = nil
		self:remove_wall()

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('land')
		self.character.OverrideDamageBehaviour = nil

		if self.current_state ~= self.state.groggy then
			self.character.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		end

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character.OverrideDamageBehaviour = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if self.current_is_hide_ui ~= is_hide_ui then

		if is_hide_ui then
			stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(self.character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		else
			local ui_dic = stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(self.character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			local stat_ui = ui_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats]
			stat_ui:Show()
		end

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
	self.current_is_hide_ui = is_hide_ui
	end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self:update_move(dt, self.prepare_duration, self.jump_start_pos, self.jump_end_pos)
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.appear)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.appear then
		self:update_move(dt, self.appear_duration, self.appear_start_pos, self.appear_end_pos)

		if self.time_passed >= self.spotlight_timing and self.fx_spotlight == nil then
			self.fx_spotlight = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('spotlight', self.jump_marker.position)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.appear_duration and not self.is_play_appear_land_animthen then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('land')
			self.is_play_appear_land_anim = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.appear_duration + self.land_anim_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stand)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stand then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stand_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.leap)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.leap then
		self:update_move(dt, self.leap_duration, self.leap_start_pos, self.leap_end_pos)
		if self.time_passed >= self.leap_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.chase)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.chase then
		self:update_chase(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.chase_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self:update_move(dt, self.current_fall_duration, self.fall_start_pos, self.fall_end_pos)
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_fall_duration then
			if self.impact_count + 1 >= self.total_impact_amount then
				self:change_state(self.state.impact)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.w_impact)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.w_impact then
		if self.time_passed >= self.weak_impact_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.leap)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.impact then
		if self.time_passed >= self.impact_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.exit)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self:update_move(dt, self.exit_duration, self.exit_start_pos, self.exit_end_pos)
		if self.time_passed >= self.exit_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.ready)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ready then
		self:update_ready_ar(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.ready_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:update_move(dt, self.action_duration, self.action_start_pos, self.action_end_pos)
		CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_action, self.character.Position, -self.exit_dir)
		CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_contrail, self.character.Position, -self.exit_dir)
		if self:publish_damage_action(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.land)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.land then
		self:update_move(dt, self.land_duration, self.land_start_pos, self.land_end_pos)
		if self.time_passed >= self.land_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move(dt, duration, start_pos, end_pos)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
	local pos = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
	self.character.Position = pos
end

function local_class:update_chase(dt)
	if self.time_passed >= self.chase_time then
		return
	end

	local diff_v = self.target.Position - self.chase_pos
	local move = math.min(self.chase_speed * dt, diff_v.magnitude)
	self.chase_pos = self.chase_pos + move * diff_v.normalized
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.select_impact_ar, self.chase_pos)
end

function local_class:update_ready_ar(dt)
	self.action_start_pos = vector(self.exit_end_pos.x, self.exit_end_pos.y, self.target.Position.z)
	local ar_pos = vector(self.ready_ar_x, self.action_start_pos.y, self.action_start_pos.z)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.ready_ar, ar_pos, -self.exit_dir)
end

function local_class:publish_damage_impact(radius, mod)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.chase_pos, radius)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = mod
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()

	if self.impact_count >= self.total_impact_amount then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('stomp', self.character.Position)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('stomp_weak', self.character.Position)
	end
end

function local_class:publish_ailment(fo)
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = fo
	local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
	ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial
	ailment_info.AilmentGauge = 10000
	damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(ailment_info, 1)
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

-- 벽에 충돌시 result = true
function local_class:publish_damage_action(dt)
	self.action_calc.Position = self.character.Position

	-- 좋은 방법은 아니지만 벽 충돌 검사를 먼저 선행해야 되니 for 두번 돌리자
	local result = false
	local objects = self.action_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.action_damage_modifier
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			self:publish_ailment(fo)

			if self.is_hit == false then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('hit', self.character.Position, -self.exit_dir)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('spiral_hit')
				self.is_hit = true
			end
			--self:dispose_fx(self.fx_contrail)
		end
	end

	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		-- 기믹 벽에 충돌
		if fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and string.find(fo.Name, 'wrestler_spiral_wall_') then
			self.land_start_pos = self.character.Position
			self.land_end_pos = self.exit_dir == vector_util.left
					and vector(self.land_start_pos.x - self.land_distance, self.land_start_pos.y, self.land_start_pos.z)
					or vector(self.land_start_pos.x + self.land_distance, self.land_start_pos.y, self.land_start_pos.z)

			if self.is_hit == false then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('hit_weak', self.character.Position, -self.exit_dir)
				stage_camera:Shake(self.shake_magnitude, self.shake_duration)
				self.is_hit = true
			end
			result = true
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	return result
end

function local_class:generate_wall()
	local dir = (self.character.Position - self.zone_bound.center).x >= 0 and direction_util.left or direction_util.right
	local list = dir == direction_util.right and self.right_pos_list or self.left_pos_list
	self.select_pos_list = dir == direction_util.right and self.right_pos_list or self.left_pos_list
	self.rand_pos_list = self:get_random_list(list, #list - self.wall_remove_amount)
	self.fx_wall_str = dir == direction_util.right and 'wall_r' or 'wall_l'
	for _, pos in pairs(self.rand_pos_list) do
		self:pop_vfo(pos, self.fx_wall_str)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_wall()

	if self.fx_wall_str ~= nil then
		self.fx_wall_str = self.fx_wall_str .. '_end'
	end

	self:clear_active_vfos()
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('rock_break')
end

function local_class:get_random_list(source, m)
	local n = #source
	if m > n then
		error("m cannot be greater than the number of elements in the source table")
	end

	local indices = {}
	for i = 1, n do
		indices[i] = i
	end

	-- Shuffle the indices table using Fisher-Yates algorithm
	for i = n, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(1, i)
		indices[i], indices[j] = indices[j], indices[i]
	end

	-- Create the result table using the first m shuffled indices
	local result = {}
	for i = 1, m do
		local original = source[indices[i]]
		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(self.wall_rand_min, self.wall_rand_max)
		result[i] = vector(original.x + rand_x, original.y, original.z)
	end

	return result
end

function local_class:create_vfo()
	local vfo = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	vfo.Name = 'wrestler_spiral_wall_' .. tostring(#self.idle_vfo_list + #self.active_vfo_list + 1)
	vfo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 10, 1))
	vfo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	vfo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
	vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	return vfo
end

function local_class:mod_timescale(toggle)
	if toggle then
		self.character.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		return
	end

	self.character.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:pop_vfo(pos, fx_str)
	local vfo
	if #self.idle_vfo_list > 0 then
		vfo = table.remove(self.idle_vfo_list, 1)
	else
		vfo = self:create_vfo()
	end

	if vfo == nil then
		return
	end

	vfo.Position = pos
	vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(fx_str, pos)
	table.insert(self.active_vfo_list, { vfo = vfo, fx = fx })
end

function local_class:push_vfo(data)
	if self.fx_wall_str then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.fx_wall_str, data.vfo.Position)
	end

	data.vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self:dispose_fx(data.fx)
	table.insert(self.idle_vfo_list, data.vfo)
end

function local_class:clear_active_vfos()
	for i = #self.active_vfo_list, 1, -1 do
		local data = table.remove(self.active_vfo_list, i)
		self:push_vfo(data)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end
	fx:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose_sfx(sfx)
	if sfx == nil then
		return
	end
	sfx:Stop()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.spine_controller:Hide(false)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self:dispose_fx(self.fx_fade)
	self.fx_fade = nil

	self:dispose_fx(self.fx_trail)
	self.fx_fade = nil

	self:dispose_fx(self.fx_action)
	self.fx_fade = nil

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.action_calc)
	self:mod_timescale(false)

	self:remove_wall()
	if self.zone_bound ~= nil then
		self.character.Position = self.zone_bound.center
	end

	battle_range_util.hide(self.ready_ar)
	battle_range_util.hide(self.impact_ar)
	battle_range_util.hide(self.weak_impact_ar)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	self.zone_bound = zone

	if is_unity_null(self.ready_ar) then
		self.ready_ar = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(zone.size.x, 1), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossYakshaBasicAttackBattleAction')

local sword_wave = {
	state = {
		disabled = 0,
		shoot = 1,
	},
	time_passed = 0,

function sword_wave:update_frame(dt)

			self:change_state(self.state.disabled)
		else
			self.calculator.Position = self.calculator.Position + self.target_dir * self.sword_wave_speed * dt

			for i = 0, objects.Count - 1 do

				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.modifier
				damage_info.direction = self.target_dir

			self.fx = nil
		end

	self.current_state = next_state

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

			self:change_state(self.state.attack)
		else
			self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		if self.time_passed > self.attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.fx_delay and self.time_passed - dt < self.fx_delay then
			local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_key, self.character.Bounds.center)
			local setter = fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.EffectDirectionSetter))
			setter:SetActiveByDirection(self.character.Direction)

		end

		end
	end

	for i = #self.wave_table, 1, -1 do

end

	--return bool
end

	self.params_dict = nil

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

return {

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
			self.cast_effect:Dispose()
			self.cast_effect = nil
		end

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.character_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)

		end

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.is_target_seach = true

		self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)

		self.synced = false

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.charge_start_pos = self.character.Position

		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position)
		local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(self.target_dir.z, -self.target_dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
		local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
		effect.transform.localRotation = rotation


		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action1", nil)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action2", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

					self.charge_speed * dt * self.target_dir)

			local ifos = sorted_list.Values
			for i = 0, ifos.Count - 1 do
				local ifo = ifos[i]

				if ifo.Name ~= nil and string.find(ifo.Name,'saya_stone_') then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
						'hit_saya_stone', ifo.Name }))
				end

				if (ifo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and
						not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(ifo.CrashBehaviour) then
					movement = dists[i].distance
					crashed_wall = true

					-- 화면 흔들기
					stage_camera:Shake(0.4, 0.3)

					-- 벽꿍 이팩트
					local wall_pos = self.character.Position + self.target_dir * movement
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wall_impact", wall_pos)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wall_charge", nil)
					break
				end
			end
			sorted_list:Dispose()

			if (self.character.Position - self.charge_start_pos).magnitude >= self.charge_length then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:sync_target_dir()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 5)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.target_dir)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:update_sync_dir(dt)
	local diff = math.abs((self.synced_target_dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.1 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - self.synced_target_dir).normalized * dt * self.synced_dir_move_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	else
		self.target_dir = self.synced_target_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:set_character_diration()
	--케스팅시간동안 캐릭터 방향 수정
	local new_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
	if self.character_direction ~= new_direction then
		self.character_direction = new_direction
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
	end

	local diff = math.abs((dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.05 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - dir).normalized * dt * self.tracking_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:charge_update(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.target_dir
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir), true,
			CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.SlipAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if fo.Name ~= nil and string.find(fo.Name,'saya_stone_') then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
				'hit_saya_stone', fo.Name }))
		end

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
			local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
			local xz_move_direction = self.target_dir:GetXz().normalized
			local knock_direction
			if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.target_dir
			else
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.target_dir
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_slash_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--호스트의 마지막 TargetDir에 맞춰서 싱크
	if idx == 5 and self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		self.synced_target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--현재 로컬의 target_dir이 sync로 날라온 dir과 다르다면 자연스럽게 이동시켜준다.
		if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
			self.synced_dir_move_speed = 15
		end
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))

	end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()

	self:cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)

end

local local_class = newclass('BossYakshaFireBounceBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	self.level = level

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.shot_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'shotRadius', 1.75)

	self.target_search_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetSearchDuration", 2)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {

function local_class:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare and self.time_passed < self.target_search_duration then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.Target) then
			self.target = e.Target
			self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
			if self.show_target_arrow then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_attack_calc()
	if #self.attack_calculator_info_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.attack_calculator_info_list)
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:return_attack_calc(info)
	info.info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.shot_radius / 2, 2, self.shot_radius / 2)
	info.calc:End()
	table.insert(self.attack_calculator_info_list, info)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false
	self.target = target
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_target_seach = false
	self.current_bounce_count = 1

	if self.fire_road_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.fire_road_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				v.is_active = false
				self:return_attack_calc(v.calc)
			end
		end
		self.fire_road_info_list = nil
	end
	self.fire_road_info_list = {}

	if self.fire_road_effect_info == nil then
		self.fire_road_effect_info = {}
	end

	--강공 발동 여부
	if CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
		if random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance then
			self.is_critical_attack = true
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 9)--강공 여부
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
		end
	end

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and self.target or nil)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.character_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.is_target_seach = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.synced = false

		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.character.Position, self.target_dir, 1)
		self.proj = self.shoot_helper:GetProjectile(1)
		self.proj_dir = self.proj.moveInfo.direction

		self:init_fire_road(self.character.Position, self.target_dir)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:init_fire_road(start_pos, dir)
	local ca = self:get_attack_calc()
	if ca ~= nil then
		ca.info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.shot_radius / 2, 2, self.shot_radius / 2)

		ca.calc.Direction = dir

			rotation = rotation,
			pos = start_pos,
			time_passed = 1.5
		})

			start_pos = start_pos,
			current_pos = start_pos,
			is_active = true, --전체 불길이 끝나야 종료

			calc = ca,
			current_size = unity_class.vector3(self.shot_radius / 2, 2, self.shot_radius / 2),

			time_passed = 0,
			dest_pos = nil,
			magnitude = 0,

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.fire_road_info_list ~= nil and #self.fire_road_info_list > 0 then
		self:update_fire_road(dt)
		self:update_proj(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then

			self:change_state(self.state.post)

		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:update_proj(dt)

					self.fire_road_info_list[self.current_bounce_count].is_plus_fire = false
					self.fire_road_info_list[self.current_bounce_count].dest_pos = self.proj.moveInfo.position

					self.current_bounce_count = self.current_bounce_count + 1

						local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
						local road_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("fire_road", self.proj.moveInfo.position)
						road_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation
						info.effect_count = info.effect_count + 1
						table.insert(self.fire_road_effect_info, {
							effect = road_effect,
							rotation = rotation,
							pos = self.proj.moveInfo.position,
							time_passed = 1.5
						})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_fire_road(dt)
	--a. calculator size가 시작지점에서 진행 방향으로 proj_speed만큼 증가
	--b. 시작 후 fire_road_duration이 지나면 시작지점이 진행 방향으로 proj_speed만큼 이동 & 이동한 거리만큼 calc size 감소
	--c. 방향이 바뀌었다면 a는 정지 후 다음 방향이 있다면 새로운 calc를 정지 지점에서 시작해서 새로운 dir로 a, b 반복
	for i = #self.fire_road_info_list, 1, -1 do
		local info = self.fire_road_info_list[i]
		if info.is_active then
			info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt

			if info.is_plus_fire then
				--벽에 충돌해서 방향이 바뀌면 is_active == false 되기전까지 계속 증가시킨다.
				info.current_size.x = info.current_size.x + dt * self.proj_speed
				info.calc.info.Size = info.current_size
			end

			if info.time_passed >= self.fire_damage_duration then
				--벽에 충돌유무와 상관없이 self.fire_damage_duration이 경과했다면 dt * self.proj_speed만큼 길이를 줄이고
				--start_pos를 dt * self.proj_speed * dir 만큼 전진시켜 준다.
				info.current_size.x = info.current_size.x - dt * self.proj_speed
				info.calc.info.Size = info.current_size
				info.current_pos = info.current_pos + (info.dir * dt * self.proj_speed)
				info.calc.calc.Position = info.current_pos

				if info.dest_pos ~= nil then
					if (info.dest_pos - info.current_pos).magnitude <= 0.1 then
						info.is_active = false
						self:return_attack_calc(info.calc)
					end
				end
			end

			self:update_ground_hit(info.calc.calc, dt)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_fire_road_effect(dt)
	if self.fire_road_effect_info == nil then return end
	for i = #self.fire_road_effect_info, 1, -1 do
		local info = self.fire_road_effect_info[i]
		if info.time_passed > 0 then
			info.time_passed = info.time_passed - dt
		else
			if info.effect ~= nil then
				info.effect:Dispose()
				info.effect = nil
			end

			table.remove(self.fire_road_effect_info, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_ground_hit(calc, dt)
	if not calc.IsStarted then
		calc:Start()
	end
	local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.fire_damage_modifire
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_fire_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:sync_target_dir()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 5)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.target_dir)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--호스트의 마지막 TargetDir에 맞춰서 싱크
	if idx == 5 and self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		self.synced_target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--현재 로컬의 target_dir이 sync로 날라온 dir과 다르다면 자연스럽게 이동시켜준다.
		if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
			self.synced_dir_move_speed = 15
		end
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_sync_dir(dt)
	local diff = math.abs((self.synced_target_dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.1 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - self.synced_target_dir).normalized * dt * self.synced_dir_move_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	else
		self.target_dir = self.synced_target_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:set_character_diration()
	--케스팅시간동안 캐릭터 방향 수정
	local new_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
	if self.character_direction ~= new_direction then
		self.character_direction = new_direction
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
	end

	local diff = math.abs((dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.05 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - dir).normalized * dt * self.tracking_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	--프로젝타일이 종료위치에 도달하면 ForceEliminate 타입으로 on_hit 호출되므로 해당 위치에 종료 이펙트 출력함.
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		if self.fire_road_info_list ~= nil and self.fire_road_info_list[#self.fire_road_info_list] ~= nil then
			self.fire_road_info_list[#self.fire_road_info_list].is_plus_fire = false
			self.fire_road_info_list[#self.fire_road_info_list].dest_pos = hit_info.position
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('proj_end', move_info.position)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	if self.fire_road_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.fire_road_info_list) do
			v.is_active = false
			self:return_attack_calc(v.calc)
		end
		self.fire_road_info_list = nil
	end

	if self.fire_road_effect_info ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.fire_road_effect_info) do
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end
		end
		self.fire_road_effect_info = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.critical_rate_list = nil

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.fire_start_size = nil
	self.attack_info = nil
	self.attack_calculator_info_list = nil
	self.character_direction = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.synced_target_dir = nil
	self.current_proj_dir = nil
	self.fire_road_info_list = nil
	self.fire_road_effect_info = nil
	self.proj = nil
	self.proj_dir = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossYakshaLightningOneBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		teleport = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	--teleport
	self.teleport_key = 'teleport'
	self.teleport_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TeleportDuration', 1.0)

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.0)
	self.prepare_fx_delay = 0.1

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1.0)
	--self.damage_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageHpRatio', 0.9)
	self.fx_delay = 0.67
	self.modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackModifier', 1)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 0.0)

	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)

	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = 1
	info.Extents = vector(self.zone_bound.size.x / 2, 2, self.zone_bound.size.z / 2)
	self.attack_calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	self.fx_prepare = nil

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
end

function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	if self.current_state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.character.Position = self.zone_bound.center
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.teleport_key)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.character.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	elseif new_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', self.character.Position)

		--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('howl', self.zone_bound.center)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif new_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('howl', self.zone_bound.center)

	elseif new_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('end')

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		if self.ash ~= nil then
			self.ash:FadeOut(1)
			self.ash = nil
		end

		if self.fx_prepare ~= nil then
			self.fx_prepare:Dispose()
			self.fx_prepare = nil
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = new_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed > self.teleport_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.prepare_fx_delay and self.time_passed - dt < self.prepare_fx_delay then
			self.fx_prepare = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('prepare', self.character.Position)
			self.ash = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare_loop')

			if self.fx_prepare ~= nil then
				local spine_controller = self.character.SpineController
				local bf = self.fx_prepare:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
				if bf == nil then
					bf = self.fx_prepare.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
				end
				bf.followBoneRotation = false
				bf.SkeletonRenderer = spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
				bf:SetBone('weapon')
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.fx_delay and self.time_passed - dt < self.fx_delay then
			if self.ash ~= nil then
				self.ash:FadeOut(1)
				self.ash = nil
			end
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', self.character.Position)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action_1')
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action_2')

			self:publish_damage()
			if self.fx_prepare ~= nil then
				self.fx_prepare:Dispose()
				self.fx_prepare = nil
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'lightning_one_canceled' }))
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:publish_damage()
	self.attack_calc.Position = self.zone_bound.center
	self.attack_calc:Start()
	local objects = self.attack_calc:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.modifier
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.attack_calc:End()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound


end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:set_attack_range(self.interval_duration)

	elseif new_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_cast)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_cast)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = new_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.shoot_count >= self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:hide_ar()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:set_attack_range(duration)
	for i, v in pairs(self.ar_list) do
		local dir = self:get_dir(i)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(v, self.character.Position + dir * self.lightning_offset, dir, self.character.Position.y)
		v:Show(duration)
	end
end

function local_class:hide_ar()
	for _, v in pairs(self.ar_list) do
		v:Hide()
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_lightning()
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action', user_party.Leader)
	for i = 1, self.lightning_amount do
		local calc = self.calc_list[i]
		local dir = self:get_dir(i)

		calc.Position = self.character.Position + dir * self.lightning_offset
		calc.Direction = dir
		calc:Start()
		local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(0)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			local damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier + (self.damage_modifier * self.critical_damage_rate)
			end

			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier

			local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
			ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Down
			ailment_info.AilmentGauge = self.ailment_gauge
			damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(ailment_info, 1)
			damage_info.forceAilment = true

			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_light_02')

	end

	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
end

function local_class:get_dir(idx)
	local angle = (idx - 1) * 360 / self.lightning_amount
	local add_angle = self.shoot_count * self.additional_angle

	return unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle + add_angle, 0) * vector_util.forward
end

end

	if fx ~= nil then
		fx:Dispose()
		fx = nil
	end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if hit_info.target == nil or not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
		return true
	end

	if self.is_critical_attack then

function local_class:dispose()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

function local_class:create_ice_pillar()

	if self.vfo == nil then
		self.vfo = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		self.vfo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 2, 1))
		self.vfo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
	end
	self.vfo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local ifo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.target_ice_position, 1)

	for _,fo in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player) ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None then

			local dir = vector_util.normalized(fo.Position - self.target_ice_position)
			if vector_util.is_almost_zero(dir) then
				dir = vector_util.normalized(fo.Position - self.character.Position)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = 0
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorNormalStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	table.insert(self.update_table, {
		time_passed = 0,
		enabled = true,
		update_frame = function(this, dt)
			this.time_passed = this.time_passed + dt
			if this.time_passed > 0.2 then
				this.enabled = false
				self.vfo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
			end
		end
	})

	self.vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	self.vfo.Position = self.target_ice_position

	self.ice_pillar = {
		fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('ice', self.vfo.Position),
		vfo = self.vfo
	}

end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	for i = #self.update_table, 1, -1 do
		if not self.update_table[i].enabled then
			table.remove(self.update_table, i)
		else
			self.update_table[i]:update_frame(dt)
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed > self.teleport_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast_attack)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_attack then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.ani_time and self.time_passed - dt < self.ani_time then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.attack_key)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action_1')
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.fx_delay and self.time_passed - dt < self.fx_delay then
			self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, self.character.Position)
		end

		if self.cast_fx ~= nil then
			local spine_controller = self.character.SpineController
			local bf = self.cast_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
			if bf == nil then
				bf = self.cast_fx.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
			end
			bf.SkeletonRenderer = spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
			bf:SetBone('weapon')
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.fx_remove_delay and self.time_passed - dt < self.fx_remove_delay then
			if self.cast_fx ~= nil then
				self.cast_fx:Dispose()
				self.cast_fx = nil
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		if self.time_passed > self.attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_wave(dt)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end

end

function local_class:update_wave(dt)
	self.calculator.Position = self.calculator.Position + self.current_look_vector * self.wave_speed * dt


	local objects = self.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if not self.safe_zone_bound:Contains(fo.Position) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.wave_modifier * self.current_damage_scale
			damage_info.direction = self.current_look_vector
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.current_look_vector
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.wave_knock_back_force
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_water_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	self.teleport_target_pos = field:GetMarker(self.teleport_marker_prefix .. info:GetIntegerAt(0)).position
	self.current_look_vector = info:GetIntegerAt(0) == 1 and vector_util.right or vector_util.left
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	--return bool
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	if self.on_damage_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_func)
		self.on_damage_func = nil
	end

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.first_attack_candidates = nil
	self.first_attack_infos = nil
	self.second_attack_candidates = nil
	self.second_attack_infos = nil
	self.side_safe_attack_ranges = nil
	self.center_safe_attack_ranges = nil
	self.current_attack_ranges = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossYakshaThunderBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		prepare = 1,
		action = 2,
		post = 3
	}

	self.attack_party_pos = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'AttackPartyPos', false)
	self.use_attack_area = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'UseAttackArea', false)
	self.attack_area_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackAreaWidth', 4)
	self.attack_area_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackAreaHeight', 4)

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 2.0)
	self.target_pos_list = nil

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1.0)
	self.thunder_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ThunderRadius', 1.5)
	self.thunder_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ThunderAmount', 10)
	self.thunder_space = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ThunderSpace', 1.0)

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1.0)
	self.critical_chance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CriticalChance', 0.5)
	self.critical_damage_rate =CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CriticalDamageRate', 0.5)

	self.ailment_gauge = 100

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	self.ar_list = {}

	self.fx_cast = nil

	for _ = 0, self.thunder_amount do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.thunder_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		table.insert(self.ar_list, ar)
	end

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end

	if self.bound == nil then
		if self.use_attack_area then
			self.bound = unity_class.bounds(vector_util.zero, unity_class.vector3(self.attack_area_width, 100, self.attack_area_height))
		else
			self.bound = unity_class.bounds(vector_util.zero, unity_class.vector3((self.zone_bound.extents.x - self.thunder_radius) * 2, 100, (self.zone_bound.extents.z - self.thunder_radius) * 2))
			self.bound.center = self.zone_bound.center
		end
	end

	if self.use_attack_area then
		self.bound.center = self:get_bound_center(self.bound)
	end

	local temp_pos
	if self.attack_party_pos then
		temp_pos = pattern_util.random_pos_non_overlap(self.bound, self.character.Position.y, math.max(0, self.thunder_amount - user_party.Count), self.thunder_space)
	else
		temp_pos = pattern_util.random_pos_non_overlap(self.bound, self.character.Position.y, self.thunder_amount, self.thunder_space)
	end

	if temp_pos == nil or #temp_pos <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	info:AppendNumber(random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance and 1 or 0)

	for _, v in pairs(temp_pos) do
		info:AppendPosition(v)
	end

	if self.attack_party_pos then
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			info:AppendPosition(user_party[i].Position)
		end
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	info:AppendTarget(target)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:get_bound_center(bound)
	return vector(
			unity_class.mathf.Clamp(self.character.Position.x, self.zone_bound.min.x + bound.extents.x, self.zone_bound.max.x - bound.extents.x),
			0,
			unity_class.mathf.Clamp(self.character.Position.z, self.zone_bound.min.z + bound.extents.z, self.zone_bound.max.z - bound.extents.z))
end

function local_class:start(info)

	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target


	self.is_critical_attack = info:GetNumberAt(0) == 1
	if self.is_critical_attack then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
	end

	self.target_pos_list = info.Positions
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	if self.current_state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self:hide_all_ar()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.fx_cast = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('prepare', self.character.Position)

		--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('howl', self.zone_bound.center)

		self:set_attack_range(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif new_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('howl', self.zone_bound.center)

		self:publish_damage()

	elseif new_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_cast)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_cast)

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = new_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:set_attack_range(duration)
	for i, v in pairs(self.target_pos_list) do
		local ar = self.ar_list[i + 1]
		if ar ~= nil then
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, v, self.character.Position.y)
			ar:Show(duration)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:publish_damage()
	if self.target_pos_list == nil then
		return
	end

	local function condition_check(fo)
		return CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup)
				and not fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead
				and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo)
	end

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action', user_party.Leader)

	for _, pos in pairs(self.target_pos_list) do
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', pos)

		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.thunder_radius)
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			if condition_check(fo) then
				local damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier
				if self.is_critical_attack then
					damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier + (self.damage_modifier * self.critical_damage_rate)
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier

				local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
				ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Down
				ailment_info.AilmentGauge = self.ailment_gauge
				damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(ailment_info, 1)
				damage_info.forceAilment = true
				damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_light_04')


				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:hide_all_ar()
	if self.ar_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for _, v in pairs(self.ar_list) do
		v:Hide()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx ~= nil then
		fx:Dispose()
		fx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self:configure_calculators()
		self.origin_table = {
			{
				x = vector(-1,0,1),
				y = vector(-1,0,-1),
				origin = self.zone_bound.center + vector_util.left * self.zone_bound.extents.x + vector_util.right * self.zone_bound.extents.z
			},
			{
				x = vector(1,0,1),
				y = vector(1,0,-1),
				origin = self.zone_bound.center + vector_util.right * self.zone_bound.extents.x + vector_util.left * self.zone_bound.extents.z
			},
			{

				y = vector(1,0,1),

			},
			{
				x = vector(-1,0,-1),
				y = vector(1,0,-1),
				origin = self.zone_bound.center + vector_util.back * self.zone_bound.extents.z + vector_util.forward * self.zone_bound.extents.x
			},
		}

		self.first_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateHollowRectangle(

				vector(self.zone_bound.extents.x * 2 - self.first_wave_width * 2, self.zone_bound.extents.z * 2 - self.first_wave_width * 2),
				vector(0,0),
				CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

		self.second_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateHollowRectangle(
				vector_util.zero,
				vector(self.zone_bound.extents.x * 2 - self.first_wave_width * 2, self.zone_bound.extents.z * 2 - self.first_wave_width * 2),
				vector(self.zone_bound.extents.x * 2 - self.first_wave_width * 2 - self.second_wave_width * 2, self.zone_bound.extents.z * 2 - self.first_wave_width * 2 - self.second_wave_width * 2),

	--second_wave
	self.second_wave_calculator_table = {}

function local_class:set_first_wave_calculator()
	for i = 1, #self.first_wave_calculator_table do
		self.first_wave_calculator_table[i]:Start()

end

function local_class:update_first_wave(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.first_wave_calculator_table do
		local objects = self.first_wave_calculator_table[i]:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do

			damage_info.modifier = self.first_wave_modifier * self.current_damage_scale
			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.first_wave_knock_back_force
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_water_01')

function local_class:update_second_wave(dt)

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
		objects:Dispose()

function local_class:get_knock_back_dir(target_pos)
	for i = 1, #self.origin_table do
		local dir = vector_util.normalized(target_pos - self.origin_table[i].origin)
		if self:is_conical_combination(self.origin_table[i].x, self.origin_table[i].y, dir)
				and vector_util.dot(target_pos - self.zone_bound.center, dir) >= 0 then
			return dir
		end
	end

	return vector_util.forward
end

function local_class:is_conical_combination(x, y, target)
	return vector_util.dot(self:cross(x, target), self:cross(target, y)) >= 0
end

function local_class:cross(x, y)
	return vector(x.y * y.z - x.z * y.y, x.z * y.x - x.x * y.z, x.x * y.y - x.y * y.x)
end

function local_class:end_wave_calculators()
	for i = 1, #self.first_wave_calculator_table do
		self.first_wave_calculator_table[i]:End()

	for i = 1, #self.second_wave_calculator_table do

function local_class:explode()

		self.default_fx:Dispose()
		self.default_fx = nil
	end

			local dir = self:get_knock_back_dir(fo.Position)

			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.explode_modifier * self.current_damage_scale
			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
