function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.pre_cast then
		self.cast_fx:Dispose()
		self.cast_fx = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.first_attack_range:Hide()


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.first_wave then
		self.second_attack_range:Hide()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.second_wave then
		self:end_wave_calculators()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end


	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.pre_cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))

		if self.character.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Right and self.character.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Left and self.character.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key)
		self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, self.character.Position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration + self.pre_cast_duration))

		if self.cast_fx ~= nil then
			local spine_controller = self.character.SpineController
			local bf = self.cast_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
			if bf == nil then
				bf = self.cast_fx.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
			end
			bf.followBoneRotation = false
			bf.SkeletonRenderer = spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
			bf:SetBone((self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left) and 'handR' or 'handL')
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.character.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Right and self.character.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Left and self.character.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		end

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.first_attack_range, self.zone_bound.center)
		self.first_attack_range:Show(self.cast_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.first_attack_range))

		self.default_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('wave_0', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('wave_0_1')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('wave_0_2')
		self.sword_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('sword', self.character.Position + self.sword_offset[self.character.Direction])

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.first_wave then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:set_first_wave_calculator()
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.second_attack_range, self.zone_bound.center)
		self.second_attack_range:Show(self.first_wave_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.second_attack_range))

		self.first_wave_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('wave_1', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('wave_1', self.zone_bound.center)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.second_wave then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:set_second_wave_calculator()

		self.second_wave_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('wave_2', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('wave_2', self.zone_bound.center)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', self.zone_bound.center)
		self:explode()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.first_attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.second_attack_range))

		if self.sword_fx ~= nil then
			self.sword_fx:Dispose()
			self.sword_fx = nil
		end

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.sword_fx ~= nil then
			self.sword_fx:Dispose()
			self.sword_fx = nil
		end

		if self.default_fx ~= nil then
			self.default_fx:Dispose()
			self.default_fx = nil
		end

		if self.first_wave_fx ~= nil then
			self.first_wave_fx:Dispose()
			self.first_wave_fx = nil
		end

		if self.second_wave_fx ~= nil then
			self.second_wave_fx:Dispose()
			self.second_wave_fx = nil
		end

		if self.first_attack_range ~= nil then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.first_attack_range))
		end

		if self.second_attack_range ~= nil then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.second_attack_range))
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self:end_wave_calculators()
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.pre_cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.pre_cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.first_wave)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.first_wave then
		if self.time_passed > self.first_wave_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.second_wave)
		else
			self:update_first_wave(dt)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.second_wave then
		if self.time_passed > self.second_wave_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explode)
		else
			self:update_first_wave(dt)
			self:update_second_wave(dt)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode then
		if self.time_passed > self.explode_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end

end

function local_class:is_pattern_hit()
	return self.is_hit
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	--return bool
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossYakshaWispBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 10)

	self.proj_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ProjCount", 3)
	self.proj_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjRadius", 1)
	self.proj_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjDamageModifier", 1.2)
	self.proj_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjDamageTerm", 1)
	self.proj_min_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjMinDistance", 3)
	self.proj_max_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjMaxDistance", 6)
	self.proj_distance_move_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjDistanceMoveSpeed", 3)
	self.proj_circle_move_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjCircleMoveSpeed", 8)
	--따로 유지시간이 없이??

	local offset = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "CastEffectOffset")
	if offset == nil then
		self.cast_offset = vector(0, 0, 4)
	else
		self.cast_offset = vector(offset[1], offset[2], offset[3])
	end

	self.critical_chance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CriticalDamageChance", 0.5)
	self.critical_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SuperDamageScale", 0.5)

	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	self.attack_calculator_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.proj_count do
		local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
		info.DamageTerm = self.proj_damage_term
		info.Duration = 9999--무제한?
		info.Radius = self.proj_radius
		info.Height = 3
		local ac = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)
		table.insert(self.attack_calculator_list, ac)
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.dist_move_duration = (self.proj_max_distance - self.proj_min_distance) / self.proj_distance_move_speed

	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.synced = nil
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.proj_info_list = nil
	self.proj_time_passed = 0
	self.proj_move_time_passed = 0
	self.is_start_move_proj = false
	self.cast_effect = nil

	self.is_move_out = true
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, nil, dir, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	--이전 도깨비불이 있는데 다시 시전됐다면 이전정보는 삭제해줘야함
	--self:dispose_proj_info()

	self.synced = false
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.proj_time_passed = 0
	self.target = target
	self.is_critical_attack = false
	self.is_start_move_proj = false
	if self.proj_info_list ~= nil then
		self:dispose_proj_info(true)
		self.proj_info_list = nil
	end
	self.proj_info_list = {}

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and self.target or nil)
	--강공 발동 여부
	if CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
		if random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance then
			self.is_critical_attack = true
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 9)--강공 여부
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:dispose_proj_info(is_restart)
	if self.proj_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.proj_info_list) do
			if v.proj_effect ~= nil then
				v.proj_effect:Dispose()
				v.proj_effect = nil
			end

			if is_restart then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("dispose", v.pos)
			end

			self.attack_calculator_list[_]:End()
		end
		self.proj_info_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
			self.cast_effect:Dispose()
			self.cast_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))

		self:ready_proj()

		self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.character.Position)

		if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
			local spine_controller = self.character.SpineController
			local bf = self.cast_effect:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
			if bf == nil then
				bf = self.cast_effect.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
			end
			bf.followBoneRotation = false
			bf.SkeletonRenderer = spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
			bf:SetBone((self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left) and 'handR' or 'handL')
		end


		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)

		self.synced = false
		self:start_proj()
		self.is_start_move_proj = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:ready_proj()
	if self.proj_info_list == nil then
		self.proj_info_list = {}
	end

	for i = 1, self.proj_count do
		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.proj_count, 0)
				* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
		local start_pos = self.character.Position + dir * self.proj_min_distance
		start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos, battle_util.get_height(start_pos))

		table.insert(self.proj_info_list, {
			dir = dir,
			pos = start_pos,
			is_active = false,
			proj_effect = nil
		})
	end
end

function local_class:start_proj()
	if self.proj_info_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_info_list) do
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj", v.pos)
		self.attack_calculator_list[_].Position = v.pos
		self.attack_calculator_list[_]:Start()
		v.proj_effect = effect
		v.is_active = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.proj_info_list ~= nil and self.is_start_move_proj then
		self:update_proj(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.prepare_duration then
		elseif not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
			self:sync_shot()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj(dt)
	if self.proj_info_list ~= nil and #self.proj_info_list <= 0 then return end

	self.proj_time_passed = self.proj_time_passed + dt
	self.proj_move_time_passed = self.proj_move_time_passed + dt
	--캐릭터 주위 회전
	--거리두 펌핑
	for _,v in pairs(self.proj_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, _ * 360 / self.proj_count -
					(self.proj_time_passed * self.proj_circle_move_speed * 10), 0)
					* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
			local dist = self.proj_min_distance
			local prog = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.proj_move_time_passed,
					0, 1, self.dist_move_duration)
			if self.is_move_out then
				dist = self.proj_min_distance + prog * (self.proj_max_distance - self.proj_min_distance)
				if dist >= self.proj_max_distance then
					self.proj_move_time_passed = 0
					self.is_move_out = false
					dist = self.proj_max_distance
				end
			else
				dist = self.proj_max_distance - prog * (self.proj_max_distance - self.proj_min_distance)
				if dist <= self.proj_min_distance then
					self.proj_move_time_passed = 0
					self.is_move_out = true
					dist = self.proj_min_distance
				end
			end

			local pos = self.character.Position + dir * dist
			pos = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, battle_util.get_height(pos))
			v.proj_effect.transform.position = pos
			v.pos = pos
			self.attack_calculator_list[_].Position = pos
			self:update_proj_damage(dt, self.attack_calculator_list[_], _)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj_damage(dt, attack_Calc, proj_index)
	local objects = attack_Calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsCrashProjectileEthereal(fo.CrashBehaviour) then
			--포지션스킬 쉴드에 닿을경우 사라지도록
			self:sync_remove_proj(proj_index)
		end

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		--TODO: 쉴드를 쳤다면 해당 구슬은 폭발하고 제거?
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_modifier = self.proj_damage_modifier
			if self.is_critical_attack then
				local critical_rate = self.critical_rate
				damage_modifier = damage_modifier + damage_modifier * critical_rate
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = damage_modifier
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_fire_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:remove_proj(index)
	if self.proj_info_list ~= nil and self.proj_info_list[index] ~= nil then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.proj_info_list[index].pos)

		if self.proj_info_list[index].proj_effect ~= nil then
			self.proj_info_list[index].proj_effect:Dispose()
			self.proj_info_list[index].proj_effect = nil
		end

		self.proj_info_list[index].is_active = false
		self.attack_calculator_list[index]:End()
	end
end

function local_class:sync_shot()
	self.synced = true
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	info:AppendNumber(1)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:sync_remove_proj(proj_index)
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	info:AppendNumber(2)
	info:AppendNumber(proj_index)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	self.target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	--액션 시작
	if idx == 1 and self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	end

	if idx == 2 then
		self:remove_proj(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 1)))
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	self:dispose_proj_info(true)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.cast_offset = nil
	self.attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.synced = nil
	self.proj_info_list = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then

			self:change_state(self.state.wait_second_rush)
			return
		end

		self:update_attack(dt)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait_second_rush then
		if self.time_passed > self.attack_interval then

		end

		self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		self.target_dir = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bounds, self.character.Bounds, self.target_dir)

	}

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

		return true
	end

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	return distance < self.attack_range_radius
end

function local_class:trigger()

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

function local_class:start(info)

	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.time_limit_fx then
		self.time_limit_fx:Dispose()
		self.time_limit_fx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator:End()

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')

		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

		self.attack_range.Position = self.character.Position
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		-- 포자 fx
		self.time_limit_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('aoe', self.character.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * self.aoe_fx_height)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action')
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = (fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
					local damage_rate = self.damage_rate
					local damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHpWoMod * damage_rate)

					--- 데미지 정보 생성
					local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
					damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.damage = damage
					damage_info.direction = direction

					--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
					command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.shoot_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.character.SpineController.TimeScale = self.action_speed
		self.shoot_ready = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.action_interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z()
			if diff.x >= 0 then
				self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			else
				self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_interval then
			if self.shoot_count == self.max_shoot_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.action_interval)
			end
		elseif self.shoot_ready and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
			self:shoot()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_interval then
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot()
	self.shoot_ready = false
	local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position):GetX0z().normalized
	local offset = self.shoot_offset
	if self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		offset.x = -offset.x
	end
	local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + offset
	self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, dir, self.shoot_count)
	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
end

function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil and hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit', hit_info.position)
			self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			local damage_rate = self.damage_rate
			local damage = math.floor(hit_info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHpWoMod * damage_rate)

			--- 데미지 정보 생성
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = hit_info.target
			damage_info.damage = damage
			damage_info.direction = hit_info.direction

			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(hit_info.target.CrashBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour)) then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('bounce', hit_info.position)
			return true
		end

	elseif hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.map_hit then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('bounce', hit_info.position)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_bounce(_, hit_info, _)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('bounce', hit_info.position)
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)

	local dur = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShakeDuration")
	local dim = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShakeDiminish")

		shake_info.duration = dur

		self.shake_info = shake_info
	end

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return target ~= nil
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 연출 방향 결정 등을 위해 타겟 방향만 넣어줌.
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, target))
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.dir_to_target = info:GetDirectionAt(0)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 특정 방향 보고 쓰는 액션이라면 방향 설정.
		local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
		if self.side_only and dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_to_target)
		end

		if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(dir_to_look, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position, direction_util.to_vector3(dir_to_look), self.character.Transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare2")

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
		if self.side_only and dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_to_target)
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position, direction_util.to_vector3(dir_to_look), self.character.Transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action2")

		if self.shake_info ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.StageCamera:Shake(self.shake_info)
		end
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.lock_direction = nil
	self.side_only = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.dir_to_target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.1)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 0.1)

	self.lock_direction = CS.Utils.GetDirectionFromDictionary(params, "LockDirection")
	self.side_only = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "SideOnly")

	self.runaway_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RunAwayDistance", 4)
	self.runaway_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RunAwayAngle", 60)
	self.runaway_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RunAwayDuration", 0.5)
	self.runaway_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RunAwayHeight", 0.8)
	self.runaway_min_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RunAwayMinCount", 1)
	self.runaway_max_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RunAwayMaxCount", 3)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.current_runaway_count = 0
	self.runaway_time_passed = 0
	self.runaway_progress = 0
	self.runaway_target_angle = 0
	self.runaway_direction = nil

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	self.current_runaway_count = unity_class.random.Range(self.runaway_min_count, self.runaway_max_count)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 특정 방향 보고 쓰는 액션이라면 방향 설정.
		local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
		if self.side_only and dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target_position - self.character.Position)
		end

		if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(dir_to_look, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))
		end

		self.runaway_time_passed = 0
		self.runaway_progress = 0
		self.runaway_target_angle = unity_class.random.Range(-(self.runaway_angle / 2), self.runaway_angle / 2)
		self.runaway_direction = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) *
				vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bounds.center - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance


		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character.SpineController:Jump(self.runaway_height, self.runaway_duration)
		self.current_runaway_count = self.current_runaway_count - 1
		--연출
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("post")
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_runaway_count <= 0 then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			end
		else
			self:runaway_update(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:runaway_update(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.runaway_time_passed, 0, 1, self.runaway_duration)
	local movement = progress - self.runaway_progress
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.runaway_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.runaway_distance * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.runaway_direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.runaway_time_passed = self.runaway_time_passed + dt
	self.runaway_progress = progress
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.lock_direction = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('CommonSlashBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.667)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 2)
	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 3)
	local attack_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackAngle", 180)
	local attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0.08)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", 0.36)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0)
	local charge_dist = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDistance", 0)
	self.charge_speed = charge_dist/self.action_duration;

	self.show_attack_range = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'ShowAttackRange', true)

	-- 15 챕터 이벤트 연출시 매뉴얼 컨트롤 대응
	self.manual_usage = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'ManualUsage', false)

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.Direction = unity_class.vector3.right
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Radius = self.attack_radius
	info.Angle = attack_angle
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, attack_delay, 1)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius, attack_angle, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.attack_radius
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local trigger_direction

	if self.manual_usage == true then
		trigger_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
	else
		-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
		local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

		if is_unity_null(target) then
			return false
		end

		-- 타겟의 방향으로 커맨드 생성
		local attack_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, target)
		if vector_util.to_direction(attack_direction) == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			attack_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
		end

		trigger_direction = attack_direction
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, trigger_direction)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	-- 베기 방향은 4방향 벡터. 돌진 방향은 그냥 주어진 벡터
	self.charge_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.slash_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction))
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.sfx_holder = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
				self.sfx_holder:Stop()
				self.sfx_holder = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)

		if self.attack_range.Shape == CS.AttackRangeShape.Circle then
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.character.Position)
		else
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.slash_direction)
		end

		if self.show_attack_range then
			self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.slash_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction
				if knock_direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = self.charge_direction
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.charge_speed > 0 then
			-- 대쉬 이동 처리
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt
			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, true)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil
	self.charge_speed = nil

	self.charge_direction = nil
	self.slash_direction = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:is_loaded()

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

function local_class:trigger()

function local_class:cancel()

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then

			self.bomb_ranges[1]:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_ranges[1]))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

			if not is_unity_null(self.growl_sfx_holder) then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.shoot_done then
			self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count]:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count]))
		end

		if next_state ~= self.state.recharge and next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			if not is_unity_null(self.prepared_fx) then
				self.prepared_fx:Dispose()
				self.prepared_fx = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recharge then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count+1]:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count+1]))

			if not is_unity_null(self.prepared_fx) then
				self.prepared_fx:Dispose()
				self.prepared_fx = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		-- 특정 방향 보고 쓰는 액션이라면 방향 설정.
		local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
		if self.side_only and dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		end

		if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(dir_to_look, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		-- 준비 사운드 두개 (growl은 delay 먹여서 재생됨)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.growl_sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("growl")
		self.last_position = self.target.Position
		local ar = self.bomb_ranges[1]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, self.last_position)
		battle_range_util.show(ar, self.prepare_duration + self.bomb_fall_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

		self.prepared_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.character.Position + unity_class.vector3(0,self.bomb_height,0), unity_class.vector3.zero)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shoot_done = false
		self.current_action_count = self.current_action_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.recharge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.last_position = self.target.Position
		local ar = self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count + 1]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, self.last_position)
		battle_range_util.show(ar, self.recharge_duration + self.bomb_fall_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.bomb_contexts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.bomb_contexts, 1, -1 do
			local bomb_tp =  self.bomb_contexts[i].time_passed + dt
			self.bomb_contexts[i].time_passed = bomb_tp

			-- 완료시 삭제
			if bomb_tp >= self.bomb_fall_duration then
				local b_position = self.bomb_contexts[i].dest_pos
				-- 낙하 위치에 데미지
				local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(b_position, self.bomb_radius, 4)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects.Values[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()
				-- 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", b_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", b_position)
				-- 오브젝트 삭제
				if not is_unity_null(self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object) then
					self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object = nil

				-- 어택레인지 종료
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_contexts[i].attack_range))
				self.bomb_contexts[i].attack_range:Hide()

				-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
				table.remove(self.bomb_contexts, i)
			elseif bomb_tp >= 0 then
				local prog = bomb_tp / self.bomb_fall_duration
				local calc_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.bomb_contexts[i].start_pos, self.bomb_contexts[i].dest_pos, prog) +
						self.bomb_height * (1 - prog * prog) * unity_class.vector3.up
				local calc_scale = 0.3 + math.min(prog, 1) * 0.5

				if not is_unity_null(self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object) then
					self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(calc_scale, calc_scale, calc_scale)
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 원기옥 어택 레인지 타겟 추적
		self.last_position = self.target.Position
		local ar = self.bomb_ranges[1]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, self.last_position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

		-- 준비 시간 완료 시 다음 스테이트로 진행
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.shoot_done and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
			self.shoot_done = true

			-- 원기옥 데이터 추가
			local calc_pos = self.character.Position + unity_class.vector3(0,self.bomb_height,0)
			local orb_eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("bomb", calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			orb_eff.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)

			table.insert(self.bomb_contexts, {
				start_pos = self.character.Position,
				dest_pos = self.last_position,
				time_passed = 0,
				height = self.bomb_height,
				pooled_object = orb_eff,
				attack_range = self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count]
			})

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot", calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot")
		end

		-- 횟수 남아 있다면 recharge, 다 끝났다면 post로 이동
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.recharge)
			else
				if not is_unity_null(self.prepared_fx) then
					self.prepared_fx:Dispose()
					self.prepared_fx = nil
				end
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recharge then
		-- 레인지 업데이트
		self.last_position = self.target.Position
		local ar = self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count + 1]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, self.last_position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

		-- recharge 완료시 다시 action
		if self.time_passed >= self.recharge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	-- 바로 중지
	if self.bomb_contexts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.bomb_contexts, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object) then
				self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object = nil
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_contexts[i].attack_range))
			self.bomb_contexts[i].attack_range:Hide()
			table.remove(self.bomb_contexts, i)
		end
	end

	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.edge_positions = nil

	if self.bomb_ranges ~= nil then
		for _, range in ipairs(self.bomb_ranges) do
			if not is_unity_null(range) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(range)
			end
		end
		self.bomb_ranges = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('CommonTeleportCenterBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.lock_direction = CS.Utils.GetDirectionFromDictionary(params, "LockDirection")
	self.side_only = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "SideOnly")

	local attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 1)
	local attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", self.action_duration)

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Radius = attack_radius
	info.Height = 2
	info.IsCenterToBottom = true
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, attack_delay, 1)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, attack_radius)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	-- 스스로 위치를 변경하는 것이므로 자유롭게 사용
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	if self.center_pos == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.center_pos))
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 특정 방향 보고 쓰는 액션이라면 방향 설정.
		local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
		if self.side_only and dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target_position - self.character.Position)
		end

		if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(dir_to_look, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))
		end

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
		self.attack_range:Show(0)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 이펙트 생성 및 순간이동 처리
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.character.Position = self.target_position
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("dest", self.target_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink")

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil

	self.lock_direction = nil
	self.side_only = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.center_pos = nil
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.center_pos = bound.center
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 점령전 빨간 모자 엘비라 로봇 (conquest_redhood_robot) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ConquestManualRedhoodRobotBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,

local local_class = newclass('ConquestManualReservoirBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)

	return obj
end

	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)


	--- 무기에서 오프셋 정보를 가져옴
	local weapon = character_util.get_weapon(self.owner)

	if weapon and weapon.WeaponSpec then
		--- 무기 오프셋
		self.shoot_offset = battle_util.get_number(weapon.WeaponSpec.ShootOffset)
	else
		--- fallback
		self.shoot_offset = 0.5
	end

function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

	return true

	return true

function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- remove recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	--- remove upper animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.owner)

	if battle ~= nil then
		local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.owner)

		if targets ~= nil then
			for _, target in pairs(targets) do
				if target.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass == CS.Oak.CoopClass.Tanker then
					battle:AddAggro(self.owner, target, character_util.get_dps(self.owner) * 0.3, false)
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			targets:Dispose()
		end
	end

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- update target direction
	if self.target then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- get center
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- ik update
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

	--- loop shoot timing
	for index = 1, #self.shoot_timing do
		--- shoot timing
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[index] - 0.05) then
			--- set shoot animation
			battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

			--- 캐릭터 반동
			character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.3, 0.1, 0.15)
		end

		--- shoot timing
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[index]) then
			--- shoot pos
			local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

			--- instantiate shoot fx and play shoot sfx
			projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
				self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
			)

			local random_angle = (random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5) * 10
			local bounce_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle, 0) * self.dir_vector

			--- 탄피 생성
			CS.Oak.ActionEffectHelper.RequestCartridgeBounce(center, bounce_dir)

			--- shoot projectile
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	local t = hit_info.target

	if t and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local m = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, #self.shoot_timing)

		--- apply damage
		self:apply_damage(t, m)
	else
		return true
	end

	return false

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_battle_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_battle_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_battle_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_battle_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_battle_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_battle_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
